web.label: Ngày 1. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Canopy Unit 1–3: thứ, tháng, sinh nhật, một ngày của con

en.tu: Ôn: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, week, weekend, o'clock, calendar, month, January, June, October, December, present, card, candle, yesterday, breakfast, lunch, dinner, wash, brush, tooth/teeth
en.cum: Ôn: on Monday / at seven o'clock / get up / wash my face / brush my teeth / have breakfast / go to school / a birthday card
en.cau: What day is it today? – It's Monday. / When is your birthday? – It's in June. / I get up at six o'clock. / I wash my face and brush my teeth. / Yesterday was Sunday.
en.truyen: Bông's Week — On Monday, Bông gets up at six o'clock. She washes her face, brushes her teeth and has breakfast. Then she goes to school. On Saturday, it is her birthday. Her friends give her a card and a present.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "days of the week song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 星期 xīngqī, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 星期日 xīngqīrì, 日历 rìlì, 年 nián, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 时间 shíjiān, 昨天 zuótiān, 时候 shíhou, 起床 qǐchuáng, 早上 zǎoshang, 中午 zhōngwǔ, 晚上 wǎnshang, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 早饭 zǎofàn, 洗脸 xǐliǎn, 上学 shàngxué
zh.cum: Ôn: 星期一 xīngqīyī / 七点 qī diǎn / 吃早饭 chī zǎofàn / 去上学 qù shàngxué / 生日卡片 shēngrì kǎpiàn
zh.cau: 今天星期几？（Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ?）– 今天星期一。（Jīntiān xīngqīyī.）/ 你的生日是几月几号？（Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?）/ 我早上六点起床。（Wǒ zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.）/ 我先洗脸，再吃早饭。（Wǒ xiān xǐliǎn, zài chī zǎofàn.）
zh.truyen: Bông的一个星期 — 星期一，Bông早上六点起床。她先洗脸，再吃早饭，然后去上学。星期六是Bông的生日。朋友们给她一张卡片。（Bông de yí ge xīngqī — Xīngqīyī, Bông zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā xiān xǐliǎn, zài chī zǎofàn, ránhòu qù shàngxué. Xīngqīliù shì Bông de shēngrì. Péngyoumen gěi tā yì zhāng kǎpiàn.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "星期歌 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 2. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Canopy Unit 4–6: sở thích, nơi chốn trong thị trấn, nghề nghiệp

en.tu: Ôn: hobby, draw, read, sing, dance, cook, listen, music, piano, comic, bike, cinema, library, hospital, shop, restaurant, zoo, doctor, nurse, driver, farmer, dentist, student, job, chef
en.cum: Ôn: play the piano / ride a bike / watch TV / listen to music / go to the library / work in a hospital
en.cau: What's your hobby? – I like reading comics. / Where do you go on Saturday? – I go to the cinema. / What's his job? – He's a doctor. / A nurse works in a hospital. / First I go to the shop, then I go to the library.
en.truyen: Saturday in Town — Leo and his dad walk in town. First they go to the library and Leo reads a comic. Then they go to a restaurant. Leo's dad is a chef there. He cooks soup for Leo. 'I love your soup, Dad!' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "jobs and occupations song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 画 huà, 听 tīng, 电视 diànshì, 音乐 yīnyuè, 看书 kàn shū, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 散步 sànbù, 上午 shàngwǔ, 下午 xiàwǔ, 医生 yīshēng, 医院 yīyuàn, 学生 xuésheng, 厨师 chúshī, 司机 sījī, 工作 gōngzuò
zh.cum: Ôn: 看电视 kàn diànshì / 听音乐 tīng yīnyuè / 去动物园 qù dòngwùyuán / 买东西 mǎi dōngxi / 在医院工作 zài yīyuàn gōngzuò
zh.cau: 你喜欢做什么？（Nǐ xǐhuan zuò shénme?）– 我喜欢唱歌和跳舞。（Wǒ xǐhuan chànggē hé tiàowǔ.）/ 下午我们去动物园。（Xiàwǔ wǒmen qù dòngwùyuán.）/ 医生在医院工作。（Yīshēng zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.）/ 我爸爸是司机。（Wǒ bàba shì sījī.）
zh.truyen: Leo的星期六 — 星期六上午，Leo和爸爸去饭店。Leo的爸爸是厨师，他在饭店工作。下午，他们去动物园散步。晚上，Leo看书，听音乐。（Leo de xīngqīliù — Xīngqīliù shàngwǔ, Leo hé bàba qù fàndiàn. Leo de bàba shì chúshī, tā zài fàndiàn gōngzuò. Xiàwǔ, tāmen qù dòngwùyuán sànbù. Wǎnshang, Leo kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "职业 儿歌 中文"

en.flash: Monday, Friday, Saturday, weekend, o'clock, calendar, month, June, present, card, candle, breakfast, wash, brush, tooth/teeth, hobby, comic, piano, cinema, library, hospital, restaurant, doctor, nurse, chef, farmer
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe chọn tranh (5 câu, kiểu Movers Listening Part 1): Bông gets up at six o'clock. / Leo is in the library. / Anna's mum is a nurse. / The party is on Saturday. / Nhan likes reading comics. 2) Nối giờ với đồng hồ (4 câu): seven o'clock / nine o'clock / twelve o'clock / three o'clock. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp, cô ghi điểm nói đầu vào: What's your hobby? / What's your mum's job? / When is your birthday?
en.truyen: Bông's Busy Week — On Monday, Bông goes to school at seven o'clock. On Wednesday, she goes to the library and reads a comic. On Friday, she plays the piano. On Saturday, it is her birthday. Her mum is a nurse and her dad is a chef. Dad cooks a big birthday cake with eight candles. Bông's friends give her cards and presents. 'This is my best week!' says Bông.
en.baihat: Days and Jobs (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Monday, Tuesday, / Monday, Tuesday, / Go to school, / Go to school. / Doctors in the hospital, / Chefs in the restaurant, / Every day, / Every day.

zh.flash: 星期 xīngqī, 星期天 xīngqītiān, 日历 rìlì, 年 nián, 时间 shíjiān, 昨天 zuótiān, 起床 qǐchuáng, 早饭 zǎofàn, 洗脸 xǐliǎn, 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 电视 diànshì, 音乐 yīnyuè, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 饭店 fàndiàn, 医生 yīshēng, 医院 yīyuàn, 厨师 chúshī, 司机 sījī
zh.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe chọn tranh (5 câu, kiểu YCT): 今天星期三。/ 我七点起床。/ 他是医生。/ 她喜欢唱歌。/ 我们去动物园。 2) Nhìn tranh chọn từ đúng (4 câu): 早饭 / 洗脸 / 看电视 / 听音乐. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp, cô ghi điểm nói đầu vào: 今天星期几？/ 你几点起床？/ 你爸爸是做什么的？
zh.truyen: Bông的生日 — 星期六是Bông的生日。早上，Bông七点起床，先洗脸，再吃早饭。Bông的妈妈是医生，她在医院工作。爸爸是厨师，他做了一个大蛋糕。下午，朋友们来Bông的家，大家一起唱歌、跳舞。Bông说：“我真快乐！”（Bông de shēngrì — Xīngqīliù shì Bông de shēngrì. Zǎoshang, Bông qī diǎn qǐchuáng, xiān xǐliǎn, zài chī zǎofàn. Bông de māma shì yīshēng, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Bàba shì chúshī, tā zuò le yí ge dà dàngāo. Xiàwǔ, péngyoumen lái Bông de jiā, dàjiā yìqǐ chànggē, tiàowǔ. Bông shuō: “Wǒ zhēn kuàilè!”）
zh.baihat: 星期歌 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 星期一，星期二，去上学，去上学。医生在医院，厨师在饭店，真快乐，真快乐！（Xīngqīyī, xīngqī'èr, qù shàngxué, qù shàngxué. Yīshēng zài yīyuàn, chúshī zài fàndiàn, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè!）

web.label: Ngày 3. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Canopy Unit 7–9: phương tiện, sở thú, nông trại

en.tu: Ôn: bus, car, train, plane, ship, helicopter, motorbike, bicycle, taxi, drive, trip, easy, elephant, giraffe, tiger, lion, zebra, bear, snake, neck, tall, short, cow, goat, horse, chicken, pig, farm, fat, thin, pretty, ugly, cute
en.cum: Ôn: go by bus / ride a bicycle / drive a car / a long neck / a fat pig / on the farm
en.cau: How do you go to school? – I go to school by bus. / My dad drives a taxi. / The giraffe has a very long neck. / The lion is big and the snake is long. / There are cows and goats on the farm. / The pig is fat and the horse is thin.
en.truyen: A Trip to the Farm — On Sunday, Nhan and his grandpa go on a trip. They go by train. At the zoo, they see a tall giraffe and a big lion. Then they go to a farm. There are cows, goats, chickens and a fat pig. 'The pig is so cute!' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "transport vehicles song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 汽车 qìchē, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 摩托车 mótuōchē, 坐 zuò, 开 kāi, 骑 qí, 走路 zǒulù, 大象 dàxiàng, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 脖子 bózi, 尾巴 wěiba, 农场 nóngchǎng, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 猪 zhū, 马 mǎ, 鸡 jī, 胖 pàng, 瘦 shòu, 可爱 kě'ài
zh.cum: Ôn: 坐飞机 zuò fēijī / 坐火车 zuò huǒchē / 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē / 开汽车 kāi qìchē / 长长的脖子 chángcháng de bózi / 在农场 zài nóngchǎng
zh.cau: 你怎么去学校？（Nǐ zěnme qù xuéxiào?）– 我坐公共汽车去学校。（Wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù xuéxiào.）/ 长颈鹿的脖子很长。（Chángjǐnglù de bózi hěn cháng.）/ 农场里有牛、羊和猪。（Nóngchǎng li yǒu niú, yáng hé zhū.）/ 这只猪很胖。（Zhè zhī zhū hěn pàng.）/ 小熊猫真可爱！（Xiǎo xióngmāo zhēn kě'ài!）
zh.truyen: 去农场 — 星期天，Nhan和爷爷坐火车去农场。农场里有牛、羊、马和鸡。一只猪很胖，一只羊很瘦。Nhan说：“爷爷，这只小猪真可爱！”（Qù nóngchǎng — Xīngqītiān, Nhan hé yéye zuò huǒchē qù nóngchǎng. Nóngchǎng li yǒu niú, yáng, mǎ hé jī. Yì zhī zhū hěn pàng, yì zhī yáng hěn shòu. Nhan shuō: “Yéye, zhè zhī xiǎo zhū zhēn kě'ài!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "交通工具 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 4. Mở khóa · Ôn quét Canopy Unit 10–12: thiên nhiên, vị trí, nhà hàng + bài đầu vào trên web

en.tu: Ôn: sun, moon, star, sky, cloud, tree, flower, grass, river, mountain, sea, beach, stone, box, house, floor, near, far, next to, in front of, top, bowl, soup, meat, vegetable, chopsticks, waiter, menu, dumpling, please, would
en.cum: Ôn: next to the tree / in front of the house / on top of the box / a bowl of soup / would like / please give me
en.cau: Where is the cat? – It's next to the box. / The moon and the stars are in the sky at night. / There is a river near the mountain. / Would you like some soup? – Yes, please. / Can I have the menu, please? / The waiter gives me a bowl of dumplings.
en.truyen: Lunch at the Restaurant — Xiaomei and Anna go to a restaurant near the river. The waiter gives them the menu. 'Would you like some dumplings?' he asks. 'Yes, please!' says Xiaomei. Anna would like soup with vegetables. They eat with chopsticks. 'Thank you!' they say.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "prepositions song next to in front of for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 太阳 tàiyáng, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 天空 tiānkōng, 山 shān, 河 hé, 树 shù, 花 huā, 草 cǎo, 石头 shítou, 盒子 hézi, 里面 lǐmiàn, 上边 shàngbian, 前面 qiánmiàn, 后面 hòumiàn, 放 fàng, 站 zhàn, 饺子 jiǎozi, 包子 bāozi, 汤 tāng, 茶 chá, 果汁 guǒzhī, 筷子 kuàizi, 服务员 fúwùyuán, 菜单 càidān, 蔬菜 shūcài, 请 qǐng
zh.cum: Ôn: 在盒子里面 zài hézi lǐmiàn / 在树后面 zài shù hòumiàn / 用筷子 yòng kuàizi / 一碗汤 yì wǎn tāng / 请问 qǐngwèn
zh.cau: 小猫在哪儿？（Xiǎo māo zài nǎr?）– 小猫在盒子里面。（Xiǎo māo zài hézi lǐmiàn.）/ 晚上，天空有月亮和星星。（Wǎnshang, tiānkōng yǒu yuèliang hé xīngxing.）/ 服务员，请给我菜单。（Fúwùyuán, qǐng gěi wǒ càidān.）/ 你想吃饺子还是包子？（Nǐ xiǎng chī jiǎozi háishi bāozi?）/ 我用筷子吃饭。（Wǒ yòng kuàizi chīfàn.）
zh.truyen: 在饭店 — 中午，Xiaomei和Anna去河旁边的饭店。服务员给她们菜单。Xiaomei说：“请给我饺子和果汁。”Anna说：“我想喝汤，吃蔬菜。”她们用筷子吃饭。（Zài fàndiàn — Zhōngwǔ, Xiaomei hé Anna qù hé pángbiān de fàndiàn. Fúwùyuán gěi tāmen càidān. Xiaomei shuō: “Qǐng gěi wǒ jiǎozi hé guǒzhī.” Anna shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng hē tāng, chī shūcài.” Tāmen yòng kuàizi chīfàn.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "在哪里 方位 儿歌"

en.flash: bus, train, plane, bicycle, taxi, trip, giraffe, lion, snake, neck, farm, cow, goat, pig, fat, thin, moon, star, river, mountain, next to, in front of, box, bowl, soup, chopsticks, waiter, menu
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Đọc và chọn Yes/No (5 câu, kiểu Movers Reading Part 2): The giraffe has a long neck. (Yes) / Pigs can fly. (No) / We eat soup with chopsticks. (No) / The moon is in the sky at night. (Yes) / A waiter works in a restaurant. (Yes). 2) Nhìn tranh, nói vị trí (4 câu): The cat is next to the box. / The ball is in front of the house. / The bird is on top of the tree. / The dog is near the river. 3) Phỏng vấn ngắn (cô ghi điểm nói đầu vào): How do you go to school? / What's your favourite animal? / What would you like for lunch?
en.truyen: Nhan's Big Trip — Nhan and Grandpa go on a trip by train. At the zoo, they see a giraffe with a long neck and a lion next to a big stone. Then they go to a farm near the mountain. There are cows, goats and a fat pig. In the evening, they go to a restaurant near the river. The waiter gives them the menu. Nhan would like dumplings and Grandpa would like soup. They look at the moon and the stars. 'What a great trip!' says Nhan.
en.baihat: The Trip Song (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The train to the farm goes choo, choo, choo, / Choo, choo, choo, / Choo, choo, choo. / The train to the farm goes choo, choo, choo, / We can see the cows!

zh.flash: 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 大象 dàxiàng, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 长颈鹿 chángjǐnglù, 农场 nóngchǎng, 牛 niú, 羊 yáng, 猪 zhū, 胖 pàng, 瘦 shòu, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 山 shān, 河 hé, 盒子 hézi, 后面 hòumiàn, 饺子 jiǎozi, 汤 tāng, 筷子 kuàizi, 服务员 fúwùyuán, 菜单 càidān
zh.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe chọn đúng/sai (5 câu, kiểu YCT): 我坐飞机去北京。/ 长颈鹿的脖子很短。/ 这只猪很胖。/ 小猫在盒子里面。/ 我用筷子吃饺子。 2) Nối câu hỏi với câu trả lời (4 câu): 你怎么去学校？– 坐公共汽车。/ 农场里有什么？– 有牛和羊。/ 你想吃什么？– 我想吃包子。/ 小狗在哪儿？– 在树后面。 3) Nói theo tranh (cô ghi điểm nói đầu vào): 这是什么动物？它在哪儿？
zh.truyen: Nhan的旅行 — 星期天，Nhan和爷爷坐火车去动物园。他们看见了大象和长颈鹿。然后他们去农场，农场里有牛、羊和一只很胖的猪。晚上，他们在河旁边的饭店吃饭。服务员给他们菜单。Nhan吃饺子，爷爷喝汤。天空有月亮和星星。（Nhan de lǚxíng — Xīngqītiān, Nhan hé yéye zuò huǒchē qù dòngwùyuán. Tāmen kànjiàn le dàxiàng hé chángjǐnglù. Ránhòu tāmen qù nóngchǎng, nóngchǎng li yǒu niú, yáng hé yì zhī hěn pàng de zhū. Wǎnshang, tāmen zài hé pángbiān de fàndiàn chīfàn. Fúwùyuán gěi tāmen càidān. Nhan chī jiǎozi, yéye hē tāng. Tiānkōng yǒu yuèliang hé xīngxing.）
zh.baihat: 坐火车 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 坐火车，坐火车，去农场，去农场。看见牛和羊，看见胖小猪，真可爱，真可爱！（Zuò huǒchē, zuò huǒchē, qù nóngchǎng, qù nóngchǎng. Kànjiàn niú hé yáng, kànjiàn pàng xiǎo zhū, zhēn kě'ài, zhēn kě'ài!）

blocks.title: Unit 1 · Hello, It's Me · 你好，我的新朋友！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 3. Unit 1 · Hello, It's Me – 你好，我的新朋友！ · Tên, tuổi, quốc tịch

web.label: Ngày 5. Unit 1 · Chào bạn mới: quốc gia và lá cờ (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: country, flag, Vietnam, England, America, Japan | Ôn: hello, teacher, friend, school, see you
en.cum: Mới: my country / the flag of Vietnam / from England | Ôn: see you tomorrow / well done
en.cau: Hello! What's your name? – My name is Anna. / Where are you from? – I'm from England. / Vietnam is my country. / This is the flag of Japan. / See you tomorrow, teacher!
en.truyen: A New Friend — Anna is a new student at Bông's school. 'Hello! My name is Anna. I'm from England,' she says. 'Hello, Anna! I'm Bông. I'm from Vietnam,' says Bông. Bông shows Anna a picture of her country's flag. 'It's red and yellow!' says Anna. 'See you tomorrow, Bông!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Where are you from song for kids countries"

zh.tu: Mới: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó | Ôn: 你好 nǐ hǎo, 朋友 péngyou, 再见 zàijiàn, 新 xīn, 一起 yìqǐ
zh.cum: Mới: 越南人 Yuènán rén / 英国人 Yīngguó rén / 美国人 Měiguó rén / 我的国家 wǒ de guójiā | Ôn: 新朋友 xīn péngyou
zh.cau: 你好！你叫什么名字？（Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?）– 我叫Anna。（Wǒ jiào Anna.）/ [Ngữ pháp: hỏi quốc tịch 你是哪国人？– 我是 + tên nước + 人] 你是哪国人？（Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?）– 我是英国人。（Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.）/ 我是越南人。（Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.）/ 越南是我的国家。（Yuènán shì wǒ de guójiā.）
zh.truyen: 新朋友 — Anna是Bông的新朋友。Anna说：“你好！我叫Anna，我是英国人。”Bông说：“你好，Anna！我叫Bông，我是越南人。”Leo说：“我是美国人。”大家一起说：“再见！”（Xīn péngyou — Anna shì Bông de xīn péngyou. Anna shuō: “Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Anna, wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.” Bông shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, Anna! Wǒ jiào Bông, wǒ shì Yuènán rén.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ shì Měiguó rén.” Dàjiā yìqǐ shuō: “Zàijiàn!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你是哪国人 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 6. Unit 1 · Ngôn ngữ, tuổi và các nước trên thế giới (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: language, age, France, Germany, Korea, Russia | Ôn: country, flag, word, which, well done
en.cum: Mới: name and age / a new language / from Korea / the flag of France | Ôn: which country
en.cau: How old are you? – I'm eight years old. / Write your name and age. / Which country is Leo from? – He's from America. / English is Anna's language. / Can you say this word in a new language?
en.truyen: The Flag Game — The teacher has a lot of flags. 'Which country is this?' she asks. 'It's France!' says Leo. 'And this one?' 'It's Korea!' says Bông. Anna finds the flag of Germany and the flag of Russia. 'Well done, everyone!' says the teacher.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "flags of the world song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 法国 Fǎguó, 德国 Déguó | Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 几岁 jǐ suì, 名字 míngzi, 中国 Zhōngguó
zh.cum: Mới: 日本人 Rìběn rén / 韩国人 Hánguó rén / 法国人 Fǎguó rén / 德国人 Déguó rén | Ôn: 哪国人 nǎ guó rén
zh.cau: 你几岁？（Nǐ jǐ suì?）– 我八岁。（Wǒ bā suì.）/ 他是哪国人？（Tā shì nǎ guó rén?）– 他是法国人。（Tā shì Fǎguó rén.）/ 她是日本人吗？（Tā shì Rìběn rén ma?）– 不是，她是韩国人。（Bú shì, tā shì Hánguó rén.）/ 中国是一个很大的国家。（Zhōngguó shì yí ge hěn dà de guójiā.）
zh.truyen: 几岁？哪国人？ — 老师问：“你们几岁？”Bông说：“我八岁。”Xiaomei说：“我七岁。”老师说：“我们有两个新同学，一个是日本人，一个是韩国人。”Leo说：“我爷爷是法国人，我奶奶是德国人。”Xiaomei说：“我的好朋友是俄国人。”（Jǐ suì? Nǎ guó rén? — Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐmen jǐ suì?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ bā suì.” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ qī suì.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen yǒu liǎng ge xīn tóngxué, yí ge shì Rìběn rén, yí ge shì Hánguó rén.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ yéye shì Fǎguó rén, wǒ nǎinai shì Déguó rén.” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ de hǎo péngyou shì Éguó rén.”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "国家 国旗 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Mới: country, flag, language, age, Vietnam, England, America, Japan, France, Germany, Korea, Russia | Ôn: hello, teacher, friend, school, word
en.slide: 1) Nhìn lá cờ chọn tên nước (6 câu): Vietnam / England / America / Japan / France / Korea. 2) Nghe và nối người với nước (kiểu Movers Listening Part 2, 4 câu): Anna – England / Leo – America / Bông – Vietnam / Xiaomei – China. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp rồi điền phiếu Name / Age / Country: What's your name? / How old are you? / Where are you from?
en.truyen: The New Student — On Monday, there is a new student in Bông's class. 'Hello! My name is Anna. I'm eight years old. I'm from England,' she says. Bông says, 'Hello, Anna! I'm Bông. I'm from Vietnam.' Leo says, 'I'm Leo. I'm from America.' The teacher shows them a lot of flags. 'Which country is this?' 'It's Japan!' 'And this one?' 'It's Germany!' In the afternoon, Anna waves. 'See you tomorrow, my new friends!'
en.baihat: Where Are You From? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Where are you from? / Where are you from? / I'm from Vietnam, / I'm from Vietnam. / What's your name, my friend? / How old are you, my friend? / I am eight, / I am eight.

zh.flash: Mới: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 法国 Fǎguó, 德国 Déguó | Ôn: 你好 nǐ hǎo, 朋友 péngyou, 再见 zàijiàn, 名字 míngzi, 新 xīn
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn lá cờ chọn tên nước (6 câu): 越南 / 英国 / 美国 / 日本 / 法国 / 韩国. 2) Nghe chọn tranh (kiểu YCT, 4 câu): 我是越南人。/ 她是英国人。/ 他是美国人。/ 我是日本人。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你叫什么名字？– 我叫___。/ 你几岁？– 我___岁。/ 你是哪国人？– 我是___人。
zh.truyen: 新同学 — 星期一，Bông有一个新同学。她说：“你好！我叫Anna，我八岁，我是英国人。”Bông说：“你好，Anna！我是越南人。”Leo说：“我是美国人。”Xiaomei说：“我是中国人。”老师说：“我们有四个国家的朋友！”下午，Anna说：“明天见！”（Xīn tóngxué — Xīngqīyī, Bông yǒu yí ge xīn tóngxué. Tā shuō: “Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Anna, wǒ bā suì, wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.” Bông shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, Anna! Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ shì Měiguó rén.” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ shì Zhōngguó rén.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen yǒu sì ge guójiā de péngyou!” Xiàwǔ, Anna shuō: “Míngtiān jiàn!”）
zh.baihat: 你是哪国人 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 你是哪国人？你是哪国人？越南人，越南人。你叫什么名字？你几岁？你几岁？我八岁，我八岁！（Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Yuènán rén, Yuènán rén. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi? Nǐ jǐ suì? Nǐ jǐ suì? Wǒ bā suì, wǒ bā suì!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 4. Unit 1 · Hello, It's Me – 你好，我的新朋友！ · Gia đình và tả người

web.label: Ngày 7. Unit 1 · Gia đình con: ba mẹ, ông bà, con trai, con gái (nhóm 2)

en.tu: Mới: parent, grandparent, son, daughter, grandson, granddaughter, grown-up | Ôn: family, mother, father, person/people, party, pick up
en.cum: Mới: my parents / my grandparents / a grown-up / their daughter | Ôn: pick up / at four o'clock
en.cau: These are my parents. / Bông is her parents' daughter. / Nhan is his grandparents' grandson. / Ask a grown-up for help. / My grandmother picks me up from school at four o'clock.
en.truyen: Bông's Family Party — It's Saturday. There is a party at Bông's house. Bông's grandparents come. 'This is our granddaughter, Bông,' says Grandma. 'And this is our grandson, Nhan.' Bông's parents are very happy. There are a lot of people at the party!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "family members song for kids grandparents"

zh.tu: Mới: 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng | Ôn: 爸爸 bàba, 妈妈 māma, 爷爷 yéye, 奶奶 nǎinai, 女 nǚ, 同学 tóngxué
zh.cum: Mới: 男老师 nán lǎoshī / 男同学 nán tóngxué / Brown先生 Brown xiānsheng | Ôn: 女老师 nǚ lǎoshī
zh.cau: 他是男老师。（Tā shì nán lǎoshī.）/ 这是Brown先生，他是Anna的爸爸。（Zhè shì Brown xiānsheng, tā shì Anna de bàba.）/ 我们有十个男同学和九个女同学。（Wǒmen yǒu shí ge nán tóngxué hé jiǔ ge nǚ tóngxué.）/ Brown先生是英国人。（Brown xiānsheng shì Yīngguó rén.）
zh.truyen: Anna的爸爸 — 星期五下午，一个男人来学校。他说：“你好，老师！我是Brown先生，我是Anna的爸爸，我是英国人。”老师说：“你好，Brown先生！”Anna说：“爸爸，这是我的新朋友Bông。”（Anna de bàba — Xīngqīwǔ xiàwǔ, yí ge nánrén lái xuéxiào. Tā shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, lǎoshī! Wǒ shì Brown xiānsheng, wǒ shì Anna de bàba, wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, Brown xiānsheng!” Anna shuō: “Bàba, zhè shì wǒ de xīn péngyou Bông.”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "家庭成员 儿歌 爸爸妈妈"

web.label: Ngày 8. Unit 1 · Tả người: râu, tóc xoăn, tóc vàng; could (nhóm 2)

en.tu: Mới: beard, moustache, curly, blond(e), well, opposite | Ôn: grandparent, son, daughter, man/men, photo
en.cum: Mới: could swim / could read / curly hair / blond hair / a long beard | Ôn: well done
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: could = quá khứ của can] When I was five, I could swim. / Grandpa could read when he was four. / My grandpa has a beard and a moustache. / Anna has blond hair and Bông has curly hair. / Leo sits opposite Anna. / Nhan can sing very well.
en.truyen: Grandpa's Photo — Nhan looks at an old photo. 'Who's this man with a beard and a moustache?' 'That's me!' says Grandpa. 'When I was young, I could swim very well. I had curly hair.' Nhan smiles. 'Now you have white hair, Grandpa!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "describing people song for kids curly hair beard"

zh.tu: Mới: 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ | Ôn: 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 国家 guójiā, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 早饭 zǎofàn
zh.cum: Mới: Hoa小姐 Hoa xiǎojiě / 我自己 wǒ zìjǐ / 你自己 nǐ zìjǐ | Ôn: Brown先生 Brown xiānsheng
zh.cau: 这是Hoa小姐，她是我妈妈的朋友。（Zhè shì Hoa xiǎojiě, tā shì wǒ māma de péngyou.）/ 你自己做早饭吗？（Nǐ zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn ma?）– 对，我自己做。（Duì, wǒ zìjǐ zuò.）/ [Ngữ pháp: nối kết quả bằng 所以] 我妈妈是中国人，所以我会说汉语。（Wǒ māma shì Zhōngguó rén, suǒyǐ wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ.）/ 我七点上学，所以我六点起床。（Wǒ qī diǎn shàngxué, suǒyǐ wǒ liù diǎn qǐchuáng.）
zh.truyen: Xiaomei自己做早饭 — Hoa小姐是Xiaomei妈妈的朋友。她问：“Xiaomei，你自己做早饭吗？”Xiaomei说：“对！我自己做早饭，所以我早上六点起床。”Hoa小姐说：“你真好！”（Xiaomei zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn — Hoa xiǎojiě shì Xiaomei māma de péngyou. Tā wèn: “Xiaomei, nǐ zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn ma?” Xiaomei shuō: “Duì! Wǒ zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn, suǒyǐ wǒ zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.” Hoa xiǎojiě shuō: “Nǐ zhēn hǎo!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我自己做 儿歌"

en.flash: Mới: parent, grandparent, son, daughter, grandson, granddaughter, grown-up, beard, moustache, curly, blond(e), well, opposite, could | Ôn: family, person/people, man/men, party, photo
en.slide: 1) Nhìn cây gia đình, điền từ (5 câu): Bông is Mum and Dad's daughter. / Nhan is Grandma's grandson. / Bông is Grandpa's granddaughter. / Mum and Dad are Bông's parents. / Grandma and Grandpa are Bông's grandparents. 2) Nghe tả người, chọn tranh đúng (kiểu Movers Listening Part 1, 4 câu): He has a beard and a moustache. / She has curly hair. / He has blond hair. / The man is sitting opposite the girl. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp với could: When you were five, could you swim? – Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't. When you were four, could you read? – Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.
en.truyen: Grandpa's Old Photo — Nhan and Bông look at an old photo. 'Who is this man with a beard and a moustache?' asks Nhan. 'That's me!' says Grandpa. 'When I was young, I had curly hair. I could swim very well.' 'And who's the girl with blond hair?' asks Bông. 'That's my friend from England,' says Grandpa. 'She's a grown-up now. She has a son and a daughter.' Bông smiles. 'And now you are a grandparent, Grandpa!'
en.baihat: This Is My Family (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — These are my parents, Mum and Dad, / Mum and Dad, Mum and Dad. / I'm their daughter, I'm their son, / We are a family! / Grandpa has a long white beard, / Long white beard, long white beard. / He could swim when he was young, / He could swim so well!

zh.flash: Mới: 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ | Ôn: 爸爸 bàba, 妈妈 māma, 爷爷 yéye, 奶奶 nǎinai, 女 nǚ, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 同学 tóngxué
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (4 câu): 男老师 / 女老师 / Brown先生 / Hoa小姐. 2) Nối hai nửa câu với 所以 (3 câu): 我妈妈是中国人，– 所以我会说汉语。/ 今天是星期天，– 所以我不上学。/ 我七点上学，– 所以我六点起床。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你自己洗脸吗？– 对，我自己洗脸。/ 你自己吃早饭吗？– 对，我自己吃早饭。
zh.truyen: Brown先生来学校 — 星期五下午，Brown先生和他的朋友Hoa小姐一起来学校。Brown先生说：“你好，老师！我是Anna的爸爸，我是英国人。”Hoa小姐说：“我是越南人。我妈妈是中国人，所以我会说汉语。”Anna说：“Hoa小姐，我也会说汉语：你好！”大家都说：“真好！”（Brown xiānsheng lái xuéxiào — Xīngqīwǔ xiàwǔ, Brown xiānsheng hé tā de péngyou Hoa xiǎojiě yìqǐ lái xuéxiào. Brown xiānsheng shuō: “Nǐ hǎo, lǎoshī! Wǒ shì Anna de bàba, wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.” Hoa xiǎojiě shuō: “Wǒ shì Yuènán rén. Wǒ māma shì Zhōngguó rén, suǒyǐ wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ.” Anna shuō: “Hoa xiǎojiě, wǒ yě huì shuō Hànyǔ: nǐ hǎo!” Dàjiā dōu shuō: “Zhēn hǎo!”）
zh.baihat: 我自己 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — 我自己起床，我自己洗脸，我自己吃早饭，所以妈妈很快乐！（Wǒ zìjǐ qǐchuáng, wǒ zìjǐ xǐliǎn, wǒ zìjǐ chī zǎofàn, suǒyǐ māma hěn kuàilè!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 5. Unit 1 · Hello, It's Me – 你好，我的新朋友！ · Trốn tìm, chú hề, cướp biển; ôn quốc gia

web.label: Ngày 9. Unit 1 · Chú hề, cướp biển và trò trốn tìm: look for (nhóm 3)

en.tu: Mới: clown, pirate, hide, shout, must | Ôn: party, room, wall, rug, sorry
en.cum: Mới: look for / look for the pirate / hide behind the wall / shout 'Hello!' | Ôn: get up / pick up
en.cau: Let's play hide-and-seek! / The clown is hiding behind the wall. / I'm looking for the pirate. / Don't shout in the room! / [Ngữ pháp: must + động từ nguyên mẫu] You must say 'sorry'.
en.truyen: The Party Game — At Bông's party, there is a clown and a pirate. 'Let's hide!' says the clown. The pirate hides under the rug. The clown hides behind the wall. Nhan looks for them. 'I can see you!' he shouts. 'Well done, Nhan!' says everyone.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hide and seek song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā | Ôn: 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 书包 shūbāo, 新 xīn, 些 xiē, 铅笔 qiānbǐ
zh.cum: Mới: 丢了书包 diū le shūbāo / 一些玫瑰花 yìxiē méiguihuā / 红玫瑰花 hóng méiguihuā | Ôn: 新铅笔 xīn qiānbǐ
zh.cau: 我的书包丢了！（Wǒ de shūbāo diū le!）/ 我的新铅笔丢了。（Wǒ de xīn qiānbǐ diū le.）/ 这些玫瑰花真漂亮！（Zhèxiē méiguihuā zhēn piàoliang!）/ 妈妈喜欢玫瑰花，所以我给她一些玫瑰花。（Māma xǐhuan méiguihuā, suǒyǐ wǒ gěi tā yìxiē méiguihuā.）
zh.truyen: 玫瑰花丢了 — Xiaomei有一些红玫瑰花，她想给老师。在学校，玫瑰花丢了！Xiaomei说：“我的玫瑰花呢？”Leo说：“看，在你的书包里！”Xiaomei说：“谢谢你，Leo！”（Méiguihuā diū le — Xiaomei yǒu yìxiē hóng méiguihuā, tā xiǎng gěi lǎoshī. Zài xuéxiào, méiguihuā diū le! Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ de méiguihuā ne?” Leo shuō: “Kàn, zài nǐ de shūbāo li!” Xiaomei shuō: “Xièxie nǐ, Leo!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "东西丢了 儿歌"

en.cum: Ôn: look for / could swim / my parents / curly hair / blond hair
en.cau: Where are you from? – I'm from Korea. / How old are you? – I'm seven years old. / Is Anna from England? – Yes, she is. / Is Leo from France? – No, he isn't. He's from America. / My grandson could read when he was five. / Which country has a red and white flag? – Japan!
en.truyen: Who Am I? (nghe – không tranh) — I'm eight years old. I'm from Vietnam. I have curly hair. My mum is a nurse and my dad is a chef. I have a brother. His name is Nhan. Who am I? – I'm Bông!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "What's your name how old are you song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 法国 Fǎguó, 德国 Déguó, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā

en.flash: Mới: clown, pirate, hide, shout, must, look for | Ôn: country, flag, language, age, parent, grandparent, beard, curly, room, wall, rug, sorry
en.slide: 1) Nghe và đánh dấu chỗ trốn trong tranh (kiểu Movers Listening Part 5, 4 câu): The clown is hiding behind the wall. / The pirate is hiding under the rug. / The kitten is hiding in the cup. / The puppy is hiding next to the door. 2) Chọn must / mustn't để hoàn thành nội quy lớp (4 câu): You must say sorry. / You mustn't shout in the room. / You must look at the teacher. / You mustn't hide in the classroom. 3) Trò chơi 'I'm looking for…': một bạn tả, cả lớp đoán: I'm looking for a pirate with a beard. / I'm looking for a girl with blond hair. / I'm looking for a boy from America.
en.truyen: The Party Game — At Bông's party, there is a clown and a pirate. 'Let's play hide-and-seek!' says the clown. The pirate hides under the rug. The clown hides behind the wall. Nhan must look for them. He looks in the room and in the kitchen. 'I can see a big red shoe!' he shouts. 'It's the clown!' Then he sees a long black beard under the rug. 'And it's the pirate!' 'Well done, Nhan!' says everyone.
en.baihat: Hide and Seek (giai điệu London Bridge) — Where's the pirate? Look for him, / Look for him, look for him. / Where's the pirate? Look for him, / He's behind the wall! / Where's the clown? Look for her, / Look for her, look for her. / Where's the clown? Look for her, / She's under the rug!

zh.flash: Mới: 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā | Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 书包 shūbāo, 些 xiē
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn câu đúng (4 câu): 我的书包丢了。/ 我的铅笔丢了。/ 这些玫瑰花很漂亮。/ 妈妈喜欢玫瑰花。 2) Sắp xếp từ thành câu (3 câu): 我 / 的 / 书包 / 丢了 → 我的书包丢了。/ 你 / 是 / 哪国人 → 你是哪国人？/ 所以 / 我 / 六点 / 起床 → 我七点上学，所以我六点起床。 3) Đóng vai hỏi – đáp: 你是哪国人？– 我是韩国人。/ Brown先生是哪国人？– 他是英国人。
zh.truyen: 玫瑰花丢了 — 早上，Xiaomei有一些红玫瑰花，她想给老师。在学校，玫瑰花丢了！Xiaomei说：“我的玫瑰花呢？”Leo说：“看，在你的书包里！”中午，Xiaomei给老师玫瑰花。老师说：“这些玫瑰花真漂亮，谢谢你！”（Méiguihuā diū le — Zǎoshang, Xiaomei yǒu yìxiē hóng méiguihuā, tā xiǎng gěi lǎoshī. Zài xuéxiào, méiguihuā diū le! Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ de méiguihuā ne?” Leo shuō: “Kàn, zài nǐ de shūbāo li!” Zhōngwǔ, Xiaomei gěi lǎoshī méiguihuā. Lǎoshī shuō: “Zhèxiē méiguihuā zhēn piàoliang, xièxie nǐ!”）
zh.baihat: 玫瑰花 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星) — 红红的玫瑰花，一些给妈妈，一些给老师，一些给朋友。我的玫瑰花，真呀真漂亮！（Hónghóng de méiguihuā, yìxiē gěi māma, yìxiē gěi lǎoshī, yìxiē gěi péngyou. Wǒ de méiguihuā, zhēn ya zhēn piàoliang!）

web.label: Ngày 11. Unit 1 · Truyện: The Lost Flower / 丢了的玫瑰花

en.tu: Ôn: clown, pirate, hide, shout, must, beard, moustache, curly, blond(e), grandparent, party | Ôn khóa trước: cup, kitten, puppy, sleep, rug, wall
en.cum: Ôn: look for / could see / hide behind the wall / say sorry
en.cau: The pirate has a long black beard. / The clown has curly blond hair. / We must look for Grandpa's flower. / The kitten is sleeping on the rug. / I could see the puppy behind the wall.
en.truyen: The Lost Flower — It's Grandma's birthday party. Grandpa has a beautiful red flower for her, but he can't find it! 'Let's look for it!' says the clown. The pirate with the black beard looks under the rug. The kitten is sleeping there. Nhan looks behind the wall. 'I could see something red!' he shouts. It's the flower, in the puppy's mouth! 'You must say sorry, puppy!' says Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "clown and pirate story for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 男 nán | Ôn khóa trước: 只 zhī, 些 xiē, 一起 yìqǐ, 晚上 wǎnshang, 那儿 nàr
zh.cum: Ôn: 丢了玫瑰花 diū le méiguihuā / 一些玫瑰花 yìxiē méiguihuā / 一只小狗 yì zhī xiǎo gǒu / 一起看看 yìqǐ kànkan
zh.cau: 爷爷的玫瑰花丢了！（Yéye de méiguihuā diū le!）/ 玫瑰花在哪儿？（Méiguihuā zài nǎr?）/ 我们一起看看。（Wǒmen yìqǐ kànkan.）/ 这只小狗真可爱！（Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu zhēn kě'ài!）
zh.truyen: 丢了的玫瑰花 — 今天是奶奶的生日。晚上，爷爷有一些红玫瑰花，他想给奶奶。玫瑰花丢了！大家一起看：不在书包里，不在房间里。Nhan说：“看！玫瑰花在小狗那儿！”爷爷说：“小狗也喜欢玫瑰花！”（Diū le de méiguihuā — Jīntiān shì nǎinai de shēngrì. Wǎnshang, yéye yǒu yìxiē hóng méiguihuā, tā xiǎng gěi nǎinai. Méiguihuā diū le! Dàjiā yìqǐ kàn: bú zài shūbāo li, bú zài fángjiān li. Nhan shuō: “Kàn! Méiguihuā zài xiǎo gǒu nàr!” Yéye shuō: “Xiǎo gǒu yě xǐhuan méiguihuā!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小狗 儿歌 中文"

web.label: Ngày 12. Unit 1 · Chuyển ngữ + Phiên dịch nhí: giới thiệu bản thân Anh ↔ Trung

en.tu: Ôn: country, flag, language, age, England, America, Vietnam, Korea, Japan, parent, son, daughter, grown-up, opposite | Ôn khóa trước: Monday, Friday, week, calendar, ruler, rubber
en.cum: Ôn: look for / could / see you on Friday / well done
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: cô đọc câu tiếng Trung, con nói lại bằng tiếng Anh] My name is Xiaomei. / I'm from Vietnam. / How old are you? / This is Mr Brown. He's from England. / See you on Friday!
en.truyen: See You on Friday! — On Friday, Mr Brown comes to school. 'Hello! I'm Mr Brown. I'm Anna's dad. I'm from England,' he says. Xiaomei's grandma is a grown-up from China. She doesn't know English. Xiaomei says it again in Chinese for her grandma. Grandma smiles. 'Well done, Xiaomei! You know two languages!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "introduce yourself English for kids my name is I am from"

zh.tu: Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 韩国 Hánguó, 日本 Rìběn, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ | Ôn khóa trước: 星期 xīngqī, 现在 xiànzài, 月 yuè, 张 zhāng, 中午 zhōngwǔ
zh.cum: Ôn: 星期五见 xīngqīwǔ jiàn / Brown先生 Brown xiānsheng / 英国人 Yīngguó rén / 我自己 wǒ zìjǐ
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: cô đọc câu tiếng Anh, con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung] 我叫Xiaomei。（Wǒ jiào Xiaomei.）/ 我是越南人。（Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.）/ 你几岁？（Nǐ jǐ suì?）/ 这是Brown先生，他是英国人。（Zhè shì Brown xiānsheng, tā shì Yīngguó rén.）/ 星期五见！（Xīngqīwǔ jiàn!）
zh.truyen: 星期五见！ — 星期五中午，Brown先生来学校。他说：“Hello! I'm Mr Brown. I'm from England.”Xiaomei的奶奶不会说英语。Xiaomei说：“奶奶，他说：你好！我是Brown先生，我是英国人。”奶奶说：“Xiaomei，你真好！”（Xīngqīwǔ jiàn! — Xīngqīwǔ zhōngwǔ, Brown xiānsheng lái xuéxiào. Tā shuō: “Hello! I'm Mr Brown. I'm from England.” Xiaomei de nǎinai bú huì shuō Yīngyǔ. Xiaomei shuō: “Nǎinai, tā shuō: nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Brown xiānsheng, wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.” Nǎinai shuō: “Xiaomei, nǐ zhēn hǎo!”）

en.flash: Ôn: country, flag, language, age, America, England, Vietnam, Japan, Korea, France, Germany, Russia, parent, son, daughter, grandson, granddaughter, grown-up, beard, moustache, curly, blond(e), clown, pirate, hide, shout, must, look for, could, opposite
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 1 – Đọc định nghĩa, chọn từ (kiểu Movers Reading Part 1, 5 câu): Every country has one. It has colours and you can see it on a building. (flag) / Your mum and dad are your ___. (parents) / This person has a big red nose and makes people happy. (clown) / Some men have this on their face. (beard) / English and Chinese are two ___. (languages) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một bạn đọc thẻ tiếng Anh, bạn kia nói tiếng Trung: I'm from Vietnam. / My name is Leo. / How old are you? / See you on Friday! 3) Đóng vai truyện 'The Lost Flower': Grandpa, the clown, the pirate, Nhan, Bông.
en.truyen: The Lost Flower (đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai) — It's Grandma's birthday party. There is a clown with curly blond hair and a pirate with a long black beard. Grandpa has a beautiful red flower for Grandma, but he can't find it! 'Oh no! Where is it?' he says. 'Let's look for it!' says the clown. The pirate looks under the rug. A kitten is sleeping there. Bông looks in the cups. Nhan looks behind the wall. 'I could see something red!' he shouts. It's the flower, in the puppy's mouth! Everyone smiles. 'You must say sorry, puppy!' says Bông. Grandpa gives the flower to Grandma. 'Happy birthday!'
en.baihat: Hello, It's Me! (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Hello, hello, it's me! / I'm from Vietnam, can't you see? / I am eight and I like to play, / I say hello every day. / Hello, hello, it's me! / I'm from Vietnam, can't you see?

zh.flash: Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 法国 Fǎguó, 德国 Déguó, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 1 – Nghe chọn tranh (kiểu YCT3, 5 câu): 他是男老师。/ 我的书包丢了。/ 她是日本人。/ 这些玫瑰花很漂亮。/ 我自己吃早饭。 2) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói tiếng Trung: I'm from England. → 我是英国人。（Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.）/ This is Mr Brown. → 这是Brown先生。（Zhè shì Brown xiānsheng.）/ Grandpa's flower is lost! → 爷爷的玫瑰花丢了！（Yéye de méiguihuā diū le!） 3) Đóng vai truyện 丢了的玫瑰花.
zh.truyen: 丢了的玫瑰花（đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai）— 今天是奶奶的生日，大家一起在家里。爷爷有一些红玫瑰花，他想给奶奶。玫瑰花丢了！爷爷说：“我的玫瑰花呢？”大家一起看：不在书包里，不在房间里。Nhan说：“看！玫瑰花在小狗那儿！”小狗很喜欢玫瑰花，所以它不给爷爷。Bông说：“小狗，给爷爷吧！”爷爷给奶奶玫瑰花：“生日快乐！”（Diū le de méiguihuā — Jīntiān shì nǎinai de shēngrì, dàjiā yìqǐ zài jiā li. Yéye yǒu yìxiē hóng méiguihuā, tā xiǎng gěi nǎinai. Méiguihuā diū le! Yéye shuō: “Wǒ de méiguihuā ne?” Dàjiā yìqǐ kàn: bú zài shūbāo li, bú zài fángjiān li. Nhan shuō: “Kàn! Méiguihuā zài xiǎo gǒu nàr!” Xiǎo gǒu hěn xǐhuan méiguihuā, suǒyǐ tā bù gěi yéye. Bông shuō: “Xiǎo gǒu, gěi yéye ba!” Yéye gěi nǎinai méiguihuā: “Shēngrì kuàilè!”）
zh.baihat: 我的新朋友 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 你好你好，你好你好，新朋友，新朋友。我是越南人，你是英国人，一起玩儿，一起玩儿！（Nǐ hǎo nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo nǐ hǎo, xīn péngyou, xīn péngyou. Wǒ shì Yuènán rén, nǐ shì Yīngguó rén, yìqǐ wánr, yìqǐ wánr!）

blocks.title: Unit 2 · My Day · 我的一天

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 7. Unit 2 · My Day – 我的一天 · Nói giờ và hoạt động hằng ngày

web.label: Ngày 13. Unit 2 · Mấy giờ rồi? Giờ hơn, giờ rưỡi, giờ kém/quá 15 phút (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: past, half, quarter, minute, always, usually | Ôn: clock, o'clock, morning, breakfast, now
en.cum: Mới: ten past five / half past seven / a quarter past eight / five minutes | Ôn: get up / at seven o'clock
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: nói giờ hơn, giờ rưỡi] What time is it? – It's ten past five. / It's half past seven. / It's a quarter past eight. / I always get up at half past six. / I usually have breakfast at seven o'clock.
en.truyen: Bông's Clock — Bông has a new clock. 'What time is it now?' asks Mum. 'It's half past six!' says Bông. She always gets up at half past six. She usually has breakfast at a quarter past seven. 'Five minutes, Bông! It's time for school!' says Mum.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "telling the time half past quarter past song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi | Ôn: 现在 xiànzài, 点 diǎn, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 起床 qǐchuáng, 早上 zǎoshang
zh.cum: Mới: 七点半 qī diǎn bàn / 五点十分 wǔ diǎn shí fēn / 一个小时 yí ge xiǎoshí / 每天 měi tiān | Ôn: 早上六点 zǎoshang liù diǎn
zh.cau: 现在几点？（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?）/ [Ngữ pháp: nói giờ ___点___分 / ___点半] 现在五点十分。（Xiànzài wǔ diǎn shí fēn.）/ 现在七点半。（Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn.）/ [Ngữ pháp: từ chỉ thời gian đứng trước động từ] 我每天六点半起床。（Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng.）/ 我学习一个小时。（Wǒ xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí.）
zh.truyen: 现在几点？ — 妈妈问：“Bông，现在几点？”Bông说：“现在六点半。”Bông每天六点半起床，七点十分吃早饭。妈妈说：“快！七点半去上学！”（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? — Māma wèn: “Bông, xiànzài jǐ diǎn?” Bông shuō: “Xiànzài liù diǎn bàn.” Bông měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, qī diǎn shí fēn chī zǎofàn. Māma shuō: “Kuài! Qī diǎn bàn qù shàngxué!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "现在几点 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 14. Unit 2 · Hoạt động hằng ngày: tắm vòi sen, bữa ăn, thỉnh thoảng (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: shower, meal, sometimes, often, never, after | Ôn: always, usually, bath, dinner, lunch, evening
en.cum: Mới: have a shower / have a meal / after dinner / three meals a day | Ôn: go to sleep / wash my face
en.cau: What do you do in the morning? – I get up and have a shower. / I sometimes have a bath in the evening. / I often have three meals a day. / [Ngữ pháp: after + hoạt động] I do my homework after dinner. / I never go to sleep after ten o'clock.
en.truyen: Leo's Evening — Leo usually has dinner at half past six. After dinner, he does his homework. He sometimes watches TV. He always has a shower at eight o'clock. He never goes to sleep after nine o'clock.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "my daily routine song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn | Ôn: 半 bàn, 每 měi, 晚上 wǎnshang, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 吃晚饭 chī wǎnfàn, 早饭 zǎofàn
zh.cum: Mới: 洗澡 xǐzǎo / 一起吃饭 yìqǐ chīfàn / 八点洗澡 bā diǎn xǐzǎo | Ôn: 吃早饭 chī zǎofàn / 吃午饭 chī wǔfàn
zh.cau: 你早上做什么？（Nǐ zǎoshang zuò shénme?）– 我早上起床、洗脸、吃早饭。（Wǒ zǎoshang qǐchuáng, xǐliǎn, chī zǎofàn.）/ 我晚上八点洗澡。（Wǒ wǎnshang bā diǎn xǐzǎo.）/ 我们一起吃饭吧！（Wǒmen yìqǐ chīfàn ba!）/ 我每天九点睡觉。（Wǒ měi tiān jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.）
zh.truyen: Leo的晚上 — Leo晚上六点半和爸爸妈妈一起吃饭。七点他看电视。八点他洗澡。九点他睡觉。妈妈说：“明天见，Leo！”（Leo de wǎnshang — Leo wǎnshang liù diǎn bàn hé bàba māma yìqǐ chīfàn. Qī diǎn tā kàn diànshì. Bā diǎn tā xǐzǎo. Jiǔ diǎn tā shuìjiào. Māma shuō: “Míngtiān jiàn, Leo!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的一天 儿歌 起床 洗澡"

en.flash: Mới: past, half, quarter, minute, always, usually, shower, meal, sometimes, often, never, after | Ôn: clock, o'clock, morning, evening, breakfast, lunch, dinner, bath
en.slide: 1) Nhìn đồng hồ chọn giờ đúng (5 câu): ten past five / half past seven / a quarter past eight / twenty past three / half past twelve. 2) Nghe và nối hoạt động với giờ (kiểu Movers Listening Part 2, 4 câu): Bông gets up at half past six. / She has breakfast at a quarter past seven. / She has a shower after dinner. / She goes to sleep at nine o'clock. 3) Xếp từ chỉ tần suất trên thang 0–100% rồi nói về mình: never / sometimes / often / usually / always – I always have breakfast. / I never have a meal in the bathroom.
en.truyen: Bông's Day — Bông always gets up at half past six. She has a shower and has breakfast at a quarter past seven. She usually goes to school by bus. At twelve o'clock, she has lunch with her classmates. After school, she sometimes paints a picture. She often has dinner at half past six. After dinner, she reads a book for twenty minutes. She never goes to sleep after nine o'clock.
en.baihat: What Time Is It? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — What time is it? / What time is it? / Half past six, / Half past six. / Time to have a shower, / Time to have a meal, / Every day, / Every day.

zh.flash: Mới: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn | Ôn: 现在 xiànzài, 点 diǎn, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 起床 qǐchuáng, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 早上 zǎoshang, 晚上 wǎnshang
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn đồng hồ chọn giờ đúng (5 câu): 五点十分 / 七点半 / 八点十五分 / 三点二十分 / 十二点半. 2) Nghe chọn tranh (kiểu YCT, 4 câu): 我六点半起床。/ 我七点吃早饭。/ 我晚上八点洗澡。/ 我九点睡觉。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 现在几点？– 现在___。/ 你每天几点起床？– 我每天___起床。
zh.truyen: Bông的一天 — Bông每天早上六点半起床。七点十分，她和妈妈一起吃早饭。七点半，她去上学。中午十二点，她在学校吃午饭。晚上六点半，她吃晚饭。八点她洗澡，九点她睡觉。（Bông de yì tiān — Bông měi tiān zǎoshang liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng. Qī diǎn shí fēn, tā hé māma yìqǐ chī zǎofàn. Qī diǎn bàn, tā qù shàngxué. Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn, tā zài xuéxiào chī wǔfàn. Wǎnshang liù diǎn bàn, tā chī wǎnfàn. Bā diǎn tā xǐzǎo, jiǔ diǎn tā shuìjiào.）
zh.baihat: 现在几点 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 现在几点？现在几点？七点半，七点半。起床洗脸吃早饭，每天去上学，真快乐，真快乐！（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Qī diǎn bàn, qī diǎn bàn. Qǐchuáng xǐliǎn chī zǎofàn, měi tiān qù shàngxué, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 8. Unit 2 · My Day – 我的一天 · Nhà con, phòng tắm, how often

web.label: Ngày 15. Unit 2 · Nhà con: trên lầu, dưới lầu, thang máy, ban công (nhóm 2)

en.tu: Mới: upstairs, downstairs, stair(s), balcony, basement, roof | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): grandparent, flag, country, son, could
en.cum: Mới: lift (US: elevator) / take the lift / go upstairs / go downstairs / on the balcony | Ôn: look for / could
en.cau: My bedroom is upstairs. / We take the lift to the tenth floor. / Grandpa reads on the balcony. / There's a flag on the roof. / My grandparents couldn't walk up the stairs, so they take the lift.
en.truyen: Where Is Grandpa? — Nhan looks for Grandpa. He isn't in the basement. He isn't downstairs. Nhan takes the lift and goes upstairs. Grandpa is on the balcony. 'Look, Nhan! I can see our country's flag on that roof!' says Grandpa.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "rooms in the house upstairs downstairs song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): 国家 guójiā, 先生 xiānsheng, 自己 zìjǐ, 丢 diū, 所以 suǒyǐ
zh.cum: Mới: 用电脑 yòng diànnǎo / 一个杯子 yí ge bēizi / 新杯子 xīn bēizi | Ôn: 我自己 wǒ zìjǐ / 丢了 diū le
zh.cau: 我每天用电脑半个小时。（Wǒ měi tiān yòng diànnǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí.）/ 这是我的新杯子。（Zhè shì wǒ de xīn bēizi.）/ 我的杯子丢了！（Wǒ de bēizi diū le!）/ 我自己洗杯子。（Wǒ zìjǐ xǐ bēizi.）/ 爸爸用电脑工作，所以他很忙。（Bàba yòng diànnǎo gōngzuò, suǒyǐ tā hěn máng.）
zh.truyen: 杯子丢了 — 早上，Nhan的杯子丢了。他说：“我的杯子呢？”爷爷说：“在电脑旁边。”Nhan说：“谢谢爷爷！”他自己洗杯子。（Bēizi diū le — Zǎoshang, Nhan de bēizi diū le. Tā shuō: “Wǒ de bēizi ne?” Yéye shuō: “Zài diànnǎo pángbiān.” Nhan shuō: “Xièxie yéye!” Tā zìjǐ xǐ bēizi.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的房间 儿歌 中文"

web.label: Ngày 16. Unit 2 · Phòng tắm và bữa ăn: khăn tắm, đĩa, cốc; how often (nhóm 2)

en.tu: Mới: towel, blanket, wet, dry, bottle, glass, plate | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): beard, moustache, parent, daughter, grown-up
en.cum: Mới: how often / a wet towel / a dry blanket / a glass of water / a bottle of milk | Ôn: ask a grown-up
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: How often…? – trạng từ tần suất] How often do you have a shower? – I have a shower every day. / I always dry my hair with a towel. / Put the plates on the table, please. / My dad has a beard. He dries it with a small towel. / Can I have a glass of water, please?
en.truyen: Bath Time — After dinner, Bông has a bath. Her towel is wet! 'Mum, can I have a dry towel?' Mum gives her a dry towel and a blanket. 'How often do you wash your hair?' asks Mum. 'Every day!' says Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how often do you song for kids always sometimes never"

zh.tu: Mới: 完 wán | Ôn: 杯子 bēizi, 电脑 diànnǎo, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 男 nán, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 半 bàn
zh.cum: Mới: 吃完饭 chīwán fàn / 洗完澡 xǐwán zǎo / 看完书 kànwán shū | Ôn: 半个小时 bàn ge xiǎoshí
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: động từ + 完 = làm xong] 我吃完饭了。（Wǒ chīwán fàn le.）/ 洗完澡，我看书。（Xǐwán zǎo, wǒ kàn shū.）/ 你看完书了吗？（Nǐ kànwán shū le ma?）– 看完了。（Kànwán le.）/ Hoa小姐用完电脑了。（Hoa xiǎojiě yòngwán diànnǎo le.）
zh.truyen: 吃完饭 — 晚上，Bông吃完饭，洗完澡，看书半个小时。九点，妈妈说：“看完了吗？睡觉吧！”Bông说：“看完了！明天见，妈妈！”（Chīwán fàn — Wǎnshang, Bông chīwán fàn, xǐwán zǎo, kàn shū bàn ge xiǎoshí. Jiǔ diǎn, māma shuō: “Kànwán le ma? Shuìjiào ba!” Bông shuō: “Kànwán le! Míngtiān jiàn, māma!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "洗澡歌 儿歌"

en.flash: Mới: upstairs, downstairs, stair(s), balcony, basement, roof, lift, elevator, towel, blanket, wet, dry, bottle, glass, plate, how often | Ôn: grandparent, flag, country, beard, parent, daughter
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh ngôi nhà, đọc và viết Yes/No (kiểu Movers Reading Part 2, 5 câu): The flag is on the roof. / Grandpa is on the balcony. / The towel is in the basement. / The cat is on the stairs. / Mum is in the lift. 2) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (4 câu): towel / blanket / bottle / plate – a wet towel / a dry blanket / a bottle of milk / a glass of water. 3) Phỏng vấn bạn với How often…?: How often do you have a shower? / How often do you go upstairs? – always / usually / sometimes / never.
en.truyen: Grandpa's Balcony — Nhan lives on the third floor. His grandparents live upstairs, on the tenth floor. Grandpa couldn't walk up the stairs, so he takes the lift. Every morning, Grandpa has a glass of water on the balcony. He can see a big flag on a roof. One day, it's raining. Grandpa's towel and blanket are wet! Nhan takes them downstairs to the basement. 'Now they're dry, Grandpa!' 'Thank you, my grandson!'
en.baihat: Up and Down (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The lift in my house goes up and down, / Up and down, up and down. / The lift in my house goes up and down, / Upstairs, downstairs! / How often do you take the lift? / Every day, every day!

zh.flash: Mới: 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán | Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 丢 diū, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 半 bàn
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (4 câu): 电脑 / 杯子 / 洗澡 / 吃饭. 2) Hoàn thành câu với 完 (3 câu): 我吃___饭了。（完）/ 洗___澡，我看书。（完）/ 你看___书了吗？（完） 3) Nghe chọn đúng/sai (kiểu YCT, 4 câu): 我的杯子丢了。/ 爸爸用电脑工作。/ 我自己洗杯子。/ 我吃完饭了。
zh.truyen: Nhan的杯子 — 早上，Nhan的新杯子丢了。他说：“我的杯子呢？”爷爷说：“在电脑旁边。”Nhan说：“谢谢爷爷！”晚上，Nhan吃完饭，自己洗杯子。洗完杯子，他用电脑半个小时。爷爷说：“Nhan真棒！”（Nhan de bēizi — Zǎoshang, Nhan de xīn bēizi diū le. Tā shuō: “Wǒ de bēizi ne?” Yéye shuō: “Zài diànnǎo pángbiān.” Nhan shuō: “Xièxie yéye!” Wǎnshang, Nhan chīwán fàn, zìjǐ xǐ bēizi. Xǐwán bēizi, tā yòng diànnǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí. Yéye shuō: “Nhan zhēn bàng!”）
zh.baihat: 洗完澡 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — 吃完饭，洗完澡，看书半小时。九点钟，睡觉了，明天见，明天见！（Chīwán fàn, xǐwán zǎo, kàn shū bàn xiǎoshí. Jiǔ diǎn zhōng, shuìjiào le, míngtiān jiàn, míngtiān jiàn!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 9. Unit 2 · My Day – 我的一天 · How long, thứ tự; ôn giờ và tần suất

web.label: Ngày 17. Unit 2 · Học bao lâu? Thứ nhất, thứ hai, cuối cùng (nhóm 3)

en.tu: Mới: second, third, last, seat, snow | Ôn: minute, half, quarter, often, first
en.cum: Mới: how long / for thirty minutes / the second floor / the last bus | Ôn: how often
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: How long…? – for + khoảng thời gian] How long do you study every day? – I study for thirty minutes. / Bông is first, Leo is second and Nhan is third. / Sit in your seat, please. / It never snows in Vietnam. / Anna lives on the third floor.
en.truyen: The Race to the Seats — In the classroom, there are three seats near the window. Leo is first, Anna is second and Bông is third. Nhan is last. 'How long do we have?' asks Nhan. 'Five minutes!' says the teacher. Nhan smiles. 'Last is OK!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "ordinal numbers song for kids first second third"

zh.tu: Mới: 去年 qùnián, 多久 duō jiǔ | Ôn: 每 měi, 小时 xiǎoshí, 半 bàn, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 完 wán
zh.cum: Mới: 去年 qùnián / 去年八月 qùnián bā yuè / 学习多久 xuéxí duō jiǔ | Ôn: 三十分钟 sānshí fēnzhōng
zh.cau: 你每天学习多久？（Nǐ měi tiān xuéxí duō jiǔ?）– 我学习三十分钟。（Wǒ xuéxí sānshí fēnzhōng.）/ 去年我七岁。（Qùnián wǒ qī suì.）/ 去年我每天学习二十分钟，现在我学习半个小时。（Qùnián wǒ měi tiān xuéxí èrshí fēnzhōng, xiànzài wǒ xuéxí bàn ge xiǎoshí.）
zh.truyen: 去年和现在 — 去年，Xiaomei七岁，她每天学习二十分钟。现在她八岁了，她每天学习一个小时。妈妈问：“你每天学习多久？”Xiaomei说：“一个小时！”（Qùnián hé xiànzài — Qùnián, Xiaomei qī suì, tā měi tiān xuéxí èrshí fēnzhōng. Xiànzài tā bā suì le, tā měi tiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí. Māma wèn: “Nǐ měi tiān xuéxí duō jiǔ?” Xiaomei shuō: “Yí ge xiǎoshí!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "多久 学习 儿童 中文"

web.label: Ngày 18. Unit 2 · Ôn không tranh: giờ, hoạt động hằng ngày, tần suất

en.tu: Ôn: past, half, quarter, minute, always, usually, sometimes, often, never, shower, meal, after, upstairs, downstairs, stair(s), balcony, basement, roof | Ôn khóa trước: lesson, class, classmate, book, page
en.cum: Ôn: half past seven / a quarter past eight / have a shower / how often / how long / take the lift
en.cau: What time is it? – It's a quarter past nine. / How often do you have a shower? – I have a shower every day. / How long is your English lesson? – It's sixty minutes. / I never have a meal on the balcony. / After school, I always go upstairs and read ten pages of my book.
en.truyen: What Time Is It? (nghe – không tranh) — It's half past six. Nhan gets up and has a shower. At a quarter past seven, he has breakfast. He usually goes to school at half past seven. His first lesson is English. After school, he sometimes plays in the basement with his classmates.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what time is it Mr Wolf song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán, 去年 qùnián | Ôn khóa trước: 点 diǎn, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 读 dú, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 老师 lǎoshī
zh.cum: Ôn: 七点半 qī diǎn bàn / 每天 měi tiān / 一个小时 yí ge xiǎoshí / 吃完饭 chīwán fàn / 学习多久 xuéxí duō jiǔ
zh.cau: 现在几点？（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?）– 现在九点十五分。（Xiànzài jiǔ diǎn shíwǔ fēn.）/ 你每天学习多久？（Nǐ měi tiān xuéxí duō jiǔ?）– 我学习一个小时。（Wǒ xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí.）/ 我每天读汉语书二十分钟。（Wǒ měi tiān dú Hànyǔ shū èrshí fēnzhōng.）/ 吃完饭，我洗澡。（Chīwán fàn, wǒ xǐzǎo.）
zh.truyen: Nhan的早上（nghe – không tranh）— 现在六点半，Nhan起床了。他七点吃早饭，七点半去上学。上午，老师说：“我们读汉语书吧！”Nhan读了二十分钟。（Nhan de zǎoshang — Xiànzài liù diǎn bàn, Nhan qǐchuáng le. Tā qī diǎn chī zǎofàn, qī diǎn bàn qù shàngxué. Shàngwǔ, lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen dú Hànyǔ shū ba!” Nhan dú le èrshí fēnzhōng.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "时间歌 儿歌 几点"

en.flash: Mới: second, third, last, seat, snow, how long | Ôn: past, half, quarter, minute, always, usually, sometimes, often, never, shower, meal, after, upstairs, downstairs, lift, how often
en.slide: 1) Nghe và viết số/giờ (kiểu Movers Listening Part 2, 5 câu): Bông studies for thirty minutes. / Leo is second. / Anna lives on the third floor. / The last bus is at half past nine. / Nhan plays the piano for fifteen minutes. 2) Xếp hàng đua: con nói vị trí của mình: I'm first. / I'm second. / I'm third. / I'm last. 3) Phỏng vấn bạn với How long…? / How often…?: How long do you watch TV every day? / How often do you go to the library?
en.truyen: The Snow Day — It never snows in Vietnam, but in England it snows in December. Anna shows her class a photo. 'This is my old school in England. It's snowing!' The children are very excited. 'How long does it snow?' asks Bông. 'Sometimes for three days!' says Anna. 'We play in the snow for hours. My brother is always first, I'm second and my dad is last!'
en.baihat: How Long? (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — How long, how long, how long / Do you read every day? / Thirty minutes, thirty minutes, / Then I go and play!

zh.flash: Mới: 去年 qùnián, 多久 duō jiǔ | Ôn: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 读 dú
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (kiểu YCT, 4 câu): 我每天学习三十分钟。/ 我学习一个小时。/ 去年我七岁。/ 现在七点半。 2) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你每天学习多久？– 我学习___。/ 你每天用电脑多久？– ___分钟。 3) Nối câu (3 câu): 去年我七岁，– 现在我八岁。/ 吃完饭，– 我洗澡。/ 你每天学习多久？– 半个小时。
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的去年和今年 — 去年，Xiaomei七岁。她每天学习二十分钟，用电脑十分钟。现在她八岁了。她每天学习一个小时，读汉语书半个小时。妈妈问：“你每天学习多久？”Xiaomei说：“一个小时！学习完，我和朋友一起玩儿。”（Xiaomei de qùnián hé jīnnián — Qùnián, Xiaomei qī suì. Tā měi tiān xuéxí èrshí fēnzhōng, yòng diànnǎo shí fēnzhōng. Xiànzài tā bā suì le. Tā měi tiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí, dú Hànyǔ shū bàn ge xiǎoshí. Māma wèn: “Nǐ měi tiān xuéxí duō jiǔ?” Xiaomei shuō: “Yí ge xiǎoshí! Xuéxí wán, wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ wánr.”）
zh.baihat: 学习多久 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 学习多久？学习多久？一小时，一小时。每天学习汉语，每天读书半小时，真快乐，真快乐！（Xuéxí duō jiǔ? Xuéxí duō jiǔ? Yì xiǎoshí, yì xiǎoshí. Měi tiān xuéxí Hànyǔ, měi tiān dú shū bàn xiǎoshí, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 10. Unit 2 · My Day – 我的一天 · Truyện, chuyển ngữ và kiểm tra nhanh Unit 2

web.label: Ngày 19. Unit 2 · Truyện: A Busy Morning / 忙忙的早上

en.tu: Ôn: always, usually, sometimes, never, shower, meal, past, half, quarter, minute, towel, bottle, plate, stairs, lift | Ôn khóa trước: egg, cake, bag, pencil, pen, eraser
en.cum: Ôn: have a shower / a quarter past seven / take the lift / a bottle of water / how long
en.cau: Leo always gets up at a quarter past six. / Today he gets up at half past seven! / He has a shower. / He puts a bottle of water, a pen and a pencil in his bag. / It takes five minutes to walk to school.
en.truyen: A Busy Morning — Leo usually gets up at a quarter past six. But today, his clock says half past seven! He has a shower and dries his hair with a towel. He eats an egg on a plate. He puts a bottle of water and his pencils in his bag. He runs down the stairs. 'How long do I have?' he asks Mum. 'Ten minutes!' Leo is at school at ten past eight. He is not last!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "morning routine story for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán | Ôn khóa trước: 鸡蛋 jīdàn, 起床 qǐchuáng, 铅笔 qiānbǐ, 明天 míngtiān, 妈妈 māma, 快乐 kuàilè
zh.cum: Ôn: 七点半起床 qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng / 吃完早饭 chīwán zǎofàn / 一个杯子 yí ge bēizi / 十分钟 shí fēnzhōng
zh.cau: Leo每天六点十五分起床。（Leo měi tiān liù diǎn shíwǔ fēn qǐchuáng.）/ 今天他七点半起床！（Jīntiān tā qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng!）/ 他吃完鸡蛋，去上学。（Tā chīwán jīdàn, qù shàngxué.）/ 走路去学校要十分钟。（Zǒulù qù xuéxiào yào shí fēnzhōng.）
zh.truyen: 忙忙的早上 — Leo每天六点十五分起床。今天他七点半起床！他洗脸，吃完一个鸡蛋，喝一杯水。妈妈说：“快！十分钟！”Leo走路去学校。八点十分，他在学校了。老师说：“Leo，早上好！”（Mángmáng de zǎoshang — Leo měi tiān liù diǎn shíwǔ fēn qǐchuáng. Jīntiān tā qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng! Tā xǐliǎn, chīwán yí ge jīdàn, hē yì bēi shuǐ. Māma shuō: “Kuài! Shí fēnzhōng!” Leo zǒulù qù xuéxiào. Bā diǎn shí fēn, tā zài xuéxiào le. Lǎoshī shuō: “Leo, zǎoshang hǎo!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "早上好 起床歌 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 20. Unit 2 · Chuyển ngữ + Phiên dịch nhí: thời gian biểu của con

en.tu: Ôn: past, half, quarter, minute, always, usually, sometimes, often, never, shower, meal, after, how often, how long | Ôn khóa trước: Mrs, kid, know, now, open, answer
en.cum: Ôn: half past six / have a shower / after dinner / for thirty minutes
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: cô đọc câu tiếng Trung, con nói lại bằng tiếng Anh] What time is it now? – It's half past seven. / I get up at six o'clock. / I study for thirty minutes every day. / I have a shower after dinner. / How long do you use the computer?
en.truyen: Mrs Lee's Question — Mrs Lee asks the kids, 'Do you know your day in two languages?' Bông puts up her hand. 'I get up at half past six. I study for thirty minutes. I always have a shower after dinner.' Then she says it again in Chinese. 'Well done!' says Mrs Lee. 'That's the correct answer!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "my day English Chinese bilingual kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán, 去年 qùnián | Ôn khóa trước: 您 nín, 大家 dàjiā, 排队 páiduì, 两 liǎng, 号 hào
zh.cum: Ôn: 现在七点半 xiànzài qī diǎn bàn / 每天学习 měi tiān xuéxí / 吃完饭 chīwán fàn / 用电脑 yòng diànnǎo
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: cô đọc câu tiếng Anh, con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung] 现在几点？– 现在七点半。（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? – Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn.）/ 我六点起床。（Wǒ liù diǎn qǐchuáng.）/ 我每天学习三十分钟。（Wǒ měi tiān xuéxí sānshí fēnzhōng.）/ 吃完晚饭，我洗澡。（Chīwán wǎnfàn, wǒ xǐzǎo.）/ 你每天用电脑多久？（Nǐ měi tiān yòng diànnǎo duō jiǔ?）
zh.truyen: 说说我的一天 — 老师说：“大家排队，说说你的一天。”Bông说：“老师，您好！我每天六点半起床，学习三十分钟，吃完晚饭洗澡。”然后她用英语说。老师说：“Bông，你真棒！”（Shuōshuo wǒ de yì tiān — Lǎoshī shuō: “Dàjiā páiduì, shuōshuo nǐ de yì tiān.” Bông shuō: “Lǎoshī, nín hǎo! Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, xuéxí sānshí fēnzhōng, chīwán wǎnfàn xǐzǎo.” Ránhòu tā yòng Yīngyǔ shuō. Lǎoshī shuō: “Bông, nǐ zhēn bàng!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的一天 中英双语 儿童"

en.flash: Ôn: past, half, quarter, minute, always, usually, sometimes, often, never, shower, meal, after, upstairs, downstairs, stair(s), balcony, basement, roof, lift, elevator, towel, blanket, wet, dry, bottle, glass, plate, seat, second, third, last, snow, how often, how long
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 2 – Đọc và chọn từ điền chỗ trống (kiểu Movers Reading Part 3, 5 câu): Leo gets up at a ___ past six. (quarter) / He has a ___ and dries his hair with a towel. (shower) / He eats an egg on a ___. (plate) / He runs down the ___. (stairs) / He is not ___ at school. (last) 2) Nghe vẽ kim đồng hồ (4 câu): half past seven / a quarter past six / ten past eight / twenty past nine. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: I get up at six o'clock. / I study for thirty minutes. / I always have a shower after dinner.
en.truyen: A Busy Morning (đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai) — Leo usually gets up at a quarter past six. But today, his clock says half past seven! 'Oh no!' he shouts. He has a shower and dries his hair with a towel. Mum puts an egg on a plate. Leo eats it in two minutes. He puts a bottle of water, a pen and three pencils in his bag. He doesn't take the lift. He runs down the stairs. 'How long do I have?' he asks. 'Ten minutes!' says Mum. Leo is at school at ten past eight. His friends are in their seats. 'Leo, you are not last!' says Mrs Lee. Leo smiles.
en.baihat: My Day Song (giai điệu London Bridge) — I get up at half past six, / Half past six, half past six. / I get up at half past six, / Then I have a shower! / I go to school at half past seven, / Half past seven, half past seven. / I go to school at half past seven, / Every day!

zh.flash: Ôn: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán, 去年 qùnián, 多久 duō jiǔ, 现在 xiànzài, 分钟 fēnzhōng
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 2 – Nghe chọn tranh (kiểu YCT3, 5 câu): 现在七点半。/ 我每天洗澡。/ 这是我的杯子。/ 我吃完饭了。/ 去年我七岁。 2) Đọc chọn đúng/sai theo thời gian biểu của Leo (4 câu): Leo六点十五分起床。/ Leo吃完早饭去上学。/ 走路去学校要一个小时。/ Leo每天学习半个小时。 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói tiếng Trung: What time is it? → 现在几点？（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?）/ I have a shower every day. → 我每天洗澡。（Wǒ měi tiān xǐzǎo.）
zh.truyen: 忙忙的早上（đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai）— Leo每天六点十五分起床。今天他七点半起床！他说：“现在七点半了！”他洗脸，吃完一个鸡蛋，喝一杯水。他说：“我的书包呢？”妈妈说：“在电脑旁边。快！十分钟！”Leo走路去学校。八点十分，他在学校了。同学们都在。老师说：“Leo，早上好！”Leo说：“明天我六点起床！”（Mángmáng de zǎoshang — Leo měi tiān liù diǎn shíwǔ fēn qǐchuáng. Jīntiān tā qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng! Tā shuō: “Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn le!” Tā xǐliǎn, chīwán yí ge jīdàn, hē yì bēi shuǐ. Tā shuō: “Wǒ de shūbāo ne?” Māma shuō: “Zài diànnǎo pángbiān. Kuài! Shí fēnzhōng!” Leo zǒulù qù xuéxiào. Bā diǎn shí fēn, tā zài xuéxiào le. Tóngxuémen dōu zài. Lǎoshī shuō: “Leo, zǎoshang hǎo!” Leo shuō: “Míngtiān wǒ liù diǎn qǐchuáng!”）
zh.baihat: 我的一天 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星) — 六点半，我起床，洗洗脸，吃早饭。七点半，去上学，学习汉语一小时。吃完饭，洗完澡，九点钟，睡觉了。（Liù diǎn bàn, wǒ qǐchuáng, xǐxi liǎn, chī zǎofàn. Qī diǎn bàn, qù shàngxué, xuéxí Hànyǔ yì xiǎoshí. Chīwán fàn, xǐwán zǎo, jiǔ diǎn zhōng, shuìjiào le.）

blocks.title: Unit 3 · When I Grow Up · 我长大以后

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 11. Unit 3 · When I Grow Up – 我长大以后 · Ước mơ nghề nghiệp

web.label: Ngày 21. Unit 3 · Khi con lớn lên: phi công, kỹ sư, nhà khoa học, bác sĩ thú y (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: future, grow, pilot, engineer, scientist, vet | Ôn: job, doctor, nurse, farmer, driver, firefighter, learn
en.cum: Mới: grow up / when I grow up / in the future / want to be a pilot | Ôn: work in a hospital
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: want to be + nghề nghiệp] What do you want to be? – I want to be a scientist. / I want to be a pilot when I grow up. / In the future, Leo wants to be an engineer. / A vet helps sick animals. / My cousin wants to be a firefighter.
en.truyen: When I Grow Up — The children draw pictures of their future. Bông draws a plane. 'I want to be a pilot!' she says. Leo draws a big house. 'I want to be an engineer.' Nhan draws a cat and a dog. 'I want to be a vet. I love animals!' Anna smiles. 'I want to be a scientist when I grow up!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what do you want to be when you grow up song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 以后 yǐhòu, 科学家 kēxuéjiā, 警察 jǐngchá, 长大 zhǎngdà, 当 dāng | Ôn: 医生 yīshēng, 司机 sījī, 厨师 chúshī, 牙医 yáyī, 工作 gōngzuò
zh.cum: Mới: 长大以后 zhǎngdà yǐhòu / 想当科学家 xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā / 当警察 dāng jǐngchá | Ôn: 在医院工作 zài yīyuàn gōngzuò
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 想当 + nghề nghiệp] 你想当什么？（Nǐ xiǎng dāng shénme?）– 我想当科学家。（Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā.）/ 我长大以后想当警察。（Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jǐngchá.）/ 我哥哥长大以后想当医生。（Wǒ gēge zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng yīshēng.）
zh.truyen: 长大以后 — 老师问：“你们长大以后想当什么？”Bông说：“我想当科学家。”Leo说：“我想当警察。”Nhan说：“我想当医生，在医院工作。”老师说：“真好！”（Zhǎngdà yǐhòu — Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐmen zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá.” Nhan shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng dāng yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Zhēn hǎo!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "长大以后想当什么 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 22. Unit 3 · Cảnh sát và nơi làm việc: xây, mang, cần, một trăm (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: workplace, build, carry, need, hundred | Ôn: future, pilot, engineer, work, employee, father
en.cum: Mới: police officer / build a house / carry a bag / a hundred people | Ôn: grow up
en.cau: I want to be a police officer when I grow up. / What does your father do? – He is an engineer. He builds houses. / A hospital is a doctor's workplace. / A pilot carries a hundred people in the plane. / Firefighters need a lot of water.
en.truyen: Dad's Workplace — Leo's dad is an engineer. His workplace is very big. He and a hundred employees build houses. 'What do they carry?' asks Leo. 'They carry big stones,' says Dad. 'We need a lot of help!' Leo says, 'I can help you in the future, Dad!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "community helpers police officer song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 帮助 bāngzhù, 百 bǎi | Ôn: 以后 yǐhòu, 警察 jǐngchá, 医生 yīshēng, 员工 yuángōng, 工作 gōngzuò, 医院 yīyuàn
zh.cum: Mới: 帮助病人 bāngzhù bìngrén / 帮助大家 bāngzhù dàjiā / 一百个人 yìbǎi ge rén | Ôn: 做什么的 zuò shénme de
zh.cau: 你爸爸是做什么的？（Nǐ bàba shì zuò shénme de?）– 他是老师。（Tā shì lǎoshī.）/ 医生帮助病人。（Yīshēng bāngzhù bìngrén.）/ 警察帮助大家。（Jǐngchá bāngzhù dàjiā.）/ 这个医院有一百个员工。（Zhège yīyuàn yǒu yìbǎi ge yuángōng.）
zh.truyen: 妈妈的工作 — Nhan的妈妈是医生，她在医院工作。医院里有一百个员工。妈妈每天帮助病人。Nhan说：“妈妈，我长大以后也想当医生，帮助病人！”（Māma de gōngzuò — Nhan de māma shì yīshēng, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Yīyuàn li yǒu yìbǎi ge yuángōng. Māma měi tiān bāngzhù bìngrén. Nhan shuō: “Māma, wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yě xiǎng dāng yīshēng, bāngzhù bìngrén!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "警察叔叔 儿歌"

en.flash: Mới: future, grow, pilot, engineer, scientist, vet, police officer, workplace, build, carry, need, hundred | Ôn: job, doctor, nurse, farmer, driver, firefighter, chef, employee
en.slide: 1) Nghe và nối người với nghề (kiểu Movers Listening Part 2, 5 câu): Bông – pilot / Leo – engineer / Nhan – vet / Anna – scientist / Xiaomei – police officer. 2) Đọc mô tả, chọn nghề (4 câu): This person flies a plane. (pilot) / This person helps sick animals. (vet) / This person builds houses. (engineer) / This person helps people in the street. (police officer) 3) Phỏng vấn theo cặp: What do you want to be when you grow up? – I want to be a ___. / What does your father do? – He is a ___.
en.truyen: Dreams of the Future — Today, the children talk about their future. 'What do you want to be when you grow up?' asks Mrs Lee. 'I want to be a pilot. I want to carry a hundred people in my plane!' says Bông. 'I want to be an engineer like my dad. Engineers build houses,' says Leo. 'I want to be a vet. Animals need help too,' says Nhan. Xiaomei says, 'I want to be a police officer. Police officers help people.' Anna says, 'And I want to be a scientist!' Mrs Lee smiles. 'What a great future!'
en.baihat: When I Grow Up (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — When I grow up, / When I grow up, / I want to be, / I want to be / A pilot or a vet, / A scientist or an engineer, / Yes, I do! / Yes, I do!

zh.flash: Mới: 以后 yǐhòu, 科学家 kēxuéjiā, 警察 jǐngchá, 长大 zhǎngdà, 当 dāng, 帮助 bāngzhù, 百 bǎi | Ôn: 医生 yīshēng, 司机 sījī, 厨师 chúshī, 牙医 yáyī, 员工 yuángōng, 工作 gōngzuò
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (5 câu): 科学家 / 警察 / 医生 / 厨师 / 司机. 2) Nghe chọn đúng/sai (kiểu YCT, 4 câu): 我长大以后想当警察。/ 医生帮助病人。/ 这个医院有一百个员工。/ 我爸爸是司机。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你长大以后想当什么？– 我想当___。/ 你妈妈是做什么的？– 她是___。
zh.truyen: 我们的梦 — 老师问：“你们长大以后想当什么？”Bông说：“我想当科学家。”Leo说：“我想当警察，帮助大家。”Nhan说：“我妈妈是医生，她在医院工作。医院有一百个员工。我长大以后也想当医生！”Xiaomei说：“我想当厨师！”老师说：“你们都很棒！”（Wǒmen de mèng — Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐmen zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá, bāngzhù dàjiā.” Nhan shuō: “Wǒ māma shì yīshēng, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. Yīyuàn yǒu yìbǎi ge yuángōng. Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yě xiǎng dāng yīshēng!” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng dāng chúshī!” Lǎoshī shuō: “Nǐmen dōu hěn bàng!”）
zh.baihat: 长大以后 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 长大以后，长大以后，想当什么？想当什么？我想当科学家，我想当警察，帮助大家，帮助大家！（Zhǎngdà yǐhòu, zhǎngdà yǐhòu, xiǎng dāng shénme? Xiǎng dāng shénme? Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā, wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá, bāngzhù dàjiā, bāngzhù dàjiā!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 12. Unit 3 · When I Grow Up – 我长大以后 · Tại sao con khóc? Vị trí trên – dưới

web.label: Ngày 23. Unit 3 · Khóc, ngã, lá rơi; tại sao? (nhóm 2 + từ nối Unit 2)

en.tu: Mới: cry, fall, leaf/leaves, lose, slowly, why | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): always, sometimes, minute, half, upstairs, downstairs, stair(s)
en.cum: Mới: fall down / walk slowly / lose a ball / the leaves fall | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): how long / how often
en.cau: Why are you crying? – I lost my ball. / The leaves fall from the tree. / Walk slowly on the stairs or you can fall down. / The baby sometimes cries for five minutes. / Why is your sister crying? – She wants her mum.
en.truyen: Don't Cry! — Bông's little sister is in the park. The leaves are falling. She runs down the stairs and falls. She starts to cry. 'Why are you crying?' asks Bông. 'I lost my ball!' Bông looks for the ball under the leaves. 'Here it is! Walk slowly next time!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "autumn leaves are falling down song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): 每 měi, 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 完 wán, 去年 qùnián
zh.cum: Mới: 别哭 bié kū / 为什么哭 wèishénme kū / 别跑 bié pǎo | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): 吃完饭 chīwán fàn / 半个小时 bàn ge xiǎoshí
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 别 + động từ = đừng…] 别哭！（Bié kū!）/ 你为什么哭？（Nǐ wèishénme kū?）– 我的球丢了。（Wǒ de qiú diū le.）/ 妹妹每天哭半个小时！（Mèimei měi tiān kū bàn ge xiǎoshí!）/ 别在房间里跑！（Bié zài fángjiān li pǎo!）/ 去年妹妹不会说话，现在她会了。（Qùnián mèimei bú huì shuōhuà, xiànzài tā huì le.）
zh.truyen: 别哭！ — Bông的妹妹在哭。Bông问：“你为什么哭？”妹妹说：“我的球丢了！”Bông说：“别哭，别哭！我们一起看看。”球在树下面。妹妹说：“谢谢姐姐！”（Bié kū! — Bông de mèimei zài kū. Bông wèn: “Nǐ wèishénme kū?” Mèimei shuō: “Wǒ de qiú diū le!” Bông shuō: “Bié kū, bié kū! Wǒmen yìqǐ kànkan.” Qiú zài shù xiàmiàn. Mèimei shuō: “Xièxie jiějie!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "别哭 儿歌 宝宝"

web.label: Ngày 24. Unit 3 · Ở trên, ở dưới, xung quanh, phía sau, dưới đáy (nhóm 2 + từ nối Unit 2)

en.tu: Mới: back, bottom, above, below, around | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): towel, bottle, plate, glass, balcony, roof, lift
en.cum: Mới: all right / at the back / at the bottom / above the clouds / around the table | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): take the lift / a glass of water
en.cau: Are you all right? – Yes, I'm all right, thank you. / The plane is above the clouds. / The fish is at the bottom of the river. / Put the bottle below the table. / The children sit around the table. / The scientist's bag is at the back of the room.
en.truyen: In the Plane — Bông and her dad are on a plane. The pilot says, 'Hello, everyone! We are above the clouds.' Bông looks below. She can see the sea and a lot of ships. A little girl at the back of the plane is crying. 'Are you all right?' asks Bông. She gives the girl a glass of water. The girl smiles.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "above below prepositions song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 拿 ná, 把 bǎ | Ôn: 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme, 杯子 bēizi, 电脑 diànnǎo, 洗澡 xǐzǎo
zh.cum: Mới: 拿书包 ná shūbāo / 把杯子拿给我 bǎ bēizi ná gěi wǒ / 把书拿来 bǎ shū ná lái | Ôn: 别哭 bié kū
zh.cau: 请你拿你的书包。（Qǐng nǐ ná nǐ de shūbāo.）/ [Ngữ pháp: 把 + đồ vật + động từ] 请把杯子拿给我。（Qǐng bǎ bēizi ná gěi wǒ.）/ 警察把书包拿给Bông。（Jǐngchá bǎ shūbāo ná gěi Bông.）/ 别拿我的铅笔！（Bié ná wǒ de qiānbǐ!）
zh.truyen: 警察帮助我 — Leo的书包丢了。他哭了。一个警察问：“你为什么哭？”Leo说：“我的书包丢了。”警察说：“别哭！”他把书包拿给Leo。Leo说：“谢谢！我长大以后也想当警察！”（Jǐngchá bāngzhù wǒ — Leo de shūbāo diū le. Tā kū le. Yí ge jǐngchá wèn: “Nǐ wèishénme kū?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ de shūbāo diū le.” Jǐngchá shuō: “Bié kū!” Tā bǎ shūbāo ná gěi Leo. Leo shuō: “Xièxie! Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yě xiǎng dāng jǐngchá!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "把字句 儿童 中文 拿给我"

en.flash: Mới: cry, fall, leaf/leaves, lose, slowly, why, back, bottom, above, below, around, all right | Ôn: pilot, vet, police officer, always, sometimes, stairs, towel, bottle, balcony
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh, nghe và tô màu (kiểu Movers Listening Part 5, 4 câu): Colour the bird above the tree blue. / Colour the leaves at the bottom of the tree yellow. / Colour the bottle below the table green. / Colour the boy at the back of the room red. 2) Nối câu hỏi Why…? với câu trả lời (4 câu): Why is the baby crying? – She wants her mum. / Why are you walking slowly? – The stairs are wet. / Why is Leo sad? – He lost his ball. / Why do the leaves fall? – The tree is old. 3) Đóng vai: một bạn khóc, bạn kia hỏi Are you all right? / Why are you crying? / Don't worry!
en.truyen: The Lost Kitten — The leaves are falling in the park. A little girl is crying. 'Are you all right? Why are you crying?' asks Nhan. 'I lost my kitten!' says the girl. Nhan and Bông look around the park. They look below the seats and at the bottom of the stairs. 'Look! It's above us!' says Bông. The kitten is in the tree. A police officer comes. He carries the kitten down slowly. 'Don't worry. Here it is!' The girl stops crying. 'Thank you!'
en.baihat: The Leaves Are Falling (giai điệu London Bridge) — Leaves are falling, falling down, / Falling down, falling down. / Leaves are falling, falling down, / Walk slowly! / Are you all right? Don't you cry, / Don't you cry, don't you cry. / Are you all right? Don't you cry, / I can help you!

zh.flash: Mới: 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme, 拿 ná, 把 bǎ | Ôn: 以后 yǐhòu, 警察 jǐngchá, 帮助 bāngzhù, 每 měi, 半 bàn, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn câu đúng (4 câu): 别哭！/ 别跑！/ 请把杯子拿给我。/ 他拿书包。 2) Sắp xếp từ thành câu với 把 (3 câu): 请 / 把 / 杯子 / 拿给我 → 请把杯子拿给我。/ 警察 / 把 / 书包 / 拿给Leo → 警察把书包拿给Leo。/ 你 / 为什么 / 哭 → 你为什么哭？ 3) Trò chơi 'Cô bảo': cô nói 请把铅笔拿给Bông。/ 请把书包拿给老师。– con làm theo.
zh.truyen: 小猫在哪儿？ — 公园里，一个小女孩在哭。Nhan问：“你为什么哭？”女孩说：“我的小猫丢了！”Nhan说：“别哭！我们帮助你。”大家一起看看：小猫在树上！一个警察来了，他把小猫拿给女孩。女孩说：“谢谢警察！”（Xiǎo māo zài nǎr? — Gōngyuán li, yí ge xiǎo nǚhái zài kū. Nhan wèn: “Nǐ wèishénme kū?” Nǚhái shuō: “Wǒ de xiǎo māo diū le!” Nhan shuō: “Bié kū! Wǒmen bāngzhù nǐ.” Dàjiā yìqǐ kànkan: xiǎo māo zài shù shang! Yí ge jǐngchá lái le, tā bǎ xiǎo māo ná gěi nǚhái. Nǚhái shuō: “Xièxie jǐngchá!”）
zh.baihat: 别哭别哭 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星) — 别哭别哭，为什么哭？我的小猫在哪儿？别哭别哭，我帮助你，警察把它拿给你。别哭别哭，笑一笑，我们都是好朋友。（Bié kū bié kū, wèishénme kū? Wǒ de xiǎo māo zài nǎr? Bié kū bié kū, wǒ bāngzhù nǐ, jǐngchá bǎ tā ná gěi nǐ. Bié kū bié kū, xiào yi xiào, wǒmen dōu shì hǎo péngyou.）

en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: be called = có tên là] My dog is called Lucky. / The vet is called Doctor Lan. / We walk along the river. / The police officer gets out of the car. / Have you got any questions? / The scientist knows everything about leaves.
en.truyen: The Vet Called Doctor Lan — Nhan's cat is sick. They take it to the vet. The vet is called Doctor Lan. She carries the cat out of the box. 'Is it all right?' asks Nhan. 'Yes. It needs some water and sleep,' says Doctor Lan. Nhan and his mum walk home along the river. 'Thank you for everything!' says Nhan.

zh.truyen: 科学家的房间 — Anna的妈妈是科学家。她的房间里有很多东西。妈妈说：“别拿我的东西！走的时候请关门。”Anna一个星期去妈妈的房间两次。她说：“我长大以后也想当科学家！”（Kēxuéjiā de fángjiān — Anna de māma shì kēxuéjiā. Tā de fángjiān li yǒu hěn duō dōngxi. Māma shuō: “Bié ná wǒ de dōngxi! Zǒu de shíhou qǐng guān mén.” Anna yí ge xīngqī qù māma de fángjiān liǎng cì. Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yě xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā!”）

en.truyen: Guess the Job! (nghe – không tranh) — This person works in a plane. The plane flies above the clouds. This person carries a hundred people from Vietnam to England. Who is it? – It's a pilot! / This person helps sick animals. Her workplace is called an animal hospital. Who is it? – It's a vet!

zh.cau: 你长大以后想当什么？（Nǐ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme?）– 我想当牙医。（Wǒ xiǎng dāng yáyī.）/ 你为什么想当警察？（Nǐ wèishénme xiǎng dāng jǐngchá?）– 我想帮助大家。（Wǒ xiǎng bāngzhù dàjiā.）/ 请把门关了。（Qǐng bǎ mén guān le.）/ 我一个星期去两次医院看奶奶。（Wǒ yí ge xīngqī qù liǎng cì yīyuàn kàn nǎinai.）
zh.truyen: 猜一猜（nghe – không tranh）— 他在医院工作，他每天帮助病人。他是谁？——他是医生！她不在医院工作，她在饭店工作，她每天做饭。她是谁？——她是厨师！（Cāi yi cāi — Tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, tā měi tiān bāngzhù bìngrén. Tā shì shéi? — Tā shì yīshēng! Tā bú zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, tā zài fàndiàn gōngzuò, tā měi tiān zuòfàn. Tā shì shéi? — Tā shì chúshī!）

en.slide: 1) Đọc và chọn từ đúng (kiểu Movers Reading Part 4, 5 chỗ trống): Nhan's cat is ___ Tom. (called) / They walk ___ the river. (along) / The vet takes the cat ___ of the box. (out) / 'Have you got ___ questions?' (any) / 'Thank you for ___!' (everything) 2) Trò chơi Guess the Job: con mô tả 2 câu, cả lớp đoán: This person works in a hospital. This person helps sick people. (doctor / nurse) 3) Vẽ và nói về ước mơ: I want to be a ___ when I grow up. My workplace is called ___.
en.truyen: Doctor Lan the Vet — Nhan's cat is called Tom. One day, Tom is sick. He doesn't want to eat anything. Nhan and his mum carry Tom in a box and walk along the river to the vet. The vet is called Doctor Lan. She takes Tom out of the box slowly. 'Why is he sick?' asks Nhan. 'He needs some water and a lot of sleep,' says Doctor Lan. 'Have you got any questions?' 'No. Thank you for everything!' says Nhan. 'I want to be a vet like you when I grow up!'
en.baihat: My Cat Is Called Tom (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — My cat's called Tom and he is sick, / He is sick, he is sick. / We walk along the river, Tom, / To see the vet! / Doctor Lan says, 'He's all right, / He's all right, he's all right.' / Tom needs water and some sleep. / Thank you for everything!

zh.truyen: 科学家的房间 — Anna的妈妈是科学家。她的房间里有很多东西：书、电脑、一百个小盒子。妈妈说：“别拿我的东西！走的时候请关门。”Anna一个星期去妈妈的房间两次。有一次，她把门关了，妈妈说：“谢谢你！”Anna说：“妈妈，我长大以后也想当科学家！”（Kēxuéjiā de fángjiān — Anna de māma shì kēxuéjiā. Tā de fángjiān li yǒu hěn duō dōngxi: shū, diànnǎo, yìbǎi ge xiǎo hézi. Māma shuō: “Bié ná wǒ de dōngxi! Zǒu de shíhou qǐng guān mén.” Anna yí ge xīngqī qù māma de fángjiān liǎng cì. Yǒu yí cì, tā bǎ mén guān le, māma shuō: “Xièxie nǐ!” Anna shuō: “Māma, wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yě xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā!”）
zh.baihat: 请关门 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — 请关门，请关门，走的时候请关门。一次两次三次，每次都关门！（Qǐng guān mén, qǐng guān mén, zǒu de shíhou qǐng guān mén. Yí cì liǎng cì sān cì, měi cì dōu guān mén!）

en.tu: Ôn: police officer, pilot, vet, scientist, grow, future, cry, fall, lose, why, above, below, around, along, out of, everything | Ôn khóa trước: oh dear, don't worry, whose, young, little, children

en.cau: Whose bag is this? – It's the little boy's bag. / Oh dear! The boy is crying. / Don't worry! I can help you. / He lost his bag along the river. / When I grow up, I want to be a police officer.
en.truyen: The Little Police Officer — Leo wants to be a police officer when he grows up. One day, he sees a little boy. The boy is crying. 'Oh dear! Why are you crying?' asks Leo. 'I lost my bag!' Leo looks around. He sees a bag below a tree, under the leaves. 'Whose bag is this?' 'It's mine!' says the boy. 'Don't worry. Here it is!' 'Thank you! You are a little police officer!'

zh.cau: 小弟弟，你为什么哭？（Xiǎo dìdi, nǐ wèishénme kū?）/ 别哭，我帮助你。（Bié kū, wǒ bāngzhù nǐ.）/ 这是你的书包吗？（Zhè shì nǐ de shūbāo ma?）/ Leo把书包拿给小弟弟。（Leo bǎ shūbāo ná gěi xiǎo dìdi.）/ 没关系！（Méi guānxi!）
