en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 3 – Nghe và đánh dấu tranh đúng (kiểu Movers Listening Part 4, 5 câu): What does Bông want to be? (pilot) / Why is the boy crying? (He lost his bag.) / Where is the bag? (below the tree) / What is the cat called? (Tom) / Where do they walk? (along the river) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: What do you want to be? / I want to be a vet. / Doctors help sick people. 3) Đóng vai truyện 'The Little Police Officer': Leo, the little boy, the boy's mum.
en.truyen: The Little Police Officer (đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai) — Leo wants to be a police officer when he grows up. One Saturday, he walks along the river with his dad. He sees a little boy. The boy is crying. 'Oh dear! Are you all right? Why are you crying?' asks Leo. 'I lost my bag! My new book is in it!' Leo and his dad look around. Leo sees something below a tree, under the leaves. It's a blue bag! 'Whose bag is this?' 'It's mine!' says the boy. He takes his book out of the bag. 'Everything is here!' The boy's mum comes. 'Thank you! What's your name?' 'I'm Leo.' 'You are a little police officer, Leo!'
en.baihat: Helpers Song (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The police officer helps us every day, / Every day, every day. / The police officer helps us every day, / Don't cry, don't cry! / The vet helps the animals every day, / Every day, every day. / The vet helps the animals every day, / All right, all right!

zh.flash: Ôn: 以后 yǐhòu, 科学家 kēxuéjiā, 警察 jǐngchá, 长大 zhǎngdà, 当 dāng, 帮助 bāngzhù, 百 bǎi, 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme, 拿 ná, 把 bǎ, 关 guān, 次 cì
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 3 – Nghe chọn tranh (kiểu YCT3, 5 câu): 我长大以后想当科学家。/ 医生帮助病人。/ 别哭！/ 请把书包拿给我。/ 请关门。 2) Đọc và nối câu hỏi – câu trả lời (4 câu): 你为什么哭？– 我的书包丢了。/ 你想当什么？– 我想当警察。/ 你爸爸是做什么的？– 他是司机。/ 你一个星期学几次汉语？– 三次。 3) Phiên dịch nhí: Don't cry! → 别哭！（Bié kū!）/ Please close the door. → 请关门。（Qǐng guān mén.）/ I want to be a scientist. → 我想当科学家。（Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā.）
zh.truyen: 小警察（đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai）— Leo长大以后想当警察。星期六，他和爸爸在河旁边散步。他看见一个小弟弟在哭。Leo问：“你为什么哭？”小弟弟说：“我的书包丢了！我的新书在书包里。”Leo说：“别哭，我们帮助你！”他们一起看看：书包在树下面！Leo把书包拿给小弟弟。小弟弟的妈妈说：“谢谢你！你真是一个小警察！”Leo说：“没关系！”（Xiǎo jǐngchá — Leo zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jǐngchá. Xīngqīliù, tā hé bàba zài hé pángbiān sànbù. Tā kànjiàn yí ge xiǎo dìdi zài kū. Leo wèn: “Nǐ wèishénme kū?” Xiǎo dìdi shuō: “Wǒ de shūbāo diū le! Wǒ de xīn shū zài shūbāo li.” Leo shuō: “Bié kū, wǒmen bāngzhù nǐ!” Tāmen yìqǐ kànkan: shūbāo zài shù xiàmiàn! Leo bǎ shūbāo ná gěi xiǎo dìdi. Xiǎo dìdi de māma shuō: “Xièxie nǐ! Nǐ zhēn shì yí ge xiǎo jǐngchá!” Leo shuō: “Méi guānxi!”）
zh.baihat: 小警察 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 小小警察，小小警察，别哭了，别哭了。我来帮助你，我来帮助你，真快乐，真快乐！（Xiǎoxiǎo jǐngchá, xiǎoxiǎo jǐngchá, bié kū le, bié kū le. Wǒ lái bāngzhù nǐ, wǒ lái bāngzhù nǐ, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè!）

blocks.title: Unit 4 · My Favourite Colour · 我最喜欢的颜色

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 15. Unit 4 · My Favourite Colour – 我最喜欢的颜色 · Màu con thích, quần áo, mặc vào – cởi ra

web.label: Ngày 29. Unit 4 · Màu con thích nhất; áo len, mặc vào, cởi ra (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: dream, sweater, straight, most | Ôn: colour, favourite, coat, scarf, shirt, cold
en.cum: Mới: put on / take off / put on your sweater / take off your coat | Ôn: my favourite colour
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: like … best / most] What's your favourite colour? – I like white best. / I really like blue. / Which colour do you like most? – I like green most. / It's cold. Put on your sweater! / Take off your coat, please. / Anna has long straight hair.
en.truyen: My Dream Sweater — It's cold. Bông puts on her old sweater. 'I have a dream,' she says. 'I want a white sweater with blue stars!' On her birthday, Grandma gives her a present. It's a white sweater with blue stars! 'This is the sweater I like most!' Bông takes off her old sweater and puts on the new one.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what's your favourite colour song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 最 zuì, 衣服 yīfu, 件 jiàn, 帽子 màozi | Ôn: 颜色 yánsè, 喜欢 xǐhuan, 白色 báisè, 蓝色 lánsè, 红色 hóngsè, 穿 chuān
zh.cum: Mới: 最喜欢 zuì xǐhuan / 一件衣服 yí jiàn yīfu / 红色的帽子 hóngsè de màozi | Ôn: 什么颜色 shénme yánsè
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 最喜欢 = thích nhất] 你最喜欢什么颜色？（Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè?）– 我最喜欢白色。（Wǒ zuì xǐhuan báisè.）/ 我很喜欢蓝色。（Wǒ hěn xǐhuan lánsè.）/ 你的帽子是什么颜色的？（Nǐ de màozi shì shénme yánsè de?）– 我的帽子是红色的。（Wǒ de màozi shì hóngsè de.）/ 我的衣服是红色的。（Wǒ de yīfu shì hóngsè de.）
zh.truyen: 我最喜欢的衣服 — 今天是Bông的生日。奶奶给她一件白色的衣服和一个蓝色的帽子。Bông说：“我最喜欢白色！我也很喜欢蓝色！”她穿上新衣服，说：“这是我最喜欢的衣服！”（Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de yīfu — Jīntiān shì Bông de shēngrì. Nǎinai gěi tā yí jiàn báisè de yīfu hé yí ge lánsè de màozi. Bông shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan báisè! Wǒ yě hěn xǐhuan lánsè!” Tā chuānshang xīn yīfu, shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de yīfu!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "颜色歌 儿歌 你最喜欢什么颜色"

web.label: Ngày 30. Unit 4 · Mặc đồ, cởi đồ; mũ bảo hiểm, bên ngoài, an toàn (nhóm 1)

en.tu: Mới: helmet, outside, safe | Ôn: sweater, shoe, sock, trousers, shorts, bike
en.cum: Mới: get dressed / get undressed / put on your helmet / play outside | Ôn: take off your shoes
en.cau: Get dressed, Leo! It's time for school. / I get undressed and have a shower. / Put on your helmet when you ride a bike. / With a helmet, you are safe. / Let's play outside!
en.truyen: Safe on the Bike — Leo gets dressed. He puts on his shorts, his socks and his shoes. 'Can I ride my bike outside?' he asks. 'Yes, but put on your helmet!' says Dad. 'With a helmet, you are safe.' In the evening, Leo gets undressed and has a shower.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "getting dressed song for kids put on"

zh.tu: Mới: 裙子 qúnzi, 裤子 kùzi, 鞋 xié, 酷 kù | Ôn: 衣服 yīfu, 件 jiàn, 最 zuì, 帽子 màozi, 条 tiáo, 穿 chuān
zh.cum: Mới: 一条裙子 yì tiáo qúnzi / 一条裤子 yì tiáo kùzi / 新鞋 xīn xié / 很酷 hěn kù | Ôn: 一件衣服 yí jiàn yīfu
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: tính từ làm vị ngữ – chủ ngữ + 很 + tính từ] 这条裙子很漂亮。（Zhè tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang.）/ 这条裤子很酷！（Zhè tiáo kùzi hěn kù!）/ 这个书包很新。（Zhège shūbāo hěn xīn.）/ 我的新鞋是白色的。（Wǒ de xīn xié shì báisè de.）/ 你最喜欢哪条裙子？（Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎ tiáo qúnzi?）
zh.truyen: 很酷的裤子 — Leo有一条新裤子，是蓝色的。Leo说：“这条裤子很酷！”Xiaomei有一条红色的裙子。她说：“我的裙子很漂亮！”他们穿上新鞋，一起去上学。（Hěn kù de kùzi — Leo yǒu yì tiáo xīn kùzi, shì lánsè de. Leo shuō: “Zhè tiáo kùzi hěn kù!” Xiaomei yǒu yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi. Tā shuō: “Wǒ de qúnzi hěn piàoliang!” Tāmen chuānshang xīn xié, yìqǐ qù shàngxué.）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "穿衣服 儿歌 裙子 裤子"

en.flash: Mới: dream, sweater, straight, most, helmet, outside, safe, put on, take off, get dressed, get undressed | Ôn: colour, favourite, coat, scarf, shirt, shoe, sock, trousers, shorts, skirt
en.slide: 1) Nghe và tô màu quần áo (kiểu Movers Listening Part 5, 5 câu): Colour Bông's sweater white. / Colour Leo's helmet orange. / Colour Anna's scarf purple. / Colour Nhan's shorts green. / Colour the boy's socks pink. 2) Nhìn tranh chọn put on / take off (4 câu): It's cold. Put on your coat. / It's hot. Take off your sweater. / Put on your helmet. / Take off your shoes. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: What's your favourite colour? – I like ___ best. / What colour is your sweater? – It's ___.
en.truyen: Bông's Dream Sweater — It's a cold morning. Bông gets dressed. She puts on her old sweater, but it's very small. 'I have a dream,' she tells Mum. 'I want a white sweater with blue stars. White is the colour I like most!' On Saturday, it's Bông's birthday. Grandma gives her a big present. It's a white sweater with blue stars! Bông takes off her old sweater and puts on her new one. Then she puts on her helmet and rides her bike outside. 'Now I'm safe and happy!' says Bông.
en.baihat: Put On, Take Off (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — Put on your sweater, it's cold today, / Cold today, cold today. / Put on your sweater, it's cold today, / Then go out and play! / Put on your helmet, you are safe, / You are safe, you are safe. / Put on your helmet, you are safe, / Ride your bike today!

zh.flash: Mới: 最 zuì, 衣服 yīfu, 件 jiàn, 帽子 màozi, 裙子 qúnzi, 裤子 kùzi, 鞋 xié, 酷 kù | Ôn: 颜色 yánsè, 白色 báisè, 蓝色 lánsè, 红色 hóngsè, 条 tiáo, 穿 chuān, 漂亮 piàoliang, 新 xīn
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (5 câu): 衣服 / 帽子 / 裙子 / 裤子 / 鞋. 2) Chọn lượng từ 件 / 条 / 个 (4 câu): 一___衣服（件）/ 一___裙子（条）/ 一___裤子（条）/ 一___帽子（个） 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你最喜欢什么颜色？– 我最喜欢___。/ 你的帽子是什么颜色的？– 是___的。/ 这条裙子漂亮吗？– 这条裙子很漂亮。
zh.truyen: Bông的生日 — 星期六是Bông的生日。奶奶给她一件白色的衣服和一个蓝色的帽子。妈妈给她一条红色的裙子。Bông说：“我最喜欢白色，我也很喜欢红色！”弟弟Nhan有一条新裤子和新鞋。Nhan说：“我的裤子很酷！”Bông说：“我的裙子很漂亮！”（Bông de shēngrì — Xīngqīliù shì Bông de shēngrì. Nǎinai gěi tā yí jiàn báisè de yīfu hé yí ge lánsè de màozi. Māma gěi tā yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi. Bông shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan báisè, wǒ yě hěn xǐhuan hóngsè!” Dìdi Nhan yǒu yì tiáo xīn kùzi hé xīn xié. Nhan shuō: “Wǒ de kùzi hěn kù!” Bông shuō: “Wǒ de qúnzi hěn piàoliang!”）
zh.baihat: 我最喜欢 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 什么颜色？什么颜色？最喜欢，最喜欢？我最喜欢白色，我也喜欢红色，真漂亮，真漂亮！（Shénme yánsè? Shénme yánsè? Zuì xǐhuan, zuì xǐhuan? Wǒ zuì xǐhuan báisè, wǒ yě xǐhuan hóngsè, zhēn piàoliang, zhēn piàoliang!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 16. Unit 4 · My Favourite Colour – 我最喜欢的颜色 · Yên lặng – ồn ào, khỏe – yếu; màu cam, hồng, tím

web.label: Ngày 31. Unit 4 · Nhanh, yên lặng, tiếng ồn, ai đó (nhóm 2 + từ nối Unit 3)

en.tu: Mới: quick, quiet, noise, someone | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): police officer, pilot, scientist, why, cry, slowly
en.cum: Mới: be quiet / make a noise / a quick shower | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): all right / be called
en.cau: Be quiet, please! The baby is sleeping. / Why is someone making a noise outside? / Someone is crying. Are you all right? / Have a quick shower, Leo! / The police officer walks slowly. He is very quiet.
en.truyen: A Noise in the Night — At night, Nhan hears a noise. 'Someone is outside!' he says. Dad goes outside slowly. 'It's all right! It's our cat. She is called Mimi.' Nhan smiles. 'Be quiet, Mimi! Come in, quick!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "quiet and loud song for kids opposites"

zh.tu: Mới: 橙 chéng, 粉 fěn, 紫 zǐ | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): 警察 jǐngchá, 科学家 kēxuéjiā, 以后 yǐhòu, 帮助 bāngzhù, 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme
zh.cum: Mới: 橙色 chéngsè / 粉色 fěnsè / 紫色 zǐsè / 粉色的裙子 fěnsè de qúnzi | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): 别哭 bié kū
zh.cau: 你最喜欢什么颜色？（Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè?）– 我最喜欢紫色。（Wǒ zuì xǐhuan zǐsè.）/ 妹妹的裙子是粉色的。（Mèimei de qúnzi shì fěnsè de.）/ 警察的帽子不是橙色的。（Jǐngchá de màozi bú shì chéngsè de.）/ 别哭，我把我的粉色帽子给你。（Bié kū, wǒ bǎ wǒ de fěnsè màozi gěi nǐ.）
zh.truyen: 粉色还是紫色？ — 妹妹在哭。Bông问：“你为什么哭？”妹妹说：“我想要粉色的裙子！”妈妈说：“别哭！这是一条粉色的裙子，那是一条紫色的裙子。”妹妹说：“我最喜欢粉色！”（Fěnsè háishi zǐsè? — Mèimei zài kū. Bông wèn: “Nǐ wèishénme kū?” Mèimei shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng yào fěnsè de qúnzi!” Māma shuō: “Bié kū! Zhè shì yì tiáo fěnsè de qúnzi, nà shì yì tiáo zǐsè de qúnzi.” Mèimei shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan fěnsè!”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "颜色 橙色 紫色 粉色 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 32. Unit 4 · Khỏe, yếu, một đôi; ba lô (nhóm 2 + từ nối Unit 3)

en.tu: Mới: strong, weak, pair | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): carry, need, hundred, build, engineer, back
en.cum: Mới: rucksack (US: backpack) / carry a rucksack / a pair of shoes / a pair of socks | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): at the back
en.cau: I carry my books in my rucksack. / Leo's backpack is orange. / I need a new pair of shoes. / Engineers are strong. They carry a hundred stones! / The baby bird is weak. It can't fly.
en.truyen: The Big Rucksack — Nhan's rucksack is very big. There are ten books, a pair of shoes and a bottle of water in it. 'I'm not strong. I'm weak!' says Nhan. Dad smiles. 'You need a small rucksack. Let's put the shoes at the back of the car.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what's in my backpack song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 外面 wàimiàn, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 进 jìn | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): 拿 ná, 把 bǎ, 关 guān, 次 cì, 百 bǎi
zh.cum: Mới: 在外面 zài wàimiàn / 拿雨伞 ná yǔsǎn / 请进 qǐng jìn / 进房间 jìn fángjiān | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): 关门 guān mén
zh.cau: 外面下雨了，拿雨伞！（Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, ná yǔsǎn!）/ 请进！（Qǐng jìn!）/ 进房间，请关门。（Jìn fángjiān, qǐng guān mén.）/ 我的雨伞是紫色的。（Wǒ de yǔsǎn shì zǐsè de.）/ 请把雨伞放在外面。（Qǐng bǎ yǔsǎn fàng zài wàimiàn.）
zh.truyen: 紫色的雨伞 — 外面下雨了。Xiaomei拿她的紫色雨伞去上学。在学校，她把雨伞放在外面，进学校。下午，雨伞丢了！老师说：“别哭，你的雨伞在门外面。”（Zǐsè de yǔsǎn — Wàimiàn xià yǔ le. Xiaomei ná tā de zǐsè yǔsǎn qù shàngxué. Zài xuéxiào, tā bǎ yǔsǎn fàng zài wàimiàn, jìn xuéxiào. Xiàwǔ, yǔsǎn diū le! Lǎoshī shuō: “Bié kū, nǐ de yǔsǎn zài mén wàimiàn.”）
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小雨伞 儿歌"

en.flash: Mới: quick, quiet, noise, someone, strong, weak, pair, rucksack, backpack | Ôn: police officer, pilot, scientist, why, cry, slowly, carry, need, hundred, engineer, back
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ đúng quiet / strong / weak / quick (4 câu): The library is quiet. / The engineer is strong. / The baby bird is weak. / Leo is quick on his bike. 2) Đọc và viết Yes/No (kiểu Movers Reading Part 2, 4 câu): There is a pair of shoes in the rucksack. / Someone is making a noise. / The police officer is quiet. / The rucksack is at the back of the car. 3) Trò chơi 'What's in my rucksack?': con đoán đồ trong ba lô của cô: Is there a pair of socks? / Is there a bottle of water?
en.truyen: Who Is Making That Noise? — It's night. Everyone is sleeping. Nhan hears a big noise. 'Someone is outside!' he says. Dad gets up. He puts on his sweater and takes his rucksack. He walks slowly outside. 'Be quiet, Nhan,' he says. Then Dad smiles. 'It's all right! It's only Mimi, our cat. She's playing with your pair of shoes!' Mimi is small and weak, but she makes a big noise. 'Come in, quick, Mimi!' says Nhan.
en.baihat: Be Quiet (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Be quiet, quiet, please, / The baby's sleeping, can't you see? / Someone's making a noise outside, / Is it a cat? Let's go and hide! / Be quiet, quiet, please, / The baby's sleeping, can't you see?

zh.flash: Mới: 橙 chéng, 粉 fěn, 紫 zǐ, 外面 wàimiàn, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 进 jìn | Ôn: 最 zuì, 衣服 yīfu, 裙子 qúnzi, 帽子 màozi, 警察 jǐngchá, 别 bié, 哭 kū, 拿 ná, 把 bǎ, 关 guān
zh.slide: 1) Nghe tô màu (kiểu YCT, 4 câu): 雨伞是紫色的。/ 帽子是橙色的。/ 裙子是粉色的。/ 鞋是白色的。 2) Nhìn tranh chọn câu đúng (3 câu): 外面下雨了。/ 请进！/ 请把雨伞放在外面。 3) Đóng vai: một bạn gõ cửa, bạn kia nói 请进！请把雨伞放在外面。请关门。
zh.truyen: 紫色的雨伞 — 外面下雨了。Xiaomei拿她的紫色雨伞去上学。妹妹穿粉色的裙子，她的帽子是橙色的。在学校，Xiaomei把雨伞放在外面，进学校。下午，雨伞丢了！Xiaomei说：“我的紫色雨伞呢？”老师说：“别哭，你的雨伞在门外面。”Xiaomei说：“谢谢老师！我最喜欢紫色！”（Zǐsè de yǔsǎn — Wàimiàn xià yǔ le. Xiaomei ná tā de zǐsè yǔsǎn qù shàngxué. Mèimei chuān fěnsè de qúnzi, tā de màozi shì chéngsè de. Zài xuéxiào, Xiaomei bǎ yǔsǎn fàng zài wàimiàn, jìn xuéxiào. Xiàwǔ, yǔsǎn diū le! Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ de zǐsè yǔsǎn ne?” Lǎoshī shuō: “Bié kū, nǐ de yǔsǎn zài mén wàimiàn.” Xiaomei shuō: “Xièxie lǎoshī! Wǒ zuì xǐhuan zǐsè!”）
zh.baihat: 小雨伞 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — 下雨了，下雨了，外面下雨了。紫色雨伞，粉色雨伞，橙色的雨伞！（Xià yǔ le, xià yǔ le, wàimiàn xià yǔ le. Zǐsè yǔsǎn, fěnsè yǔsǎn, chéngsè de yǔsǎn!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 17. Unit 4 · My Favourite Colour – 我最喜欢的颜色 · Tệ – tệ hơn – tệ nhất; ôn màu sắc và quần áo

web.label: Ngày 33. Unit 4 · Tệ, tệ hơn, tệ nhất; ngạc nhiên (nhóm 3)

en.tu: Mới: terrible, worse, worst, surprised | Ôn: most, best, good, bad, weak, strong
en.cum: Mới: the worst day / a terrible noise / be surprised | Ôn: like … best / put on
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh bad – worse – worst] My old shoes are bad. Leo's shoes are worse. Nhan's shoes are the worst! / This is a terrible noise! / Bông is surprised. Her sweater is pink! / Today is the worst day! I lost my rucksack.
en.truyen: The Worst Day — Today is a terrible day for Leo. It's cold and he can't find his sweater. His shoes are wet. Then he loses his helmet. 'This is the worst day!' he says. But in the afternoon, he is surprised. His friends give him a new orange helmet! 'Now it's the best day!'

zh.cau: 你找什么？（Nǐ zhǎo shénme?）– 我找我的鞋。（Wǒ zhǎo wǒ de xié.）/ 这件衣服一千块。（Zhè jiàn yīfu yìqiān kuài.）/ 商店里有一千个帽子！（Shāngdiàn li yǒu yìqiān ge màozi!）/ 我找到了！（Wǒ zhǎodào le!）

en.slide: 1) Nhìn 3 tranh, điền bad / worse / the worst (3 câu): Leo's drawing is bad. / Nhan's drawing is worse. / The cat's drawing is the worst! 2) Nghe và nối người với quần áo (kiểu Movers Listening Part 2, 5 câu): Xiaomei – pink skirt / Leo – orange helmet / Anna – purple rucksack / Bông – white sweater / Nhan – a pair of green socks. 3) Kể theo tranh 'The Worst Day' (4 tranh): con nói mỗi tranh 1–2 câu.
en.truyen: The Worst Day — Today is a terrible day for Leo. It's cold and he can't find his sweater. 'Someone has my sweater!' he shouts. Then he puts on his shoes, but they are wet. 'Oh no, this is worse!' At school, he loses his helmet. 'This is the worst day!' he says. He is very sad and quiet. But in the afternoon, he is surprised. His friends give him a present. It's a new orange helmet and a pair of new socks! 'Thank you! Now it's the best day!'
en.baihat: Bad, Worse, Worst (giai điệu London Bridge) — My shoes are wet, it's bad, it's bad, / Bad, bad, bad, bad. / I lost my helmet, that is worse, / The worst day! / My friends are here with a present for me, / For me, for me. / I'm surprised, I'm happy now, / The best day!

zh.truyen: 找鞋 — 早上，Leo找他的鞋。不在房间里，不在外面，不在书包里。Leo说：“我的鞋呢？”妈妈说：“你的鞋在雨伞下面！”Leo说：“找到了！”下午，Leo和妈妈去商店。商店里有一千个帽子，有红色的、橙色的、紫色的。Leo说：“这个橙色的帽子最酷！”妈妈说：“这个帽子一百块。”（Zhǎo xié — Zǎoshang, Leo zhǎo tā de xié. Bú zài fángjiān li, bú zài wàimiàn, bú zài shūbāo li. Leo shuō: “Wǒ de xié ne?” Māma shuō: “Nǐ de xié zài yǔsǎn xiàmiàn!” Leo shuō: “Zhǎodào le!” Xiàwǔ, Leo hé māma qù shāngdiàn. Shāngdiàn li yǒu yìqiān ge màozi, yǒu hóngsè de, chéngsè de, zǐsè de. Leo shuō: “Zhège chéngsè de màozi zuì kù!” Māma shuō: “Zhège màozi yìbǎi kuài.”）
zh.baihat: 找鞋子 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 找啊找啊，找啊找啊，我的鞋，我的鞋。不在房间里面，就在雨伞下面，找到了，找到了！（Zhǎo a zhǎo a, zhǎo a zhǎo a, wǒ de xié, wǒ de xié. Bú zài fángjiān lǐmiàn, jiù zài yǔsǎn xiàmiàn, zhǎodào le, zhǎodào le!）

en.truyen: The Clothes Party — It's a clothes party! Everyone must wear the colours of their country. Anna puts on a red, white and blue sweater, like the flag of England. zh.cau: Bông穿越南的颜色：红色和黄色。（Bông chuān Yuènán de yánsè: hóngsè hé huángsè.）/ Anna的衣服是英国的颜色。（Anna de yīfu shì Yīngguó de yánsè.）/ Brown先生的帽子丢了！（Brown xiānsheng de màozi diū le!）/ 谁的衣服最酷？（Shéi de yīfu zuì kù?）
zh.truyen: 国家的颜色 — 今天大家都穿自己国家的颜色。Bông穿一条红色的裙子和一件黄色的衣服，是越南的颜色。Anna的衣服是红色、白色和蓝色的，是英国的颜色。Brown先生有一个很酷的帽子，帽子上有玫瑰花。下午，他的帽子丢了！大家一起找，帽子在外面！（Guójiā de yánsè — Jīntiān dàjiā dōu chuān zìjǐ guójiā de yánsè. Bông chuān yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi hé yí jiàn huángsè de yīfu, shì Yuènán de yánsè. Anna de yīfu shì hóngsè, báisè hé lánsè de, shì Yīngguó de yánsè. en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 4 – Đọc và chọn từ điền chỗ trống (kiểu Movers Reading Part 3, 5 câu): It's cold. ___ on your sweater. (Put) / A ___ keeps your head safe. (helmet) / Be ___! (worst) 2) Nghe và tô màu tranh 'The Clothes Party' (5 câu): Anna's sweater is red, white and blue. / Bông's skirt is red. / Leo's helmet is blue. / The clown's coat is purple. / The clown's hair is blond. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: What's your favourite colour? / I like white best. / This skirt is very pretty.
en.truyen: The Clothes Party (đọc đầy đủ, đóng vai) — It's a clothes party at school! Everyone must wear the colours of their country. Anna puts on a red, white and blue sweater, like the flag of England. Bông gets dressed in a red skirt and a yellow shirt, like the flag of Vietnam. Leo puts on a blue helmet with white stars, like the flag of America. Xiaomei has a red dress with yellow stars, like the flag of China. Then a clown comes in. He has curly blond hair and a big green, purple and orange coat. 'Which country is that?' asks Leo. Everyone is surprised. The clown takes off his hair. It's Grandpa! 'These are the worst clothes at the party!' says Bông. 'No, they are the best!' says Grandpa.
en.baihat: My Favourite Colour (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — What's your favourite, / What's your favourite, / Favourite colour? / Favourite colour? / I like white the best, / I like blue the most, / Red is nice, / Purple too!

en.cum: Ôn: look for / could swim / lift (US: elevator) / how often / how long / half past seven / a quarter past eight / have a shower
en.cau: Where are you from? – I'm from Vietnam. / How old are you? – I'm eight years old. / My grandpa has a beard and he could swim very well. / What time is it? – It's half past seven. / How often do you have a shower? – Every day. / How long do you study every day? – For thirty minutes.
en.truyen: Grandpa's Day — Grandpa is from Vietnam. He has a white beard and a moustache. He always gets up at a quarter past five. He has a shower and dries his face with a towel. He usually has his first meal on the balcony at six o'clock. Then he takes the lift downstairs and walks for thirty minutes. 'How often do you walk, Grandpa?' asks Nhan. 'Every day!'

zh.tu: Ôn Unit 1: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 法国 Fǎguó, 德国 Déguó, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā | Ôn Unit 2: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán, 去年 qùnián
zh.cum: Ôn: 哪国人 nǎ guó rén / 越南人 Yuènán rén / 我自己 wǒ zìjǐ / 七点半 qī diǎn bàn / 每天 měi tiān / 吃完饭 chīwán fàn / 一个小时 yí ge xiǎoshí
zh.cau: 你是哪国人？（Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?）– 我是越南人。（Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.）/ 我的书包丢了，所以我很不快乐。（Wǒ de shūbāo diū le, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn bú kuàilè.）/ 现在几点？– 现在五点十分。（Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? – Xiànzài wǔ diǎn shí fēn.）/ 我每天学习一个小时。（Wǒ měi tiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí.）/ 吃完饭，我洗澡。（Chīwán fàn, wǒ xǐzǎo.）
zh.truyen: 爷爷的一天 — 爷爷是越南人。他每天五点半起床，自己做早饭。吃完早饭，他用电脑半个小时。去年，爷爷不会用电脑，现在他会了！晚上，他洗澡，看书。爷爷说：“我每天都很快乐！”（Yéye de yì tiān — Yéye shì Yuènán rén. Tā měi tiān wǔ diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn. Chīwán zǎofàn, tā yòng diànnǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí. Qùnián, yéye bú huì yòng diànnǎo, xiànzài tā huì le! Wǎnshang, tā xǐzǎo, kàn shū. Yéye shuō: “Wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn kuàilè!”）

en.cau: What do you want to be when you grow up? – I want to be a pilot. / Why is the girl crying? – She lost her rucksack. / The plane is above the clouds. / What's your favourite colour? – I like purple best. / Put on your helmet. It keeps you safe. / This is the worst day!
en.truyen: The Pilot's Sweater — Anna's dream is to be a pilot in the future. Today, she gets dressed in a blue sweater and puts on her helmet. She rides her bike along the river. Then she falls! She doesn't cry. 'Are you all right?' asks a police officer. 'Yes! Pilots are strong!' says Anna. She looks at her sweater. It's wet. 'Oh no, it's my favourite sweater!'

zh.tu: Ôn Unit 3: 以后 yǐhòu, 科学家 kēxuéjiā, 警察 jǐngchá, 长大 zhǎngdà, 当 dāng, 帮助 bāngzhù, 百 bǎi, 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme, 拿 ná, 把 bǎ, 关 guān, 次 cì | Ôn Unit 4: 最 zuì, 衣服 yīfu, 件 jiàn, 帽子 màozi, 裙子 qúnzi, 裤子 kùzi, 鞋 xié, 酷 kù, 橙 chéng, 粉 fěn, 紫 zǐ, 外面 wàimiàn, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 进 jìn, 找 zhǎo, 千 qiān
zh.cum: Ôn: 长大以后 zhǎngdà yǐhòu / 想当警察 xiǎng dāng jǐngchá / 别哭 bié kū / 把杯子拿给我 bǎ bēizi ná gěi wǒ / 最喜欢 zuì xǐhuan / 一条裙子 yì tiáo qúnzi / 找雨伞 zhǎo yǔsǎn
zh.cau: 你长大以后想当什么？（Nǐ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme?）– 我想当科学家。（Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā.）/ 你为什么哭？（Nǐ wèishénme kū?）/ 请把雨伞拿给我。（Qǐng bǎ yǔsǎn ná gěi wǒ.）/ 你最喜欢什么颜色？– 我最喜欢紫色。（Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè? – Wǒ zuì xǐhuan zǐsè.）/ 这条裙子很漂亮。（Zhè tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang.）
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的雨伞 — Xiaomei长大以后想当科学家。今天外面下雨了，她拿她的紫色雨伞去上学。在学校，雨伞丢了！她想哭。Leo说：“别哭！我帮助你找。”他们找了三次，雨伞在门外面！Xiaomei说：“谢谢你！你长大以后可以当警察！”（Xiaomei de yǔsǎn — Xiaomei zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā. Jīntiān wàimiàn xià yǔ le, tā ná tā de zǐsè yǔsǎn qù shàngxué. Zài xuéxiào, yǔsǎn diū le! Tā xiǎng kū. Leo shuō: “Bié kū! Wǒ bāngzhù nǐ zhǎo.” Tāmen zhǎo le sān cì, yǔsǎn zài mén wàimiàn! Xiaomei shuō: “Xièxie nǐ! Nǐ zhǎngdà yǐhòu kěyǐ dāng jǐngchá!”）

en.truyen: Our Class Book — Mrs Lee's class makes a book about themselves. Anna writes: 'I'm from England. I'm eight. I always get up at half past six. I want to be a pilot. My favourite colour is blue.' Leo writes: 'I'm from America. My dad is an engineer. I usually have a shower after dinner. I want to be a police officer. I like orange best.' Bông writes: 'I'm from Vietnam. My grandpa has a white beard. I want to be a scientist. My dream sweater is white with blue stars.' Mrs Lee says, 'What a great book! Everything is here!'

zh.truyen: 我们的书 — 老师说：“我们做一本书吧！”Anna说：“我是英国人，我八岁。我每天六点半起床。我长大以后想当科学家。我最喜欢蓝色。”Leo说：“我是美国人。我每天学习一个小时。我想当警察，帮助大家。我最喜欢橙色。”Bông说：“我是越南人。我自己做早饭。我最喜欢白色的衣服。”老师说：“真好！”（Wǒmen de shū — Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen zuò yì běn shū ba!” Anna shuō: “Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén, wǒ bā suì. Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng. Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan lánsè.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ shì Měiguó rén. Wǒ měi tiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá, bāngzhù dàjiā. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chéngsè.” Bông shuō: “Wǒ shì Yuènán rén. Wǒ zìjǐ zuò zǎofàn. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan báisè de yīfu.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Zhēn hǎo!”）
zh.baihat: 复习歌 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎) — 你是哪国？越南人！现在几点？七点半！长大以后想当什么？我想当科学家！最喜欢，什么颜色？我最喜欢紫色！（Nǐ shì nǎ guó? Yuènán rén! Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Qī diǎn bàn! Zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme? Wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā! Zuì xǐhuan, shénme yánsè? Wǒ zuì xǐhuan zǐsè!）

en.truyen: Kiểm tra – truyện đọc 'Nhan's Saturday' (bản đầy đủ) — On Saturday, Nhan gets up at half past seven. He has a shower and dries his hair with a towel. He gets dressed and puts on his green sweater. He takes the lift upstairs to his grandparents' flat. Grandpa has a white beard and a moustache. He is a vet. He helps sick animals every day. Today, a little dog is crying in a box. Grandpa takes it out of the box slowly. 'Is it all right?' asks Nhan. 'Yes. It needs some water.' 'What do you want to be when you grow up?' asks Grandpa. 'I want to be a vet like you!' says Nhan.
en.baihat: Review Rap (giai điệu London Bridge, cả lớp hát mở đầu buổi kiểm tra) — Where are you from? I'm from Vietnam, / From Vietnam, from Vietnam. / What time is it? It's half past six, / Time to get up! / What do you want to be? A vet! / A vet, a vet. / What's your favourite colour? Green! / I like green best!

zh.flash: Unit 1: 国家 guójiā, 越南 Yuènán, 英国 Yīngguó, 美国 Měiguó, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 所以 suǒyǐ, 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā | Unit 2: 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 吃饭 chīfàn, 电脑 diànnǎo, 杯子 bēizi, 完 wán, 去年 qùnián | Unit 3: 以后 yǐhòu, 科学家 kēxuéjiā, 警察 jǐngchá, 帮助 bāngzhù, 百 bǎi, 哭 kū, 别 bié, 为什么 wèishénme, 拿 ná, 把 bǎ, 关 guān, 次 cì | Unit 4: 最 zuì, 衣服 yīfu, 件 jiàn, 帽子 màozi, 裙子 qúnzi, 裤子 kùzi, 鞋 xié, 酷 kù, 橙 chéng, 粉 fěn, 紫 zǐ, 外面 wàimiàn, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 进 jìn, 找 zhǎo, 千 qiān
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra Nghe kiểu YCT3 (≤15 phút): nghe 6 câu, chọn tranh đúng: 我是韩国人。/ 现在五点十分。/ 我每天洗澡。/ 医生帮助病人。/ 请关门。/ 这条裙子很漂亮。 2) Kiểm tra Đọc kiểu YCT3 (≤15 phút): đọc truyện Leo的星期六, chọn đúng/sai 4 câu; nối 4 câu hỏi – trả lời: 你为什么哭？– 我的雨伞丢了。/ 你想当什么？– 我想当科学家。/ 你每天学习多久？– 半个小时。/ 你找什么？– 我找我的鞋。 3) Chuyển ngữ BRIDGE (5 phút/cặp): cô đọc câu tiếng Anh, con nói tiếng Trung và ngược lại: I'm from Vietnam. ↔ 我是越南人。/ It's half past seven. ↔ 现在七点半。/ I want to be a police officer. ↔ 我想当警察。/ I like purple best. ↔ 我最喜欢紫色。
zh.truyen: Kiểm tra – truyện đọc Leo的星期六（bản đầy đủ）— 星期六，Leo七点半起床。他洗脸，吃完早饭，穿一条蓝色的裤子和一件白色的衣服。外面下雨了，他拿紫色的雨伞去看爷爷。爷爷是医生，他在医院工作，每天帮助病人。一个小女孩在哭，爷爷说：“别哭！”Leo说：“爷爷，我长大以后也想当医生！”爷爷说：“好！你自己学习，每天一个小时！”（Leo de xīngqīliù — Xīngqīliù, Leo qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng. Tā xǐliǎn, chīwán zǎofàn, chuān yì tiáo lánsè de kùzi hé yí jiàn báisè de yīfu. Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, tā ná zǐsè de yǔsǎn qù kàn yéye. Yéye shì yīshēng, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, měi tiān bāngzhù bìngrén. Yí ge xiǎo nǚhái zài kū, yéye shuō: “Bié kū!” Leo shuō: “Yéye, wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yě xiǎng dāng yīshēng!” Yéye shuō: “Hǎo! Nǐ zìjǐ xuéxí, měi tiān yí ge xiǎoshí!”）
zh.baihat: 复习歌 (giai điệu Hai con hổ 两只老虎, cả lớp hát mở đầu buổi kiểm tra) — 你是哪国？越南人！现在几点？七点半！长大以后想当什么？我想当警察！最喜欢，什么颜色？我最喜欢紫色！（Nǐ shì nǎ guó? Yuènán rén! Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Qī diǎn bàn! Zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme? Wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá! Zuì xǐhuan, shénme yánsè? Wǒ zuì xǐhuan zǐsè!）

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 21. Unit 5 · Animals – Con vật trong sở thú

web.label: Ngày 41. Unit 5 · Ở sở thú: con vật mới

en.tu: Mới: kangaroo, panda, dolphin, wolf, cage, feed | Ôn: how often, zoo, elephant, giraffe, tiger, lion
en.cum: go to the zoo / feed the panda / a kangaroo in a cage / a grey wolf / a dolphin in the sea
en.cau: Look! It's a panda. / The kangaroo can jump. / The dolphin can swim. / The wolf is in a cage. / Can I feed the panda? / How often do you go to the zoo?
en.truyen: Leo at the Zoo — On Saturday Leo goes to the zoo with his dad. He sees a panda, a kangaroo and a dolphin. The kangaroo can jump! A grey wolf is in a big cage. 'Can I feed the panda?' asks Leo. 'Yes, you can,' says Dad. 'How often can we come here?' 'Every month!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "zoo animals for kids kangaroo panda dolphin wolf"

zh.tu: Mới: 熊 xióng, 狮子 shīzi, 狼 láng, 欢迎 huānyíng | Ôn: 每 měi, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 大象 dàxiàng, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 动物园 dòngwùyuán
zh.cum: 欢迎来动物园 huānyíng lái dòngwùyuán / 一只熊 yì zhī xióng / 两只狮子 liǎng zhī shīzi / 一只狼 yì zhī láng
zh.cau: 欢迎来动物园！(Huānyíng lái dòngwùyuán!) / 这是熊猫，那是熊。(Zhè shì xióngmāo, nà shì xióng.) / 狮子很大。(Shīzi hěn dà.) / 狼在那儿。(Láng zài nàr.) / 你每个月都去动物园吗？(Nǐ měi gè yuè dōu qù dòngwùyuán ma?)
zh.truyen: Leo去动物园 — 星期六，Leo和爸爸去动物园。'欢迎来动物园！' Leo看见熊猫、熊和两只狮子。一只狼在旁边。Leo说：'爸爸，我们每个月都来吧！' (Xīngqīliù, Leo hé bàba qù dòngwùyuán. 'Huānyíng lái dòngwùyuán!' Leo kànjiàn xióngmāo, xióng hé liǎng zhī shīzi. Yì zhī láng zài pángbiān. Leo shuō: 'Bàba, wǒmen měi gè yuè dōu lái ba!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "动物园 动物 儿童 熊 狮子 狼"

web.label: Ngày 42. Unit 5 · Nhanh hay chậm?

en.tu: Mới: fast, slow, heavy, huge, loud, than | Ôn: how often, horse, bear, mouse, cat, big
en.cum: very fast / very slow / a huge elephant / a loud lion / bigger than / smaller than / faster than
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn A is bigger than B] The elephant is bigger than the cat. / The mouse is smaller than the lion. / The horse is faster than the bear. / It's fast. / The elephant is huge and heavy. / The lion is loud.
en.truyen: The Animal Race — Leo and Anna watch an animal race at the zoo. The horse is fast. The bear is slow and heavy. The elephant is huge. It's bigger than the horse, but it's slower. The lion is loud: 'Roar!' 'The horse is first!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "comparatives for kids bigger than faster than animals"

zh.tu: Mới: 快 kuài, 慢 màn | Ôn: 去年 qùnián, 马 mǎ, 大象 dàxiàng, 猫 māo, 大 dà, 小 xiǎo
zh.cum: 很快 hěn kuài / 很慢 hěn màn / 比猫大 bǐ māo dà / 比狮子小 bǐ shīzi xiǎo / 比熊快 bǐ xióng kuài
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh A 比 B + tính từ] 大象比猫大。(Dàxiàng bǐ māo dà.) / 老鼠比狮子小。(Lǎoshǔ bǐ shīzi xiǎo.) / 马比熊快。(Mǎ bǐ xióng kuài.) / 它很快。(Tā hěn kuài.) / 熊很慢。(Xióng hěn màn.) / 去年我去了动物园。(Qùnián wǒ qùle dòngwùyuán.)
zh.truyen: 比一比 — Leo和Anna在动物园看动物跑。马很快，熊很慢。大象很大，它比马大，也比马慢。Anna说：'马第一！' (Leo hé Anna zài dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù pǎo. Mǎ hěn kuài, xióng hěn màn. Dàxiàng hěn dà, tā bǐ mǎ dà, yě bǐ mǎ màn. Anna shuō: 'Mǎ dì-yī!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "比较 儿童 大象比猫大 快 慢"

en.flash: Mới: kangaroo, panda, dolphin, wolf, cage, feed, fast, slow, heavy, huge, loud, than | Ôn: elephant, lion, horse, bear, mouse
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): kangaroo / panda / dolphin / wolf / cage / feed. 2) Kéo thả từ so sánh vào câu: The elephant is ___ than the cat. (bigger) / The mouse is ___ than the lion. (smaller) / The horse is ___ than the bear. (faster). 3) Nghe cô tả, chọn con vật: 'It's huge and heavy.' (elephant) / 'It's fast and it can jump.' (kangaroo)
en.truyen: A Day at the Zoo — Leo and Dad go to the zoo. First they see a kangaroo. It's fast and it can jump. Then they see a panda. It's slow, but it's very cute. Leo feeds the panda. A grey wolf is in a cage. It's loud! The elephant is huge and heavy. It's bigger than the kangaroo. 'I love the zoo!' says Leo.
en.baihat: Animals at the Zoo (giai điệu The Farmer in the Dell) — The kangaroo is fast, the kangaroo is fast, / Jump, jump, jump all day, the kangaroo is fast. / The panda is slow, the panda is slow, / Eat, eat, eat all day, the panda is slow. / The elephant is huge, it's bigger than the cat, / Stamp, stamp, stamp all day, it's bigger than the cat.

zh.flash: Mới: 熊 xióng, 狮子 shīzi, 狼 láng, 欢迎 huānyíng, 快 kuài, 慢 màn | Ôn: 熊猫 xióngmāo, 大象 dàxiàng, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 马 mǎ, 每 měi
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (4 câu): 熊 / 狮子 / 狼 / 熊猫. 2) Nối câu với tranh: 大象比猫大。/ 马比熊快。/ 熊很慢。/ 老鼠比狮子小。 3) Đóng vai nhân viên sở thú chào khách: 欢迎来动物园！— 谢谢！
zh.truyen: 动物园的一天 — Leo和爸爸去动物园。'欢迎来动物园！' 他们看见熊猫、熊和狮子。马很快，熊很慢。大象比马大。Leo说：'我很喜欢动物园！' (Leo hé bàba qù dòngwùyuán. 'Huānyíng lái dòngwùyuán!' Tāmen kànjiàn xióngmāo, xióng hé shīzi. Mǎ hěn kuài, xióng hěn màn. Dàxiàng bǐ mǎ dà. Leo shuō: 'Wǒ hěn xǐhuan dòngwùyuán!')
zh.baihat: 熊猫熊猫 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 熊猫熊猫，熊猫熊猫，走得慢，走得慢，大象比小猫大，老鼠比狮子小，真可爱，真可爱！(Xióngmāo xióngmāo, xióngmāo xióngmāo, zǒu de màn, zǒu de màn, dàxiàng bǐ xiǎo māo dà, lǎoshǔ bǐ shīzi xiǎo, zhēn kě'ài, zhēn kě'ài!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 22. Unit 5 · Animals – Con vật như thế nào?

web.label: Ngày 43. Unit 5 · Con vật như thế nào?

en.tu: Mới: dangerous, clever, kind, naughty, brave, famous | Ôn: strong, weak, quick, quiet, safe, how often
en.cum: a dangerous wolf / a clever dolphin / a kind panda / a naughty bird / a brave girl / a famous zoo
en.cau: The wolf is dangerous. / Dolphins are clever. / The lion is strong, but the mouse is weak. / The naughty bird takes my hat! / You are brave and kind. / Stay here. It's safe.
en.truyen: The Naughty Bird — Bông and Nhan are at a famous zoo. They see a clever dolphin. It's quick and it can play with a ball. Then a naughty bird takes Nhan's hat! Bông is brave. 'Stop, bird!' she says. The bird puts the hat on the grass. 'Thank you, Bông. You're very kind,' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "adjectives for kids brave clever kind naughty dangerous"

zh.tu: Mới: 坏 huài, 可怕 kěpà, 知道 zhīdào | Ôn: 外面 wàimiàn, 进 jìn, 找 zhǎo, 最 zuì, 帽子 màozi, 每 měi
zh.cum: 坏狼 huài láng / 很可怕 hěn kěpà / 我知道 wǒ zhīdào / 在外面 zài wàimiàn / 找帽子 zhǎo màozi
zh.cau: 狼很坏。(Láng hěn huài.) / 老虎很可怕。(Lǎohǔ hěn kěpà.) / 你知道熊猫在哪儿吗？(Nǐ zhīdào xióngmāo zài nǎr ma?) / 我知道，它在外面。(Wǒ zhīdào, tā zài wàimiàn.) / 别进去！(Bié jìnqù!)
zh.truyen: 坏鸟 — Bông和Nhan在动物园。一只坏鸟拿了Nhan的帽子！Nhan说：'我的帽子呢？' Bông说：'我知道，帽子在外面！' 她找到了帽子。Nhan说：'谢谢你，Bông！' (Bông hé Nhan zài dòngwùyuán. Yì zhī huài niǎo nále Nhan de màozi! Nhan shuō: 'Wǒ de màozi ne?' Bông shuō: 'Wǒ zhīdào, màozi zài wàimiàn!' Tā zhǎodàole màozi. Nhan shuō: 'Xièxie nǐ, Bông!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童故事 坏 可怕 知道 动物"

web.label: Ngày 44. Unit 5 · Tốt hơn, tốt nhất

en.tu: Mới: bad, better, best, boring, exciting, brilliant, difficult | Ôn: worse, worst, terrible, surprised, how often
en.cum: good – better – best / bad – worse – worst / an exciting day / a boring game / a difficult game / Brilliant!
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn better / worse] Pandas are better than wolves! / The zoo is exciting. It isn't boring. / The dolphin show is the best! / This game is difficult. / My drawing is bad, but your drawing is worse. / Brilliant!
en.truyen: The Best Day — Anna's class goes to the zoo. 'The zoo is boring,' says Leo. Then they see the dolphin show. It's exciting! A dolphin jumps over a ball. 'Brilliant!' says Leo. He is surprised. 'This is the best day!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "good better best bad worse worst song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 难 nán, 当然 dāngrán | Ôn: 最 zuì, 衣服 yīfu, 鞋 xié, 千 qiān, 可以 kěyǐ
zh.cum: 很难 hěn nán / 不难 bù nán / 当然可以 dāngrán kěyǐ / 最好 zuì hǎo
zh.cau: 这个游戏很难。(Zhège yóuxì hěn nán.) / 汉语难吗？不难！(Hànyǔ nán ma? Bù nán!) / 我可以看狮子吗？——当然可以！(Wǒ kěyǐ kàn shīzi ma? — Dāngrán kěyǐ!) / 熊猫最可爱。(Xióngmāo zuì kě'ài.)
zh.truyen: 最好的一天 — Anna的班去动物园。Leo问：'老师，我可以看狮子吗？' 老师说：'当然可以！' 狮子很大，很可怕。熊猫最可爱。Leo说：'今天最好！' (Anna de bān qù dòngwùyuán. Leo wèn: 'Lǎoshī, wǒ kěyǐ kàn shīzi ma?' Lǎoshī shuō: 'Dāngrán kěyǐ!' Shīzi hěn dà, hěn kěpà. Xióngmāo zuì kě'ài. Leo shuō: 'Jīntiān zuì hǎo!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "当然可以 儿童 对话 难 不难"

en.flash: Mới: dangerous, clever, kind, naughty, brave, famous, bad, better, best, boring, exciting, brilliant, difficult | Ôn: strong, weak, safe, worse, worst, surprised
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn tính từ (6 câu): dangerous / clever / kind / naughty / brave / famous. 2) Điền từ vào thang so sánh: good – ___ – best / bad – worse – ___ (better, worst). 3) Đọc câu chọn Yes/No theo tranh: The wolf is dangerous. / The dolphin show is boring. / The panda is kind.
en.truyen: The Naughty Bird at the Zoo — Anna's class goes to a famous zoo. Leo thinks the zoo is boring. Then a naughty bird takes Nhan's hat! Bông is brave and quick: 'Stop, bird!' The bird drops the hat. Then they watch the dolphin show. The dolphins are clever. It's exciting! 'This is the best day! Brilliant!' says Leo.
en.baihat: Good, Better, Best (giai điệu London Bridge) — Good, better, best, the panda is the best, / The panda is the best, so kind and cute! / Bad, worse, worst, the wolf is the worst, / The wolf is the worst, be careful, too!

zh.flash: Mới: 坏 huài, 可怕 kěpà, 知道 zhīdào, 难 nán, 当然 dāngrán | Ôn: 外面 wàimiàn, 找 zhǎo, 最 zuì, 帽子 màozi, 可以 kěyǐ
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn đúng/sai theo tranh: 狼很坏。/ 老虎很可怕。/ 熊猫最可爱。 2) Hỏi – đáp cặp đôi: 我可以看熊猫吗？——当然可以！/ 你知道狮子在哪儿吗？——我知道，在外面。 3) Xếp chữ thành câu: 难 / 很 / 游戏 / 这个 → 这个游戏很难。
zh.truyen: 坏鸟和帽子 — Anna的班去动物园。一只坏鸟拿了Nhan的帽子！Nhan很害怕。Bông说：'别害怕，我知道它在哪儿！' 她找到了帽子。Leo问：'老师，我们可以看熊猫吗？' 老师说：'当然可以！' (Anna de bān qù dòngwùyuán. Yì zhī huài niǎo nále Nhan de màozi! Nhan hěn hàipà. Bông shuō: 'Bié hàipà, wǒ zhīdào tā zài nǎr!' Tā zhǎodàole màozi. Leo wèn: 'Lǎoshī, wǒmen kěyǐ kàn xióngmāo ma?' Lǎoshī shuō: 'Dāngrán kěyǐ!')
zh.baihat: 当然可以 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 可以看吗？可以看吗？当然可以！当然可以！老虎很可怕，坏狼也可怕，别害怕，别害怕！(Kěyǐ kàn ma? Kěyǐ kàn ma? Dāngrán kěyǐ! Dāngrán kěyǐ! Lǎohǔ hěn kěpà, huài láng yě kěpà, bié hàipà, bié hàipà!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 23. Unit 5 · Animals – Sợ, ngủ hay thức?

web.label: Ngày 45. Unit 5 · Sợ, ngủ hay thức?

en.tu: Mới: afraid, frightened, asleep, awake, careful | Ôn: how often, dream, noise, quiet, safe
en.cum: be afraid of snakes / frightened of the wolf / fast asleep / wide awake / Be careful! / make a noise
en.cau: I'm afraid of snakes. / Are you frightened of the wolf? / The panda is asleep. / Is the lion awake? / Be careful! The tiger is awake. / Be quiet! Don't make a noise.
en.truyen: Shh! — Bông and Leo visit the zoo in the evening. The panda is asleep. Maybe it has a dream. The lion is awake. Leo is frightened. 'Be careful, Leo. Be quiet, don't make a noise,' says Bông. 'Don't be afraid. The lion is in a cage. We're safe.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "asleep awake afraid feelings song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 着急 zháojí | Ôn: 小时 xiǎoshí, 害怕 hàipà, 睡觉 shuìjiào, 别 bié, 哭 kū
zh.cum: 别着急 bié zháojí / 很着急 hěn zháojí / 别害怕 bié hàipà / 在睡觉 zài shuìjiào
zh.cau: 熊猫在睡觉。(Xióngmāo zài shuìjiào.) / 别着急，慢慢走。(Bié zháojí, mànmàn zǒu.) / 我害怕狼。(Wǒ hàipà láng.) / 别哭，狮子在里面。(Bié kū, shīzi zài lǐmiàn.) / 熊猫睡了三个小时。(Xióngmāo shuìle sān gè xiǎoshí.)
zh.truyen: 嘘！— 晚上，Bông和Leo在动物园。熊猫在睡觉，它睡了三个小时。狮子没睡觉。Leo很害怕，他很着急。Bông说：'别着急，别害怕！狮子在里面。' (Wǎnshang, Bông hé Leo zài dòngwùyuán. Xióngmāo zài shuìjiào, tā shuìle sān gè xiǎoshí. Shīzi méi shuìjiào. Leo hěn hàipà, tā hěn zháojí. Bông shuō: 'Bié zháojí, bié hàipà! Shīzi zài lǐmiàn.')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "别着急 儿童歌 害怕 睡觉"

web.label: Ngày 46. Unit 5 · Ôn không tranh: đoán con vật

en.tu: Ôn: kangaroo, panda, dolphin, wolf, fast, slow, heavy, than, dangerous, clever, afraid, asleep, careful | Ôn nhanh: how often
en.cum: faster than / slower than / heavier than / afraid of / Be careful!
en.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) Which is faster, a kangaroo or a bear? / The elephant is heavier than the panda. / Is the wolf dangerous? Yes, it is. / Is the panda awake? No, it's asleep. / How often do you feed your cat?
en.truyen: Guess the Animal — Listen and guess. It's black and white. It's slower than a kangaroo. It's heavy, but it's kind and cute. It's from China. What is it? A panda! / It lives in the sea. It's clever and fast. It isn't dangerous. What is it? A dolphin!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "guess the animal riddles for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 熊 xióng, 狮子 shīzi, 狼 láng, 欢迎 huānyíng, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 坏 huài, 可怕 kěpà, 知道 zhīdào, 难 nán, 当然 dāngrán, 着急 zháojí | Ôn nhanh: 每 měi, 小时 xiǎoshí
zh.cum: 比熊快 bǐ xióng kuài / 比狼大 bǐ láng dà / 别着急 bié zháojí / 当然知道 dāngrán zhīdào
zh.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) 马比熊快吗？(Mǎ bǐ xióng kuài ma?) / 狼很坏吗？(Láng hěn huài ma?) / 你知道狮子在哪儿吗？——当然知道！(Nǐ zhīdào shīzi zài nǎr ma? — Dāngrán zhīdào!) / 大象比猫大吗？(Dàxiàng bǐ māo dà ma?)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — 它是黑白的。它很可爱。它比狗大，比大象小。它走得很慢。它从中国来。它是什么？熊猫！(Tā shì hēibái de. Tā hěn kě'ài. Tā bǐ gǒu dà, bǐ dàxiàng xiǎo. Tā zǒu de hěn màn. Tā cóng Zhōngguó lái. Tā shì shénme? Xióngmāo!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "猜动物 儿童 谜语 熊猫"

en.flash: Mới: afraid, frightened, asleep, awake, careful | Ôn: kangaroo, panda, dolphin, wolf, fast, slow, heavy, than, dangerous, clever, quiet, noise
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn asleep / awake (4 tranh: panda, lion, cat, wolf). 2) Nghe cô đọc câu, chọn tranh đúng: Be careful! The tiger is awake. / The panda is asleep. / I'm afraid of snakes. 3) Trò đoán con vật không tranh: cô đọc 3 câu gợi ý (It's bigger than a cat. It's dangerous. It's loud.) → con nói tên (lion).
en.truyen: The Night at the Zoo — Bông and Leo are at the zoo in the evening. The panda is asleep. The lion is awake and loud. Leo is frightened. 'Be careful. Be quiet,' says Bông. 'Don't be afraid. We're safe.' Then they see the kangaroo. It's awake, too! It jumps fast. Leo laughs. 'The zoo at night is exciting!'
en.baihat: Are You Asleep? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Are you asleep? Are you asleep, / Panda bear, panda bear? / Lion is awake now, lion is awake now, / Be careful! Be careful!

zh.flash: Mới: 着急 zháojí | Ôn: 熊 xióng, 狮子 shīzi, 狼 láng, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 坏 huài, 可怕 kěpà, 知道 zhīdào, 害怕 hàipà, 睡觉 shuìjiào
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh: 熊猫在睡觉。/ 狮子没睡觉。/ Leo很害怕。 2) Ghép câu khuyên với tình huống: 别着急！/ 别害怕！/ 别哭！ 3) Đoán con vật không tranh: 它比猫大，它很可怕，它是什么？(狮子)
zh.truyen: 嘘！别着急 — 晚上，Bông和Leo在动物园。熊猫在睡觉。狮子没睡觉，它很可怕。Leo很害怕，很着急。Bông说：'别着急，别害怕！狮子在里面。' 然后他们看见马，马跑得很快。Leo笑了。(Wǎnshang, Bông hé Leo zài dòngwùyuán. Xióngmāo zài shuìjiào. Shīzi méi shuìjiào, tā hěn kěpà. Leo hěn hàipà, hěn zháojí. Bông shuō: 'Bié zháojí, bié hàipà! Shīzi zài lǐmiàn.' Ránhòu tāmen kànjiàn mǎ, mǎ pǎo de hěn kuài. Leo xiào le.)
zh.baihat: 别着急 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 别着急呀，别着急呀，慢慢走，慢慢走，熊猫在睡觉，狮子在里面，别害怕，别害怕！(Bié zháojí ya, bié zháojí ya, mànmàn zǒu, mànmàn zǒu, xióngmāo zài shuìjiào, shīzi zài lǐmiàn, bié hàipà, bié hàipà!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 24. Unit 5 · Animals – Truyện và Phiên dịch nhí

web.label: Ngày 47. Unit 5 · Truyện: Sư tử và chuột

en.tu: Ôn: huge, asleep, awake, afraid, frightened, brave, kind, clever, than | Ôn nhanh: how often
en.cum: a huge lion / a small mouse / fast asleep / I know the way / bigger than
en.cau: The lion is bigger than the mouse. / The mouse is small, but she is brave. / Don't be afraid. I know the way! / Thank you. You are very kind.
en.truyen: The Lion and the Mouse — A huge lion is asleep. A small mouse runs on his nose. The lion is awake and angry. 'Please don't eat me!' says the mouse. The lion laughs and lets her go. One day the lion can't find his home. He is frightened. The mouse says, 'Don't be afraid. I know the way!' She takes him home. 'You are small, but you are clever and kind!' says the lion.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "The Lion and the Mouse story for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 狮子 shīzi, 着急 zháojí, 知道 zhīdào, 坏 huài, 可怕 kěpà, 当然 dāngrán | Ôn nhanh: 每 měi, 完 wán
zh.cum: 一只大狮子 yì zhī dà shīzi / 一只小老鼠 yì zhī xiǎo lǎoshǔ / 别着急 bié zháojí / 我知道 wǒ zhīdào
zh.cau: 狮子比老鼠大。(Shīzi bǐ lǎoshǔ dà.) / 别吃我！(Bié chī wǒ!) / 别着急，我知道路！(Bié zháojí, wǒ zhīdào lù!) / 谢谢你，小老鼠！(Xièxie nǐ, xiǎo lǎoshǔ!)
zh.truyen: 狮子和老鼠 — 一只大狮子在睡觉。一只小老鼠跑到它的鼻子上。狮子很生气。老鼠说：'别吃我！' 狮子笑了。有一天，狮子找不到家，它很着急。小老鼠说：'别着急，我知道！' 它帮助狮子回家。狮子说：'谢谢你，小老鼠！' (Yì zhī dà shīzi zài shuìjiào. Yì zhī xiǎo lǎoshǔ pǎodào tā de bízi shang. Shīzi hěn shēngqì. Lǎoshǔ shuō: 'Bié chī wǒ!' Shīzi xiào le. Yǒu yì tiān, shīzi zhǎo bú dào jiā, tā hěn zháojí. Xiǎo lǎoshǔ shuō: 'Bié zháojí, wǒ zhīdào!' Tā bāngzhù shīzi huí jiā. Shīzi shuō: 'Xièxie nǐ, xiǎo lǎoshǔ!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "狮子和老鼠 儿童故事"

web.label: Ngày 48. Unit 5 · Phiên dịch nhí ở sở thú

en.tu: Ôn: panda, kangaroo, wolf, dolphin, fast, slow, dangerous, careful, than, best | Ôn nhanh: how often
en.cum: Welcome to the zoo! / Of course! / Be careful! / slower than / Don't be afraid.
en.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Trung, nói tiếng Anh) Welcome to the zoo! / Is the lion dangerous? Yes, it is. Be careful! / Can we see the pandas? Of course! / The panda is slower than the horse. / Do you know where the wolf is?
en.truyen: Little Interpreter at the Zoo — Xiaomei is from China. She visits the zoo in Hanoi with Nhan. Nhan helps her. 'Welcome to the zoo!' says the zoo keeper. Nhan says it in Chinese for Xiaomei. Xiaomei asks, 'Is the lion dangerous?' 'Yes, it is. Be careful!' 'Can we see the pandas?' 'Of course!' The pandas are slow and cute. 'This is the best zoo!' says Xiaomei.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "kids interpreter English Chinese animals zoo"

zh.tu: Ôn: 欢迎 huānyíng, 当然 dāngrán, 知道 zhīdào, 着急 zháojí, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 可怕 kěpà, 熊 xióng | Ôn nhanh: 每 měi, 去年 qùnián
zh.cum: 欢迎来动物园 huānyíng lái dòngwùyuán / 当然可以 dāngrán kěyǐ / 比马慢 bǐ mǎ màn / 别害怕 bié hàipà
zh.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Anh, nói tiếng Trung) 欢迎来河内动物园！(Huānyíng lái Hénèi dòngwùyuán!) / 狮子可怕吗？(Shīzi kěpà ma?) / 我们可以看熊猫吗？——当然可以！(Wǒmen kěyǐ kàn xióngmāo ma? — Dāngrán kěyǐ!) / 熊猫比马慢。(Xióngmāo bǐ mǎ màn.) / 你知道狼在哪儿吗？(Nǐ zhīdào láng zài nǎr ma?)
zh.truyen: 小翻译 — Xiaomei是中国人。她和Nhan去河内动物园。'欢迎来动物园！' Xiaomei问：'狮子可怕吗？' Nhan说：'很可怕，别进去！' Xiaomei问：'我们可以看熊猫吗？' Nhan说：'当然可以！' 熊猫很慢，很可爱。(Xiaomei shì Zhōngguó rén. Tā hé Nhan qù Hénèi dòngwùyuán. 'Huānyíng lái dòngwùyuán!' Xiaomei wèn: 'Shīzi kěpà ma?' Nhan shuō: 'Hěn kěpà, bié jìnqù!' Xiaomei wèn: 'Wǒmen kěyǐ kàn xióngmāo ma?' Nhan shuō: 'Dāngrán kěyǐ!' Xióngmāo hěn màn, hěn kě'ài.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "欢迎 当然可以 儿童 中英文 动物"

en.flash: Ôn: kangaroo, panda, slow, fast, heavy, than, huge, brave, kind, clever, dangerous, afraid, asleep, awake, careful, best
en.slide: 1) Xếp tranh theo thứ tự truyện The Lion and the Mouse (5 tranh) và nói 1 câu cho mỗi tranh. 2) Đọc và chọn từ đúng (dạng Movers Reading Part 4, 5 câu): The lion is ___ than the mouse. (bigger / smaller) / The mouse is small but ___. (brave / boring) 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Việt tình huống, con nói tiếng Anh: Welcome to the zoo! / Be careful! / Of course!
en.truyen: The Lion and the Mouse — A huge lion is asleep under a tree. A small mouse runs on his nose. The lion is awake and angry. 'Please don't eat me! I can help you one day,' says the mouse. The lion laughs. 'You are smaller than my foot!' But he lets her go. One day the lion can't find his home. He is frightened. The brave mouse says, 'Don't be afraid. I know the way!' She takes him home. 'You are small, but you are the best friend!' says the lion.
en.baihat: The Lion and the Mouse (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Small, small, small brown mouse, / Brave and kind and clever, / Helps the huge and frightened lion, / Best friends now forever!

zh.flash: Ôn: 熊 xióng, 狮子 shīzi, 狼 láng, 欢迎 huānyíng, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 坏 huài, 难 nán, 当然 dāngrán, 着急 zháojí, 知道 zhīdào, 可怕 kěpà
zh.slide: 1) Xếp tranh truyện 狮子和老鼠 và nói câu: 狮子在睡觉。/ 别吃我！/ 别着急，我知道！ 2) Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: Welcome to the zoo! → 欢迎来动物园！/ Of course! → 当然！/ The panda is slower than the horse. → 熊猫比马慢。 3) Nghe chọn câu trả lời đúng (dạng YCT3 nghe): 你知道熊猫在哪儿吗？ a) 我知道，在那儿。 b) 熊猫很可爱。
zh.truyen: 狮子和老鼠 — 一只大狮子在睡觉。小老鼠跑到它的鼻子上。狮子很生气：'我要吃你！' 老鼠说：'别吃我！我可以帮助你。' 狮子笑了：'你比我的脚小！' 有一天，狮子找不到家，它很着急。小老鼠说：'别着急，我知道！' 它帮助狮子回家了。(Yì zhī dà shīzi zài shuìjiào. Xiǎo lǎoshǔ pǎodào tā de bízi shang. Shīzi hěn shēngqì: 'Wǒ yào chī nǐ!' Lǎoshǔ shuō: 'Bié chī wǒ! Wǒ kěyǐ bāngzhù nǐ.' Shīzi xiào le: 'Nǐ bǐ wǒ de jiǎo xiǎo!' Yǒu yì tiān, shīzi zhǎo bú dào jiā, tā hěn zháojí. Xiǎo lǎoshǔ shuō: 'Bié zháojí, wǒ zhīdào!' Tā bāngzhù shīzi huí jiā le.)
zh.baihat: 小老鼠 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 小老鼠呀，小老鼠呀，不害怕，不害怕，大狮子着急了，大狮子着急了，我知道！我知道！(Xiǎo lǎoshǔ ya, xiǎo lǎoshǔ ya, bú hàipà, bú hàipà, dà shīzi zháojí le, dà shīzi zháojí le, wǒ zhīdào! Wǒ zhīdào!)

blocks.title: Unit 6 · I Like Sports · 我喜欢运动！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 25. Unit 6 · I Like Sports – Trượt băng và đội bóng

web.label: Ngày 49. Unit 6 · Trượt băng, trượt patin

en.tu: Mới: ice, skate, ice skates, ice skating, roller skates, roller skating, practise | Ôn: could, sometimes, hobby, ride, bike
en.cum: go ice skating / go roller skating / a pair of ice skates / new roller skates / skate on the ice / practise every day
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: Can + động từ] Can you skate? Yes, I can. / No, I can't. / I go ice skating at the weekend. / I practise roller skating every day. / I couldn't skate last year, but I can now. / Sometimes I fall on the ice.
en.truyen: Anna's New Skates — Anna has got a pair of new roller skates. She can't skate well. She practises every day after school. Sometimes she falls, but she doesn't cry. Now she can skate fast! 'Let's go ice skating at the weekend!' says Dad.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "ice skating roller skating vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 滑冰 huábīng, 跑步 pǎobù, 太极拳 tàijíquán | Ôn: 自己 zìjǐ, 喜欢 xǐhuan, 每 měi, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 快 kuài
zh.cum: 去滑冰 qù huábīng / 每天跑步 měi tiān pǎobù / 打太极拳 dǎ tàijíquán / 自己滑冰 zìjǐ huábīng
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi có/không với 吗] 你喜欢滑冰吗？(Nǐ xǐhuan huábīng ma?) / 我喜欢跑步。(Wǒ xǐhuan pǎobù.) / 爷爷每天早上打太极拳。(Yéye měi tiān zǎoshang dǎ tàijíquán.) / 我会自己滑冰。(Wǒ huì zìjǐ huábīng.)
zh.truyen: Anna学滑冰 — Anna很喜欢滑冰。她每天下午去滑冰。她滑得很慢，她不着急，也不哭。现在她滑得很快！爸爸说：'星期六我们一起去滑冰吧！' (Anna hěn xǐhuan huábīng. Tā měi tiān xiàwǔ qù huábīng. Tā huá de hěn màn, tā bù zháojí, yě bù kū. Xiànzài tā huá de hěn kuài! Bàba shuō: 'Xīngqīliù wǒmen yìqǐ qù huábīng ba!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "滑冰 跑步 太极拳 儿童 运动"

web.label: Ngày 50. Unit 6 · Đội bóng của em

en.tu: Mới: team, volleyball, win, match, player, goal, kick, score | Ôn: lift, quarter, football, basketball, ball
en.cum: a football match / play volleyball / win the match / score a goal / kick the ball / a good player / my team
en.cau: What sport do you like? I like football. / I don't like basketball. / Do you like volleyball? / Our team can win! / He kicks the ball and scores a goal. / The match starts at quarter past four.
en.truyen: The Big Match — Leo's team has a football match on Saturday. It starts at quarter past three. Leo kicks the ball. Goal! Leo scores! Leo's team wins the match. 'You're a brilliant player!' says the teacher. After the match, the team takes the lift to the café on the roof.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports vocabulary for kids football volleyball team win"

zh.tu: Mới: 篮球 lánqiú, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 足球 zúqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 排球 páiqiú | Ôn: 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 喜欢 xǐhuan, 进 jìn
zh.cum: 踢足球 tī zúqiú / 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú / 打排球 dǎ páiqiú / 男孩子 nán háizi / 进球 jìn qiú
zh.cau: 你喜欢什么运动？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?) / 我喜欢足球。(Wǒ xǐhuan zúqiú.) / 我不喜欢篮球。(Wǒ bù xǐhuan lánqiú.) / 你喜欢打排球吗？(Nǐ xǐhuan dǎ páiqiú ma?) / 张先生每天打篮球。(Zhāng xiānsheng měi tiān dǎ lánqiú.)
zh.truyen: 星期六踢足球 — 星期六下午，Leo和男同学们踢足球。Leo跑得很快。进了！Leo很高兴。老师说：'Leo，你踢得真好！' 他们也喜欢打篮球。(Xīngqīliù xiàwǔ, Leo hé nán tóngxuémen tī zúqiú. Leo pǎo de hěn kuài. Jìn le! Leo hěn gāoxìng. Lǎoshī shuō: 'Leo, nǐ tī de zhēn hǎo!' Tāmen yě xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "踢足球 打篮球 打排球 儿童 汉语"

en.flash: Mới: ice, skate, ice skates, ice skating, roller skates, roller skating, practise, team, volleyball, win, match, player, goal, kick, score | Ôn: football, basketball, badminton, ball, bike
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (8 câu): ice skates / roller skates / volleyball / goal / kick / score / team / player. 2) Hỏi – đáp theo bảng tick: Can you skate? Yes, I can. / No, I can't. — Do you like volleyball? 3) Nghe chọn tranh đúng (dạng Movers Listening Part 4): 'The match starts at quarter past four.' / 'He kicks the ball and scores a goal.'
en.truyen: The Skating Team — Anna practises roller skating every day. Leo plays in a football team. On Saturday, Leo's team has a match. Leo kicks the ball and scores a goal! His team wins. Then Leo and Anna go ice skating. Leo can't skate well. 'Practise every day, like me!' says Anna.
en.baihat: This Is the Way We Skate on Ice (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — This is the way we skate on ice, / skate on ice, skate on ice, / This is the way we skate on ice, / so early in the morning. / This is the way we kick the ball, / kick the ball, score a goal, / This is the way our team can win, / so early in the morning.

zh.flash: Mới: 滑冰 huábīng, 跑步 pǎobù, 太极拳 tàijíquán, 篮球 lánqiú, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 足球 zúqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 排球 páiqiú | Ôn: 喜欢 xǐhuan, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 自己 zìjǐ
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 滑冰 / 跑步 / 太极拳 / 踢足球 / 打篮球 / 打排球. 2) Phỏng vấn bạn: 你喜欢什么运动？— 我喜欢……/ 我不喜欢…… 3) Nối động từ với môn: 踢 — 足球 / 打 — 篮球、排球、太极拳.
zh.truyen: 我们喜欢运动 — Anna喜欢滑冰，她每天去滑冰。Leo喜欢踢足球。爷爷喜欢打太极拳。爸爸喜欢跑步。Leo问Anna：'你喜欢打篮球吗？' Anna说：'我不喜欢篮球，我喜欢滑冰！' (Anna xǐhuan huábīng, tā měi tiān qù huábīng. Leo xǐhuan tī zúqiú. Yéye xǐhuan dǎ tàijíquán. Bàba xǐhuan pǎobù. Leo wèn Anna: 'Nǐ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú ma?' Anna shuō: 'Wǒ bù xǐhuan lánqiú, wǒ xǐhuan huábīng!')
zh.baihat: 你喜欢什么运动 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 你喜欢什么？你喜欢什么？什么运动？什么运动？我喜欢踢足球，我喜欢打篮球，跑跑步，滑滑冰！(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme? Nǐ xǐhuan shénme? Shénme yùndòng? Shénme yùndòng? Wǒ xǐhuan tī zúqiú, wǒ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú, pǎopao bù, huáhua bīng!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 26. Unit 6 · I Like Sports – Hội chợ, phim và nhạc

web.label: Ngày 51. Unit 6 · Hội chợ cuối tuần

en.tu: Mới: funfair, fair, circus, dress up, band, pop star | Ôn: exciting, boring, best, brave, afraid, half
en.cum: go to the funfair / at the circus / dress up as a clown / a pop star in a band / an exciting fair
en.cau: Let's go to the funfair! / The circus is exciting. It isn't boring. / I want to dress up as a pop star. / My brother plays in a band. / The band starts at half past six. / Don't be afraid of the clown!
en.truyen: At the Funfair — Bông and Nhan go to the funfair in the park. There is a circus, too. Nhan dresses up as a clown. A band plays music. 'I want to be a pop star!' says Bông, and she sings with the band. Then they play table tennis at the fair. 'This is the best day!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "funfair circus vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú | Ôn: 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 难 nán, 当然 dāngrán, 杯子 bēizi
zh.cum: 打乒乓球 dǎ pīngpāngqiú / 打网球 dǎ wǎngqiú / 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú / 一起打 yìqǐ dǎ
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 会 + động từ] 你会打羽毛球吗？(Nǐ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú ma?) / 会。/ 不会。(Huì. / Bú huì.) / 我们一起打乒乓球吧！(Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú ba!) / 网球难吗？当然不难！(Wǎngqiú nán ma? Dāngrán bù nán!)
zh.truyen: 在公园玩 — 星期天，Bông和Nhan在公园玩。那儿有乒乓球和羽毛球。Nhan问：'你会打乒乓球吗？' Bông说：'当然会！' 她们一起打乒乓球。Bông打得很快，Nhan打得很慢。她们很高兴。(Xīngqītiān, Bông hé Nhan zài gōngyuán wán. Nàr yǒu pīngpāngqiú hé yǔmáoqiú. Nhan wèn: 'Nǐ huì dǎ pīngpāngqiú ma?' Bông shuō: 'Dāngrán huì!' Tāmen yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú. Bông dǎ de hěn kuài, Nhan dǎ de hěn màn. Tāmen hěn gāoxìng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "打乒乓球 打羽毛球 你会吗 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 52. Unit 6 · Phim và nhạc

en.tu: Mới: film, movie, film star, CD, DVD, comic book | Ôn: famous, clever, difficult, meal, watch, TV
en.cum: watch a film (US movie) / a famous film star / a new CD / a DVD about animals / read a comic book
en.cau: Do you like films? Yes, I do. / My favourite film star is very famous. / I listen to a CD in the car. / We watch a DVD after our meal. / I read comic books at the weekend. / In the USA, a film is called a movie.
en.truyen: Film Night — It's Friday evening. Leo's family has a film night. Dad has a new DVD about animals: pandas, lions and a clever dolphin. After the film, Leo reads a comic book and listens to a CD by a famous pop star. 'I love film night!' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "film movie comic book vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 电影 diànyǐng, 上网 shàngwǎng | Ôn: 知道 zhīdào, 电视 diànshì, 电脑 diànnǎo, 国家 guójiā
zh.cum: 看电影 kàn diànyǐng / 上网 shàngwǎng / 看电视 kàn diànshì / 用电脑上网 yòng diànnǎo shàngwǎng
zh.cau: 你喜欢看电影吗？(Nǐ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng ma?) / 我喜欢看电影。(Wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng.) / 我不喜欢上网。(Wǒ bù xǐhuan shàngwǎng.) / 你知道这个电影吗？(Nǐ zhīdào zhège diànyǐng ma?) / 这个电影是哪个国家的？(Zhège diànyǐng shì nǎge guójiā de?)
zh.truyen: 看电影的晚上 — 星期五晚上，Leo一家看电影。电影里有很多动物：熊猫、狮子和大象。看完电影，Leo用电脑上网，看动物。他说：'我喜欢看电影！' (Xīngqīwǔ wǎnshang, Leo yì jiā kàn diànyǐng. Diànyǐng lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù: xióngmāo, shīzi hé dàxiàng. Kànwán diànyǐng, Leo yòng diànnǎo shàngwǎng, kàn dòngwù. Tā shuō: 'Wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "看电影 上网 儿童 汉语 对话"

en.flash: Mới: funfair, fair, circus, dress up, band, pop star, film, movie, film star, CD, DVD, comic book | Ôn: exciting, boring, famous, clever, watch, TV
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): circus / band / pop star / CD / DVD / comic book. 2) Ghép từ tiếng Anh – Anh với tiếng Anh – Mỹ: film ↔ movie / film star ↔ movie star. 3) Đọc đoạn ngắn và trả lời Yes/No (dạng Movers Reading): 'Bông dresses up as a pop star. She sings with a band.' — Does Bông sing? / Is Nhan a clown?
en.truyen: The Funfair and the Film — On Saturday, Bông and Nhan go to the funfair. There's a circus and a band. Nhan dresses up as a clown and Bông dresses up as a pop star. In the evening, they watch a film on DVD at Bông's house. The film star is very famous. After the film, they read comic books. 'Today is exciting, not boring!'
en.baihat: Pop Star Song (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — Pop star, pop star, in a band, / Sing a song and clap your hands. / At the funfair, at the fair, / Dress up, dress up, everywhere. / Watch a film and read a comic, / Pop star, pop star, you're fantastic!

zh.flash: Mới: 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 电影 diànyǐng, 上网 shàngwǎng | Ôn: 篮球 lánqiú, 足球 zúqiú, 电视 diànshì, 电脑 diànnǎo, 当然 dāngrán
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh: 打乒乓球 / 打网球 / 打羽毛球 / 看电影 / 上网. 2) Hỏi – đáp 会/不会 theo bảng tick: 你会打网球吗？— 会。/ 不会。 3) Hoàn thành câu: 我们一起___吧！(打乒乓球 / 看电影)
zh.truyen: 周末 — 星期六，Bông和Nhan在公园打乒乓球和羽毛球。Nhan问：'你会打网球吗？' Bông说：'不会，你呢？' 晚上，她们一起看电影，电影里有很多动物。看完电影，她们用电脑上网。(Xīngqīliù, Bông hé Nhan zài gōngyuán dǎ pīngpāngqiú hé yǔmáoqiú. Nhan wèn: 'Nǐ huì dǎ wǎngqiú ma?' Bông shuō: 'Bú huì, nǐ ne?' Wǎnshang, tāmen yìqǐ kàn diànyǐng, diànyǐng lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù. Kànwán diànyǐng, tāmen yòng diànnǎo shàngwǎng.)
zh.baihat: 我们一起打球吧 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 你会打吗？你会打吗？乒乓球，乒乓球！当然会，当然会！我们一起打吧！一起打！一起打！(Nǐ huì dǎ ma? Nǐ huì dǎ ma? Pīngpāngqiú, pīngpāngqiú! Dāngrán huì, dāngrán huì! Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ ba! Yìqǐ dǎ! Yìqǐ dǎ!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 27. Unit 6 · I Like Sports – Quà tặng và trò đoán

web.label: Ngày 53. Unit 6 · Món quà thể thao

en.tu: Mới: net, bat, sail, model, catch a bus | Ôn: could, sometimes, baseball, boat, river
en.cum: hit the ball with a bat / over the net / sail a boat / a model boat / catch the bus
en.cau: The ball is in the net! / I've got a new baseball bat. / We sail a model boat on the river. / Let's catch the bus to the park. / Sometimes Grandpa sails a real boat.
en.truyen: Leo's Present — It's Leo's birthday. Grandpa gives him a present: a model boat and a baseball bat! On Sunday they catch the bus to the river. Leo sails his model boat. Then they play baseball. Leo hits the ball with his new bat. It goes over the net!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports equipment for kids bat net ball"

zh.tu: Mới: 礼物 lǐwù, 少 shǎo | Ôn: 先生 xiānsheng, 自己 zìjǐ, 生日 shēngrì, 多 duō, 着急 zháojí
zh.cum: 生日礼物 shēngrì lǐwù / 很少 hěn shǎo / 很多 hěn duō / 一个礼物 yí gè lǐwù
zh.cau: 这是我的生日礼物。(Zhè shì wǒ de shēngrì lǐwù.) / 我很少上网。(Wǒ hěn shǎo shàngwǎng.) / 爷爷很少打篮球。(Yéye hěn shǎo dǎ lánqiú.) / 我的礼物是一个篮球。(Wǒ de lǐwù shì yí gè lánqiú.)
zh.truyen: Leo的生日礼物 — 今天是Leo的生日。爷爷给他一个礼物：一个篮球！Leo很高兴。下午，他们一起去公园打篮球。爷爷很少打篮球，他打得很慢。Leo说：'爷爷，别着急！' (Jīntiān shì Leo de shēngrì. Yéye gěi tā yí gè lǐwù: yí gè lánqiú! Leo hěn gāoxìng. Xiàwǔ, tāmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán dǎ lánqiú. Yéye hěn shǎo dǎ lánqiú, tā dǎ de hěn màn. Leo shuō: 'Yéye, bié zháojí!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "生日礼物 儿童 汉语 很少 很多"

web.label: Ngày 54. Unit 6 · Ôn không tranh: Tôi là ai?

en.tu: Ôn: ice, skate, practise, team, volleyball, win, match, film, comic book, roller skating, band, net | Ôn nhanh: could, sometimes
en.cum: go ice skating / win the match / watch a film / play in a band / dress up / catch the bus
en.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) What sport do you like? / Can you skate? / Do you like volleyball? / Let's play table tennis together! / Who scores the goal? / Could you swim when you were five?
en.truyen: Who Am I? — Listen and guess. I play in a team. I kick the ball. I score goals. Who am I? A football player! / I've got skates. I skate on the ice. I practise every day. What's my sport? Ice skating! / I sing in a band. I'm very famous. Who am I? A pop star!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "guess the sport game for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 排球 páiqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 上网 shàngwǎng, 电影 diànyǐng, 礼物 lǐwù, 滑冰 huábīng, 太极拳 tàijíquán, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 少 shǎo | Ôn nhanh: 国家 guójiā, 男 nán
zh.cum: 踢足球 tī zúqiú / 打网球 dǎ wǎngqiú / 看电影 kàn diànyǐng / 很少上网 hěn shǎo shàngwǎng
zh.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) 你喜欢什么运动？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?) / 你会打乒乓球吗？(Nǐ huì dǎ pīngpāngqiú ma?) / 我很少看电影。(Wǒ hěn shǎo kàn diànyǐng.) / 我们一起去跑步吧！(Wǒmen yìqǐ qù pǎobù ba!)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — 我喜欢这个运动。我不用手，我用脚。我踢什么？足球！/ 爷爷每天早上在公园做这个运动，他做得很慢。这是什么？太极拳！(Wǒ xǐhuan zhège yùndòng. Wǒ bú yòng shǒu, wǒ yòng jiǎo. Wǒ tī shénme? Zúqiú! / Yéye měi tiān zǎoshang zài gōngyuán zuò zhège yùndòng, tā zuò de hěn màn. Zhè shì shénme? Tàijíquán!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "猜运动 儿童 汉语 游戏"

en.flash: Mới: net, bat, sail, model, catch a bus | Ôn: ice skating, roller skating, practise, team, volleyball, win, match, goal, film, comic book, band, pop star
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (5 câu): net / bat / sail / model boat / catch the bus. 2) Trò 'Who am I?': cô đọc 3 câu gợi ý, đội nào đoán đúng trước được điểm (football player / ice skater / pop star / film star). 3) Nghe và tô màu (dạng Movers Listening Part 5): 'Colour the bat red.' / 'Colour the model boat blue.' / 'Colour the net green.'
en.truyen: Leo's Birthday Present — It's Leo's birthday. Grandpa gives him a model boat and a baseball bat. They catch the bus to the river. Leo sails his model boat. Then Grandpa says, 'Can you hit the ball with your bat?' Leo practises. The ball goes over the net! 'You're a good player!' says Grandpa. 'Our team can win!'
en.baihat: Catch the Bus (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — We catch the bus to the river, the river, the river, / We catch the bus to the river, to sail our boat. / We hit the ball with a baseball bat, a baseball bat, a baseball bat, / We hit the ball with a baseball bat, over the net!

zh.flash: Mới: 礼物 lǐwù, 少 shǎo | Ôn: 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 排球 páiqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 上网 shàngwǎng, 电影 diànyǐng, 滑冰 huábīng, 太极拳 tàijíquán
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh: 我的礼物是一个篮球。/ 爷爷很少打网球。/ 我很少上网。 2) Trò 猜一猜: cô đọc gợi ý (我用脚。我踢……) → con nói môn thể thao. 3) Khảo sát lớp: 你很少做什么运动？— 我很少…… (ghi vào bảng 多 / 少).
zh.truyen: Leo的生日 — 今天是Leo的生日。爷爷给他一个礼物：一个篮球！Leo说：'谢谢爷爷！我们一起打篮球吧！' 爷爷很少打篮球，他打得很慢。Leo说：'别着急，爷爷！' 爷爷笑了：'我喜欢打太极拳！' (Jīntiān shì Leo de shēngrì. Yéye gěi tā yí gè lǐwù: yí gè lánqiú! Leo shuō: 'Xièxie yéye! Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú ba!' Yéye hěn shǎo dǎ lánqiú, tā dǎ de hěn màn. Leo shuō: 'Bié zháojí, yéye!' Yéye xiào le: 'Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ tàijíquán!')
zh.baihat: 生日礼物 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 一个礼物，一个礼物，是篮球，是篮球！爷爷很少打球，爷爷很少打球，打太极，打太极！(Yí gè lǐwù, yí gè lǐwù, shì lánqiú, shì lánqiú! Yéye hěn shǎo dǎ qiú, yéye hěn shǎo dǎ qiú, dǎ tàijí, dǎ tàijí!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 28. Unit 6 · I Like Sports – Truyện và Phiên dịch nhí

web.label: Ngày 55. Unit 6 · Truyện: Nhan và đội bóng chuyền

en.tu: Ôn: team, volleyball, practise, win, match, player, net, score, difficult, brave | Ôn nhanh: sometimes, could
en.cum: play volleyball / practise every day / over the net / win the match / a good player
en.cau: Nhan can't play volleyball well. / Volleyball is difficult, but Nhan is brave. / She practises every day after school. / Our team can win the match!
en.truyen: Nhan and the Volleyball Team — Nhan wants to be in the school volleyball team. But she can't hit the ball over the net. Sometimes she cries. Her friend Leo says, 'Don't be sad. Let's practise together!' They practise every day. On Saturday there's a big match. Nhan hits the ball over the net and scores! Her team wins. 'You're a brilliant player, Nhan!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "volleyball for kids practise team story"

zh.tu: Ôn: 排球 páiqiú, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 礼物 lǐwù, 难 nán, 别 bié, 哭 kū | Ôn nhanh: 自己 zìjǐ, 先生 xiānsheng
zh.cum: 打排球 dǎ páiqiú / 每天打 měi tiān dǎ / 别哭 bié kū / 一起打 yìqǐ dǎ
zh.cau: 排球很难。(Páiqiú hěn nán.) / 别哭，我们一起打吧！(Bié kū, wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ ba!) / Nhan每天打排球。(Nhan měi tiān dǎ páiqiú.) / 老师给她一个礼物。(Lǎoshī gěi tā yí gè lǐwù.)
zh.truyen: Nhan和排球 — Nhan喜欢打排球。排球很难，她打得不好，她哭了。Leo说：'别哭！我们一起打吧！' 他们每天下午一起打排球。星期六，Nhan打得很好！老师给她一个礼物。Nhan说：'谢谢Leo！' (Nhan xǐhuan dǎ páiqiú. Páiqiú hěn nán, tā dǎ de bù hǎo, tā kū le. Leo shuō: 'Bié kū! Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ ba!' Tāmen měi tiān xiàwǔ yìqǐ dǎ páiqiú. Xīngqīliù, Nhan dǎ de hěn hǎo! Lǎoshī gěi tā yí gè lǐwù. Nhan shuō: 'Xièxie Leo!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "打排球 儿童 故事 汉语"

web.label: Ngày 56. Unit 6 · Phiên dịch nhí: phỏng vấn thể thao

en.tu: Ôn: ice skating, volleyball, team, win, film, pop star, practise, skate | Ôn nhanh: could, sometimes
en.cum: What sport do you like? / Can you play …? / Let's play … together! / I don't like …
en.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Trung, nói tiếng Anh) What sport do you like? I like table tennis. / Can you play badminton? Yes, I can. / I don't like basketball. / Let's play table tennis together! / Do you like films?
en.truyen: The Sports Interview — Xiaomei visits Anna's school. Nhan is the little interpreter. Anna asks, 'What sport do you like?' Nhan says it in Chinese. Xiaomei answers, 'I like table tennis and ice skating.' Nhan says it in English. 'Can you play badminton?' 'No, I can't.' 'Let's play table tennis together!' The girls play and laugh.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports interview kids English Chinese"

zh.tu: Ôn: 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 滑冰 huábīng, 篮球 lánqiú, 电影 diànyǐng, 上网 shàngwǎng, 少 shǎo | Ôn nhanh: 国家 guójiā, 自己 zìjǐ
zh.cum: 你喜欢什么运动 nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng / 你会……吗 nǐ huì … ma / 一起打乒乓球 yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú / 我不喜欢 wǒ bù xǐhuan
zh.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Anh, nói tiếng Trung) 你喜欢什么运动？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?) / 我喜欢乒乓球和滑冰。(Wǒ xǐhuan pīngpāngqiú hé huábīng.) / 你会打羽毛球吗？——不会。(Nǐ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú ma? — Bú huì.) / 我们一起打乒乓球吧！(Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú ba!)
zh.truyen: 运动小记者 — Xiaomei来Anna的学校。Nhan是小翻译。Anna问：'你喜欢什么运动？' Xiaomei说：'我喜欢乒乓球和滑冰。' Anna问：'你会打羽毛球吗？' Xiaomei说：'不会。' Anna说：'我们一起打乒乓球吧！' (Xiaomei lái Anna de xuéxiào. Nhan shì xiǎo fānyì. Anna wèn: 'Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?' Xiaomei shuō: 'Wǒ xǐhuan pīngpāngqiú hé huábīng.' Anna wèn: 'Nǐ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú ma?' Xiaomei shuō: 'Bú huì.' Anna shuō: 'Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú ba!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你喜欢什么运动 儿童 对话"

en.flash: Ôn: ice, skate, practise, team, volleyball, win, match, player, goal, score, net, bat, film, band, pop star, comic book
en.slide: 1) Xếp 5 tranh truyện Nhan and the Volleyball Team và kể lại, mỗi tranh 1 câu. 2) Đọc và điền từ (dạng Movers Reading Part 3, 5 chỗ trống): practise / team / net / win / match. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một con hỏi bằng tiếng Việt tình huống, bạn kia nói tiếng Anh: What sport do you like? / Can you play badminton? / Let's play table tennis together!
en.truyen: Nhan and the Volleyball Team — Nhan wants to be in the school volleyball team, but volleyball is difficult. She can't hit the ball over the net. Sometimes she cries. Leo says, 'Don't be sad. Let's practise together!' They practise every day after school. On Saturday there's a big match. Nhan is brave. She hits the ball over the net and scores! Her team wins the match. The teacher gives her a present: a comic book about a famous volleyball player.
en.baihat: Practise Every Day (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — Nhan can play volleyball, volleyball, volleyball, / Nhan can play volleyball, she practises every day! / Hit the ball over the net, over the net, over the net, / Hit the ball over the net, and our team can win!

zh.flash: Ôn: 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 排球 páiqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 滑冰 huábīng, 太极拳 tàijíquán, 电影 diànyǐng, 上网 shàngwǎng, 礼物 lǐwù, 少 shǎo
zh.slide: 1) Xếp tranh và kể truyện Nhan和排球 bằng câu: 排球很难。/ 别哭！/ 我们一起打吧！ 2) Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: What sport do you like? → 你喜欢什么运动？/ Can you play badminton? → 你会打羽毛球吗？ 3) Nghe chọn tranh đúng (dạng YCT3 nghe, 5 câu): 我喜欢踢足球。/ 爷爷每天打太极拳。/ 我很少上网。
zh.truyen: Nhan和排球 — Nhan很喜欢打排球。排球很难，她打得不好，她哭了。Leo说：'别哭！我们一起打吧！' 他们每天下午一起打排球。星期六，Nhan打得很好！老师给Nhan一个礼物。Nhan说：'谢谢老师，谢谢Leo！' (Nhan hěn xǐhuan dǎ páiqiú. Páiqiú hěn nán, tā dǎ de bù hǎo, tā kū le. Leo shuō: 'Bié kū! Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ ba!' Tāmen měi tiān xiàwǔ yìqǐ dǎ páiqiú. Xīngqīliù, Nhan dǎ de hěn hǎo! Lǎoshī gěi Nhan yí gè lǐwù. Nhan shuō: 'Xièxie lǎoshī, xièxie Leo!')
zh.baihat: 我们一起打排球 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 别哭别哭，别哭别哭，一起打，一起打！每天打排球，每天打排球，打得好！打得好！(Bié kū bié kū, bié kū bié kū, yìqǐ dǎ, yìqǐ dǎ! Měi tiān dǎ páiqiú, měi tiān dǎ páiqiú, dǎ de hǎo! Dǎ de hǎo!)

blocks.title: Unit 7 · Yummy Food · 好吃的点心！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 29. Unit 7 · Yummy Food – Bữa trưa và tráng miệng

web.label: Ngày 57. Unit 7 · Hộp cơm trưa

en.tu: Mới: sandwich, cheese, salad, pasta, sauce, pancake | Ôn: always, country, bread, tomato, lunch, breakfast
en.cum: a cheese sandwich / a tomato salad / pasta with tomato sauce / pancakes for breakfast / a lunch box
en.cau: I want to eat rice. / I want to eat a cheese sandwich. / I always have pancakes for breakfast. / I'd like pasta with tomato sauce, please. / Pasta is from Italy. It's a famous food in that country.
en.truyen: Lunch Box — It's Monday. Mum makes Anna's lunch box: a cheese sandwich and a tomato salad. Leo always has pasta with tomato sauce. At lunch they sit together at school. Anna gives Leo half of her sandwich. 'Thank you! Yummy!' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "food vocabulary for kids sandwich cheese salad pasta pancake"

zh.tu: Mới: 面包 miànbāo, 菜 cài, 卖 mài | Ôn: 半 bàn, 米饭 mǐfàn, 吃 chī, 饭店 fàndiàn, 午饭 wǔfàn
zh.cum: 吃面包 chī miànbāo / 卖面包 mài miànbāo / 两个菜 liǎng gè cài / 半个面包 bàn gè miànbāo
zh.cau: 我想吃米饭。(Wǒ xiǎng chī mǐfàn.) / 我想吃面包。(Wǒ xiǎng chī miànbāo.) / 这个饭店卖什么菜？(Zhège fàndiàn mài shénme cài?) / 妈妈做了三个菜。(Māma zuòle sān gè cài.)
zh.truyen: 午饭 — 星期一中午，Anna和Leo在学校吃午饭。Anna吃面包，Leo吃米饭和两个菜。Anna给Leo半个面包。Leo说：'谢谢！很好吃！' (Xīngqīyī zhōngwǔ, Anna hé Leo zài xuéxiào chī wǔfàn. Anna chī miànbāo, Leo chī mǐfàn hé liǎng gè cài. Anna gěi Leo bàn gè miànbāo. Leo shuō: 'Xièxie! Hěn hǎochī!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我想吃 面包 米饭 儿童 汉语"

web.label: Ngày 58. Unit 7 · Đồ uống và tráng miệng

en.tu: Mới: dessert, biscuit, cookie, milkshake, tea, coffee | Ôn: past, look for, ice cream, chocolate, juice, milk
en.cum: a chocolate milkshake / a cup of tea / a cup of coffee / biscuits (US cookies) / ice cream for dessert
en.cau: What's your favourite dessert? / My favourite dessert is ice cream. / What would you like to drink? I'd like a milkshake, please. / Grandma drinks tea at half past three. / In the USA, biscuits are called cookies.
en.truyen: Grandma's Tea Time — At half past three, Grandma has tea time. She drinks a cup of tea. Dad drinks coffee. Bông has a chocolate milkshake and some biscuits. 'What's your favourite dessert, Grandma?' asks Bông. 'Ice cream!' says Grandma. Everyone laughs.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "desserts and drinks vocabulary for kids milkshake biscuit"

zh.tu: Mới: 点心 diǎnxin, 饼干 bǐnggān, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 糖果 tángguǒ | Ôn: 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 茶 chá, 果汁 guǒzhī, 牛奶 niúnǎi, 最 zuì
zh.cum: 吃点心 chī diǎnxin / 巧克力饼干 qiǎokèlì bǐnggān / 一个冰淇淋 yí gè bīngqílín / 很多糖果 hěn duō tángguǒ
zh.cau: 你想喝什么？(Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme?) / 你最喜欢的点心是什么？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de diǎnxin shì shénme?) / 我最喜欢的点心是冰淇淋。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de diǎnxin shì bīngqílín.) / 洗澡以后，我喝牛奶。(Xǐzǎo yǐhòu, wǒ hē niúnǎi.)
zh.truyen: 奶奶的点心 — 下午三点半，奶奶喝茶，吃点心。Bông喝果汁，吃巧克力饼干。Bông问：'奶奶，你最喜欢的点心是什么？' 奶奶说：'冰淇淋！' 大家都笑了。(Xiàwǔ sān diǎn bàn, nǎinai hē chá, chī diǎnxin. Bông hē guǒzhī, chī qiǎokèlì bǐnggān. Bông wèn: 'Nǎinai, nǐ zuì xǐhuan de diǎnxin shì shénme?' Nǎinai shuō: 'Bīngqílín!' Dàjiā dōu xiào le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "点心 冰淇淋 巧克力 饼干 儿童"

en.flash: Mới: sandwich, cheese, salad, pasta, sauce, pancake, dessert, biscuit, cookie, milkshake, tea, coffee | Ôn: bread, tomato, ice cream, chocolate, juice, milk
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (8 câu): sandwich / cheese / salad / pasta / pancake / milkshake / tea / coffee. 2) Hỏi – đáp cặp đôi: What's your favourite dessert? — My favourite dessert is … / What would you like to drink? — I'd like …, please. 3) Kéo thả món ăn vào hộp cơm theo câu cô đọc: 'Put a cheese sandwich and a salad in Anna's lunch box.'
en.truyen: Lunch and Tea Time — At school, Anna has a cheese sandwich and a tomato salad. Leo has pasta with tomato sauce. After school, they go to Grandma's house. It's half past three: tea time! Grandma drinks tea. Anna drinks a milkshake. Leo eats biscuits. 'In America, biscuits are called cookies,' says Grandma. 'What's your favourite dessert?' 'Pancakes!' says Leo.
en.baihat: What Would You Like? (giai điệu London Bridge) — What would you like to eat today, eat today, eat today? / A cheese sandwich and a salad, please, yummy, yummy! / What would you like to drink today, drink today, drink today? / A milkshake or a cup of tea, yummy, yummy!

zh.flash: Mới: 面包 miànbāo, 菜 cài, 卖 mài, 点心 diǎnxin, 饼干 bǐnggān, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 糖果 tángguǒ | Ôn: 米饭 mǐfàn, 茶 chá, 果汁 guǒzhī, 牛奶 niúnǎi
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 面包 / 饼干 / 冰淇淋 / 巧克力 / 糖果 / 点心. 2) Đóng vai cửa hàng bánh: 你卖什么？— 我卖面包和饼干。/ 你想吃什么？— 我想吃…… 3) Phỏng vấn: 你最喜欢的点心是什么？ ghi kết quả lên bảng.
zh.truyen: 奶奶家 — 中午，Anna吃面包，Leo吃米饭和菜。下午三点半，他们去奶奶家。奶奶喝茶，Anna喝牛奶，Leo吃巧克力饼干。奶奶问：'你们最喜欢的点心是什么？' Anna说：'冰淇淋！' Leo说：'糖果！' (Zhōngwǔ, Anna chī miànbāo, Leo chī mǐfàn hé cài. Xiàwǔ sān diǎn bàn, tāmen qù nǎinai jiā. Nǎinai hē chá, Anna hē niúnǎi, Leo chī qiǎokèlì bǐnggān. Nǎinai wèn: 'Nǐmen zuì xǐhuan de diǎnxin shì shénme?' Anna shuō: 'Bīngqílín!' Leo shuō: 'Tángguǒ!')
zh.baihat: 你想吃什么 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 你想吃什么？你想吃什么？我想吃，我想吃，面包和饼干，巧克力冰淇淋，真好吃！真好吃！(Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Wǒ xiǎng chī, wǒ xiǎng chī, miànbāo hé bǐnggān, qiǎokèlì bīngqílín, zhēn hǎochī! Zhēn hǎochī!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 30. Unit 7 · Yummy Food – Vị món ăn và ở nhà hàng

web.label: Ngày 59. Unit 7 · Vị gì thế?

en.tu: Mới: sweet, salty, sour, spicy, bitter, both | Ôn: team, win, practise, match, film, flag
en.cum: very sweet / too salty / a sour lemon / spicy food / bitter coffee / both … and …
en.cau: This cake is very sweet. / Lemons are sour. / The chips are salty. / I don't like spicy food. / Coffee is bitter. / I like both cheese and chocolate. / Our team can win the tasting game!
en.truyen: The Tasting Game — Leo's team plays a tasting game after the football match. Leo eats a lemon. 'Sour!' Anna drinks coffee. 'Bitter!' Nhan eats chips. 'Salty!' Bông eats a sweet. 'Sweet!' Xiaomei eats some spicy chicken. 'Spicy!' Their team wins the game!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "tastes for kids sweet salty sour spicy bitter"

zh.tu: Mới: 甜 tián, 咸 xián, 酸 suān, 辣 là, 苦 kǔ | Ôn: 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 礼物 lǐwù, 电影 diànyǐng, 少 shǎo, 丢 diū
zh.cum: 很甜 hěn tián / 太咸了 tài xián le / 有点儿酸 yǒudiǎnr suān / 很辣 hěn là / 很苦 hěn kǔ
zh.cau: 这个蛋糕很甜。(Zhège dàngāo hěn tián.) / 汤太咸了。(Tāng tài xián le.) / 这个苹果有点儿酸。(Zhège píngguǒ yǒudiǎnr suān.) / 我很少吃辣的菜。(Wǒ hěn shǎo chī là de cài.) / 茶很苦。(Chá hěn kǔ.)
zh.truyen: 甜、酸、苦、辣 — 打完篮球，Leo和同学们玩一个游戏。Anna喝茶：'很苦！' Nhan喝汤：'太咸了！' Bông吃糖果：'很甜！' Xiaomei吃苹果：'有点儿酸！' Leo吃菜：'很辣！' 大家都笑了。(Dǎwán lánqiú, Leo hé tóngxuémen wán yí gè yóuxì. Anna hē chá: 'Hěn kǔ!' Nhan hē tāng: 'Tài xián le!' Bông chī tángguǒ: 'Hěn tián!' Xiaomei chī píngguǒ: 'Yǒudiǎnr suān!' Leo chī cài: 'Hěn là!' Dàjiā dōu xiào le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "酸甜苦辣咸 儿童 味道"

web.label: Ngày 60. Unit 7 · Ở nhà hàng

en.tu: Mới: excuse me, call, change, something, nothing, because | Ôn: language, look for, menu, waiter, watermelon
en.cum: Excuse me! / call the waiter / change my drink / something sweet / nothing in the bowl
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi lựa chọn … or …?] Do you like apples or bananas? / Would you like ice cream or watermelon? / Excuse me, can I change my drink, please? / I want something sweet. / There's nothing in my bowl! / I like watermelon because it's sweet.
en.truyen: At the Restaurant — Leo and his dad are in a restaurant. 'Excuse me!' Dad calls the waiter. 'Can we see the menu, please?' Leo wants something sweet. 'Ice cream or watermelon?' asks the waiter. 'Watermelon, because it's hot today!' Leo's juice is sour. 'Excuse me, can I change my drink, please?'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "at the restaurant role play for kids excuse me menu"

zh.tu: Mới: 还是 háishi, 西瓜 xīguā, 因为 yīnwèi | Ôn: 小姐 xiǎojiě, 服务员 fúwùyuán, 菜单 càidān, 请 qǐng, 甜 tián
zh.cum: 苹果还是香蕉 píngguǒ háishi xiāngjiāo / 吃西瓜 chī xīguā / 因为很甜 yīnwèi hěn tián / 请给我菜单 qǐng gěi wǒ càidān
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi lựa chọn A 还是 B？] 你喜欢苹果还是香蕉？(Nǐ xǐhuan píngguǒ háishi xiāngjiāo?) / 你想喝茶还是果汁？(Nǐ xiǎng hē chá háishi guǒzhī?) / 我喜欢西瓜，因为西瓜很甜。(Wǒ xǐhuan xīguā, yīnwèi xīguā hěn tián.) / 小姐，请给我菜单。(Xiǎojiě, qǐng gěi wǒ càidān.)
zh.truyen: 在饭店 — Leo和爸爸在饭店。爸爸说：'小姐，请给我们菜单。' 服务员问：'你们想吃冰淇淋还是西瓜？' Leo说：'西瓜！因为今天很热。' 西瓜很甜，很好吃！(Leo hé bàba zài fàndiàn. Bàba shuō: 'Xiǎojiě, qǐng gěi wǒmen càidān.' Fúwùyuán wèn: 'Nǐmen xiǎng chī bīngqílín háishi xīguā?' Leo shuō: 'Xīguā! Yīnwèi jīntiān hěn rè.' Xīguā hěn tián, hěn hǎochī!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "还是 选择问句 儿童 汉语 饭店"

en.flash: Mới: sweet, salty, sour, spicy, bitter, both, excuse me, call, change, something, nothing, because | Ôn: menu, waiter, watermelon, lemon, coffee, chips
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn vị (5 câu): sweet / salty / sour / spicy / bitter. 2) Đóng vai nhà hàng: Excuse me! Can I see the menu, please? — Would you like … or …? — …, please, because … 3) Nghe và nối (dạng Movers Listening Part 1): cô đọc 'Leo wants something sweet. Anna doesn't want anything spicy.' → nối tên với món.
en.truyen: The Tasting Restaurant — Leo's family goes to a new restaurant. 'Excuse me!' Dad calls the waiter. 'Would you like something sweet or something spicy?' asks the waiter. Leo wants both! The chicken is spicy. The soup is salty. The lemon juice is sour. Dad's coffee is bitter. 'Can I change my drink, please? I want a milkshake because it's sweet!' says Leo. There's nothing on his plate at the end. Yummy!
en.baihat: Sweet and Sour (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — Sweet, sweet, sweet, the cake is sweet, / Salty, salty chips I eat. / Sour lemon, spicy food, / Bitter coffee isn't good! / Excuse me, please, can I change? / Something sweet, the same again!

zh.flash: Mới: 甜 tián, 咸 xián, 酸 suān, 辣 là, 苦 kǔ, 还是 háishi, 西瓜 xīguā, 因为 yīnwèi | Ôn: 服务员 fúwùyuán, 菜单 càidān, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 茶 chá, 汤 tāng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh vị: 很甜 / 太咸了 / 有点儿酸 / 很辣 / 很苦. 2) Hỏi – đáp câu lựa chọn: 你想吃西瓜还是冰淇淋？— 我想吃西瓜，因为西瓜很甜。 3) Đóng vai gọi món: 小姐，请给我菜单。/ 你们想吃什么？
zh.truyen: 在饭店吃饭 — Leo一家去饭店。爸爸说：'小姐，请给我们菜单。' 服务员问：'你们想吃甜的还是辣的？' Leo说：'甜的！' 汤太咸了，茶很苦。Leo说：'我想吃西瓜，因为西瓜很甜！' (Leo yì jiā qù fàndiàn. Bàba shuō: 'Xiǎojiě, qǐng gěi wǒmen càidān.' Fúwùyuán wèn: 'Nǐmen xiǎng chī tián de háishi là de?' Leo shuō: 'Tián de!' Tāng tài xián le, chá hěn kǔ. Leo shuō: 'Wǒ xiǎng chī xīguā, yīnwèi xīguā hěn tián!')
zh.baihat: 酸甜苦辣 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 西瓜很甜，西瓜很甜，汤很咸，汤很咸，苹果有点儿酸，茶很苦，菜很辣，真好吃！真好吃！(Xīguā hěn tián, xīguā hěn tián, tāng hěn xián, tāng hěn xián, píngguǒ yǒudiǎnr suān, chá hěn kǔ, cài hěn là, zhēn hǎochī! Zhēn hǎochī!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 31. Unit 7 · Yummy Food – Làm bánh và thực đơn bí mật

web.label: Ngày 61. Unit 7 · Làm bánh pancake

en.tu: Mới: break, inside, badly, loudly, quickly | Ôn: look for, flag, pancake, plate, chocolate
en.cum: look inside the box / break a plate / cook badly / laugh loudly / eat quickly
en.cau: Look inside the box. There's some chocolate! / Oh no! I break a plate. / Don't eat quickly. / My brother laughs loudly. / I'm looking for the chocolate. / I cook badly, but my pancakes are yummy.
en.truyen: Making Pancakes — Nhan and her mum make pancakes. Nhan is looking for the chocolate. It's inside the box! Oh no! Nhan breaks a plate. 'It's OK,' says Mum. Nhan makes the pancakes badly — they aren't round. But they're yummy! Her brother eats quickly and laughs loudly. 'More, please!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "making pancakes for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 但是 dànshì | Ôn: 丢 diū, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā, 找 zhǎo, 里面 lǐmiàn, 盒子 hézi
