zh.cum: 但是很好吃 dànshì hěn hǎochī / 找巧克力 zhǎo qiǎokèlì / 在盒子里面 zài hézi lǐmiàn / 丢了 diū le
zh.cau: 这个点心很小，但是很好吃。(Zhège diǎnxin hěn xiǎo, dànshì hěn hǎochī.) / 我喜欢巧克力，但是我不喜欢糖果。(Wǒ xǐhuan qiǎokèlì, dànshì wǒ bù xǐhuan tángguǒ.) / 我的面包丢了！(Wǒ de miànbāo diū le!) / 妈妈在找什么？(Māma zài zhǎo shénme?)
zh.truyen: 做点心 — Nhan和妈妈做点心。Nhan在找巧克力。巧克力在哪儿？在盒子里面！Nhan做的点心不好看，但是很好吃。哥哥说：'很甜，很好吃！' (Nhan hé māma zuò diǎnxin. Nhan zài zhǎo qiǎokèlì. Qiǎokèlì zài nǎr? Zài hézi lǐmiàn! Nhan zuò de diǎnxin bù hǎokàn, dànshì hěn hǎochī. Gēge shuō: 'Hěn tián, hěn hǎochī!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "但是 儿童 汉语 做点心"

web.label: Ngày 62. Unit 7 · Ôn không tranh: thực đơn bí mật

en.tu: Ôn: sandwich, sweet, excuse me, biscuit, cookie, pasta, salad, dessert, salty, spicy, sour, bitter, because | Ôn nhanh: always, country
en.cum: a cheese sandwich / something sweet / both … and … / Excuse me! / because it's sweet
en.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) Do you like pasta or salad? / What's your favourite dessert? / Is coffee sweet or bitter? / Excuse me, can I have a sandwich, please? / Why do you like ice cream? Because it's sweet.
en.truyen: The Secret Menu — Listen and guess the food. It's round. It's sweet. We eat it for breakfast with chocolate sauce. What is it? A pancake! / It's yellow. It's sour. We make lemonade with it. What is it? A lemon! / It's from Italy. We eat it with tomato sauce. What is it? Pasta!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "guess the food riddles for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 饼干 bǐnggān, 菜 cài, 还是 háishi, 辣 là, 卖 mài, 面包 miànbāo, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 西瓜 xīguā, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 咸 xián, 点心 diǎnxin, 糖果 tángguǒ, 苦 kǔ, 酸 suān, 但是 dànshì, 因为 yīnwèi | Ôn nhanh: 半 bàn, 洗澡 xǐzǎo
zh.cum: 西瓜还是苹果 xīguā háishi píngguǒ / 因为很甜 yīnwèi hěn tián / 但是很辣 dànshì hěn là
zh.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) 你想吃面包还是米饭？(Nǐ xiǎng chī miànbāo háishi mǐfàn?) / 你为什么喜欢西瓜？因为西瓜很甜。(Nǐ wèishénme xǐhuan xīguā? Yīnwèi xīguā hěn tián.) / 茶甜吗？不甜，很苦。(Chá tián ma? Bù tián, hěn kǔ.) / 这个菜很好吃，但是很辣。(Zhège cài hěn hǎochī, dànshì hěn là.)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — 它很大，是绿色的，里面是红色的。它很甜，夏天很好吃。它是什么？西瓜！/ 它是黑色的，很甜，小朋友都喜欢。它是什么？巧克力！(Tā hěn dà, shì lǜsè de, lǐmiàn shì hóngsè de. Tā hěn tián, xiàtiān hěn hǎochī. Tā shì shénme? Xīguā! / Tā shì hēisè de, hěn tián, xiǎopéngyou dōu xǐhuan. Tā shì shénme? Qiǎokèlì!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "猜水果 谜语 儿童 西瓜"

en.flash: Mới: break, inside, badly, loudly, quickly | Ôn: sandwich, cheese, pasta, sauce, pancake, dessert, biscuit, cookie, sweet, salty, sour, spicy, bitter, excuse me, something, nothing
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn trạng từ (4 câu): He eats quickly. / She laughs loudly. / He cooks badly. / Look inside the box. 2) Trò 'Secret Menu': cô đọc 3 gợi ý, đội đoán món (pancake / lemon / pasta / sandwich). 3) Sắp xếp các bước làm pancake theo tranh và nói: First … Then …
en.truyen: Nhan's Pancake Party — Nhan and her mum make pancakes for a party. Nhan is looking for the chocolate. It's inside the box! Oh no, she breaks a plate. 'Don't worry,' says Mum. Nhan makes the pancakes badly — they aren't round. But with chocolate sauce they're sweet and yummy! Her friends eat quickly and laugh loudly. 'Can we have something more?' 'Sorry, there's nothing on the plate now!'
en.baihat: Pancake Song (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Make, make, make pancakes, / Look inside the box, / Chocolate sauce and cheese and milk, / Eat them quickly, yum! / Oh no, I break a plate, / Laughing loudly, ha! / Pancakes, pancakes, round or not, / They're the best, hurrah!

zh.flash: Mới: 但是 dànshì | Ôn: 面包 miànbāo, 菜 cài, 卖 mài, 点心 diǎnxin, 饼干 bǐnggān, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 糖果 tángguǒ, 甜 tián, 咸 xián, 酸 suān, 辣 là, 苦 kǔ, 还是 háishi, 西瓜 xīguā, 因为 yīnwèi
zh.slide: 1) Nối hai nửa câu với 但是: 这个点心很小 — 但是很好吃 / 我喜欢巧克力 — 但是我不喜欢糖果. 2) Trò 猜一猜 không tranh: cô đọc gợi ý → con nói tên món (西瓜 / 巧克力 / 面包). 3) Nghe chọn đúng/sai (dạng YCT3 nghe): 巧克力在盒子里面。/ Nhan的点心不好吃。
zh.truyen: Nhan的点心 — Nhan和妈妈做点心。Nhan在找巧克力。妈妈说：'巧克力在盒子里面。' Nhan做的点心不好看，但是很甜，很好吃。朋友们问：'你们卖点心吗？' Nhan笑了：'不卖！我们一起吃吧！' (Nhan hé māma zuò diǎnxin. Nhan zài zhǎo qiǎokèlì. Māma shuō: 'Qiǎokèlì zài hézi lǐmiàn.' Nhan zuò de diǎnxin bù hǎokàn, dànshì hěn tián, hěn hǎochī. Péngyoumen wèn: 'Nǐmen mài diǎnxin ma?' Nhan xiào le: 'Bú mài! Wǒmen yìqǐ chī ba!')
zh.baihat: 但是很好吃 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 点心很小，点心很小，但是甜，但是甜，巧克力在里面，巧克力在里面，真好吃！真好吃！(Diǎnxin hěn xiǎo, diǎnxin hěn xiǎo, dànshì tián, dànshì tián, qiǎokèlì zài lǐmiàn, qiǎokèlì zài lǐmiàn, zhēn hǎochī! Zhēn hǎochī!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 32. Unit 7 · Yummy Food – Truyện và Phiên dịch nhí

web.label: Ngày 63. Unit 7 · Truyện: Thực đơn của Xiaomei

en.tu: Ôn: sandwich, sweet, salad, pasta, dessert, milkshake, cookie, spicy, both, because | Ôn nhanh: always, country, language
en.cum: a class party / a menu for the party / something sweet / both … and …
en.cau: Let's make a menu! / We want both sweet and salty food. / Leo doesn't eat spicy food. / I like cookies because they're sweet.
en.truyen: Xiaomei's Menu — Xiaomei and Bông make a menu for the class party. 'Let's have sandwiches and pasta,' says Bông. 'And a salad!' says Xiaomei. 'Leo doesn't like spicy food, so no spicy chicken.' For dessert, they want both ice cream and cookies. For drinks, milkshakes and lemonade. The class loves the menu!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "make a menu for kids food project"

zh.tu: Ôn: 面包 miànbāo, 菜 cài, 点心 diǎnxin, 饼干 bǐnggān, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 辣 là, 甜 tián, 还是 háishi, 因为 yīnwèi | Ôn nhanh: 小姐 xiǎojiě, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā
zh.cum: 做菜单 zuò càidān / 甜的点心 tián de diǎnxin / 不吃辣的 bù chī là de / 面包还是米饭 miànbāo háishi mǐfàn
zh.cau: 我们做一个菜单吧！(Wǒmen zuò yí gè càidān ba!) / 你想吃面包还是米饭？(Nǐ xiǎng chī miànbāo háishi mǐfàn?) / Leo不吃辣的菜。(Leo bù chī là de cài.) / 我喜欢饼干，因为饼干很甜。(Wǒ xǐhuan bǐnggān, yīnwèi bǐnggān hěn tián.)
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的菜单 — Xiaomei和Bông给班里做菜单。Bông问：'我们吃面包还是米饭？' Xiaomei说：'面包！还有一个菜。' Leo不吃辣的，因为他觉得辣的不好吃。点心是冰淇淋和饼干。大家都很喜欢这个菜单！(Xiaomei hé Bông gěi bān lǐ zuò càidān. Bông wèn: 'Wǒmen chī miànbāo háishi mǐfàn?' Xiaomei shuō: 'Miànbāo! Hái yǒu yí gè cài.' Leo bù chī là de, yīnwèi tā juéde là de bù hǎochī. Diǎnxin shì bīngqílín hé bǐnggān. Dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuan zhège càidān!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童 做菜单 汉语 点心"

web.label: Ngày 64. Unit 7 · Phiên dịch nhí: gọi món

en.tu: Ôn: excuse me, sandwich, sweet, biscuit, cookie, salty, spicy, change, something, because | Ôn nhanh: language, look for
en.cum: Excuse me! / What would you like? / … or …? / because it's …
en.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Trung, nói tiếng Anh) Excuse me, can I see the menu, please? / Would you like tea or juice? / I want something sweet. / This soup is too salty. / I like watermelon because it's sweet.
en.truyen: The Little Interpreter at the Café — Xiaomei's grandma visits Hanoi. She can't speak English. Nhan helps her at a café. 'Excuse me!' Nhan calls the waiter. 'Grandma would like tea or juice?' 'Tea, please.' 'And something sweet: chocolate biscuits!' Grandma smiles. 'Thank you, little interpreter!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "ordering food role play kids English Chinese"

zh.tu: Ôn: 还是 háishi, 甜 tián, 咸 xián, 饼干 bǐnggān, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 西瓜 xīguā, 卖 mài, 因为 yīnwèi, 但是 dànshì | Ôn nhanh: 小姐 xiǎojiě, 丢 diū
zh.cum: 请给我菜单 qǐng gěi wǒ càidān / 茶还是果汁 chá háishi guǒzhī / 甜的点心 tián de diǎnxin / 太咸了 tài xián le
zh.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Anh, nói tiếng Trung) 小姐，请给我菜单。(Xiǎojiě, qǐng gěi wǒ càidān.) / 你想喝茶还是果汁？(Nǐ xiǎng hē chá háishi guǒzhī?) / 我想吃甜的点心。(Wǒ xiǎng chī tián de diǎnxin.) / 这个汤太咸了。(Zhège tāng tài xián le.) / 我喜欢西瓜，因为西瓜很甜。(Wǒ xǐhuan xīguā, yīnwèi xīguā hěn tián.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译在饭店 — Xiaomei的奶奶来河内。她不会说英语。Nhan帮助她。Nhan说：'小姐，请给我们菜单。' 服务员问：'奶奶想喝茶还是果汁？' 奶奶说：'喝茶。' Nhan说：'还要巧克力饼干！' 奶奶笑了：'谢谢你，小翻译！' (Xiaomei de nǎinai lái Hénèi. Tā bú huì shuō Yīngyǔ. Nhan bāngzhù tā. Nhan shuō: 'Xiǎojiě, qǐng gěi wǒmen càidān.' Fúwùyuán wèn: 'Nǎinai xiǎng hē chá háishi guǒzhī?' Nǎinai shuō: 'Hē chá.' Nhan shuō: 'Hái yào qiǎokèlì bǐnggān!' Nǎinai xiào le: 'Xièxie nǐ, xiǎo fānyì!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "点菜 儿童 汉语 对话 饭店"

en.flash: Ôn: sandwich, sweet, excuse me, biscuit, cookie, cheese, salad, pasta, pancake, milkshake, dessert, salty, sour, spicy, bitter, both, because
en.slide: 1) Dự án nhỏ: mỗi nhóm làm thực đơn của riêng mình (Starter / Main / Dessert / Drinks) và giới thiệu: 'Our menu has …' 2) Đọc truyện Xiaomei's Menu, chọn đúng/sai (dạng Movers Reading Part 2, 5 câu): Leo likes spicy food. (No) / They want both ice cream and cookies. (Yes) 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp tại 'nhà hàng lớp': Excuse me! / Would you like … or …? / …, please, because …
en.truyen: Xiaomei's Menu — Xiaomei and Bông make a menu for the class party. 'Let's have sandwiches, pasta and a big salad,' says Bông. 'Leo doesn't like spicy food,' says Xiaomei, 'so no spicy chicken.' For dessert, they want both ice cream and chocolate cookies. For drinks, there's milkshake, lemonade and tea. At the party, Leo says, 'Excuse me, can I have something sweet?' 'Of course! Here's a cookie!' Everyone loves Xiaomei's menu.
en.baihat: Our Party Menu (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — On our menu there's pasta and cheese, / pasta and cheese, pasta and cheese, / On our menu there's pasta and cheese, / and salad, too! / For dessert we've got cookies and ice cream, / cookies and ice cream, cookies and ice cream, / For dessert we've got cookies and ice cream, / sweet and yummy!

zh.flash: Ôn: 饼干 bǐnggān, 菜 cài, 还是 háishi, 辣 là, 卖 mài, 面包 miànbāo, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 西瓜 xīguā, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 咸 xián, 点心 diǎnxin, 糖果 tángguǒ, 苦 kǔ, 酸 suān, 但是 dànshì, 因为 yīnwèi
zh.slide: 1) Mỗi nhóm làm 菜单 và giới thiệu: 我们的菜单有……，点心是…… 2) Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: Excuse me, the menu, please. → 小姐，请给我菜单。/ Tea or juice? → 茶还是果汁？ 3) Nghe chọn câu trả lời đúng (dạng YCT3): 你想吃面包还是米饭？ a) 我想吃米饭。 b) 米饭很咸。
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的菜单 — Xiaomei和Bông给班里做菜单。有面包、米饭和三个菜。Leo不吃辣的。点心有冰淇淋、饼干和西瓜。Leo问：'我可以吃甜的点心吗？' Xiaomei说：'当然可以！' 大家都说：'这个菜单真好！' (Xiaomei hé Bông gěi bān lǐ zuò càidān. Yǒu miànbāo, mǐfàn hé sān gè cài. Leo bù chī là de. Diǎnxin yǒu bīngqílín, bǐnggān hé xīguā. Leo wèn: 'Wǒ kěyǐ chī tián de diǎnxin ma?' Xiaomei shuō: 'Dāngrán kěyǐ!' Dàjiā dōu shuō: 'Zhège càidān zhēn hǎo!')
zh.baihat: 我们的菜单 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 面包米饭，面包米饭，还有菜，还有菜，饼干和冰淇淋，西瓜甜又甜，真好吃！真好吃！(Miànbāo mǐfàn, miànbāo mǐfàn, hái yǒu cài, hái yǒu cài, bǐnggān hé bīngqílín, xīguā tián yòu tián, zhēn hǎochī! Zhēn hǎochī!)

blocks.title: Unit 8 · How's the weather today? · 今天天气怎么样？

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 33. Unit 8 · How's the weather today? – Bốn mùa và khi con bị ốm

web.label: Ngày 65. Unit 8 · Bốn mùa

en.tu: Mới: season, spring, summer, autumn, fall, winter, wind | Ôn: usually, sandwich, sweet, snow, sun
en.cum: four seasons / in spring / in summer / in autumn (US fall) / in winter / a strong wind
en.cau: How's the weather today? / It's sunny today. / What season is it now? It's summer. / In winter it usually snows in the mountains. / In autumn there's a lot of wind. / In the USA, autumn is called fall.
en.truyen: Four Seasons in the Park — In spring, Bông sees lots of flowers in the park. In summer, it's hot and sunny, and she eats a sweet ice cream. In autumn, the wind is strong and the leaves fall. In winter, it's cold. 'What's your favourite season?' asks Mum. 'Summer, because I love ice cream!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "four seasons song for kids spring summer autumn winter"

zh.tu: Mới: 季节 jìjié, 春天 chūntiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān | Ôn: 电脑 diànnǎo, 天气 tiānqì, 冷 lěng, 热 rè, 刮风 guāfēng, 下雪 xiàxuě
zh.cum: 四个季节 sì gè jìjié / 春天来了 chūntiān lái le / 夏天很热 xiàtiān hěn rè / 冬天很冷 dōngtiān hěn lěng / 秋天刮风 qiūtiān guāfēng
zh.cau: 今天天气怎么样？(Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) / 今天是晴天。(Jīntiān shì qíngtiān.) / 现在是什么季节？(Xiànzài shì shénme jìjié?) / 现在是夏天。(Xiànzài shì xiàtiān.) / 冬天很冷，有时候下雪。(Dōngtiān hěn lěng, yǒu shíhou xiàxuě.)
zh.truyen: 公园的四个季节 — 春天，公园里有很多花。夏天很热，Bông吃冰淇淋。秋天常常刮风。冬天很冷。妈妈问：'你最喜欢什么季节？' Bông说：'夏天，因为我喜欢冰淇淋！' (Chūntiān, gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō huā. Xiàtiān hěn rè, Bông chī bīngqílín. Qiūtiān chángcháng guāfēng. Dōngtiān hěn lěng. Māma wèn: 'Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jìjié?' Bông shuō: 'Xiàtiān, yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuan bīngqílín!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "四季歌 儿童 春夏秋冬"

web.label: Ngày 66. Unit 8 · Con bị ốm

en.tu: Mới: ill, sick, cough, temperature, fever, matter, more | Ôn: shower, how long, minute, cold, doctor
en.cum: What's the matter? / have a cough / have a temperature / have a fever / feel ill / drink more water
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: have got + bệnh] Are you well? / I've got a cold. / What's the matter? I've got a cough. / Leo is sick. He's got a temperature. / Drink more water. / How long do you sleep? Ten hours.
en.truyen: Leo Is Ill — It's winter. Leo is ill. He's got a cough and a temperature. 'What's the matter, Leo?' asks Mum. 'I've got a fever.' Mum calls the doctor. 'Drink more water and sleep,' says the doctor. 'Don't have a cold shower.' Leo can't go to school today.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what's the matter song for kids I've got a cold cough"

zh.tu: Mới: 身体 shēntǐ, 生病 shēngbìng, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo | Ôn: 外面 wàimiàn, 医生 yīshēng, 冷 lěng, 喝 hē
zh.cum: 身体好 shēntǐ hǎo / 生病了 shēngbìng le / 感冒了 gǎnmào le / 发烧了 fāshāo le / 多喝水 duō hē shuǐ
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 了 chỉ sự thay đổi trạng thái] 你身体好吗？(Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma?) / 我感冒了。(Wǒ gǎnmào le.) / Leo生病了，他发烧了。(Leo shēngbìng le, tā fāshāo le.) / 外面很冷，别出去。(Wàimiàn hěn lěng, bié chūqù.)
zh.truyen: Leo生病了 — 冬天，外面很冷。Leo生病了。妈妈问：'Leo，你身体不好吗？' Leo说：'我感冒了，我发烧了。' 妈妈给医生打电话。医生说：'多喝水，多睡觉。' 今天Leo不去上学。(Dōngtiān, wàimiàn hěn lěng. Leo shēngbìng le. Māma wèn: 'Leo, nǐ shēntǐ bù hǎo ma?' Leo shuō: 'Wǒ gǎnmào le, wǒ fāshāo le.' Māma gěi yīshēng dǎ diànhuà. Yīshēng shuō: 'Duō hē shuǐ, duō shuìjiào.' Jīntiān Leo bú qù shàngxué.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我感冒了 儿童 汉语 生病 发烧"

en.flash: Mới: season, spring, summer, autumn, fall, winter, wind, ill, sick, cough, temperature, fever, matter, more | Ôn: sunny, cold, hot, snow, doctor
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn mùa (4 câu): spring / summer / autumn (fall) / winter. 2) Hỏi – đáp theo tranh: How's the weather today? — It's sunny / windy. / What season is it now? — It's … 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: What's the matter? — I've got a cough / a temperature / a fever. — Drink more water!
en.truyen: Leo's Winter — It's winter. The wind is strong and it's very cold. Leo plays outside without his sweater. The next day he's ill. He's got a cough, a fever and a temperature. 'What's the matter?' asks Mum. Mum calls the doctor. 'Drink more water and sleep,' says the doctor. In spring Leo is well again. 'Spring is my favourite season!' he says.
en.baihat: Four Seasons (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Spring and summer, spring and summer, / Autumn, winter, autumn, winter, / How's the weather today? How's the weather today? / Sunny and hot! Sunny and hot! / What's the matter? What's the matter? / I've got a cough, I've got a cough!

zh.flash: Mới: 季节 jìjié, 春天 chūntiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān, 身体 shēntǐ, 生病 shēngbìng, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo | Ôn: 天气 tiānqì, 冷 lěng, 热 rè, 刮风 guāfēng, 下雪 xiàxuě, 医生 yīshēng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh mùa: 春天 / 夏天 / 秋天 / 冬天. 2) Hỏi – đáp: 今天天气怎么样？— 今天是晴天。/ 现在是什么季节？— 现在是…… 3) Đóng vai: 你身体好吗？— 我感冒了。/ 我发烧了。— 多喝水！
zh.truyen: Leo的冬天 — 冬天，外面刮风，很冷。Leo没穿毛衣，在外面玩。第二天，Leo生病了。他感冒了，也发烧了。妈妈问：'你身体不好吗？' 医生说：'多喝水，多睡觉。' 春天来了，Leo的身体很好。(Dōngtiān, wàimiàn guāfēng, hěn lěng. Leo méi chuān máoyī, zài wàimiàn wán. Dì-èr tiān, Leo shēngbìng le. Tā gǎnmào le, yě fāshāo le. Māma wèn: 'Nǐ shēntǐ bù hǎo ma?' Yīshēng shuō: 'Duō hē shuǐ, duō shuìjiào.' Chūntiān lái le, Leo de shēntǐ hěn hǎo.)
zh.baihat: 四季歌 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 春天夏天，秋天冬天，四季节，四季节，夏天热，冬天冷，秋天常刮风，我喜欢，我喜欢！(Chūntiān xiàtiān, qiūtiān dōngtiān, sì jìjié, sì jìjié, xiàtiān rè, dōngtiān lěng, qiūtiān cháng guāfēng, wǒ xǐhuan, wǒ xǐhuan!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 34. Unit 8 · How's the weather today? – Đau ở đâu? Ở nha sĩ

web.label: Ngày 67. Unit 8 · Con đau ở đâu?

en.tu: Mới: sore, throat, headache, earache, toothache, stomach, stomach-ache, stomachache | Ôn: sweet, chocolate, biscuit, spicy, excuse me, quickly
en.cum: a sore throat / have a headache / have an earache / have a toothache / have a stomach-ache (US stomachache)
en.cau: I've got a sore throat. / I've got a headache. / I've got a toothache because I eat lots of sweets. / Spicy food gives me a stomach-ache. / Excuse me, I've got an earache. / In the USA, people write 'stomachache'.
en.truyen: Too Many Sweets — After the party, Nhan eats lots of sweet biscuits and chocolate very quickly. At night, she's got a stomach-ache and a toothache. 'What's the matter?' asks Dad. 'My stomach! And my tooth!' Dad says, 'No more sweets today!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "I've got a headache toothache stomachache song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 疼 téng, 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng, 牙疼 yá téng, 肚子 dùzi, 舒服 shūfu | Ôn: 甜 tián, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 饼干 bǐnggān, 辣 là, 糖果 tángguǒ, 哭 kū
zh.cum: 肚子疼 dùzi téng / 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng / 牙疼 yá téng / 头疼 tóu téng / 不舒服 bù shūfu
zh.cau: 我嗓子疼。(Wǒ sǎngzi téng.) / 我肚子疼，很不舒服。(Wǒ dùzi téng, hěn bù shūfu.) / 我吃了很多糖果，牙疼了。(Wǒ chīle hěn duō tángguǒ, yá téng le.) / 你哪儿不舒服？(Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?) / 别哭，我们去看医生。(Bié kū, wǒmen qù kàn yīshēng.)
zh.truyen: 糖果太多了 — 晚上，Nhan吃了很多饼干、巧克力和糖果。她肚子疼，牙也疼。爸爸问：'你哪儿不舒服？' Nhan说：'我肚子疼！' 爸爸说：'今天别吃糖果了！' (Wǎnshang, Nhan chīle hěn duō bǐnggān, qiǎokèlì hé tángguǒ. Tā dùzi téng, yá yě téng. Bàba wèn: 'Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?' Nhan shuō: 'Wǒ dùzi téng!' Bàba shuō: 'Jīntiān bié chī tángguǒ le!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你哪儿不舒服 儿童 汉语 肚子疼"

web.label: Ngày 68. Unit 8 · Ở phòng khám nha sĩ

en.tu: Mới: toothbrush, toothpaste, hurt, carefully, quietly, think | Ôn: straight, sandwich, salad, sweet, dentist
en.cum: a new toothbrush / some toothpaste / brush your teeth carefully / speak quietly / I think …
en.cau: Where does it hurt? My tooth hurts. / Brush your teeth carefully. / I think you've got a toothache. / Please speak quietly. The baby is asleep. / Go straight to the bathroom and brush your teeth.
en.truyen: At the Dentist — Nhan goes to the dentist. 'Where does it hurt?' 'Here!' The dentist looks carefully. 'I think you eat lots of sweets.' He gives Nhan a new toothbrush and some toothpaste. 'Brush your teeth carefully every morning and evening. Eat a sandwich or a salad, not sweets!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "brush your teeth song for kids toothbrush toothpaste"

zh.tu: Mới: 饿 è, 饱 bǎo, 药 yào | Ôn: 哭 kū, 菜 cài, 面包 miànbāo, 苦 kǔ, 但是 dànshì, 牙医 yáyī
zh.cum: 很饿 hěn è / 吃饱了 chībǎo le / 吃药 chī yào / 饿了 è le
zh.cau: 我饿了。(Wǒ è le.) / 我吃饱了。(Wǒ chībǎo le.) / 你要吃药。(Nǐ yào chī yào.) / 药很苦，但是你要吃。(Yào hěn kǔ, dànshì nǐ yào chī.)
zh.truyen: 看牙医 — Nhan牙疼，去看牙医。牙医说：'你吃了很多糖果。' 他给Nhan药。药很苦，但是Nhan没哭，她吃了。回家以后，Nhan很饿。妈妈给她面包。Nhan说：'我吃饱了，谢谢妈妈！' (Nhan yá téng, qù kàn yáyī. Yáyī shuō: 'Nǐ chīle hěn duō tángguǒ.' Tā gěi Nhan yào. Yào hěn kǔ, dànshì Nhan méi kū, tā chī le. Huí jiā yǐhòu, Nhan hěn è. Māma gěi tā miànbāo. Nhan shuō: 'Wǒ chībǎo le, xièxie māma!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我饿了 我吃饱了 儿童 汉语"

en.flash: Mới: sore, throat, headache, earache, toothache, stomach, stomach-ache, stomachache, toothbrush, toothpaste, hurt, carefully, quietly, think | Ôn: sweet, chocolate, dentist, doctor
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn bệnh (6 câu): headache / earache / toothache / stomach-ache / sore throat / cough. 2) Trò 'Doctor, doctor': một con diễn tả bằng động tác, bạn hỏi What's the matter? — I've got a … / Where does it hurt? 3) Đọc và chọn lời khuyên đúng (dạng Movers Reading Part 1): I've got a toothache. → Brush your teeth carefully. / I've got a sore throat. → Drink more water.
en.truyen: Nhan at the Dentist — After the party, Nhan eats lots of sweets quickly. At night she's got a stomach-ache and a toothache. The next day Dad takes her to the dentist. 'Where does it hurt?' asks the dentist. He looks carefully. 'I think you eat too many sweets.' He gives Nhan a toothbrush and some toothpaste. 'Brush your teeth carefully. Speak quietly now and rest.' Nhan smiles. 'Thank you!'
en.baihat: Brush Your Teeth (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — This is the way we brush our teeth, / brush our teeth, brush our teeth, / Toothbrush, toothpaste, carefully, / no more toothache! / What's the matter? Where does it hurt? / Where does it hurt? Where does it hurt? / I've got a headache and a sore throat, / I'm not well today!

zh.flash: Mới: 疼 téng, 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng, 牙疼 yá téng, 肚子 dùzi, 舒服 shūfu, 饿 è, 饱 bǎo, 药 yào | Ôn: 糖果 tángguǒ, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 苦 kǔ, 牙医 yáyī, 医生 yīshēng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chỉ vào bộ phận đau trên tranh: 肚子疼 / 嗓子疼 / 牙疼 / 头疼. 2) Đóng vai bác sĩ: 你哪儿不舒服？— 我肚子疼。— 你要吃药。→ con trả lời: 好！谢谢医生！ 3) Ghép trạng thái: 饿了 → 吃面包 / 吃饱了 → 不吃了.
zh.truyen: Nhan看牙医 — 晚上，Nhan吃了很多糖果和巧克力，她肚子疼，牙也疼。第二天，爸爸和她去看牙医。牙医问：'你哪儿不舒服？' Nhan说：'我牙疼。' 牙医给她药。药很苦，但是她吃了。回家以后，她饿了，吃了面包。'我吃饱了！' (Wǎnshang, Nhan chīle hěn duō tángguǒ hé qiǎokèlì, tā dùzi téng, yá yě téng. Dì-èr tiān, bàba hé tā qù kàn yáyī. Yáyī wèn: 'Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?' Nhan shuō: 'Wǒ yá téng.' Yáyī gěi tā yào. Yào hěn kǔ, dànshì tā chī le. Huí jiā yǐhòu, tā è le, chīle miànbāo. 'Wǒ chībǎo le!')
zh.baihat: 哪儿不舒服 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 哪儿疼呀？哪儿疼呀？肚子疼！肚子疼！牙疼嗓子也疼，牙疼嗓子也疼，不舒服，不舒服！(Nǎr téng ya? Nǎr téng ya? Dùzi téng! Dùzi téng! Yá téng sǎngzi yě téng, yá téng sǎngzi yě téng, bù shūfu, bù shūfu!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 35. Unit 8 · How's the weather today? – Ngày mưa và bản tin thời tiết

web.label: Ngày 69. Unit 8 · Ngày mưa ở nhà

en.tu: Mới: bring, climb, fix, invite, off | Ôn: how long, minute, usually, umbrella, wet
en.cum: bring an umbrella / climb a tree / fix the bike / invite friends / take off your wet shoes
en.cau: Bring your umbrella. It's raining. / Don't climb the tree. It's wet! / Dad can fix my bike. / I want to invite you to my house. / Take off your wet shoes, please. / How long can you stay? Thirty minutes.
en.truyen: A Rainy Day — Anna wants to invite Bông to play. But it's raining and windy. 'Bring your umbrella!' says Bông's mum. Bông comes. She takes off her wet shoes. They can't climb the tree today. They help Dad fix Anna's bike inside the house. 'Rainy days are fun, too!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "rainy day vocabulary for kids umbrella"

zh.tu: Mới: 休息 xiūxi, 事情 shìqing | Ôn: 外面 wàimiàn, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 哭 kū, 拿 ná, 电脑 diànnǎo
zh.cum: 好好休息 hǎohǎo xiūxi / 什么事情 shénme shìqing / 拿雨伞 ná yǔsǎn / 在家休息 zài jiā xiūxi
zh.cau: 你生病了，要好好休息。(Nǐ shēngbìng le, yào hǎohǎo xiūxi.) / 有什么事情？(Yǒu shénme shìqing?) / 外面下雨了，拿雨伞吧！(Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, ná yǔsǎn ba!) / 别哭，休息一下。(Bié kū, xiūxi yíxià.)
zh.truyen: 下雨了 — Anna想请Bông来玩。外面下雨了，也刮风。妈妈说：'拿雨伞吧！' Bông来了。她们不去外面，在家里玩。Anna问：'妈妈，有什么事情要做吗？' 妈妈说：'没有，你们玩吧，我休息一下。' (Anna xiǎng qǐng Bông lái wán. Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, yě guāfēng. Māma shuō: 'Ná yǔsǎn ba!' Bông lái le. Tāmen bú qù wàimiàn, zài jiā lǐ wán. Anna wèn: 'Māma, yǒu shénme shìqing yào zuò ma?' Māma shuō: 'Méiyǒu, nǐmen wán ba, wǒ xiūxi yíxià.')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "下雨了 儿童 汉语 雨伞 休息"

web.label: Ngày 70. Unit 8 · Ôn không tranh: bản tin thời tiết

en.tu: Ôn: cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, winter, autumn, fall, headache, season, more | Ôn nhanh: usually, how long, minute
en.cum: a sore throat / in winter / in summer / What's the matter? / drink more water
en.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) How's the weather today? / What season is it now? / Are you well? / What's the matter? I've got a cough. / How long do you brush your teeth? Two minutes.
en.truyen: The Weather Report — Listen. 'Good morning! It's spring in Hanoi. Today it's warm and sunny. In Beijing, it's windy and cold. Children, bring your sweaters!' / Riddle: It's the hottest season. We go to the beach and eat ice cream. What season is it? Summer!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "weather report for kids English"

zh.tu: Ôn: 饱 bǎo, 肚子 dùzi, 饿 è, 发烧 fāshāo, 感冒 gǎnmào, 身体 shēntǐ, 生病 shēngbìng, 事情 shìqing, 舒服 shūfu, 疼 téng, 休息 xiūxi, 药 yào, 冬天 dōngtiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 春天 chūntiān, 季节 jìjié | Ôn nhanh: 电脑 diànnǎo, 外面 wàimiàn
zh.cum: 今天天气怎么样 jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng / 我感冒了 wǒ gǎnmào le / 好好休息 hǎohǎo xiūxi / 吃饱了 chībǎo le
zh.cau: (Nghe – trả lời, không tranh) 今天天气怎么样？(Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) / 现在是什么季节？(Xiànzài shì shénme jìjié?) / 你身体好吗？(Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma?) / 你哪儿不舒服？我嗓子疼。(Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu? Wǒ sǎngzi téng.) / 你饿吗？不饿，我吃饱了。(Nǐ è ma? Bú è, wǒ chībǎo le.)
zh.truyen: 天气预报 — 大家好！现在是春天。今天河内天气很好，是晴天。北京刮风，很冷。小朋友们，外面冷，别感冒！/ 猜一猜：这个季节很冷，有时候下雪。是什么季节？冬天！(Dàjiā hǎo! Xiànzài shì chūntiān. Jīntiān Hénèi tiānqì hěn hǎo, shì qíngtiān. Běijīng guāfēng, hěn lěng. Xiǎopéngyoumen, wàimiàn lěng, bié gǎnmào! / Cāi yi cāi: zhège jìjié hěn lěng, yǒu shíhou xiàxuě. Shì shénme jìjié? Dōngtiān!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童 天气预报 汉语 晴天 刮风"

en.flash: Mới: bring, climb, fix, invite, off | Ôn: cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, autumn, winter, season, headache, umbrella, wet, windy
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn động từ (5 câu): bring / climb / fix / invite / take off. 2) Làm phát thanh viên thời tiết: con chọn thẻ thành phố + thẻ thời tiết và nói: 'In Hanoi it's sunny. In Beijing it's windy and cold.' 3) Nghe và chọn tranh (dạng Movers Listening Part 3): 'Bông brings her umbrella because it's raining.' / 'Dad fixes the bike.'
en.truyen: A Rainy Day at Anna's — It's autumn. Anna invites Bông to play. But it's raining and windy. Bông brings her umbrella. She takes off her wet shoes. 'Let's climb the tree!' says Bông. 'No, it's wet. Be careful!' says Anna's dad. So they help Dad fix the bike. Then they watch the weather report on TV: 'Tomorrow it's sunny!' 'Hooray! Tomorrow we can climb the tree!'
en.baihat: Rain, Rain (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Rain, rain, rain today, / Bring your umbrella, please, / Take off your shoes, come inside, / Fix the bike with me! / Wind, wind, wind today, / Don't climb up the tree, / Invite your friends and play inside, / Happy, you and me!

zh.flash: Mới: 休息 xiūxi, 事情 shìqing | Ôn: 季节 jìjié, 春天 chūntiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 生病 shēngbìng, 疼 téng, 舒服 shūfu, 饿 è, 饱 bǎo, 药 yào, 雨伞 yǔsǎn
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh: 外面下雨了，拿雨伞吧！/ 我生病了，在家休息。/ 有什么事情？ 2) Làm phát thanh viên: 今天河内是晴天。北京刮风，很冷。 3) Trò đúng/sai không tranh (dạng YCT3): cô đọc '冬天很热。' → con giơ thẻ 对 / 不对.
zh.truyen: 下雨天 — 秋天，Anna请Bông来家里玩。外面下雨了，也刮风。Bông拿了雨伞。她们不去外面，在家里玩。Anna的妈妈感冒了，她在休息。Anna问：'妈妈，你身体不舒服吗？有什么事情吗？' 妈妈说：'没事，我休息一下就好。' (Qiūtiān, Anna qǐng Bông lái jiā lǐ wán. Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, yě guāfēng. Bông nále yǔsǎn. Tāmen bú qù wàimiàn, zài jiā lǐ wán. Anna de māma gǎnmào le, tā zài xiūxi. Anna wèn: 'Māma, nǐ shēntǐ bù shūfu ma? Yǒu shénme shìqing ma?' Māma shuō: 'Méi shì, wǒ xiūxi yíxià jiù hǎo.')
zh.baihat: 下雨了 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 下雨了呀，下雨了呀，拿雨伞，拿雨伞，外面刮风了，外面下雨了，在家玩，在家玩！(Xià yǔ le ya, xià yǔ le ya, ná yǔsǎn, ná yǔsǎn, wàimiàn guāfēng le, wàimiàn xià yǔ le, zài jiā wán, zài jiā wán!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 36. Unit 8 · How's the weather today? – Truyện và Phiên dịch nhí

web.label: Ngày 71. Unit 8 · Truyện: Gấu nhỏ qua bốn mùa

en.tu: Ôn: spring, summer, autumn, winter, season, cough, temperature, sore, toothache, more, ill | Ôn nhanh: usually, how long
en.cum: in spring / in winter / a sore throat / What's the matter? / Are you well?
en.cau: In winter the bear usually sleeps. / What's the matter, Little Bear? I've got a sore throat. / Are you well now? Yes, I am! / Spring is my favourite season.
en.truyen: Little Bear's Seasons — In autumn, Little Bear eats lots of fruit. In winter, it's cold and he usually sleeps in his house under a big tree. In spring, he wakes up, but he's ill. He's got a cough and a sore throat. 'What's the matter?' asks Rabbit. Rabbit brings him hot water. In summer, Little Bear is well. 'I love summer! I can swim in the river!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "bear seasons story for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 春天 chūntiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān, 感冒 gǎnmào, 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng, 身体 shēntǐ, 休息 xiūxi, 饿 è | Ôn nhanh: 外面 wàimiàn, 哭 kū
zh.cum: 冬天睡觉 dōngtiān shuìjiào / 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng / 身体好了 shēntǐ hǎo le / 好好休息 hǎohǎo xiūxi
zh.cau: 冬天，小熊在睡觉。(Dōngtiān, xiǎoxióng zài shuìjiào.) / 小熊，你怎么了？我嗓子疼。(Xiǎoxióng, nǐ zěnme le? Wǒ sǎngzi téng.) / 你要好好休息。(Nǐ yào hǎohǎo xiūxi.) / 夏天来了，小熊的身体好了。(Xiàtiān lái le, xiǎoxióng de shēntǐ hǎo le.)
zh.truyen: 小熊的四个季节 — 秋天，小熊吃了很多水果。冬天很冷，小熊在家里睡觉。春天来了，小熊很饿，它感冒了，嗓子疼。兔子说：'别着急，好好休息！' 夏天来了，小熊的身体好了。它说：'我喜欢夏天！' (Qiūtiān, xiǎoxióng chīle hěn duō shuǐguǒ. Dōngtiān hěn lěng, xiǎoxióng zài jiā lǐ shuìjiào. Chūntiān lái le, xiǎoxióng hěn è, tā gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng. Tùzi shuō: 'Bié zháojí, hǎohǎo xiūxi!' Xiàtiān lái le, xiǎoxióng de shēntǐ hǎo le. Tā shuō: 'Wǒ xǐhuan xiàtiān!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小熊 四季 儿童故事"

web.label: Ngày 72. Unit 8 · Phiên dịch nhí: gọi điện hỏi thăm

en.tu: Ôn: summer, winter, spring, autumn, cough, temperature, sore, toothache, more, season | Ôn nhanh: minute, how long
en.cum: How's the weather? / Are you well? / I've got a cold. / Get well soon!
en.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Trung, nói tiếng Anh) How's the weather in Beijing today? It's cold and windy. / What season is it now? It's winter. / Are you well? No, I've got a cold. / I've got a sore throat. / Drink more water and rest!
en.truyen: A Phone Call to Beijing — Nhan calls Xiaomei in Beijing. 'How's the weather today?' 'It's winter here. It's very cold and windy.' 'In Hanoi, it's warm,' says Nhan. 'Are you well?' 'No, I've got a cold and a sore throat.' 'Oh no! Drink more water. Get well soon!' Leo listens and says it in Chinese for Grandma.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "phone call weather health role play kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 冬天 dōngtiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 季节 jìjié, 感冒 gǎnmào, 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng, 身体 shēntǐ, 休息 xiūxi, 药 yào, 发烧 fāshāo | Ôn nhanh: 电脑 diànnǎo, 外面 wàimiàn
zh.cum: 北京天气怎么样 Běijīng tiānqì zěnmeyàng / 你身体好吗 nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma / 我感冒了 wǒ gǎnmào le / 多喝水 duō hē shuǐ
zh.cau: (Phiên dịch nhí: nghe tiếng Anh, nói tiếng Trung) 今天北京天气怎么样？(Jīntiān Běijīng tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) / 现在是冬天，很冷。(Xiànzài shì dōngtiān, hěn lěng.) / 你身体好吗？(Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma?) / 我感冒了，嗓子疼。(Wǒ gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng.) / 多喝水，好好休息！(Duō hē shuǐ, hǎohǎo xiūxi!)
zh.truyen: 给北京打电话 — Nhan用电脑给Xiaomei打电话。Nhan问：'今天北京天气怎么样？' Xiaomei说：'现在是冬天，外面很冷，刮风。' Nhan问：'你身体好吗？' Xiaomei说：'不太好，我感冒了，嗓子疼。' Nhan说：'多喝水，好好休息！' (Nhan yòng diànnǎo gěi Xiaomei dǎ diànhuà. Nhan wèn: 'Jīntiān Běijīng tiānqì zěnmeyàng?' Xiaomei shuō: 'Xiànzài shì dōngtiān, wàimiàn hěn lěng, guāfēng.' Nhan wèn: 'Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma?' Xiaomei shuō: 'Bú tài hǎo, wǒ gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng.' Nhan shuō: 'Duō hē shuǐ, hǎohǎo xiūxi!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "打电话 问天气 儿童 汉语"

en.flash: Ôn: cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, winter, autumn, fall, season, headache, stomach-ache, toothbrush, bring, fix, more
en.slide: 1) Xếp 4 tranh truyện Little Bear's Seasons theo mùa và nói: In autumn … / In winter … / In spring … / In summer … 2) Hội thoại kết hợp 3 chủ đề (thời tiết – mùa – sức khỏe) theo thẻ gợi ý: How's the weather? → What season is it? → Are you well? → I've got … 3) Phiên dịch nhí qua 'điện thoại': một con gọi bằng tiếng Trung, bạn dịch sang tiếng Anh cho cả lớp.
en.truyen: Little Bear's Seasons — In autumn, Little Bear eats lots of fruit. In winter, it's cold and it snows. Little Bear usually sleeps in his house under a big tree. In spring, he wakes up. He's hungry, but he's ill. He's got a cough and a sore throat. 'What's the matter?' asks Rabbit. Rabbit brings him hot water. 'Drink more water and rest.' In summer, Little Bear is well. He climbs the tree and swims in the river. 'Summer is my favourite season!'
en.baihat: Little Bear's Song (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — Little Bear sleeps in winter, / in winter, in winter, / Little Bear sleeps in winter, / when it's cold and snows. / Little Bear has got a cough, / a sore throat, a sore throat, / Drink more water, Little Bear, / and in summer you'll be well!

zh.flash: Ôn: 饱 bǎo, 肚子 dùzi, 饿 è, 发烧 fāshāo, 感冒 gǎnmào, 身体 shēntǐ, 生病 shēngbìng, 事情 shìqing, 舒服 shūfu, 疼 téng, 休息 xiūxi, 药 yào, 冬天 dōngtiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 春天 chūntiān, 季节 jìjié
zh.slide: 1) Xếp tranh truyện 小熊的四个季节 và nói: 秋天…… / 冬天…… / 春天…… / 夏天…… 2) Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: How's the weather today? → 今天天气怎么样？/ I've got a cold. → 我感冒了。/ Drink more water! → 多喝水！ 3) Nghe chọn câu trả lời đúng (dạng YCT3, 5 câu): 你身体好吗？ a) 我感冒了。 b) 今天是晴天。
zh.truyen: 小熊的四个季节 — 秋天，小熊吃了很多水果。冬天很冷，下雪了，小熊在家里睡觉。春天来了，小熊很饿，它感冒了，嗓子疼，也发烧了。兔子问：'你哪儿不舒服？' 兔子说：'吃药，好好休息！' 夏天来了，小熊的身体好了。它说：'我吃饱了，我们去玩吧！' (Qiūtiān, xiǎoxióng chīle hěn duō shuǐguǒ. Dōngtiān hěn lěng, xiàxuě le, xiǎoxióng zài jiā lǐ shuìjiào. Chūntiān lái le, xiǎoxióng hěn è, tā gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng, yě fāshāo le. Tùzi wèn: 'Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?' Tùzi shuō: 'Chī yào, hǎohǎo xiūxi!' Xiàtiān lái le, xiǎoxióng de shēntǐ hǎo le. Tā shuō: 'Wǒ chībǎo le, wǒmen qù wán ba!')
zh.baihat: 小熊小熊 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 小熊小熊，小熊小熊，感冒了，感冒了，多喝水，多休息，多喝水，多休息，夏天好，夏天好！(Xiǎoxióng xiǎoxióng, xiǎoxióng xiǎoxióng, gǎnmào le, gǎnmào le, duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi, duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi, xiàtiān hǎo, xiàtiān hǎo!)

blocks.title: Tuần 19 · Ôn và kiểm tra chặng 2 (Unit 5–8)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 37. Ôn và kiểm tra chặng 2 · Ôn tổng hợp Unit 1, 2, 5, 6

web.label: Ngày 73. Ôn chặng 2 · Quét Unit 1 và Unit 5 (bạn mới, con vật)

en.tu: Ôn: country, flag, language, could, look for (U1) | kangaroo, panda, slow, than, fast, heavy, dangerous, clever, afraid (U5)
en.cum: look for my flag / speak two languages / bigger than / faster than / be afraid of
en.cau: Where are you from? I'm from Vietnam. / I can speak two languages. / I couldn't swim last year, but I can now. / The kangaroo is faster than the panda. / The elephant is heavier than the lion. / Are you afraid of wolves?
en.truyen: Leo's New Friend — Leo has got a new friend, Xiaomei. She's from China. She can speak two languages. They go to the zoo. Xiaomei is looking for the pandas. 'Pandas are slow, but kangaroos are fast!' says Leo. 'The wolf is dangerous. Be careful!' 'I'm not afraid,' says Xiaomei. 'I'm brave!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Movers vocabulary review animals countries"

zh.tu: Ôn: 丢 diū, 国家 guójiā, 玫瑰花 méiguihuā, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ (U1) | 当然 dāngrán, 坏 huài, 欢迎 huānyíng, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 难 nán, 着急 zháojí, 知道 zhīdào (U5)
zh.cum: 你是哪国人 nǐ shì nǎ guó rén / 比熊快 bǐ xióng kuài / 当然知道 dāngrán zhīdào / 别着急 bié zháojí
zh.cau: 你是哪国人？我是越南人。(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.) / 欢迎来越南！(Huānyíng lái Yuènán!) / 马比熊快。(Mǎ bǐ xióng kuài.) / 你知道熊猫在哪儿吗？——当然知道！(Nǐ zhīdào xióngmāo zài nǎr ma? — Dāngrán zhīdào!) / 我的玫瑰花丢了，别着急！(Wǒ de méiguihuā diū le, bié zháojí!)
zh.truyen: 新朋友 — Leo有一个新朋友Xiaomei，她是中国人。Leo说：'欢迎来越南！' 他们去动物园。Xiaomei问：'你知道熊猫在哪儿吗？' Leo说：'当然知道！熊猫很慢，马很快。' 狼很坏，Xiaomei不害怕。(Leo yǒu yí gè xīn péngyou Xiaomei, tā shì Zhōngguó rén. Leo shuō: 'Huānyíng lái Yuènán!' Tāmen qù dòngwùyuán. Xiaomei wèn: 'Nǐ zhīdào xióngmāo zài nǎr ma?' Leo shuō: 'Dāngrán zhīdào! Xióngmāo hěn màn, mǎ hěn kuài.' Láng hěn huài, Xiaomei bú hàipà.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT3 词汇 复习 动物 国家"

web.label: Ngày 74. Ôn chặng 2 · Quét Unit 2 và Unit 6 (một ngày của em, thể thao)

en.tu: Ôn: always, shower, sometimes, half, meal, minute, past, quarter, usually, lift, how often, how long (U2) | ice, practise, skate, team, volleyball, win, film, comic book, ice skating, roller skating (U6)
en.cum: half past seven / quarter past four / how often / practise every day / win the match / go ice skating
en.cau: What time is it? It's half past seven. / How often do you play volleyball? Twice a week. / I usually have a shower after the match. / How long do you practise? Forty minutes. / Can you skate? Yes, I can. / Our team always wins!
en.truyen: Anna's Busy Day — Anna usually gets up at quarter past six. She has a shower and eats her meal. After school, she practises volleyball for forty minutes. Sometimes she goes roller skating with Leo. In the evening, she reads a comic book or watches a film. 'How often do you skate?' 'Every Saturday!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "telling the time and sports review for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 半 bàn, 杯子 bēizi, 电脑 diànnǎo, 每 měi, 去年 qùnián, 完 wán, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 小时 xiǎoshí (U2) | 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 电影 diànyǐng, 礼物 lǐwù, 排球 páiqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 上网 shàngwǎng, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú (U6)
zh.cum: 七点半 qī diǎn bàn / 每天跑步 měi tiān pǎobù / 打乒乓球 dǎ pīngpāngqiú / 一个小时 yí gè xiǎoshí
zh.cau: 现在几点？现在七点半。(Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn.) / 我每天跑步半个小时。(Wǒ měi tiān pǎobù bàn gè xiǎoshí.) / 打完篮球，我洗澡。(Dǎwán lánqiú, wǒ xǐzǎo.) / 你会打网球吗？(Nǐ huì dǎ wǎngqiú ma?) / 去年的生日礼物是一个足球。(Qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù shì yí gè zúqiú.)
zh.truyen: Anna的一天 — Anna每天六点半起床。下午她打排球，打一个小时。打完排球，她洗澡。晚上，她看电影，有时候上网。Anna说：'我最喜欢星期六，因为我和Leo一起打乒乓球！' (Anna měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng. Xiàwǔ tā dǎ páiqiú, dǎ yí gè xiǎoshí. Dǎwán páiqiú, tā xǐzǎo. Wǎnshang, tā kàn diànyǐng, yǒu shíhou shàngwǎng. Anna shuō: 'Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xīngqīliù, yīnwèi wǒ hé Leo yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "几点了 儿童 汉语 运动 复习"

en.flash: Ôn: country, flag, language, could, look for, always, sometimes, usually, half, quarter, minute, how often, how long, kangaroo, panda, fast, slow, heavy, than, ice, skate, practise, team, volleyball, win
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Bánh xe ôn tập': quay bánh xe chủ đề (Countries / Time / Animals / Sports), con trả lời câu hỏi cô rút: Where are you from? / What time is it? / Which is faster, a kangaroo or a panda? / What sport do you like? 2) Dạng Movers Listening Part 2 (5 câu): nghe hội thoại và điền giờ, tên môn thể thao vào phiếu (quarter past four / volleyball). 3) Dạng Movers Reading Part 5 rút gọn: đọc đoạn 'Anna's Busy Day' và điền 1–3 từ vào 5 câu.
en.truyen: The Sports Day at the Zoo — Leo and Xiaomei go to the zoo on Sports Day. Xiaomei is from China and can speak two languages. At quarter past nine, there's an animal race. The kangaroo is faster than the panda. The elephant is heavier than the lion. Then the children play volleyball. Leo's team practises every day, so they win! 'How often do you come here?' asks Xiaomei. 'Sometimes on Saturdays!' says Leo.
en.baihat: Review Song (giai điệu The Farmer in the Dell) — I'm from Vietnam, I'm from Vietnam, / I can speak two languages, I'm from Vietnam! / The kangaroo is fast, the panda is slow, / Faster, slower, here we go! / I practise every day, I practise every day, / My team can win the volleyball, hip hip hooray!

zh.flash: Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 自己 zìjǐ, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 先生 xiānsheng, 半 bàn, 每 měi, 小时 xiǎoshí, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 完 wán, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 当然 dāngrán, 知道 zhīdào, 欢迎 huānyíng, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 电影 diànyǐng, 礼物 lǐwù
zh.slide: 1) Trò 'Bánh xe ôn tập': 你是哪国人？/ 现在几点？/ 马比熊快吗？/ 你喜欢什么运动？ 2) Dạng YCT3 nghe – chọn tranh (5 câu): 我每天跑步半个小时。/ 熊猫比马慢。/ 打完篮球，我洗澡。 3) Dạng YCT3 đọc – nối câu hỏi với câu trả lời: 你会打网球吗？— 不会。/ 你知道他是谁吗？— 当然知道！
zh.truyen: 运动会 — 星期六，Leo和Xiaomei去动物园。Xiaomei是中国人，她会说汉语和英语。九点半，动物跑步：马比熊快，熊比马慢。然后，小朋友们打排球、打乒乓球。Leo每天打一个小时，他打得很好。老师给他一个礼物。Xiaomei说：'当然是Leo第一！' (Xīngqīliù, Leo hé Xiaomei qù dòngwùyuán. Xiaomei shì Zhōngguó rén, tā huì shuō Hànyǔ hé Yīngyǔ. Jiǔ diǎn bàn, dòngwù pǎobù: mǎ bǐ xióng kuài, xióng bǐ mǎ màn. Ránhòu, xiǎopéngyoumen dǎ páiqiú, dǎ pīngpāngqiú. Leo měi tiān dǎ yí gè xiǎoshí, tā dǎ de hěn hǎo. Lǎoshī gěi tā yí gè lǐwù. Xiaomei shuō: 'Dāngrán shì Leo dì-yī!')
zh.baihat: 复习歌 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 你是哪国，你是哪国，越南人，越南人，马比熊快，熊比马慢，打篮球，踢足球，真快乐，真快乐！(Nǐ shì nǎ guó, nǐ shì nǎ guó, Yuènán rén, Yuènán rén, mǎ bǐ xióng kuài, xióng bǐ mǎ màn, dǎ lánqiú, tī zúqiú, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 38. Ôn và kiểm tra chặng 2 · Kiểm tra chặng 2 (Unit 5–8, quét Unit 1–8)

web.label: Ngày 75. Ôn chặng 2 · Quét Unit 3 và Unit 7 (nghề nghiệp, món ăn)

en.tu: Ôn: cry, fall, grow, leaf/leaves, engineer, future, pilot, all right, be called, police officer (U3) | sandwich, sweet, excuse me, biscuit, cookie, salad, pasta, dessert, spicy, sour, because (U7)
en.cum: when I grow up / in the future / a police officer / Excuse me! / something sweet / because it's …
en.cau: What do you want to be? I want to be a pilot. / I want to be an engineer when I grow up. / Are you all right? / Excuse me, can I have a sandwich, please? / Do you like biscuits or cake? / I like pasta because it isn't spicy.
en.truyen: The Future Chef — Nhan wants to be a chef in the future. 'When I grow up, I want to cook for a pilot and a police officer!' She makes a sandwich, a salad and some sweet cookies. Leo eats a spicy chicken leg and cries, 'It's spicy!' 'Are you all right?' asks Nhan. 'Yes! I like your food because it's yummy!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "jobs and food vocabulary review for kids Movers"

zh.tu: Ôn: 百 bǎi, 帮助 bāngzhù, 别 bié, 次 cì, 关 guān, 警察 jǐngchá, 哭 kū, 拿 ná (U3) | 饼干 bǐnggān, 菜 cài, 还是 háishi, 辣 là, 卖 mài, 面包 miànbāo, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 西瓜 xīguā (U7)
zh.cum: 长大以后 zhǎngdà yǐhòu / 想当警察 xiǎng dāng jǐngchá / 面包还是饼干 miànbāo háishi bǐnggān / 别哭 bié kū
zh.cau: 你长大以后想当什么？(Nǐ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng shénme?) / 我想当警察。(Wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá.) / 你想吃面包还是饼干？(Nǐ xiǎng chī miànbāo háishi bǐnggān?) / 这个菜很辣，别哭！(Zhège cài hěn là, bié kū!) / 这个商店卖巧克力和西瓜。(Zhège shāngdiàn mài qiǎokèlì hé xīguā.)
zh.truyen: 以后的厨师 — Nhan长大以后想当厨师。她做面包、菜和巧克力饼干。Leo吃了一个很辣的菜，他哭了：'很辣！' Nhan拿来西瓜，说：'别哭，西瓜很甜！' 警察叔叔说：'谢谢你帮助我们，很好吃！' (Nhan zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng chúshī. Tā zuò miànbāo, cài hé qiǎokèlì bǐnggān. Leo chīle yí gè hěn là de cài, tā kū le: 'Hěn là!' Nhan nálái xīguā, shuō: 'Bié kū, xīguā hěn tián!' Jǐngchá shūshu shuō: 'Xièxie nǐ bāngzhù wǒmen, hěn hǎochī!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我长大以后想当 儿童 汉语 食物 复习"

web.label: Ngày 76. Ôn chặng 2 · Quét Unit 4 và Unit 8 (trang phục, thời tiết – sức khỏe)

en.tu: Ôn: dream, straight, sweater, get dressed, put on, take off, backpack, rucksack (U4) | cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, winter, autumn, fall (U8)
en.cum: put on your sweater / take off your wet shoes / a sore throat / in winter / in summer
en.cau: What's your favourite colour? I like blue best. / It's winter. Put on your sweater! / It's summer. Take off your sweater. / What's the matter? I've got a cough and a temperature. / I've got a toothache. / Get dressed quickly, it's late!
en.truyen: Bông's Bad Dream — Bông has a bad dream: it's winter, but she isn't wearing her sweater! She wakes up. It's spring and it's sunny. She gets dressed and puts on her blue backpack. At school, Leo has got a cough and a sore throat. 'Have you got a temperature?' asks the teacher. 'Go home and rest!' In the USA, autumn is called fall.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "clothes weather health review for kids Movers"

zh.tu: Ôn: 件 jiàn, 进 jìn, 裤子 kùzi, 千 qiān, 裙子 qúnzi, 外面 wàimiàn, 鞋 xié, 衣服 yīfu, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 找 zhǎo, 最 zuì (U4) | 饱 bǎo, 肚子 dùzi, 饿 è, 发烧 fāshāo, 感冒 gǎnmào, 身体 shēntǐ, 生病 shēngbìng, 事情 shìqing, 舒服 shūfu, 疼 téng, 休息 xiūxi, 药 yào, 冬天 dōngtiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān (U8)
zh.cum: 穿衣服 chuān yīfu / 一件衣服 yí jiàn yīfu / 拿雨伞 ná yǔsǎn / 感冒了 gǎnmào le / 好好休息 hǎohǎo xiūxi
zh.cau: 冬天很冷，多穿衣服！(Dōngtiān hěn lěng, duō chuān yīfu!) / 夏天我穿裙子。(Xiàtiān wǒ chuān qúnzi.) / 外面下雨了，拿雨伞吧！(Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, ná yǔsǎn ba!) / 你身体好吗？我感冒了，发烧了。(Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma? Wǒ gǎnmào le, fāshāo le.) / 我饿了。/ 我吃饱了。(Wǒ è le. / Wǒ chībǎo le.)
zh.truyen: Bông的冬天 — 冬天，外面很冷。Bông没穿那件衣服，她生病了。她感冒了，肚子也疼。妈妈说：'吃药，好好休息！' 第二天，Bông的身体好了。她穿上裤子和鞋，拿了雨伞，说：'我饿了！' (Dōngtiān, wàimiàn hěn lěng. Bông méi chuān nà jiàn yīfu, tā shēngbìng le. Tā gǎnmào le, dùzi yě téng. Māma shuō: 'Chī yào, hǎohǎo xiūxi!' Dì-èr tiān, Bông de shēntǐ hǎo le. Tā chuānshang kùzi hé xié, nále yǔsǎn, shuō: 'Wǒ è le!')
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT3 复习 衣服 天气 身体"

en.flash: Ôn: cry, grow, engineer, future, pilot, police officer, dream, straight, sweater, get dressed, put on, take off, kangaroo, panda, than, fast, slow, heavy, ice, practise, skate, team, volleyball, win, sandwich, sweet, excuse me, biscuit, cookie, cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, winter, autumn
en.slide: Bài kiểm tra chặng 2 dạng Movers (mỗi phần ≤ 15 phút): 1) Nghe (Listening Part 1 & 4): nối tên với người trong tranh công viên (Leo is playing volleyball. / Anna has got a cough.) và chọn tranh đúng cho 5 câu hỏi (What's the matter with Nhan? → toothache). 2) Đọc – viết (Reading Part 2 & 4): đọc đoạn 'Xiaomei's Menu' chọn Yes/No; điền 5 từ (than / sweet / practise / winter / sore). 3) Nói (Speaking): nhìn 2 tranh tìm điểm khác (The kangaroo is fast. / The panda is slow.), trả lời 4 câu: What's your favourite season? What sport can you play? What's your favourite dessert? What's the matter?
en.truyen: The Big Review Day — It's winter in Beijing and summer in Hanoi. Xiaomei visits Leo. She wants to be a pilot in the future. They go to the zoo: the kangaroo is faster than the panda. Then Leo's team plays volleyball and wins. At lunch they eat cheese sandwiches and sweet cookies. In the evening, Xiaomei has got a cough and a sore throat. 'Put on your sweater and drink more water!' says Leo's mum. The next day, Xiaomei is well again.
en.baihat: Unit 5 to 8 Song (giai điệu London Bridge) — Kangaroos are faster than pandas, faster than pandas, faster than pandas, / Practise every day, our team can win, hip hooray! / Sandwiches and cookies are sweet, cookies are sweet, cookies are sweet, / Spring, summer, autumn, winter — I've got a cough today!

zh.flash: Ôn: 警察 jǐngchá, 帮助 bāngzhù, 哭 kū, 衣服 yīfu, 裙子 qúnzi, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 最 zuì, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 知道 zhīdào, 当然 dāngrán, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 电影 diànyǐng, 还是 háishi, 面包 miànbāo, 甜 tián, 辣 là, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 身体 shēntǐ, 休息 xiūxi, 冬天 dōngtiān, 夏天 xiàtiān
zh.slide: Bài kiểm tra chặng 2 dạng YCT3 (mỗi phần ≤ 15 phút): 1) Nghe (Phần 1–2): nghe câu, chọn đúng/sai theo tranh (熊猫比马慢。/ 我感冒了。) và chọn tranh đúng cho hội thoại ngắn (你想喝茶还是果汁？— 果汁。). 2) Đọc (Phần 3–4): nối câu hỏi với câu trả lời (你身体好吗？— 我发烧了。/ 你会打乒乓球吗？— 会。); chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống: 因为 / 但是 / 还是 / 比. 3) Nói: giới thiệu bản thân, trả lời 你最喜欢什么季节？你喜欢什么运动？你最喜欢的点心是什么？
zh.truyen: 大复习 — 现在河内是夏天，北京是冬天。Xiaomei来河内看Leo。她长大以后想当警察。他们去动物园：马比熊快。然后他们打乒乓球、看电影。中午他们吃面包和甜的饼干，Leo不吃辣的。晚上，Xiaomei感冒了，嗓子疼。妈妈说：'多穿衣服，好好休息！' 第二天，Xiaomei的身体好了。(Xiànzài Hénèi shì xiàtiān, Běijīng shì dōngtiān. Xiaomei lái Hénèi kàn Leo. Tā zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jǐngchá. Tāmen qù dòngwùyuán: mǎ bǐ xióng kuài. Ránhòu tāmen dǎ pīngpāngqiú, kàn diànyǐng. Zhōngwǔ tāmen chī miànbāo hé tián de bǐnggān, Leo bù chī là de. Wǎnshang, Xiaomei gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng. Māma shuō: 'Duō chuān yīfu, hǎohǎo xiūxi!' Dì-èr tiān, Xiaomei de shēntǐ hǎo le.)
zh.baihat: 复习歌 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 马比熊快，马比熊快，打篮球，打篮球，面包还是饼干？面包还是饼干？我感冒了，要休息！(Mǎ bǐ xióng kuài, mǎ bǐ xióng kuài, dǎ lánqiú, dǎ lánqiú, miànbāo háishi bǐnggān? Miànbāo háishi bǐnggān? Wǒ gǎnmào le, yào xiūxi!)

blocks.title: Unit 9 · At School · 我的学校

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 39. Unit 9 · At School – Các nơi trong trường, rẽ trái rẽ phải

web.label: Ngày 77. Unit 9 · Cổng trường, văn phòng, nhà ăn

en.tu: Mới: gate, office, canteen, left, right | Ôn: band, comic book, pop star, library, playground, classroom
en.cum: the school gate / the teachers' office / a big canteen / on the left / on the right / next to the gate
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: My school has … and …] My school has a big gate and a canteen. / Where is the office? / The office is next to the gate. / The canteen is on the left. / The library is on the right.
en.truyen: Anna's New School — Anna is at her new school. She sees a big gate. "Where is the office?" she asks. Leo says, "The office is next to the gate." The canteen is on the left and the library is on the right. "My school has a big canteen and a library!" says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "places in school vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 教室 jiàoshì, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 大门 dàmén, 办公室 bàngōngshì | Ôn: 电影 diànyǐng, 上网 shàngwǎng, 学校 xuéxiào, 旁边 pángbiān
zh.cum: 学校的大门 xuéxiào de dàmén / 一个大图书馆 yī gè dà túshūguǎn / 我们的教室 wǒmen de jiàoshì / 老师的办公室 lǎoshī de bàngōngshì / 大门旁边 dàmén pángbiān
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 有……和……] 我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个大门。(Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yī gè dà túshūguǎn hé yī gè dàmén.) / 办公室在哪儿？(Bàngōngshì zài nǎr?) / 办公室在大门旁边。(Bàngōngshì zài dàmén pángbiān.) / 这是我们的教室。(Zhè shì wǒmen de jiàoshì.)
zh.truyen: Anna的新学校 — Anna去新学校。她看见一个大门。她问：“办公室在哪儿？”Leo说：“办公室在大门旁边。”Anna说：“我的学校有一个大图书馆和很多教室！”(Anna qù xīn xuéxiào. Tā kànjiàn yī gè dàmén. Tā wèn: “Bàngōngshì zài nǎr?” Leo shuō: “Bàngōngshì zài dàmén pángbiān.” Anna shuō: “Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yī gè dà túshūguǎn hé hěn duō jiàoshì!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "学校 教室 图书馆 儿童中文"

web.label: Ngày 78. Unit 9 · Rẽ trái, rẽ phải trong trường

en.tu: Mới: turn, leave, come on, have (got) to, wait | Ôn: dress up, film, movie, gate, office, left, right
en.cum: turn left / turn right / come on / wait for me / have got to go / leave the classroom
en.cau: Come on, Nhan! Let's play football in the playground. / Wait for me, please! / We have got to leave the classroom now. / Turn right at the gate. / The playground is between the library and the office.
en.truyen: Football Time — "Come on, Nhan!" says Leo. "Let's play football in the playground." "Wait for me!" says Nhan. "Where is the playground?" "It's on the right, between the library and the office." They leave the classroom, turn right and play football together.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "turn left turn right directions song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān, 操场 cāochǎng | Ôn: 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 前面 qiánmiàn, 后面 hòumiàn
zh.cum: 左边 zuǒbiān / 右边 yòubiān / 在……中间 zài…zhōngjiān / 去操场 qù cāochǎng / 在操场上踢足球 zài cāochǎng shang tī zúqiú
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 在 + nơi chốn + 中间] 操场在图书馆和办公室中间。(Cāochǎng zài túshūguǎn hé bàngōngshì zhōngjiān.) / 图书馆在左边。(Túshūguǎn zài zuǒbiān.) / 操场在右边。(Cāochǎng zài yòubiān.) / 我们去操场踢足球吧！(Wǒmen qù cāochǎng tī zúqiú ba!)
zh.truyen: 去操场 — 下午，Leo说：“Nhan，我们去操场踢足球吧！”Nhan问：“操场在哪儿？”Leo说：“操场在右边，在图书馆和办公室中间。”他们一起去操场踢足球。(Xiàwǔ, Leo shuō: “Nhan, wǒmen qù cāochǎng tī zúqiú ba!” Nhan wèn: “Cāochǎng zài nǎr?” Leo shuō: “Cāochǎng zài yòubiān, zài túshūguǎn hé bàngōngshì zhōngjiān.” Tāmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng tī zúqiú.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "左边 右边 中间 儿歌"

en.flash: Mới: gate, office, canteen, left, right, turn, leave, come on, have (got) to, wait | Ôn: library, playground, classroom, garden, next to, in front of
en.slide: 1) Nhìn sơ đồ trường, chạm đúng nơi cô đọc (6 lượt): gate / office / canteen / library / playground / classroom. 2) Nghe chỉ dẫn, kéo hình Leo đi trên sơ đồ (4 lượt): Turn left. / Turn right. / Wait at the gate. / Come on, go to the canteen! 3) Đọc câu, chọn tranh đúng trong 3 tranh (tranh nhiễu có goal, net, player): The office is next to the gate. / The canteen is on the left. / We have got to leave now.
en.truyen: Anna's New School — It is Anna's first day at her new school. She is at the big gate. "Where is the office?" she asks. Leo says, "Come on! Turn right. The office is next to the gate." Then they turn left and see the canteen and the library. "Wait for me!" says Nhan. "We have got to go to class!" Anna is very happy. "My school has a big canteen and a library!"
en.baihat: Where's the Office? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Where's the office? Where's the office? / Next to the gate, next to the gate. / Turn left, then turn right, turn left, then turn right, / Come on, wait! Come on, wait!

zh.flash: Mới: 教室 jiàoshì, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 大门 dàmén, 办公室 bàngōngshì, 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān, 操场 cāochǎng | Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 旁边 pángbiān, 前面 qiánmiàn, 后面 hòumiàn, 踢足球 tī zúqiú
zh.slide: 1) Nghe từ, chạm đúng nơi trên sơ đồ trường (6 lượt): 教室 / 图书馆 / 大门 / 办公室 / 操场 / 学校. 2) Nghe câu, đặt hình Bông vào đúng chỗ (4 câu): Bông在左边。/ Bông在右边。/ Bông在图书馆和办公室中间。/ Bông在大门旁边。 3) Ghép câu hỏi với câu trả lời: 办公室在哪儿？— 办公室在大门旁边。/ 操场在哪儿？— 操场在右边。/ 图书馆在哪儿？— 图书馆在左边。
zh.truyen: Anna的新学校 — 今天Anna去新学校。她看见一个大门。她问：“办公室在哪儿？”Leo说：“办公室在大门旁边。”然后他们去操场。操场在右边，在图书馆和办公室中间。Anna说：“我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个大操场！”(Jīntiān Anna qù xīn xuéxiào. Tā kànjiàn yī gè dàmén. Tā wèn: “Bàngōngshì zài nǎr?” Leo shuō: “Bàngōngshì zài dàmén pángbiān.” Ránhòu tāmen qù cāochǎng. Cāochǎng zài yòubiān, zài túshūguǎn hé bàngōngshì zhōngjiān. Anna shuō: “Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yī gè dà túshūguǎn hé yī gè dà cāochǎng!”)
zh.baihat: 图书馆在哪儿 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 图书馆呀，图书馆呀，在哪儿？在哪儿？就在教室左边，就在大门旁边，走走走！走走走！(Túshūguǎn ya, túshūguǎn ya, zài nǎr? Zài nǎr? Jiù zài jiàoshì zuǒbiān, jiù zài dàmén pángbiān, zǒu zǒu zǒu! Zǒu zǒu zǒu!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 40. Unit 9 · At School – Trong lớp học, hỏi cô khi chưa hiểu

web.label: Ngày 79. Unit 9 · Giờ học trên lớp

en.tu: Mới: teach, practice, text, mistake, wrong, only | Ôn: ice skates, roller skates, cough, headache, sore throat
en.cum: teach English / football practice / read the text / make a mistake / the wrong answer / only one pencil
en.cau: Our teacher teaches English in this classroom. / Read the text, please. / Oh no, I made a mistake! / That's the wrong answer. / I've only got one pencil. / Leo can't come to football practice because he's got a cough.
en.truyen: Bông's English Class — I'm Bông and I'm in Year 2. This morning our teacher teaches English. We read a text, and I write an answer, but it's wrong. "It's only a mistake," says the teacher. "Let's practise again." At lunchtime I eat in the canteen. Leo has got a cough, so he is at home today.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "classroom language for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 食堂 shítáng, 花园 huāyuán, 课 kè, 年级 niánjí | Ôn: 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 疼 téng, 休息 xiūxi, 同学 tóngxué
zh.cum: 上课 shàngkè / 汉语课 Hànyǔ kè / 二年级 èr niánjí / 在食堂吃午饭 zài shítáng chī wǔfàn / 教室前面的花园 jiàoshì qiánmiàn de huāyuán
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 在 + nơi chốn + 前面] 花园在教室前面。(Huāyuán zài jiàoshì qiánmiàn.) / 我上二年级。(Wǒ shàng èr niánjí.) / 今天上午有汉语课。(Jīntiān shàngwǔ yǒu Hànyǔ kè.) / 我们在食堂吃午饭。(Wǒmen zài shítáng chī wǔfàn.) / Leo感冒了，今天在家休息。(Leo gǎnmào le, jīntiān zài jiā xiūxi.)
zh.truyen: Bông的汉语课 — 我叫Bông，我上二年级。今天上午有汉语课。我们的教室前面有一个花园。中午，我和同学在食堂吃午饭。Leo感冒了，他今天在家休息。(Wǒ jiào Bông, wǒ shàng èr niánjí. Jīntiān shàngwǔ yǒu Hànyǔ kè. Wǒmen de jiàoshì qiánmiàn yǒu yī gè huāyuán. Zhōngwǔ, wǒ hé tóngxué zài shítáng chī wǔfàn. Leo gǎnmào le, tā jīntiān zài jiā xiūxi.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我上二年级 学校生活 儿童中文"

web.label: Ngày 80. Unit 9 · Con chưa hiểu, con hỏi cô

en.tu: Mới: mean, idea, difference, different, laugh, shall | Ôn: film star, temperature, summer, winter, spring
en.cum: What does … mean? / a good idea / What's the difference? / very different / Shall we …? / laugh together
en.cau: What does "canteen" mean? / Shall we go to the library? – Good idea! / What's the difference between summer and winter? / Summer is hot, but winter is cold. They are very different. / The children laugh in the playground.
en.truyen: What Does It Mean? — In the library, Anna reads a book. "What does 'winter' mean?" she asks. Leo doesn't know. "Shall we ask the teacher?" "Good idea!" The teacher says, "Winter is the cold season." Anna and Leo laugh. "Now we understand!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "What does it mean kids English conversation"

zh.tu: Mới: 本 běn, 问题 wèntí, 懂 dǒng, 意思 yìsi | Ôn: 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 生病 shēngbìng, 休息 xiūxi, 夏天 xiàtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān
zh.cum: 一本书 yī běn shū / 有一个问题 yǒu yī gè wèntí / 听懂 tīngdǒng / 什么意思 shénme yìsi / 我懂了 wǒ dǒng le
zh.cau: 老师，我有一个问题。(Lǎoshī, wǒ yǒu yī gè wèntí.) / “冬天”是什么意思？(“Dōngtiān” shì shénme yìsi?) / 你懂了吗？——我懂了！(Nǐ dǒng le ma? — Wǒ dǒng le!) / 我在图书馆看一本书。(Wǒ zài túshūguǎn kàn yī běn shū.)
zh.truyen: 什么意思？— Anna在图书馆看一本书。她问Leo：“‘冬天’是什么意思？”Leo说：“我不懂。我们去问老师吧！”老师说：“冬天很冷。”Anna和Leo笑了：“谢谢老师，我们懂了！”(Anna zài túshūguǎn kàn yī běn shū. Tā wèn Leo: “‘Dōngtiān’ shì shénme yìsi?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ bù dǒng. Wǒmen qù wèn lǎoshī ba!” Lǎoshī shuō: “Dōngtiān hěn lěng.” Anna hé Leo xiào le: “Xièxie lǎoshī, wǒmen dǒng le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "是什么意思 我有一个问题 中文 儿童"

en.flash: Mới: teach, practice, text, mistake, wrong, only, mean, idea, difference, different, laugh, shall | Ôn: understand, question, spell, cough, winter, summer
en.slide: 1) Nghe và chọn Yes/No với tranh lớp học (5 câu): The teacher teaches English. / Nhan makes a mistake. / The children laugh. / Leo has got a cough. / They read a text. 2) Hoàn thành hội thoại bằng thẻ chữ: A: What does "canteen" mean? B: It's the place where we eat. A: Shall we go there? B: Good idea! 3) Tìm 3 điểm khác nhau giữa 2 tranh lớp học rồi nói câu: In picture A, the teacher is next to the door. In picture B, she is next to the window. (What's the difference?)
en.truyen: Bông's English Class — I'm Bông and I'm in Year 2. This morning our teacher teaches English. We read a text about winter. I write an answer, but it's wrong. "It's only a mistake," says the teacher. "Let's practise again." Then Leo asks, "What does 'season' mean?" The teacher says, "Spring, summer, autumn and winter are seasons." "Shall we draw the seasons?" says Anna. "Good idea!" Everyone laughs.
en.baihat: What Does It Mean? (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — What does it mean? What does it mean? / Ask the teacher, it's OK! / Only a mistake, let's try again, / Practise, practise with a friend. / What does it mean? Now I know! / Good idea! Here we go!

zh.flash: Mới: 食堂 shítáng, 花园 huāyuán, 课 kè, 年级 niánjí, 本 běn, 问题 wèntí, 懂 dǒng, 意思 yìsi | Ôn: 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 休息 xiūxi, 同学 tóngxué, 汉语 Hànyǔ

Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ xǐhuan wǒ de xīn xuéxiào!”)
zh.baihat: 我的学校 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 我的学校，我的学校，真漂亮，真漂亮，有一个图书馆，有一个大操场，我喜欢！我喜欢！(Wǒ de xuéxiào, wǒ de xuéxiào, zhēn piàoliang, zhēn piàoliang, yǒu yī gè túshūguǎn, yǒu yī gè dà cāochǎng, wǒ xǐhuan! Wǒ xǐhuan!)

blocks.title: Unit 10 · Let's Go Shopping · 我们去超市吧！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 43. Unit 10 · Let's Go Shopping – Đi siêu thị, hỏi giá

web.label: Ngày 85. Unit 10 · Cùng đi siêu thị

en.tu: Mới: shopping, go shopping, supermarket, let, money, market, shopping centre | Ôn: always, how often, meal, panda, shop, buy
en.cum: go shopping / go to the supermarket / Let's go! / Let me help you. / have got some money / at the market / a big shopping centre
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: rủ rê Let's …] Let's go to the supermarket! / I always go shopping with my mum at the weekend. / How often do you go shopping? / Let me help you, Mum. / Have you got any money? / The market is near the shopping centre.
en.truyen: Shopping Day — It's Saturday. "Let's go shopping!" says Mum. Anna and Leo go to the supermarket with her. Leo wants a toy panda. "Have you got any money?" asks Mum. "Yes, I have!" says Leo. They buy some fruit and a toy panda.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "let's go shopping supermarket song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 超市 chāoshì, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù | Ôn: 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 钱 qián, 半 bàn, 杯子 bēizi
zh.cum: 去超市 qù chāoshì / 买水果 mǎi shuǐguǒ / 买东西 mǎi dōngxi / 一个玩具 yī gè wánjù / 熊猫玩具 xióngmāo wánjù / 我们去……吧 wǒmen qù…ba
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: rủ rê 我们……吧] 我们去超市吧！(Wǒmen qù chāoshì ba!) / 我要买一个玩具。(Wǒ yào mǎi yī gè wánjù.) / 超市里有很多水果。(Chāoshì li yǒu hěn duō shuǐguǒ.) / 你想买什么？(Nǐ xiǎng mǎi shénme?)
zh.truyen: 去超市 — 星期六，妈妈说：“我们去超市吧！”Anna和Leo和妈妈一起去超市。他们买水果。Leo想买一个熊猫玩具。妈妈问：“你有钱吗？”Leo说：“有！”(Xīngqīliù, māma shuō: “Wǒmen qù chāoshì ba!” Anna hé Leo hé māma yīqǐ qù chāoshì. Tāmen mǎi shuǐguǒ. Leo xiǎng mǎi yī gè xióngmāo wánjù. Māma wèn: “Nǐ yǒu qián ma?” Leo shuō: “Yǒu!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "去超市 买东西 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 86. Unit 10 · Bao nhiêu tiền? Đắt hay rẻ?

en.tu: Mới: how much, cheap, expensive, dollar, yuan, sale, size | Ôn: sweater, slow, than, half, hundred
en.cum: How much is it? / too expensive / very cheap / ten dollars / fifty yuan / on sale / my size
en.cau: How much is this? – It's ten yuan. / How much is this sweater? – It's twenty dollars. / [Ngữ pháp: too + tính từ] This hat is too expensive. / This one is cheap. / These shoes are on sale. / The red skirt is cheaper than the blue one. / Is it my size?
en.truyen: Too Expensive! — Anna wants a new skirt. "How much is this one?" she asks. "It's two hundred yuan." "Oh, that's too expensive!" Then she sees a red skirt on sale. "How much is it?" "Only fifty yuan." "Great, it's cheap! And it's my size!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how much is it song kids cheap expensive"

zh.tu: Mới: 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán | Ôn: 多少 duōshao, 钱 qián, 帽子 màozi, 裙子 qúnzi, 千 qiān, 百 bǎi
zh.cum: 多少钱 duōshao qián / 太贵了 tài guì le / 很便宜 hěn piányi / 五十元 wǔshí yuán / 十块钱 shí kuài qián / 一条裙子 yī tiáo qúnzi
zh.cau: 这个多少钱？(Zhège duōshao qián?) / 十块钱。(Shí kuài qián.) / [Ngữ pháp: 太 + tính từ + 了] 这个帽子太贵了。(Zhège màozi tài guì le.) / 这个很便宜。(Zhège hěn piányi.) / 这条裙子五十元。(Zhè tiáo qúnzi wǔshí yuán.)
zh.truyen: 太贵了！— Anna想买一条新裙子。她问：“这条裙子多少钱？”“两百元。”Anna说：“太贵了！”然后她看见一条红裙子。“这条多少钱？”“五十元。”Anna说：“很便宜！我要买这条。”(Anna xiǎng mǎi yī tiáo xīn qúnzi. Tā wèn: “Zhè tiáo qúnzi duōshao qián?” “Liǎng bǎi yuán.” Anna shuō: “Tài guì le!” Ránhòu tā kànjiàn yī tiáo hóng qúnzi. “Zhè tiáo duōshao qián?” “Wǔshí yuán.” Anna shuō: “Hěn piányi! Wǒ yào mǎi zhè tiáo.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "多少钱 太贵了 便宜 中文 儿童"

en.flash: Mới: shopping, go shopping, supermarket, let, money, market, shopping centre, how much, cheap, expensive, dollar, yuan, sale, size | Ôn: shop, buy, sweater, hundred
en.slide: 1) Nghe và nối giá với món đồ (dạng Movers Listening, 5 món): toy panda – ten yuan / sweater – twenty dollars / hat – fifty yuan / skirt – a hundred yuan / apples – two dollars. 2) Nhìn bảng giá, chọn cheap hoặc expensive và nói câu: This hat is too expensive. / This one is cheap. (thẻ nhiễu: helmet, pair, hundred). 3) Đóng vai người bán – người mua: A: How much is this? B: It's ten yuan. A: Let's buy it! / It's too expensive.
en.truyen: Too Expensive! — On Saturday Anna and Leo go shopping with Mum. "Let's go to the supermarket first," says Mum. They buy some fruit. Then they go to the shopping centre. Anna sees a skirt. "How much is it?" "Two hundred yuan." "That's too expensive!" Then she finds a red skirt on sale. "Only fifty yuan! It's cheap, and it's my size!" Leo has got some money too. He buys a toy panda for ten yuan.
en.baihat: How Much Is It? (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — How much is it? How much is it? / How much is the toy? / It's ten yuan, it's ten yuan, / It's cheap! Let's buy! / Too expensive, too expensive, / Twenty dollars? No! / Let's go to the supermarket, / Let's go, go, go!

zh.flash: Mới: 超市 chāoshì, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán | Ôn: 买 mǎi, 多少 duōshao, 钱 qián, 块 kuài, 帽子 màozi, 裙子 qúnzi
zh.slide: 1) Nghe giá, chọn thẻ số đúng (dạng YCT3 听力选择, 4 câu): 这个玩具十块钱。/ 这条裙子五十元。/ 水果二十元。/ 帽子一百元。 2) Nhìn tranh, nói 太贵了！ hoặc 很便宜！ (6 món, thẻ nhiễu: 鞋, 雨伞). 3) Đóng vai ở siêu thị: A: 我们去超市吧！B: 好！A: 这个多少钱？B: 十块钱。A: 太贵了！/ 很便宜，我要买。
zh.truyen: 太贵了！— 星期六，妈妈说：“我们去超市吧！”他们先买水果。然后Anna看见一条裙子。“这条裙子多少钱？”“两百元。”“太贵了！”然后她看见一条红裙子，只要五十元。Anna说：“很便宜，我要买这条！”Leo也有钱，他买了一个熊猫玩具。(Xīngqīliù, māma shuō: “Wǒmen qù chāoshì ba!” Tāmen xiān mǎi shuǐguǒ. Ránhòu Anna kànjiàn yī tiáo qúnzi. “Zhè tiáo qúnzi duōshao qián?” “Liǎng bǎi yuán.” “Tài guì le!” Ránhòu tā kànjiàn yī tiáo hóng qúnzi, zhǐ yào wǔshí yuán. Anna shuō: “Hěn piányi, wǒ yào mǎi zhè tiáo!” Leo yě yǒu qián, tā mǎi le yī gè xióngmāo wánjù.)
zh.baihat: 多少钱 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 多少钱呀，多少钱呀，玩具呢？玩具呢？十块钱很便宜，一百元太贵了，买不买？买不买？(Duōshao qián ya, duōshao qián ya, wánjù ne? Wánjù ne? Shí kuài qián hěn piányi, yī bǎi yuán tài guì le, mǎi bu mǎi? Mǎi bu mǎi?)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 44. Unit 10 · Let's Go Shopping – Trong thành phố, bến xe, bãi đỗ xe

web.label: Ngày 87. Unit 10 · Trong trung tâm thành phố

en.tu: Mới: city, centre, city/town centre, sports centre, building, road, café | Ôn từ nối: office, gate, turn left, turn right, wait | Ôn nhanh: catch a bus, engineer, lift
en.cum: in the city / the city centre / the town centre / the sports centre / a tall building / cross the road / at the café
en.cau: Where's the supermarket? Is it far? – No, it's near. / The supermarket is in the city centre, next to the café. / Turn left at the tall building. / The sports centre is between the library and the supermarket. / Wait for me! Let's cross the road together.
en.truyen: In the City Centre — Leo and his dad are in the city centre. There are lots of tall buildings. "Where's the supermarket? Is it far?" asks Leo. "No, it's near," says Dad. "Turn left at that tall building. It's next to the café." They wait and cross the road. "Here it is!" says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "places in the city vocabulary song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn, 车站 chēzhàn | Ôn từ nối: 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān, 图书馆 túshūguǎn | Ôn nhanh: 国家 guójiā, 进 jìn
zh.cum: 很近 hěn jìn / 很远 hěn yuǎn / 不远 bù yuǎn / 去车站 qù chēzhàn / 在车站左边 zài chēzhàn zuǒbiān
zh.cau: 超市远吗？——不远，很近。(Chāoshì yuǎn ma? — Bù yuǎn, hěn jìn.) / 车站在哪儿？(Chēzhàn zài nǎr?) / 超市在车站左边。(Chāoshì zài chēzhàn zuǒbiān.) / 图书馆很远，我们坐公共汽车去吧。(Túshūguǎn hěn yuǎn, wǒmen zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù ba.)
zh.truyen: 超市远吗？— Leo和爸爸去超市。Leo问：“超市远吗？”爸爸说：“不远，很近。超市在车站左边。”他们走到车站，超市就在左边。Leo说：“真的很近！”(Leo hé bàba qù chāoshì. Leo wèn: “Chāoshì yuǎn ma?” Bàba shuō: “Bù yuǎn, hěn jìn. Chāoshì zài chēzhàn zuǒbiān.” Tāmen zǒu dào chēzhàn, chāoshì jiù zài zuǒbiān. Leo shuō: “Zhēn de hěn jìn!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "远 近 反义词 儿童 中文"

web.label: Ngày 88. Unit 10 · Bến xe buýt, bãi đỗ xe

en.tu: Mới: bus station, bus stop, car park, station, ground, plant, address | Ôn từ nối: come on, have (got) to, shall, idea, wrong | Ôn nhanh: fall, dream, roller skating
en.cum: at the bus stop / the bus station / the train station / in the car park / on the ground / a small plant / What's your address?
en.cau: Shall we go by bus? – Good idea! / We have got to wait at the bus stop. / The car park is behind the supermarket. / Oh no! My money is on the ground! / Grandma buys a plant at the market. / What's your address? – It's 12 Green Street.
en.truyen: At the Bus Stop — Anna and her grandma have got to go to the market. "Shall we go by bus?" says Grandma. "Good idea!" They wait at the bus stop. Oh no! Anna's money falls on the ground. She looks for it and finds it. At the market, they buy a small plant for Mum.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "at the bus stop song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 让 ràng, 送 sòng, 美元 měiyuán | Ôn từ nối: 问题 wèntí, 迟到 chídào, 笑 xiào, 意思 yìsi | Ôn nhanh: 哭 kū, 拿 ná, 丢 diū
zh.cum: 让我看看 ràng wǒ kànkan / 送给妈妈 sòng gěi māma / 送你一个礼物 sòng nǐ yī gè lǐwù / 十美元 shí měiyuán / 在车站等 zài chēzhàn děng
zh.cau: 让我看看。(Ràng wǒ kànkan.) / 妈妈让我去超市买水果。(Māma ràng wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi shuǐguǒ.) / 我想送妈妈一个礼物。(Wǒ xiǎng sòng māma yī gè lǐwù.) / 这个玩具十美元。(Zhège wánjù shí měiyuán.) / 快点儿，别迟到！(Kuài diǎnr, bié chídào!)
zh.truyen: 在车站 — 奶奶和Anna去买东西。她们在车站等公共汽车。Anna的钱丢了！她哭了。奶奶说：“别哭，让我看看。”钱在地上！Anna笑了。然后她们买了一些花，送给妈妈。(Nǎinai hé Anna qù mǎi dōngxi. Tāmen zài chēzhàn děng gōnggòng qìchē. Anna de qián diū le! Tā kū le. Nǎinai shuō: “Bié kū, ràng wǒ kànkan.” Qián zài dìshang! Anna xiào le. Ránhòu tāmen mǎi le yīxiē huā, sòng gěi māma.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "送给妈妈 礼物 儿歌 中文"

en.flash: Mới: city, centre, city/town centre, sports centre, building, road, café, bus station, bus stop, car park, station, ground, plant, address | Ôn: office, gate, turn left, turn right, wait, shall
en.slide: 1) Nghe và vẽ đường đi trên bản đồ thành phố (5 lệnh): Start at the bus stop. / Turn left at the café. / Go past the car park. / Turn right at the tall building. / The sports centre is next to the supermarket. 2) Nhìn tranh, đọc và chọn từ đúng (dạng Movers Reading Part 1, 5 câu): You wait here for a bus. (bus stop) / You can leave your car here. (car park) / You can drink coffee here. (café) / Trains stop here. (station) / You play sports here. (sports centre). 3) Hỏi – đáp địa chỉ theo cặp: What's your address? – It's 12 Green Street.
en.truyen: A Day in the City — Anna and her grandma have got to go to the city centre. "Shall we go by bus?" says Grandma. "Good idea!" They wait at the bus stop. Oh no! Anna's money falls on the ground, but she finds it. The bus goes past the car park and the train station. They get to a café next to a tall building. Grandma has a coffee and Anna has a milkshake. Then they buy a small plant for Mum at the market.
en.baihat: The Bus Stop Song (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — We wait at the bus stop, bus stop, bus stop, / We wait at the bus stop in the city centre. / The bus goes to the station, station, station, / The bus goes to the station, past the café and the car park!

zh.flash: Mới: 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn, 车站 chēzhàn, 让 ràng, 送 sòng, 美元 měiyuán | Ôn: 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 礼物 lǐwù, 丢 diū
zh.slide: 1) Nghe câu, chọn tranh đúng (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): 超市很近。/ 车站很远。/ 我送妈妈一个礼物。/ 这个玩具十美元。 2) Ghép nửa câu: 超市远吗？— 不远，很近。/ 妈妈让我 — 去超市买水果。/ 我想送 — 妈妈一个礼物。 3) Trò chơi "Gần hay xa": cô chỉ hai nơi trên bản đồ, con nói câu: 车站很近。/ 图书馆很远，我们坐公共汽车去吧。
zh.truyen: 在车站 — 奶奶和Anna去买东西。图书馆很远，她们在车站等公共汽车。Anna的钱丢了！她哭了。奶奶说：“别哭，让我看看。”钱在地上！Anna笑了。超市很近，就在车站旁边。她们买了一些花，送给妈妈。(Nǎinai hé Anna qù mǎi dōngxi. Túshūguǎn hěn yuǎn, tāmen zài chēzhàn děng gōnggòng qìchē. Anna de qián diū le! Tā kū le. Nǎinai shuō: “Bié kū, ràng wǒ kànkan.” Qián zài dìshang! Anna xiào le. Chāoshì hěn jìn, jiù zài chēzhàn pángbiān. Tāmen mǎi le yīxiē huā, sòng gěi māma.)
zh.baihat: 车站远不远 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 车站远吗？车站远吗？不太远，不太远，就在超市右边，就在学校左边，很近呀！很近呀！(Chēzhàn yuǎn ma? Chēzhàn yuǎn ma? Bú tài yuǎn, bú tài yuǎn, jiù zài chāoshì yòubiān, jiù zài xuéxiào zuǒbiān, hěn jìn ya! Hěn jìn ya!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 45. Unit 10 · Let's Go Shopping – Mua trên mạng, gọi điện, ôn không tranh

web.label: Ngày 89. Unit 10 · Mua sắm trên mạng, gọi điện

en.tu: Mới: internet, app, laptop, machine, e-book, email, message, send | Ôn: country, how long, flag, supermarket, money
en.cum: on the internet / a shopping app / Dad's laptop / the coffee machine / read an e-book / send an email / send a message
en.cau: Can we go shopping on the internet? / Dad buys an e-book on his laptop. / This shopping app is great! / Send me a message, please. / I send an email to my grandma in another country. / The coffee machine in the café is expensive.
en.truyen: Shopping on the Internet — Leo's dad is busy, so he goes shopping on the internet. He opens a shopping app on his laptop. "Let me help you!" says Leo. They buy an e-book and a toy panda. Then Dad sends a message to Mum: "We've got a present for Leo!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "computer and internet words for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 喂 wèi | Ôn: 超市 chāoshì, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 送 sòng, 上网 shàngwǎng | Ôn nhanh: 玫瑰花 méiguīhuā, 快 kuài
zh.cum: 喂，你好！wèi, nǐ hǎo / 打电话 dǎ diànhuà / 在网上买 zài wǎng shang mǎi / 送玩具 sòng wánjù / 网上的东西 wǎng shang de dōngxi
zh.cau: 喂，是妈妈吗？(Wèi, shì māma ma?) / 喂，你在哪儿？——我在超市。(Wèi, nǐ zài nǎr? — Wǒ zài chāoshì.) / 我们在网上买玩具吧！(Wǒmen zài wǎng shang mǎi wánjù ba!) / 网上的玩具很便宜。(Wǎng shang de wánjù hěn piányi.)
zh.truyen: 喂，妈妈！— 爸爸很忙，他上网买东西。Leo说：“让我看看！”他们买了一本书和一个熊猫玩具。然后，爸爸给妈妈打电话：“喂，我们给Leo买了一个礼物！”(Bàba hěn máng, tā shàngwǎng mǎi dōngxi. Leo shuō: “Ràng wǒ kànkan!” Tāmen mǎi le yī běn shū hé yī gè xióngmāo wánjù. Ránhòu, bàba gěi māma dǎ diànhuà: “Wèi, wǒmen gěi Leo mǎi le yī gè lǐwù!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "喂 你好 打电话 儿童中文 对话"

web.label: Ngày 90. Unit 10 · Ôn không tranh

en.tu: Ôn: shopping, go shopping, supermarket, let, money, market, shopping centre, how much, cheap, expensive, dollar, yuan, sale, size, city, centre, city/town centre, sports centre, building, road, café, bus station, bus stop, car park, station, ground, plant, address, internet, app, laptop, machine, e-book, email, message, send | Ôn nhanh: always, sweater
en.cum: go shopping / How much is it? / too expensive / on sale / at the bus stop / in the car park / send a message
en.cau: Let's go to the supermarket! / How much is this? – It's ten yuan. / This hat is too expensive. / This one is cheap. / Have you got any apples? / The sports centre is near the bus station.
en.truyen: Leo's Shopping List — Leo has got twenty yuan. He goes to the supermarket near the bus stop. Apples are cheap, so he buys three. A toy car is too expensive. "How much is this e-book?" he asks. "It's on sale. Only ten yuan." Leo buys it and sends a message to Mum.

zh.tu: Ôn: 超市 chāoshì, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán, 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn, 车站 chēzhàn, 让 ràng, 送 sòng, 美元 měiyuán, 喂 wèi | Ôn nhanh: 裙子 qúnzi, 千 qiān
zh.cum: 多少钱 duōshao qián / 太贵了 tài guì le / 很便宜 hěn piányi / 不远 bù yuǎn / 让我看看 ràng wǒ kànkan / 送给妈妈 sòng gěi māma
zh.cau: 我们去超市吧！(Wǒmen qù chāoshì ba!) / 这个多少钱？——十块钱。(Zhège duōshao qián? — Shí kuài qián.) / 这个帽子太贵了。(Zhège màozi tài guì le.) / 你们有苹果吗？(Nǐmen yǒu píngguǒ ma?) / 超市在车站旁边，很近。(Chāoshì zài chēzhàn pángbiān, hěn jìn.)
zh.truyen: Leo去买东西 — Leo有二十元。他去车站旁边的超市。苹果很便宜，他买了三个。一个汽车玩具太贵了。他问：“这本书多少钱？”“十元。”Leo买了这本书，然后给妈妈打电话：“喂，妈妈，我买了一本书！”(Leo yǒu èrshí yuán. Tā qù chēzhàn pángbiān de chāoshì. Píngguǒ hěn piányi, tā mǎi le sān gè. Yī gè qìchē wánjù tài guì le. Tā wèn: “Zhè běn shū duōshao qián?” “Shí yuán.” Leo mǎi le zhè běn shū, ránhòu gěi māma dǎ diànhuà: “Wèi, māma, wǒ mǎi le yī běn shū!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "买东西 多少钱 中文 儿童 对话"

en.flash: Mới: internet, app, laptop, machine, e-book, email, message, send | Ôn: shopping, supermarket, money, how much, cheap, expensive, bus stop, car park, city centre
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh, chọn từ đúng (6 tranh): laptop / app / e-book / email / message / machine. 2) Ôn không tranh – đọc định nghĩa, viết từ (dạng Movers Reading Part 1): You can read this on a laptop. (e-book) / You write this and send it on the internet. (email) / You buy food here. It's big. (supermarket) / You put your car here. (car park). 3) Viết tin nhắn ngắn cho mẹ trên slide: Mum, I'm at the supermarket. Apples are cheap. Shall I buy some?
en.truyen: Shopping on the Internet — Leo's dad is busy today, so he goes shopping on the internet. He opens a shopping app on his laptop. "Let me help you!" says Leo. The e-books are cheap, but the toys are expensive. "How much is this toy panda?" asks Leo. "It's on sale. Only ten dollars." They buy an e-book and the toy panda. Then Dad sends a message to Mum: "We've got a present for Leo!"
en.baihat: Send a Message (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Send, send, send a message, / On the laptop, please! / Shopping on the internet, / Cheap and easy, see! / Write, write, write an email, / Send it to my friend, / Read an e-book on the app, / Now it is the end!

zh.flash: Mới: 喂 wèi | Ôn: 超市 chāoshì, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán, 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn, 车站 chēzhàn, 让 ràng, 送 sòng, 美元 měiyuán, 上网 shàngwǎng, 打电话 dǎ diànhuà
zh.slide: 1) Đóng vai gọi điện (cặp đôi): A: 喂，是妈妈吗？B: 是我。你在哪儿？A: 我在超市。水果很便宜！ 2) Ôn không tranh – nghe từ, nói từ trái nghĩa: 贵 → 便宜 / 远 → 近 / 左 → 右 / 买 → 卖. 3) Chọn từ điền câu (太 / 让 / 送 / 喂): ___，你好！/ 这个___贵了。/ 妈妈___我去超市。/ 我想___你一个礼物。
zh.truyen: 喂，妈妈！— 爸爸很忙，他上网买东西。Leo说：“让我看看！”网上的书很便宜，可是玩具很贵。Leo问：“这个熊猫玩具多少钱？”爸爸说：“十美元。”他们买了一本书和一个熊猫玩具。然后，爸爸给妈妈打电话：“喂，我们给Leo买了一个礼物！”(Bàba hěn máng, tā shàngwǎng mǎi dōngxi. Leo shuō: “Ràng wǒ kànkan!” Wǎng shang de shū hěn piányi, kěshì wánjù hěn guì. Leo wèn: “Zhège xióngmāo wánjù duōshao qián?” Bàba shuō: “Shí měiyuán.” Tāmen mǎi le yī běn shū hé yī gè xióngmāo wánjù. Ránhòu, bàba gěi māma dǎ diànhuà: “Wèi, wǒmen gěi Leo mǎi le yī gè lǐwù!”)
zh.baihat: 喂喂妈妈 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 喂喂妈妈，喂喂妈妈，你在哪？你在哪？我在超市买菜，水果真的便宜，回来吧！回来吧！(Wèi wèi māma, wèi wèi māma, nǐ zài nǎ? Nǐ zài nǎ? Wǒ zài chāoshì mǎi cài, shuǐguǒ zhēn de piányi, huílái ba! Huílái ba!)

en.tu: Ôn: sale, how much, cheap, expensive, dollar, money, plant, e-book, comic book, library | Ôn nhanh: meal, panda
en.cum: a class sale / How much is …? / only two dollars / too expensive / give the money to the library
en.cau: How much is this plant? – It's only two dollars. It's cheap! / That toy is too expensive. / Let's buy an e-book! / We give the money to the library.
en.truyen: The Class Sale — Anna's class has a sale. Leo sells comic books and Xiaomei sells plants. "How much is this plant?" asks Nhan. "It's only two dollars. It's cheap!" says Xiaomei. Bông wants a big toy, but it's too expensive. At the end of the day, the class has got lots of money. They use it to buy new books for the library.

zh.tu: Ôn: 卖 mài, 多少钱 duōshao qián, 便宜 piányi, 贵 guì, 太 tài, 元 yuán, 玩具 wánjù, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 花 huā | Ôn nhanh: 快 kuài, 哭 kū
zh.cum: 卖书 mài shū / 卖花 mài huā / 五块钱 wǔ kuài qián / 很便宜 hěn piányi / 太贵了 tài guì le / 给图书馆买新书 gěi túshūguǎn mǎi xīn shū
zh.cau: 这些花多少钱？(Zhèxiē huā duōshao qián?) / 五块钱，很便宜！(Wǔ kuài qián, hěn piányi!) / 二十块钱？太贵了！(Èrshí kuài qián? Tài guì le!) / 我们用这些钱给图书馆买新书。(Wǒmen yòng zhèxiē qián gěi túshūguǎn mǎi xīn shū.)
zh.truyen: 班里的小超市 — 今天我们班有一个小超市。Leo卖书，Xiaomei卖花。Nhan问：“这些花多少钱？”Xiaomei说：“五块钱，很便宜！”Bông想买一个大玩具。“二十块钱？太贵了！”最后，我们用这些钱给图书馆买新书。(Jīntiān wǒmen bān yǒu yī gè xiǎo chāoshì. Leo mài shū, Xiaomei mài huā. Nhan wèn: “Zhèxiē huā duōshao qián?” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǔ kuài qián, hěn piányi!” Bông xiǎng mǎi yī gè dà wánjù. “Èrshí kuài qián? Tài guì le!” Zuìhòu, wǒmen yòng zhèxiē qián gěi túshūguǎn mǎi xīn shū.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小超市 买卖游戏 儿童 中文"

en.tu: Ôn: supermarket, how much, yuan, buy, toy, apples, expensive, cheap, let's | Ôn nhanh: country, half
en.cum: Let's go to … / How much is …? / ten yuan / want to buy / Have you got any …? / too expensive
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Trung, nói câu tiếng Anh] Let's go to the supermarket! / How much is this? / It's ten yuan. / I want to buy a toy. / Have you got any apples? / This hat is too expensive. / This one is cheap.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter Anna — Xiaomei's grandma is at the supermarket. She only speaks Chinese. She wants to buy apples. Anna helps her. She asks the man in the shop, "Have you got any apples? How much are they?" "They're three dollars." Anna tells Grandma in Chinese. Grandma says, "That's cheap! Thank you, Anna!"

zh.tu: Ôn: 超市 chāoshì, 多少钱 duōshao qián, 块 kuài, 买 mǎi, 玩具 wánjù, 苹果 píngguǒ, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 吧 ba | Ôn nhanh: 国家 guójiā, 半 bàn
zh.cum: 我们去……吧 wǒmen qù…ba / ……多少钱 …duōshao qián / 十块钱 shí kuài qián / 我要买 wǒ yào mǎi / 你们有……吗 nǐmen yǒu…ma / 太贵了 tài guì le
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Anh, nói câu tiếng Trung] 我们去超市吧！(Wǒmen qù chāoshì ba!) / 这个多少钱？(Zhège duōshao qián?) / 十块钱。(Shí kuài qián.) / 我要买一个玩具。(Wǒ yào mǎi yī gè wánjù.) / 你们有苹果吗？(Nǐmen yǒu píngguǒ ma?) / 这个帽子太贵了。(Zhège màozi tài guì le.) / 这个很便宜。(Zhège hěn piányi.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译Anna — Xiaomei的奶奶在超市。她只会说汉语。她想买苹果。Anna帮助她，用英语问：“你们有苹果吗？多少钱？”“三美元。”Anna用汉语告诉奶奶。奶奶说：“很便宜！谢谢你，Anna！”(Xiaomei de nǎinai zài chāoshì. Tā zhǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ. Tā xiǎng mǎi píngguǒ. Anna bāngzhù tā, yòng Yīngyǔ wèn: “Nǐmen yǒu píngguǒ ma? Duōshao qián?” “Sān měiyuán.” Anna yòng Hànyǔ gàosu nǎinai. Nǎinai shuō: “Hěn piányi! Xièxie nǐ, Anna!”)
