en.flash: Ôn: shopping, supermarket, money, how much, cheap, expensive, dollar, yuan, sale, size, city centre, bus stop, café, laptop, e-book, send | Ôn từ khóa trước: shop, buy, library
en.slide: 1) Nghe truyện, điền giá vào bảng (dạng Movers Listening Part 2, 4 chỗ): comic book – ___ dollar(s) / plant – ___ dollars / toy – ___ dollars / e-book – ___ dollars. 2) Trò chơi "Phiên chợ lớp": mỗi con có 10 dollars giấy, mua bán bằng câu: How much is this? / It's three dollars. / That's too expensive! / OK, I'll buy it. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: bạn A nói câu tiếng Trung, bạn B nói lại bằng tiếng Anh: Let's go to the supermarket! / Have you got any apples? / This one is cheap.
en.truyen: The Class Sale — Anna's class has a sale. Leo sells comic books for one dollar. Xiaomei sells plants. "How much is this plant?" asks Nhan. "It's only two dollars. It's cheap!" Bông wants a big toy, but it's ten dollars. "That's too expensive!" she says. Anna sends a message to all the parents: "Come to our class sale!" At the end of the day, the class has got lots of money. They use it to buy new books for the library.
en.baihat: Our Class Sale (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Come to our class sale, class sale, class sale, / Come to our class sale, it's all cheap! / How much is the e-book, the e-book, the e-book? / Only one dollar! Let's buy it, let's buy!

zh.flash: Ôn: 超市 chāoshì, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán, 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn, 车站 chēzhàn, 让 ràng, 送 sòng, 美元 měiyuán, 喂 wèi | Ôn từ khóa trước: 买 mǎi, 东西 dōngxi, 卖 mài
zh.slide: 1) Nghe truyện, chọn đúng/sai (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): Leo卖花。/ 这些花五块钱。/ 大玩具很便宜。/ 我们给图书馆买新书。 2) Trò chơi "Siêu thị nhỏ": con dùng tiền giấy mua bán bằng câu: 这个多少钱？/ 五块钱。/ 太贵了！/ 很便宜，我要买。 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói câu tiếng Trung: How much is this? → 这个多少钱？/ I want to buy a toy. → 我要买一个玩具。/ This hat is too expensive. → 这个帽子太贵了。
zh.truyen: 班里的小超市 — 今天我们班有一个小超市。Leo卖书，Xiaomei卖花。Nhan问：“这些花多少钱？”Xiaomei说：“五块钱，很便宜！”Bông想买一个大玩具。“二十块钱？太贵了！”Anna给爸爸妈妈们打电话：“喂，来我们的小超市吧！”最后，我们用这些钱给图书馆买新书。(Jīntiān wǒmen bān yǒu yī gè xiǎo chāoshì. Leo mài shū, Xiaomei mài huā. Nhan wèn: “Zhèxiē huā duōshao qián?” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǔ kuài qián, hěn piányi!” Bông xiǎng mǎi yī gè dà wánjù. “Èrshí kuài qián? Tài guì le!” Anna gěi bàba māmamen dǎ diànhuà: “Wèi, lái wǒmen de xiǎo chāoshì ba!” Zuìhòu, wǒmen yòng zhèxiē qián gěi túshūguǎn mǎi xīn shū.)
zh.baihat: 去超市吧 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 去超市吧，去超市吧，买水果，买玩具，这个不太贵呀，那个很便宜呀，买买买！买买买！(Qù chāoshì ba, qù chāoshì ba, mǎi shuǐguǒ, mǎi wánjù, zhège bú tài guì ya, nàge hěn piányi ya, mǎi mǎi mǎi! Mǎi mǎi mǎi!)

blocks.title: Unit 11 · My Dream Holiday · 我理想的假期

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 47. Unit 11 · My Dream Holiday – Con muốn đi đâu, chuẩn bị va li

web.label: Ngày 93. Unit 11 · Con muốn đi đâu?

en.tu: Mới: travel, visit, London, world, map | Ôn: all right, be called, look for, language, plane, train, trip
en.cum: travel by plane / visit London / around the world / a map of the world / go on a trip
en.cau: Where do you want to go? – I want to visit London. / [Ngữ pháp: be going to – dự định] I'm going to go to London. / I want to travel around the world. / Let's look for London on the map. / How do you get to Beijing? – I go to Beijing by plane.
en.truyen: Leo's Big Trip — Leo looks at a map of the world. "Where do you want to go?" asks Dad. "I want to visit Beijing to see the pandas. Then I want to visit London!" says Leo. "How do we get there?" "We travel by plane." Leo is very happy. "I'm going to travel around the world!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "where do you want to go travel song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 旅行 lǚxíng | Ôn: 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 北京 Běijīng, 坐 zuò, 熊猫 xióngmāo | Ôn nhanh: 帮助 bāngzhù, 男 nán
zh.cum: 去旅行 qù lǚxíng / 坐飞机 zuò fēijī / 去北京 qù Běijīng / 想去哪儿 xiǎng qù nǎr
zh.cau: 你想去哪儿？(Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?) / 我想去北京旅行。(Wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng lǚxíng.) / 你怎么去北京？(Nǐ zěnme qù Běijīng?) / [Ngữ pháp: 坐 + phương tiện + 去 + nơi chốn] 我坐飞机去北京。(Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.)
zh.truyen: Leo想去旅行 — Leo说：“爸爸，我想去旅行！”爸爸问：“你想去哪儿？”Leo说：“我想去北京看熊猫！”爸爸问：“我们怎么去北京？”Leo说：“我们坐飞机去北京！”(Leo shuō: “Bàba, wǒ xiǎng qù lǚxíng!” Bàba wèn: “Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng kàn xióngmāo!” Bàba wèn: “Wǒmen zěnme qù Běijīng?” Leo shuō: “Wǒmen zuò fēijī qù Běijīng!”)

en.tu: Mới: ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off | Ôn: get dressed, put on, take off, backpack, sweater
en.cum: a plane ticket / a train ticket / a big suitcase / stay at a hotel / get on the plane / get off the train
en.cau: Have you got your ticket? / Put your sweater in the suitcase. / We're going to stay at a hotel in London. / Get on the train, please! / We get off the plane in London.
en.truyen: Packing for London — Anna is going to London with her family. She puts her sweater and her backpack next to a big suitcase. "Have you got the plane tickets?" asks Mum. "Yes!" says Dad. They get on the plane. Ten hours later, they get off in London and go to their hotel.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "packing a suitcase for a trip kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 伦敦 Lúndūn | Ôn: 飞机 fēijī, 衣服 yīfu, 小时 xiǎoshí, 远 yuǎn | Ôn nhanh: 件 jiàn, 裤子 kùzi
zh.cum: 去伦敦 qù Lúndūn / 坐飞机去伦敦 zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn / 三件衣服 sān jiàn yīfu / 两条裤子 liǎng tiáo kùzi / 十个小时 shí gè xiǎoshí
zh.cau: 我要去伦敦。(Wǒ yào qù Lúndūn.) / 我们坐飞机去伦敦。(Wǒmen zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn.) / 伦敦远吗？——很远。(Lúndūn yuǎn ma? — Hěn yuǎn.) / 我有三件衣服和两条裤子。(Wǒ yǒu sān jiàn yīfu hé liǎng tiáo kùzi.)
zh.truyen: 去伦敦 — Anna和爸爸妈妈要去伦敦。妈妈问：“你的衣服呢？”Anna说：“在这儿！三件衣服和两条裤子。”伦敦很远，他们坐飞机去，坐了十个小时！(Anna hé bàba māma yào qù Lúndūn. Māma wèn: “Nǐ de yīfu ne?” Anna shuō: “Zài zhèr! Sān jiàn yīfu hé liǎng tiáo kùzi.” Lúndūn hěn yuǎn, tāmen zuò fēijī qù, zuò le shí gè xiǎoshí!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "伦敦 儿童 中文 旅行"

en.flash: Mới: travel, visit, London, world, map, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off | Ôn: plane, train, trip, sweater, backpack, put on
en.slide: 1) Nhìn bản đồ thế giới, nghe và chạm đúng nơi (5 lượt): London / Beijing / Vietnam / the sea / an island. 2) Kéo đồ vào va li và nói câu (thẻ nhiễu: towel, blanket, police officer): Put the sweater in the suitcase. / Put the ticket in the backpack. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp rồi ghi vào bảng: A: Where do you want to go? B: I want to visit London. A: How do you get there? B: By plane. I'm going to stay at a hotel.
en.truyen: Leo's Big Trip — Leo looks at a map of the world. "Where do you want to go?" asks Dad. "I want to visit Beijing and London!" says Leo. Mum gets the plane tickets. Leo puts his sweater and his backpack in a big suitcase. Then they get on the plane. Many hours later, they get off in London and go to their hotel. "I'm going to travel around the world!" says Leo.
en.baihat: Where Do You Want to Go? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Where do you want to go? Where do you want to go? / London! London! / Get on the plane, get off in London, / Bye-bye! Bye-bye!

zh.flash: Mới: 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn | Ôn: 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 北京 Běijīng, 坐 zuò, 衣服 yīfu, 件 jiàn, 裤子 kùzi, 小时 xiǎoshí
zh.slide: 1) Nghe câu, nối người với phương tiện (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): Leo坐飞机去北京。/ Anna坐飞机去伦敦。/ Nhan坐火车去上海。/ Bông坐公共汽车去学校。 2) Sắp xếp từ thành câu: 我 / 坐飞机 / 去 / 伦敦 → 我坐飞机去伦敦。/ 你 / 去哪儿 / 想 → 你想去哪儿？ 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp (thẻ nhiễu: 美国, 越南, 韩国): 你想去哪儿？— 我想去北京旅行。/ 你怎么去？— 我坐火车去。
zh.truyen: Leo想去旅行 — Leo说：“爸爸，我想去旅行！”爸爸问：“你想去哪儿？”Leo说：“我想去北京看熊猫，还想去伦敦！”爸爸问：“我们怎么去？”Leo说：“坐飞机去！”伦敦很远，他们坐了十个小时的飞机。(Leo shuō: “Bàba, wǒ xiǎng qù lǚxíng!” Bàba wèn: “Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng kàn xióngmāo, hái xiǎng qù Lúndūn!” Bàba wèn: “Wǒmen zěnme qù?” Leo shuō: “Zuò fēijī qù!” Lúndūn hěn yuǎn, tāmen zuò le shí gè xiǎoshí de fēijī.)
zh.baihat: 去旅行 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 去旅行呀，去旅行呀，去哪儿？去哪儿？坐飞机去伦敦，坐火车去北京，真高兴！真高兴！(Qù lǚxíng ya, qù lǚxíng ya, qù nǎr? Qù nǎr? Zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn, zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng, zhēn gāoxìng! Zhēn gāoxìng!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 48. Unit 11 · My Dream Holiday – Biển đảo và miền quê

web.label: Ngày 95. Unit 11 · Đảo, cá voi, cá mập

en.tu: Mới: shark, whale, island, rock, swimming pool | Ôn từ nối: money, how much, expensive, cheap, city | Ôn nhanh: fast, heavy, future
en.cum: on an island / a big whale / a fast shark / sit on a rock / the hotel swimming pool / near the beach
en.cau: I want to visit an island. / Look! There's a whale in the sea! / Sharks are fast and dangerous. / Let's sit on that rock. / The hotel has got a swimming pool, but it isn't expensive. / The beach is near the hotel.
en.truyen: Island Trip — Nhan's family travels to an island. Their hotel is near the beach and it has got a swimming pool. Nhan sits on a big rock and looks at the sea. "Look! A whale!" says Mum. Then Nhan sees a fast fish. "Is that a shark?" he asks. "No, it's a dolphin!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sea animals for kids whale shark"

zh.tu: Mới: 海滩 hǎitān | Ôn từ nối: 远 yuǎn, 近 jìn, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 车站 chēzhàn | Ôn nhanh: 慢 màn, 百 bǎi
zh.cum: 在海滩上 zài hǎitān shang / 去海滩玩 qù hǎitān wán / 海滩很近 hǎitān hěn jìn / 看大海 kàn dàhǎi / 大石头 dà shítou
zh.cau: 我想去海滩玩。(Wǒ xiǎng qù hǎitān wán.) / 海滩不远，很近。(Hǎitān bù yuǎn, hěn jìn.) / 我们坐公共汽车去海滩。(Wǒmen zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù hǎitān.) / 海滩上有很多人。(Hǎitān shang yǒu hěn duō rén.)
zh.truyen: 去海滩 — Nhan和爸爸妈妈去旅行。海滩很近，他们走路去海滩。Nhan坐在大石头上看大海。妈妈说：“看！那是什么？”Nhan说：“是一条大鱼！”(Nhan hé bàba māma qù lǚxíng. Hǎitān hěn jìn, tāmen zǒulù qù hǎitān. Nhan zuò zài dà shítou shang kàn dàhǎi. Māma shuō: “Kàn! Nà shì shénme?” Nhan shuō: “Shì yī tiáo dà yú!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "海滩 大海 儿歌 中文"

web.label: Ngày 96. Unit 11 · Về miền quê

en.tu: Mới: countryside, village, field, tractor, snail, town/city centre | Ôn từ nối: supermarket, shopping, bus stop, bus station | Ôn nhanh: grow, leaf/leaves, cry
en.cum: in the countryside / a small village / a big field / drive a tractor / a slow snail / far from the town/city centre
en.cau: My grandparents live in a village in the countryside. / The village is far from the town centre. / Grandpa drives a tractor in the field. / Look! There's a snail on the leaf! / There isn't a supermarket in the village.
en.truyen: In the Countryside — Bông visits her grandparents in a small village. It's far from the town centre, so she gets off the bus at the last bus stop. Grandpa drives a tractor in the field. Bông finds a slow snail on a leaf. She takes a photo of it and sends it to Mum.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "countryside village farm vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 拍照 pāizhào | Ôn từ nối: 超市 chāoshì, 车站 chēzhàn, 送 sòng, 让 ràng | Ôn nhanh: 电脑 diànnǎo, 关 guān
zh.cum: 拍照 pāizhào / 给小鸡拍照 gěi xiǎo jī pāizhào / 在农场拍照 zài nóngchǎng pāizhào / 拍很多照片 pāi hěn duō zhàopiàn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 想 + động từ] 我想在海滩上拍照。(Wǒ xiǎng zài hǎitān shang pāizhào.) / 爷爷奶奶家有一个农场。(Yéye nǎinai jiā yǒu yī gè nóngchǎng.) / 我们在农场拍照吧！(Wǒmen zài nóngchǎng pāizhào ba!) / 农场很远，没有超市。(Nóngchǎng hěn yuǎn, méiyǒu chāoshì.)
zh.truyen: 在农场 — Bông去爷爷奶奶家。爷爷奶奶家有一个农场，很远，没有超市。Bông看见牛、羊和鸡。她很喜欢拍照。她给小鸡拍照，然后送给妈妈看。(Bông qù yéye nǎinai jiā. Yéye nǎinai jiā yǒu yī gè nóngchǎng, hěn yuǎn, méiyǒu chāoshì. Bông kànjiàn niú, yáng hé jī. Tā hěn xǐhuan pāizhào. Tā gěi xiǎo jī pāizhào, ránhòu sòng gěi māma kàn.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "拍照 农场 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Mới: shark, whale, island, rock, swimming pool, countryside, village, field, tractor, snail, town/city centre | Ôn: beach, sea, dolphin, bus stop, supermarket, take a photo
en.slide: 1) Nghe và nối tên với tranh (dạng Movers Listening Part 1, 5 người): Nhan is sitting on a rock. / Anna is in the swimming pool. / Grandpa is driving a tractor. / Bông is looking at a snail. / Leo is looking at a whale. 2) Phân loại thẻ từ vào 2 cột "Sea" – "Countryside": shark / whale / island / rock / village / field / tractor / snail. 3) Đọc và chọn Yes/No (4 câu): A tractor is in the sea. / A whale is very big. / A village is in the town centre. / A snail is slow.
en.truyen: Two Trips — Nhan's family travels to an island. Their hotel is near the beach and has got a swimming pool. Nhan sits on a rock and sees a whale. "Is that a shark?" "No, it's a dolphin!" Bông visits her grandparents in a small village in the countryside. It's far from the town centre. Grandpa drives a tractor in the field, and Bông finds a slow snail. Nhan and Bông take photos and send them to their class.
en.baihat: Row to the Island (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Row, row, row your boat / To the island, see! / Look, a whale! Look, a shark! / Swimming in the sea! / Drive, drive, drive the tractor / In the countryside, / Past the village, past the field, / A snail is by my side!

zh.flash: Mới: 海滩 hǎitān, 拍照 pāizhào | Ôn: 远 yuǎn, 近 jìn, 车站 chēzhàn, 超市 chāoshì, 送 sòng, 农场 nóngchǎng, 石头 shítou, 鱼 yú
zh.slide: 1) Nghe câu, chọn tranh đúng (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): 我在海滩上拍照。/ 海滩很近。/ 农场很远。/ Bông给小鸡拍照。 2) Chọn từ điền câu (海滩 / 拍照 / 远 / 近): 我想去___玩。/ 我们在农场___吧！/ 农场很___，没有超市。/ 海滩不远，很___。 3) Nói câu về ảnh của con: 这是我在海滩上拍的照片。/ 我想在……拍照。
zh.truyen: 海滩和农场 — Nhan和爸爸妈妈去旅行。海滩很近，他们走路去。Nhan坐在大石头上看大海，他看见一条大鱼。Bông去爷爷奶奶家。爷爷奶奶家有一个农场，很远，没有超市。Bông给小鸡拍照。Nhan和Bông给老师和同学看照片。(Nhan hé bàba māma qù lǚxíng. Hǎitān hěn jìn, tāmen zǒulù qù. Nhan zuò zài dà shítou shang kàn dàhǎi, tā kànjiàn yī tiáo dà yú. Bông qù yéye nǎinai jiā. Yéye nǎinai jiā yǒu yī gè nóngchǎng, hěn yuǎn, méiyǒu chāoshì. Bông gěi xiǎo jī pāizhào. Nhan hé Bông gěi lǎoshī hé tóngxué kàn zhàopiàn.)
zh.baihat: 去海滩 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 去海滩呀，去海滩呀，真好玩，真好玩，我在海滩拍照，我在农场拍照，咔嚓嚓！咔嚓嚓！(Qù hǎitān ya, qù hǎitān ya, zhēn hǎowán, zhēn hǎowán, wǒ zài hǎitān pāizhào, wǒ zài nóngchǎng pāizhào, kāchācha! Kāchācha!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 49. Unit 11 · My Dream Holiday – Vườn thú, rừng, thác nước; ôn không tranh

web.label: Ngày 97. Unit 11 · Vườn thú, rừng, hồ và thác nước

en.tu: Mới: jungle, lake, waterfall, parrot, penguin | Ôn: kangaroo, dolphin, cage, feed, panda | Ôn nhanh: sometimes, shower
en.cum: in the jungle / a big lake / a tall waterfall / a red parrot / penguins in the water / visit the zoo
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: want to … to … – nói mục đích] I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. / Parrots live in the jungle. / Penguins can swim, but they can't fly. / Let's take photos next to the waterfall. / There's a big lake near the village.
en.truyen: At the Zoo — Xiaomei visits a big zoo in Beijing. She wants to see the pandas. First she sees a red parrot from the jungle. Then she sees penguins swim in a small lake. There's a waterfall next to the pandas. "They're so cute!" says Xiaomei, and she takes lots of photos.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "jungle animals parrot penguin song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 参观 cānguān | Ôn: 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 北京 Běijīng, 拍照 pāizhào | Ôn nhanh: 每 měi, 去年 qùnián
zh.cum: 参观动物园 cānguān dòngwùyuán / 参观学校 cānguān xuéxiào / 去北京参观 qù Běijīng cānguān / 看熊猫 kàn xióngmāo
zh.cau: 我想去动物园看熊猫。(Wǒ xiǎng qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.) / 我们去参观动物园吧！(Wǒmen qù cānguān dòngwùyuán ba!) / 我想在熊猫旁边拍照。(Wǒ xiǎng zài xióngmāo pángbiān pāizhào.) / 你怎么去北京？——我坐火车去北京。(Nǐ zěnme qù Běijīng? — Wǒ zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng.)
zh.truyen: 参观动物园 — Xiaomei去北京旅行。她去参观动物园，她想看熊猫。动物园里有很多动物：老虎、大象和熊猫。熊猫很可爱，Xiaomei拍了很多照片。(Xiaomei qù Běijīng lǚxíng. Tā qù cānguān dòngwùyuán, tā xiǎng kàn xióngmāo. Dòngwùyuán li yǒu hěn duō dòngwù: lǎohǔ, dàxiàng hé xióngmāo. Xióngmāo hěn kě'ài, Xiaomei pāi le hěn duō zhàopiàn.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "参观动物园 看熊猫 儿童 中文"

web.label: Ngày 98. Unit 11 · Ôn không tranh

en.tu: Ôn: travel, visit, London, world, map, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off, shark, whale, island, rock, swimming pool, countryside, village, field, tractor, snail, town/city centre, jungle, lake, waterfall, parrot, penguin | Ôn nhanh: language, future
en.cum: visit London / a plane ticket / get on the bus / get off the train / on an island / in the countryside / in the jungle
en.cau: Where do you want to go? / I'm going to go to London. / How do you get to Beijing? – By plane. / I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. / I want to take photos on the beach.
en.truyen: Guess Where! — "I'm going to travel by ship. There's a big rock and a beach. I can see a whale. Where am I?" "On an island!" "Now I'm going to get on a bus. I can see a village, a field and a tractor. Where am I?" "In the countryside!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "travel vocabulary review game for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 海滩 hǎitān, 拍照 pāizhào, 参观 cānguān, 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 北京 Běijīng, 动物园 dòngwùyuán | Ôn nhanh: 别 bié, 警察 jǐngchá
zh.cum: 去旅行 qù lǚxíng / 坐飞机去伦敦 zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn / 在海滩上拍照 zài hǎitān shang pāizhào / 参观动物园 cānguān dòngwùyuán
zh.cau: 你想去哪儿？(Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?) / 我要去伦敦。(Wǒ yào qù Lúndūn.) / 你怎么去北京？(Nǐ zěnme qù Běijīng?) / 我坐飞机去北京。(Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.) / 我想去动物园看熊猫。(Wǒ xiǎng qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.) / 我想在海滩上拍照。(Wǒ xiǎng zài hǎitān shang pāizhào.)
zh.truyen: 猜猜我在哪儿 — “我坐飞机去旅行。这儿很远，有很多人说英语。我在哪儿？”“你在伦敦！”“我坐火车去旅行。我去参观动物园，看熊猫。我在哪儿？”“你在北京！”(“Wǒ zuò fēijī qù lǚxíng. Zhèr hěn yuǎn, yǒu hěn duō rén shuō Yīngyǔ. Wǒ zài nǎr?” “Nǐ zài Lúndūn!” “Wǒ zuò huǒchē qù lǚxíng. Wǒ qù cānguān dòngwùyuán, kàn xióngmāo. Wǒ zài nǎr?” “Nǐ zài Běijīng!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你想去哪儿 旅行 中文 对话 儿童"

en.flash: Mới: jungle, lake, waterfall, parrot, penguin | Ôn: travel, visit, London, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off, shark, whale, island, village, kangaroo, panda
en.slide: 1) Nghe và tô màu tranh vườn thú (dạng Movers Listening tô màu, 4 lệnh): Colour the parrot red. / Colour the penguin next to the lake black and white. / Colour the waterfall blue. / Colour the tree in the jungle green. 2) Ôn không tranh – trò chơi "Guess where!": cô đọc gợi ý, con nói nơi: I can see a whale and a rock. (an island) / I can see a tractor and a field. (the countryside) / I can see a parrot and tall trees. (the jungle). 3) Nói câu mục đích theo thẻ: I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. / I want to go to the island to see the whales.
en.truyen: At the Zoo — Xiaomei visits a big zoo in Beijing with her mum. "I want to see the pandas!" she says. First they see a red parrot from the jungle. "Hello!" says the parrot. Xiaomei laughs. Then they see penguins swim in a small lake. Next to the pandas there's a waterfall. The pandas are eating. "They're so cute!" says Xiaomei, and she takes lots of photos.
en.baihat: At the Zoo (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The parrot in the jungle says "Hello, hello!" / "Hello, hello! Hello, hello!" / The penguins in the lake go swim, swim, swim, / All day long! / The panda by the waterfall eats, eats, eats, / All day long!

zh.flash: Mới: 参观 cānguān | Ôn: 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 海滩 hǎitān, 拍照 pāizhào, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 老虎 lǎohǔ, 大象 dàxiàng, 北京 Běijīng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và đánh số tranh theo thứ tự (4 tranh): Xiaomei去北京。/ 她参观动物园。/ 她看熊猫。/ 她拍照。 2) Ôn không tranh – trò chơi "Đoán nơi": cô nói 我坐飞机去，很远，有很多人说英语 → con nói 伦敦; 我看见大海和大石头 → 海滩; 我看见熊猫和老虎 → 动物园. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你想去哪儿参观？— 我想去参观动物园，看熊猫。
zh.truyen: 参观动物园 — Xiaomei和妈妈去北京旅行。Xiaomei说：“我想去参观动物园，看熊猫！”动物园里有很多动物：老虎、大象和熊猫。熊猫在吃东西，很可爱！Xiaomei在熊猫旁边拍了很多照片。(Xiaomei hé māma qù Běijīng lǚxíng. Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù cānguān dòngwùyuán, kàn xióngmāo!” Dòngwùyuán li yǒu hěn duō dòngwù: lǎohǔ, dàxiàng hé xióngmāo. Xióngmāo zài chī dōngxi, hěn kě'ài! Xiaomei zài xióngmāo pángbiān pāi le hěn duō zhàopiàn.)
zh.baihat: 参观动物园 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 动物园呀，动物园呀，去参观，去参观，我想看看熊猫，我想看看老虎，真可爱！真可爱！(Dòngwùyuán ya, dòngwùyuán ya, qù cānguān, qù cānguān, wǒ xiǎng kànkan xióngmāo, wǒ xiǎng kànkan lǎohǔ, zhēn kě'ài! Zhēn kě'ài!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 50. Unit 11 · My Dream Holiday – Truyện Chuyến đi mơ ước, Phiên dịch nhí

web.label: Ngày 99. Unit 11 · Truyện: Chuyến đi mơ ước của Anna

en.tu: Ôn: dream, travel, visit, London, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off, swimming pool, island, whale | Ôn nhanh: be called, heavy
en.cum: my dream trip / pack a suitcase / get on the plane / a hotel with a swimming pool / visit an island
en.cau: Anna is going to go to London. / She gets on the plane with her suitcase. / Her hotel has got a swimming pool. / She wants to visit an island to see the whales.
en.truyen: Anna's Dream Trip — Anna has a dream. She packs a heavy suitcase and gets on a plane to London. She gets off and goes to a hotel with a big swimming pool. The next day she takes a ship to an island. She sees a whale and takes a photo. Then Mum says, "Wake up, Anna!" It's only a dream, but Anna wants to visit London one day!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "my dream holiday story for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 飞机 fēijī, 海滩 hǎitān, 拍照 pāizhào, 参观 cānguān, 熊猫 xióngmāo | Ôn nhanh: 百 bǎi, 帮助 bāngzhù
zh.cum: 做梦 zuòmèng / 坐飞机去伦敦 zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn / 在海滩上拍照 zài hǎitān shang pāizhào / 参观动物园 cānguān dòngwùyuán
zh.cau: Anna坐飞机去伦敦。(Anna zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn.) / 她在海滩上拍照。(Tā zài hǎitān shang pāizhào.) / 她想去北京参观动物园。(Tā xiǎng qù Běijīng cānguān dòngwùyuán.)
zh.truyen: Anna的梦 — Anna做了一个梦。她坐飞机去伦敦旅行。然后她去海滩，在海滩上拍照。她还去北京参观动物园，看熊猫。妈妈说：“Anna，起床了！”这是一个梦，可是Anna真的很想去旅行！(Anna zuò le yī gè mèng. Tā zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn lǚxíng. Ránhòu tā qù hǎitān, zài hǎitān shang pāizhào. Tā hái qù Běijīng cānguān dòngwùyuán, kàn xióngmāo. Māma shuō: “Anna, qǐchuáng le!” Zhè shì yī gè mèng, kěshì Anna zhēn de hěn xiǎng qù lǚxíng!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的梦 旅行 中文故事 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 100. Unit 11 · Chuyển ngữ – Phiên dịch nhí

en.tu: Ôn: want to go, London, Beijing, plane, zoo, pandas, take photos, beach | Ôn nhanh: look for, language
en.cum: Where do you want to go? / I'm going to go to … / How do you get to …? / by plane / to see the pandas / take photos on the beach
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Trung, nói câu tiếng Anh] Where do you want to go? / I'm going to go to London. / How do you get to Beijing? / I go to Beijing by plane. / I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. / I want to take photos on the beach.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter Leo — Leo's family is at a hotel in London. Grandma only speaks Chinese. She wants to visit the zoo. Leo asks the man at the hotel, "How do we get to the zoo?" "Get on the bus at the bus stop and get off at the zoo." Leo tells Grandma in Chinese. "Thank you, Leo!" says Grandma.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how do you get to school by bus by car song"

zh.tu: Ôn: 想去 xiǎng qù, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 北京 Běijīng, 飞机 fēijī, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 拍照 pāizhào, 海滩 hǎitān | Ôn nhanh: 男 nán, 每 měi
zh.cum: 你想去哪儿 nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr / 我要去…… wǒ yào qù… / 你怎么去…… nǐ zěnme qù… / 坐飞机 zuò fēijī / 看熊猫 kàn xióngmāo / 在海滩上拍照 zài hǎitān shang pāizhào
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Anh, nói câu tiếng Trung] 你想去哪儿？(Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?) / 我要去伦敦。(Wǒ yào qù Lúndūn.) / 你怎么去北京？(Nǐ zěnme qù Běijīng?) / 我坐飞机去北京。(Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.) / 我想去动物园看熊猫。(Wǒ xiǎng qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.) / 我想在海滩上拍照。(Wǒ xiǎng zài hǎitān shang pāizhào.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译Leo — Leo和家人在伦敦旅行。奶奶只会说汉语，她想去参观动物园。Leo用英语问：“我们怎么去动物园？”“坐公共汽车去。”Leo用汉语告诉奶奶：“我们坐公共汽车去动物园。”奶奶说：“谢谢你，Leo！”(Leo hé jiārén zài Lúndūn lǚxíng. Nǎinai zhǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ, tā xiǎng qù cānguān dòngwùyuán. Leo yòng Yīngyǔ wèn: “Wǒmen zěnme qù dòngwùyuán?” “Zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù.” Leo yòng Hànyǔ gàosu nǎinai: “Wǒmen zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù dòngwùyuán.” Nǎinai shuō: “Xièxie nǐ, Leo!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你怎么去 坐公共汽车 儿歌"

en.flash: Ôn: travel, visit, London, world, map, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off, shark, whale, island, swimming pool, countryside, village, jungle, waterfall, parrot, penguin | Ôn từ khóa trước: plane, ship, trip, near, far
en.slide: 1) Đọc truyện, chọn từ đúng điền vào chỗ trống (dạng Movers Reading, 5 chỗ, từ: suitcase / plane / hotel / island / whale): Anna packs a heavy ___. / She gets on a ___ to London. / Her ___ has got a swimming pool. / She takes a ship to an ___. / She sees a ___. 2) Dự án mini "My Dream Trip": con vẽ chuyến đi mơ ước và nói 3 câu: I want to visit … / I'm going to go by … / I want to … there. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: bạn A nói câu tiếng Trung, bạn B nói tiếng Anh: Where do you want to go? / I go to Beijing by plane. / I want to take photos on the beach.
en.truyen: Anna's Dream Trip — Anna has a dream. She packs a heavy suitcase and gets her ticket. She gets on a plane to London. When she gets off, she goes to a hotel with a big swimming pool. The next day she takes a ship to an island. She sees a whale and a shark, and she takes lots of photos. Then she flies to Beijing to visit the pandas. "Wake up, Anna!" says Mum. It's only a dream, but Anna wants to travel around the world one day!
en.baihat: My Dream Trip (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Pack my suitcase, here's my ticket, / Get on the plane, we fly away! / London, Beijing, see the world, / Sharks and whales and pandas play. / Pack my suitcase, here's my ticket, / My dream trip starts today!

zh.flash: Ôn: 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 海滩 hǎitān, 拍照 pāizhào, 参观 cānguān | Ôn từ khóa trước: 飞机 fēijī, 火车 huǒchē, 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 坐 zuò, 北京 Běijīng, 上海 Shànghǎi, 熊猫 xióngmāo
zh.slide: 1) Nghe truyện, chọn đúng/sai (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): Anna坐火车去伦敦。/ Anna在海滩上拍照。/ Anna去北京参观动物园。/ 这不是一个梦。 2) Dự án mini "我理想的旅行": con nói 3 câu về tranh của mình: 我想去…… / 我坐……去…… / 我想在……拍照。 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói câu tiếng Trung: I'm going to go to London. → 我要去伦敦。/ How do you get to Beijing? → 你怎么去北京？/ I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. → 我想去动物园看熊猫。
zh.truyen: Anna的梦 — Anna做了一个梦。她坐飞机去伦敦旅行。然后她去海滩，在海滩上拍照。她还坐火车去北京参观动物园，看熊猫。妈妈说：“Anna，起床了！”这是一个梦，可是Anna真的很想去旅行！她说：“妈妈，我们去伦敦旅行吧！”(Anna zuò le yī gè mèng. Tā zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn lǚxíng. Ránhòu tā qù hǎitān, zài hǎitān shang pāizhào. Tā hái zuò huǒchē qù Běijīng cānguān dòngwùyuán, kàn xióngmāo. Māma shuō: “Anna, qǐchuáng le!” Zhè shì yī gè mèng, kěshì Anna zhēn de hěn xiǎng qù lǚxíng! Tā shuō: “Māma, wǒmen qù Lúndūn lǚxíng ba!”)
zh.baihat: 我理想的旅行 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 我要旅行，我要旅行，去哪儿？去伦敦！我想参观伦敦，还想参观北京，真高兴！真高兴！(Wǒ yào lǚxíng, wǒ yào lǚxíng, qù nǎr? Qù Lúndūn! Wǒ xiǎng cānguān Lúndūn, hái xiǎng cānguān Běijīng, zhēn gāoxìng! Zhēn gāoxìng!)

blocks.title: Unit 12 · Let's Celebrate · 我们一起庆祝吧！

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 51. Unit 12 · Let's Celebrate – Ngày lễ yêu thích, Tết Trung thu

web.label: Ngày 101. Unit 12 · Ngày lễ con yêu thích

en.tu: Mới: festival, holiday, celebrate | Ôn: birthday, candle, card, present, ice skating, team
en.cum: my favourite festival / on holiday / celebrate New Year / celebrate my birthday / with my family
en.cau: What's your favourite festival? – My favourite festival is New Year. / We celebrate New Year with our family. / I'm very happy at New Year. / We are on holiday at New Year. / We celebrate my birthday with a cake and candles.
en.truyen: Our Favourite Festivals — The teacher asks, "What's your favourite festival?" Leo says, "I like my birthday best! We celebrate it with a cake and candles." Anna says, "My favourite festival is New Year. We are on holiday and we celebrate with our family. I'm very happy at New Year!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "festivals and holidays vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù | Ôn: 生日 shēngrì, 高兴 gāoxìng, 新年 xīnnián | Ôn nhanh: 礼物 lǐwù, 欢迎 huānyíng
zh.cum: 我最喜欢的节日 wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiérì / 庆祝新年 qìngzhù xīnnián / 庆祝生日 qìngzhù shēngrì / 和家人一起 hé jiārén yīqǐ / 很开心 hěn kāixīn
zh.cau: 你最喜欢什么节日？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?) / 我最喜欢新年。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xīnnián.) / 新年我很开心。(Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn.) / [Ngữ pháp: rủ rê 我们……吧] 我们一起庆祝吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ qìngzhù ba!)
zh.truyen: 我最喜欢的节日 — 老师问：“你最喜欢什么节日？”Leo说：“我最喜欢我的生日！”Anna说：“我最喜欢新年。新年我们和家人一起庆祝，我很开心！”老师说：“我们一起庆祝吧！”(Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan wǒ de shēngrì!” Anna shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xīnnián. Xīnnián wǒmen hé jiārén yīqǐ qìngzhù, wǒ hěn kāixīn!” Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen yīqǐ qìngzhù ba!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中国节日 儿童 中文 你最喜欢什么节日"

web.label: Ngày 102. Unit 12 · Tết Trung thu

en.tu: Mới: mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern | Ôn: moon, star, autumn, sweet, practise, volleyball
en.cum: the Mid-Autumn Festival / eat mooncakes / a red lantern / a star lantern / look at the moon
en.cau: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We eat mooncakes and look at the moon. / I've got a red star lantern. / Mooncakes are very sweet. / The moon is big and round tonight.
en.truyen: The Mid-Autumn Festival — It's the Mid-Autumn Festival. Xiaomei and Bông have got lanterns. Xiaomei's lantern is a red star and Bông's lantern is a fish. They eat sweet mooncakes with Grandma and look at the big, round moon. "This is my favourite festival!" says Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Mid-Autumn Festival for kids explained"

zh.tu: Mới: 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong | Ôn: 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 秋天 qiūtiān, 甜 tián | Ôn nhanh: 排球 páiqiú
zh.cum: 过中秋节 guò Zhōngqiū Jié / 吃月饼 chī yuèbǐng / 红灯笼 hóng dēnglong / 星星灯笼 xīngxing dēnglong / 看月亮 kàn yuèliang
zh.cau: 这是中秋节。(Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié.) / 中秋节我们吃月饼，看月亮。(Zhōngqiū Jié wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang.) / 我有一个红灯笼。(Wǒ yǒu yī gè hóng dēnglong.) / 月饼很甜。(Yuèbǐng hěn tián.)
zh.truyen: 中秋节 — 今天是中秋节。Xiaomei和Bông有灯笼。Xiaomei的灯笼是一个红星星，Bông的灯笼是一条鱼。她们和奶奶一起吃月饼，看月亮。月饼很甜，月亮很大！Bông说：“我最喜欢中秋节！”(Jīntiān shì Zhōngqiū Jié. Xiaomei hé Bông yǒu dēnglong. Xiaomei de dēnglong shì yī gè hóng xīngxing, Bông de dēnglong shì yī tiáo yú. Tāmen hé nǎinai yīqǐ chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang. Yuèbǐng hěn tián, yuèliang hěn dà! Bông shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan Zhōngqiū Jié!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中秋节 儿歌 月饼 灯笼"

en.flash: Mới: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern | Ôn: birthday, candle, present, moon, star, sweet
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh, chọn từ đúng (6 tranh): festival / lantern / mooncake / moon / candle / present. 2) Nghe và tô màu chiếc đèn lồng (dạng Movers Listening tô màu, 4 lệnh): Colour the star lantern red. / Colour the fish lantern yellow. / Colour the mooncake brown. / Colour the moon in the sky orange. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp, ghi vào bảng của lớp: A: What's your favourite festival? B: My favourite festival is the Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and look at the moon.
en.truyen: The Mid-Autumn Festival — Today the teacher asks, "What's your favourite festival?" Leo says, "My birthday!" Bông says, "The Mid-Autumn Festival!" That evening, Bông and Xiaomei celebrate with Grandma. Xiaomei's lantern is a red star and Bông's lantern is a fish. They eat sweet mooncakes and look at the big, round moon. "This is the best festival!" says Bông. "We're on holiday tomorrow, too!"
en.baihat: Mid-Autumn Night (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Look at my lantern, red and round, / Look at the moon, big and round! / Eat a mooncake, sweet and nice, / Celebrate with friends tonight! / Look at my lantern, red and round, / Happy Mid-Autumn all around!

zh.flash: Mới: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong | Ôn: 生日 shēngrì, 新年 xīnnián, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 甜 tián, 礼物 lǐwù
zh.slide: 1) Nghe câu, chọn tranh đúng (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): 这是中秋节。/ 我有一个红灯笼。/ 月饼很甜。/ 我们一起看月亮。 2) Chọn từ điền câu (节日 / 月饼 / 灯笼 / 庆祝): 你最喜欢什么___？/ 中秋节我们吃___。/ 我有一个星星___。/ 我们一起___吧！ 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你最喜欢什么节日？— 我最喜欢中秋节，我们吃月饼，看月亮。
zh.truyen: 中秋节 — 老师问：“你最喜欢什么节日？”Leo说：“我的生日！”Bông说：“中秋节！”晚上，Bông和Xiaomei和奶奶一起庆祝中秋节。Xiaomei的灯笼是一个红星星，Bông的灯笼是一条鱼。她们吃月饼，看月亮。月饼很甜，月亮很大！(Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ de shēngrì!” Bông shuō: “Zhōngqiū Jié!” Wǎnshang, Bông hé Xiaomei hé nǎinai yīqǐ qìngzhù Zhōngqiū Jié. Xiaomei de dēnglong shì yī gè hóng xīngxing, Bông de dēnglong shì yī tiáo yú. Tāmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang. Yuèbǐng hěn tián, yuèliang hěn dà!)
zh.baihat: 中秋节 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 中秋节呀，中秋节呀，吃月饼，吃月饼，拿着红红灯笼，看看圆圆月亮，真开心！真开心！(Zhōngqiū Jié ya, Zhōngqiū Jié ya, chī yuèbǐng, chī yuèbǐng, ná zhe hónghóng dēnglong, kànkan yuányuán yuèliang, zhēn kāixīn! Zhēn kāixīn!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 52. Unit 12 · Let's Celebrate – Tết: lì xì, lời chúc, múa lân, pháo hoa

web.label: Ngày 103. Unit 12 · Tết: tiền lì xì và lời chúc

en.tu: Mới: lucky, wish, gift | Ôn từ nối: travel, visit, village, take photos | Ôn nhanh: win, match
en.cum: lucky money / my lucky number / I wish you … / a New Year gift / visit Grandma and Grandpa
en.cau: What do you do at New Year? – We get lucky money. / We visit our grandparents at New Year. / I wish you a happy New Year! / Grandpa gives me a gift. / Seven is my lucky number.
en.truyen: Lucky Money — At New Year, Nhan and his family travel to his grandparents' village. Nhan says, "I wish you a happy New Year, Grandma!" Grandma gives him some lucky money and a small gift. "Thank you! I'm very lucky!" says Nhan. Then everyone takes photos together.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Lunar New Year lucky money for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 红包 hóngbāo | Ôn từ nối: 旅行 lǚxíng, 参观 cānguān, 拍照 pāizhào | Ôn nhanh: 当然 dāngrán, 礼物 lǐwù
zh.cum: 拿红包 ná hóngbāo / 一个大红包 yī gè dà hóngbāo / 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè / 去爷爷奶奶家 qù yéye nǎinai jiā
zh.cau: 新年你们做什么？(Xīnnián nǐmen zuò shénme?) / 我们拿红包。(Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.) / 奶奶，新年快乐！(Nǎinai, xīnnián kuàilè!) / 新年我们去爷爷奶奶家，一起拍照。(Xīnnián wǒmen qù yéye nǎinai jiā, yīqǐ pāizhào.)
zh.truyen: 拿红包 — 新年，Nhan和爸爸妈妈去爷爷奶奶家。Nhan说：“奶奶，新年快乐！”奶奶给他一个大红包和一个礼物。Nhan说：“谢谢奶奶！”然后，大家一起拍照。(Xīnnián, Nhan hé bàba māma qù yéye nǎinai jiā. Nhan shuō: “Nǎinai, xīnnián kuàilè!” Nǎinai gěi tā yī gè dà hóngbāo hé yī gè lǐwù. Nhan shuō: “Xièxie nǎinai!” Ránhòu, dàjiā yīqǐ pāizhào.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "新年快乐 红包 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 104. Unit 12 · Múa lân, pháo hoa, nhảy dây ngày Tết

en.tu: Mới: firework, during, skip | Ôn từ nối: city centre, get on, get off, hotel | Ôn nhanh: ice skating, volleyball
en.cum: watch the fireworks / the lion dance / during New Year / during the festival / skip in the playground
en.cau: [Từ chức năng: during] During New Year, we watch the fireworks. / We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. / During the holiday, children skip in the playground. / The fireworks are big and loud. / Can you skip? – Yes, I can!
en.truyen: Fireworks in the City — During New Year, Leo's family gets on a bus to the city centre. They get off and watch the lion dance. Then the fireworks start. They are big, loud and beautiful! Leo's sister skips and laughs. "Come on, Leo! Let's skip too!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "lion dance for kids New Year fireworks"

zh.tu: Mới: 舞狮 wǔshī | Ôn từ nối: 伦敦 Lúndūn, 海滩 hǎitān | Ôn: 狮子 shīzi, 跳 tiào | Ôn nhanh: 跑步 pǎobù, 网球 wǎngqiú
zh.cum: 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 舞狮真好看 wǔshī zhēn hǎokàn / 新年的时候 xīnnián de shíhou / 跳得很高 tiào de hěn gāo
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: ……的时候 – trong dịp] 新年的时候，我们看舞狮。(Xīnnián de shíhou, wǒmen kàn wǔshī.) / 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。(Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.) / 舞狮真好看！(Wǔshī zhēn hǎokàn!) / “狮子”跳得很高！(“Shīzi” tiào de hěn gāo!)
zh.truyen: 看舞狮 — 新年的时候，Leo和家人去看舞狮。两只“狮子”跳得很高，大家都笑了。Leo说：“舞狮真好看！”妹妹说：“我们一起跳吧！”(Xīnnián de shíhou, Leo hé jiārén qù kàn wǔshī. Liǎng zhī “shīzi” tiào de hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiào le. Leo shuō: “Wǔshī zhēn hǎokàn!” Mèimei shuō: “Wǒmen yīqǐ tiào ba!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "舞狮 儿童 新年"

en.flash: Mới: lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip | Ôn: travel, visit, village, city centre, take photos, lion, dance
en.slide: 1) Nghe và nối người với hoạt động ngày Tết (dạng Movers Listening Part 1, 5 người): Nhan gets lucky money. / Grandma gives a gift. / Leo watches the fireworks. / Leo's sister skips. / Grandpa takes photos. 2) Đọc và chọn từ đúng (thẻ nhiễu: brave, boring, exciting): During New Year, we watch the ___. (fireworks) / I ___ you a happy New Year! (wish) / Seven is my ___ number. (lucky) 3) Viết thiệp chúc Tết trên slide rồi đọc to: Dear Grandma, I wish you a happy New Year! Love, …
en.truyen: New Year with Grandma — At New Year, Nhan and his family travel to his grandparents' village. Nhan says, "I wish you a happy New Year, Grandma!" Grandma gives him lucky money and a small gift. "I'm very lucky!" says Nhan. During the holiday, they visit the city centre. They watch the lion dance and the fireworks. Nhan's sister skips and laughs. Then everyone takes photos together.
en.baihat: Happy New Year (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Happy New Year, lucky money, lucky money, lucky money, / Happy New Year, lucky money, I wish you well! / Watch the fireworks, lion dance, lion dance, lion dance, / Watch the fireworks, lion dance, skip and celebrate!

zh.flash: Mới: 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī | Ôn: 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 礼物 lǐwù, 旅行 lǚxíng, 拍照 pāizhào, 狮子 shīzi, 跳 tiào, 时候 shíhou
zh.slide: 1) Nghe câu, chọn đúng/sai với tranh (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): 奶奶给Nhan一个红包。/ 我们看舞狮。/ “狮子”跳得很高。/ 新年的时候，我们吃月饼。 2) Sắp xếp từ thành câu: 新年 / 我们 / 红包 / 拿 → 新年我们拿红包。/ 的时候 / 新年 / 看舞狮 / 我们 → 新年的时候，我们看舞狮。 3) Đóng vai chúc Tết: A: 奶奶，新年快乐！B: 谢谢！给你一个红包。A: 谢谢奶奶！
zh.truyen: 新年 — 新年，Nhan和爸爸妈妈去爷爷奶奶家。Nhan说：“奶奶，新年快乐！”奶奶给他一个大红包和一个礼物。新年的时候，他们去看舞狮。两只“狮子”跳得很高，大家都笑了。然后，大家一起拍照。(Xīnnián, Nhan hé bàba māma qù yéye nǎinai jiā. Nhan shuō: “Nǎinai, xīnnián kuàilè!” Nǎinai gěi tā yī gè dà hóngbāo hé yī gè lǐwù. Xīnnián de shíhou, tāmen qù kàn wǔshī. Liǎng zhī “shīzi” tiào de hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiào le. Ránhòu, dàjiā yīqǐ pāizhào.)
zh.baihat: 新年到了 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 新年到了，新年到了，拿红包，看舞狮，大家一起庆祝，新年快乐快乐，真开心！真开心！(Xīnnián dào le, xīnnián dào le, ná hóngbāo, kàn wǔshī, dàjiā yīqǐ qìngzhù, xīnnián kuàilè kuàilè, zhēn kāixīn! Zhēn kāixīn!)

en.cau: During the summer holiday, Xiaomei visits her grandpa in Beijing. / I put my swimsuit in my suitcase. / Let's look for the treasure! / Is the treasure under the water? / Our team wins the treasure hunt!
en.truyen: Holiday in Beijing — During the summer holiday, Xiaomei visits her grandpa in Beijing. In the evening they watch Beijing opera. The next day they go to the swimming pool. Xiaomei wears her new swimsuit. Grandpa says, "Let's look for the treasure! It's in the water." Xiaomei finds a small toy fish and laughs.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "treasure hunt game for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 京剧 jīngjù | Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 北京 Běijīng, 游泳 yóuyǒng, 找 zhǎo | Ôn nhanh: 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 着急 zháojí
zh.cum: 看京剧 kàn jīngjù / 京剧很好看 jīngjù hěn hǎokàn / 去北京看爷爷 qù Běijīng kàn yéye / 去游泳 qù yóuyǒng
zh.cau: 晚上我们一起看京剧。(Wǎnshang wǒmen yīqǐ kàn jīngjù.) / 京剧很好看！(Jīngjù hěn hǎokàn!) / 夏天我去北京看爷爷。(Xiàtiān wǒ qù Běijīng kàn yéye.) / 你找一找，水里有一个玩具鱼！(Nǐ zhǎo yi zhǎo, shuǐ li yǒu yī gè wánjù yú!)
zh.truyen: 在北京 — 夏天，Xiaomei去北京看爷爷。晚上，他们一起看京剧。京剧很好看！第二天，他们去游泳。爷爷说：“你找一找，水里有一个玩具鱼！”Xiaomei找到了，她笑了。(Xiàtiān, Xiaomei qù Běijīng kàn yéye. Wǎnshang, tāmen yīqǐ kàn jīngjù. Jīngjù hěn hǎokàn! Dì-èr tiān, tāmen qù yóuyǒng. Yéye shuō: “Nǐ zhǎo yi zhǎo, shuǐ li yǒu yī gè wánjù yú!” Xiaomei zhǎo dào le, tā xiào le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "京剧 儿童 介绍"

en.cum: the Mid-Autumn Festival / lucky money / watch the fireworks / the lion dance / during New Year / look for the treasure
en.cau: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. / What do you do at New Year? – We get lucky money. / What's your favourite festival? / I'm very happy at New Year. / During the festival, we skip and laugh.
en.truyen: Which Festival? — "We eat mooncakes and carry lanterns. Which festival is it?" "The Mid-Autumn Festival!" "We get lucky money and watch the fireworks. Which festival is it?" "New Year!" "I wish you a happy New Year!" says Leo.

zh.tu: Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 京剧 jīngjù | Ôn nhanh: 坏 huài, 难 nán
zh.cum: 吃月饼 chī yuèbǐng / 拿灯笼 ná dēnglong / 拿红包 ná hóngbāo / 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 看京剧 kàn jīngjù
zh.cau: 这是中秋节。(Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié.) / 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。(Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.) / 新年你们做什么？(Xīnnián nǐmen zuò shénme?) / 我们拿红包。(Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.) / 你最喜欢什么节日？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?) / 新年我很开心。(Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn.)
zh.truyen: 这是什么节日？— “我们吃月饼，拿灯笼，看月亮。这是什么节日？”“中秋节！”“我们拿红包，看舞狮。这是什么节日？”“新年！”Leo说：“新年快乐！”(“Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, ná dēnglong, kàn yuèliang. Zhè shì shénme jiérì?” “Zhōngqiū Jié!” “Wǒmen ná hóngbāo, kàn wǔshī. Zhè shì shénme jiérì?” “Xīnnián!” Leo shuō: “Xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "春节 中秋节 儿童 中文 节日"

en.flash: Mới: swimsuit, treasure | Ôn: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern, lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip, swimming pool
en.slide: 1) Trò chơi săn kho báu trên slide: nghe chỉ dẫn, kéo nhân vật tới kho báu (4 lệnh): The treasure is under the rock. / It's next to the swimming pool. / It's between the lantern and the mooncake. / It's in front of the hotel. 2) Ôn không tranh – đọc gợi ý, nói tên lễ hội (dạng Movers Reading Part 1): We eat mooncakes and carry lanterns. (the Mid-Autumn Festival) / We get lucky money and watch fireworks. (New Year) / We have a cake and candles. (a birthday). 3) Nói câu với "during": During the summer holiday, I … / During New Year, we …
en.truyen: Holiday in Beijing — During the summer holiday, Xiaomei visits her grandpa in Beijing. In the evening they watch Beijing opera. The clothes are red and gold, and the music is loud. The next day they go to the swimming pool. Xiaomei wears her new swimsuit. Grandpa says, "Let's have a treasure hunt! The treasure is in the water." Xiaomei looks and looks. She finds a small toy fish and laughs. "I'm lucky!"
en.baihat: Treasure Hunt (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Look, look, look for treasure, / Under every rock! / Put on your swimsuit, jump in the pool, / Find the treasure box!

zh.flash: Mới: 京剧 jīngjù | Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 北京 Běijīng, 游泳 yóuyǒng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe câu, chọn tranh đúng (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): 晚上我们看京剧。/ 京剧很好看。/ 夏天Xiaomei去北京。/ 他们去游泳。 2) Ôn không tranh – nghe gợi ý, nói tên lễ hội: 我们吃月饼，拿灯笼 → 中秋节 / 我们拿红包，看舞狮 → 新年 / 我们吃蛋糕 → 生日. 3) Ghép tranh hoạt động với lễ hội: 吃月饼 – 中秋节 / 拿红包 – 新年 / 看舞狮 – 新年 / 拿灯笼 – 中秋节.
zh.truyen: 在北京 — 夏天，Xiaomei去北京看爷爷。晚上，他们一起看京剧。京剧的衣服是红色和金色的，很好看！第二天，他们去游泳。爷爷说：“你找一找，水里有一个玩具鱼！”Xiaomei找到了，她笑了。(Xiàtiān, Xiaomei qù Běijīng kàn yéye. Wǎnshang, tāmen yīqǐ kàn jīngjù. Jīngjù de yīfu shì hóngsè hé jīnsè de, hěn hǎokàn! Dì-èr tiān, tāmen qù yóuyǒng. Yéye shuō: “Nǐ zhǎo yi zhǎo, shuǐ li yǒu yī gè wánjù yú!” Xiaomei zhǎo dào le, tā xiào le.)
zh.baihat: 看京剧 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 看京剧呀，看京剧呀，真好看，真好看，夏天去看爷爷，我和爷爷去看，真高兴！真高兴！(Kàn jīngjù ya, kàn jīngjù ya, zhēn hǎokàn, zhēn hǎokàn, xiàtiān qù kàn yéye, wǒ hé yéye qù kàn, zhēn gāoxìng! Zhēn gāoxìng!)

en.tu: Ôn: festival, celebrate, lantern, mooncake, lucky, wish, gift, card | Ôn từ U9: come on, idea, shall, playground, laugh
en.cum: a class festival / make lanterns / write wish cards / lucky money game / celebrate together
en.cau: Shall we have a class festival? – Good idea! / We make red lanterns. / We write wish cards. / Come on, let's celebrate together!
en.truyen: Our Class Festival — "Shall we have a festival in our class?" asks the teacher. "Good idea!" say the children. Anna and Bông make red lanterns. Leo brings mooncakes. Nhan and Xiaomei write wish cards: "I wish you a happy New Year!" In the playground, they play a lucky money game and watch a lion dance. Everyone laughs and celebrates together.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how to make a paper lantern for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 灯笼 dēnglong, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 卡片 kǎpiàn | Ôn từ U9: 教室 jiàoshì, 操场 cāochǎng, 笑 xiào
zh.cum: 做灯笼 zuò dēnglong / 吃月饼 chī yuèbǐng / 写卡片 xiě kǎpiàn / 在操场上看舞狮 zài cāochǎng shang kàn wǔshī / 一起庆祝 yīqǐ qìngzhù
zh.cau: 我们班一起庆祝节日吧！(Wǒmen bān yīqǐ qìngzhù jiérì ba!) / 我们做红灯笼。(Wǒmen zuò hóng dēnglong.) / 我们写新年卡片。(Wǒmen xiě xīnnián kǎpiàn.) / 大家都很开心！(Dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn!)
zh.truyen: 我们班的节日 — 老师说：“我们班一起庆祝节日吧！”Anna和Bông做红灯笼。Leo拿来月饼。Nhan和Xiaomei写卡片：“新年快乐！”在操场上，大家拿红包，看舞狮。大家都笑了，很开心！(Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen bān yīqǐ qìngzhù jiérì ba!” Anna hé Bông zuò hóng dēnglong. Leo ná lái yuèbǐng. Nhan hé Xiaomei xiě kǎpiàn: “Xīnnián kuàilè!” Zài cāochǎng shang, dàjiā ná hóngbāo, kàn wǔshī. Dàjiā dōu xiào le, hěn kāixīn!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "做灯笼 手工 儿童"

en.tu: Ôn: Mid-Autumn Festival, mooncakes, lion dance, New Year, lucky money, favourite festival, happy | Ôn nhanh: ice, team
en.cum: This is … / eat mooncakes / watch the lion dance / at New Year / get lucky money / my favourite festival
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Trung, nói câu tiếng Anh] This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. / What do you do at New Year? / We get lucky money. / What's your favourite festival? / I'm very happy at New Year.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter Xiaomei — A new friend from London visits Xiaomei's class during the Mid-Autumn Festival. He doesn't understand Chinese. The teacher says something in Chinese, and Xiaomei helps: "This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance." The new friend smiles. "Thank you! Now I understand!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Mid-Autumn Festival story for kids English"

zh.tu: Ôn: 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 舞狮 wǔshī, 新年 xīnnián, 红包 hóngbāo, 节日 jiérì, 开心 kāixīn | Ôn nhanh: 欢迎 huānyíng, 当然 dāngrán
zh.cum: 这是…… zhè shì… / 吃月饼 chī yuèbǐng / 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 新年 xīnnián / 拿红包 ná hóngbāo / 最喜欢的节日 zuì xǐhuan de jiérì
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Anh, nói câu tiếng Trung] 这是中秋节。(Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié.) / 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。(Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.) / 新年你们做什么？(Xīnnián nǐmen zuò shénme?) / 我们拿红包。(Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.) / 你最喜欢什么节日？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?) / 新年我很开心。(Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译Xiaomei — 中秋节的时候，一个伦敦的新朋友来我们班。他不懂汉语。老师用汉语说：“这是中秋节。我们吃月饼，看舞狮。”Xiaomei用英语告诉他。新朋友笑了：“谢谢你！我懂了！”老师说：“欢迎你！”(Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, yī gè Lúndūn de xīn péngyou lái wǒmen bān. Tā bù dǒng Hànyǔ. Lǎoshī yòng Hànyǔ shuō: “Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié. Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.” Xiaomei yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu tā. Xīn péngyou xiào le: “Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ dǒng le!” Lǎoshī shuō: “Huānyíng nǐ!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中秋节的故事 儿童 动画"

en.flash: Ôn: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern, lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip, swimsuit, treasure | Ôn từ khóa trước: card, present, birthday, take a photo
en.slide: 1) Làm đèn lồng theo lệnh trên slide (thủ công, mỗi bước 1 câu): Draw a big circle. / Colour it red. / Cut it out. / Draw a star in the middle. / Write a wish on your lantern: I wish … 2) Đọc truyện, trả lời câu hỏi (dạng Movers Reading, 4 câu): Who makes lanterns? / What does Leo bring? / What do Nhan and Xiaomei write? / Where do they watch the lion dance? 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: bạn A nói câu tiếng Trung, bạn B nói tiếng Anh: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We get lucky money. / What's your favourite festival?
en.truyen: Our Class Festival — "Shall we have a festival in our class?" asks the teacher. "Good idea!" say the children. Anna and Bông make red lanterns. Leo brings mooncakes for everyone. Nhan and Xiaomei write wish cards: "I wish you a happy New Year!" During the festival, the children play a lucky money game in the playground and watch a lion dance. Then they take a photo together. "This is the best festival!" says Anna. Everyone laughs and celebrates.
en.baihat: Let's Celebrate! (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The lanterns at the festival go round and round, / Round and round, round and round. / The lion dance at New Year goes jump, jump, jump, / Jump, jump, jump! / The children with their lucky money say "Thank you!", / "Thank you! Thank you!"

zh.flash: Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 京剧 jīngjù | Ôn từ khóa trước: 卡片 kǎpiàn, 生日 shēngrì, 告诉 gàosu
zh.slide: 1) Làm bao lì xì theo lệnh tiếng Trung (thủ công): 这是红包。/ 画一个星星。/ 写“新年快乐”。/ 送给你的朋友。 2) Nghe truyện, chọn đúng/sai (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): Anna做红灯笼。/ Leo拿来红包。/ 他们在教室里看舞狮。/ 大家都很开心。 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói câu tiếng Trung: We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. → 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。/ What do you do at New Year? → 新年你们做什么？/ I'm very happy at New Year. → 新年我很开心。

Leo ná lái yuèbǐng. Nhan hé Xiaomei xiě kǎpiàn: “Xīnnián kuàilè!” Zài cāochǎng shang, dàjiā ná hóngbāo, kàn wǔshī. Ránhòu dàjiā yīqǐ pāizhào. Anna shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiérì!” Dàjiā dōu xiào le.)
zh.baihat: 我们一起庆祝吧 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 庆祝节日，庆祝节日，真快乐，真快乐，中秋节吃月饼，新年拿大红包，庆祝吧！庆祝吧！(Qìngzhù jiérì, qìngzhù jiérì, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè, Zhōngqiū Jié chī yuèbǐng, xīnnián ná dà hóngbāo, qìngzhù ba! Qìngzhù ba!)

en.tu: Ôn: country, flag, language, could, look for, always, sometimes, shower, half, quarter, past, minute, how long, cry, grow, future, engineer, pilot, police officer, dream, sweater, put on, take off, backpack
en.cum: Where are you from? / half past seven / a quarter past five / for thirty minutes / want to be a pilot / put on my sweater / take off my shoes
en.cau: Where are you from? – I'm from Vietnam. / What time is it? – It's half past seven. / How long do you study every day? – I study for thirty minutes. / What do you want to be? – I want to be a pilot. / What's your favourite colour? – I like blue best. / Put on your sweater. It's cold.
en.truyen: Leo's Day — Leo is from Vietnam and he can speak three languages. He always gets up at half past six. He has a shower and puts on his blue sweater. He studies English for thirty minutes every day. In the future, he wants to be a pilot. "I can fly to every country in the world!" he says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what time is it daily routine song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 自己 zìjǐ, 男 nán, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 半 bàn, 每 měi, 小时 xiǎoshí, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 电脑 diànnǎo, 帮助 bāngzhù, 警察 jǐngchá, 哭 kū, 别 bié, 衣服 yīfu, 裙子 qúnzi, 鞋 xié, 最 zuì, 找 zhǎo
zh.cum: 你是哪国人 nǐ shì nǎ guó rén / 七点半 qī diǎn bàn / 每天 měitiān / 三十分钟 sānshí fēnzhōng / 想当警察 xiǎng dāng jǐngchá / 最喜欢 zuì xǐhuan
zh.cau: 你是哪国人？——我是越南人。(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? — Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.) / 现在几点？——现在七点半。(Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? — Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn.) / 你每天学习多久？——我学习三十分钟。(Nǐ měitiān xuéxí duōjiǔ? — Wǒ xuéxí sānshí fēnzhōng.) / 你想当什么？——我想当警察。(Nǐ xiǎng dāng shénme? — Wǒ xiǎng dāng jǐngchá.) / 你最喜欢什么颜色？——我最喜欢蓝色。(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè? — Wǒ zuì xǐhuan lánsè.)
zh.truyen: Leo的一天 — Leo是越南人。他每天六点半起床，然后洗澡，穿蓝色的衣服。他每天学习汉语三十分钟。Leo长大以后想当警察，帮助别人。(Leo shì Yuènán rén. Tā měitiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, ránhòu xǐzǎo, chuān lánsè de yīfu. Tā měitiān xuéxí Hànyǔ sānshí fēnzhōng. Leo zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jǐngchá, bāngzhù biérén.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的一天 现在几点 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 110. Cuối khóa · Ôn toàn khóa: Unit 5–8

en.tu: Ôn: kangaroo, panda, slow, fast, heavy, than, ice, skate, ice skating, roller skates, practise, team, win, volleyball, match, comic book, film star, sandwich, sweet, biscuit, excuse me, cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, autumn, winter
en.cum: bigger than / ice skating / win the match / a volleyball team / excuse me / a sore throat / have got a cough
en.cau: The elephant is bigger than the cat. / Can you play badminton? – Yes, I can. / Let's play table tennis together! / What would you like to drink? / Do you like apples or bananas? / How's the weather today? – It's sunny today. / I've got a sore throat.
en.truyen: The Big Match — It's summer and it's sunny. Anna's volleyball team has got a match. Anna is fast, but today she's got a cough and a sore throat. "Excuse me, can I sit down?" she asks. Her team practises hard and wins! After the match, they eat sandwiches and sweet biscuits.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports and food vocabulary review kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 当然 dāngrán, 欢迎 huānyíng, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 难 nán, 知道 zhīdào, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 排球 páiqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 电影 diànyǐng, 面包 miànbāo, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 辣 là, 还是 háishi, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 疼 téng, 休息 xiūxi, 夏天 xiàtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān
zh.cum: 比猫大 bǐ māo dà / 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú / 一起打乒乓球 yīqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú / 苹果还是香蕉 píngguǒ háishi xiāngjiāo / 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng
zh.cau: 大象比猫大。(Dàxiàng bǐ māo dà.) / 你会打羽毛球吗？——会。(Nǐ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú ma? — Huì.) / 我们一起打乒乓球吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú ba!) / 你喜欢苹果还是香蕉？(Nǐ xǐhuan píngguǒ háishi xiāngjiāo?) / 今天天气怎么样？——今天是晴天。(Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng? — Jīntiān shì qíngtiān.) / 我嗓子疼。(Wǒ sǎngzi téng.)
zh.truyen: 打排球 — 夏天，今天是晴天。Anna喜欢打排球，她跑得很快。可是今天她感冒了，嗓子疼。她在旁边休息，同学们打排球。最后，大家一起吃面包和巧克力，都很高兴。(Xiàtiān, jīntiān shì qíngtiān. Anna xǐhuan dǎ páiqiú, tā pǎo de hěn kuài. Kěshì jīntiān tā gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng. Tā zài pángbiān xiūxi, tóngxuémen dǎ páiqiú. Zuìhòu, dàjiā yīqǐ chī miànbāo hé qiǎokèlì, dōu hěn gāoxìng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你喜欢什么运动 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Ôn U1–4: country, language, flag, half past, quarter, always, sometimes, engineer, pilot, future, police officer, sweater, put on, take off | Ôn U5–8: kangaroo, panda, fast, slow, than, team, win, volleyball, sandwich, sweet, excuse me, cough, sore throat, summer, winter
en.slide: 1) Thi thử mini dạng Movers Listening Part 1 (nghe và nối tên, 5 người): Leo – the boy in a blue sweater / Anna – the girl playing volleyball / Nhan – the boy with a cough / Bông – the girl eating a sandwich / Xiaomei – the girl looking at the kangaroo. 2) Dạng Movers Reading & Writing Part 1 (đọc định nghĩa, chọn từ, 5 câu): This person flies a plane. (pilot) / This animal is black and white. It lives in China. (panda) / You wear this when it's cold. (sweater) / This is the hot season. (summer) / You eat this. It's got bread and cheese in it. (sandwich). 3) Dạng Movers Speaking Part 1 (nhìn 2 tranh, nói 4 điểm khác nhau): In picture A, it's half past seven. In picture B, it's a quarter past eight.
en.truyen: Leo and Anna's Year — Leo is from Vietnam and he can speak three languages. He always gets up at half past six and studies English for thirty minutes. In the future he wants to be a pilot. His friend Anna loves sport. She is faster than Leo! In the summer her volleyball team has got a big match. Anna has got a cough, but her team practises and wins. "Excuse me, can we have some sandwiches?" says Leo. They eat and laugh together.
en.baihat: This Is Our Year (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Hello, friends from every country, / Half past seven, wake up, see! / Pilots, pandas, sports and food, / Summer, winter, all is good! / Hello, friends, let's sing together, / We are friends for ever and ever!

zh.flash: Ôn U1–4: 国家 guójiā, 自己 zìjǐ, 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 每 měi, 警察 jǐngchá, 帮助 bāngzhù, 衣服 yīfu, 裙子 qúnzi, 鞋 xié, 最 zuì | Ôn U5–8: 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 当然 dāngrán, 欢迎 huānyíng, 排球 páiqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 跑步 pǎobù, 面包 miànbāo, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 休息 xiūxi
zh.slide: 1) Thi thử mini dạng YCT3 听力 Phần 1 (nghe và phán đoán đúng/sai với tranh, 5 câu): 现在七点半。/ 他想当警察。/ 大象比猫大。/ 我喜欢打乒乓球。/ 我感冒了。 2) Dạng YCT3 阅读 (chọn câu trả lời phù hợp, 4 câu): 你是哪国人？— 我是越南人。/ 你会打羽毛球吗？— 会。/ 你喜欢苹果还是香蕉？— 我喜欢苹果。/ 今天天气怎么样？— 今天是晴天。 3) Dạng YCT3 口语 (nhìn tranh, trả lời câu hỏi của cô): 他在做什么？/ 现在几点？/ 你最喜欢什么颜色？
zh.truyen: Leo和Anna — Leo是越南人。他每天六点半起床，每天学习汉语三十分钟。他长大以后想当警察。他的朋友Anna喜欢打排球，她跑得比Leo快！夏天，Anna感冒了，嗓子疼，她在旁边休息。最后，大家一起吃面包和巧克力，都很高兴。(Leo shì Yuènán rén. Tā měitiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, měitiān xuéxí Hànyǔ sānshí fēnzhōng. Tā zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jǐngchá. Tā de péngyou Anna xǐhuan dǎ páiqiú, tā pǎo de bǐ Leo kuài! Xiàtiān, Anna gǎnmào le, sǎngzi téng, tā zài pángbiān xiūxi. Zuìhòu, dàjiā yīqǐ chī miànbāo hé qiǎokèlì, dōu hěn gāoxìng.)
zh.baihat: 我们的一年 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 一年过去，一年过去，真快呀，真快呀，我们一起学习，我们一起唱歌，好朋友！好朋友！(Yī nián guòqù, yī nián guòqù, zhēn kuài ya, zhēn kuài ya, wǒmen yīqǐ xuéxí, wǒmen yīqǐ chànggē, hǎo péngyou! Hǎo péngyou!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 56. Tuần 28 · Cuối khóa: ôn Unit 9–12, dự án "My Town and Me", hồ sơ BRIDGE

web.label: Ngày 111. Cuối khóa · Ôn toàn khóa: Unit 9–12

en.tu: Ôn: gate, office, leave, turn, right, left, have (got) to, come on, shopping, supermarket, cheap, expensive, let, money, how much, go shopping, ticket, travel, visit, hotel, suitcase, London, shark, festival, holiday, lucky, wish, skip
en.cum: turn left / next to the gate / How much is it? / too expensive / get on the plane / visit London / lucky money
en.cau: Where is the library? – It's on the left. / How much is this? – It's ten yuan. / This hat is too expensive. / How do you get to Beijing? – I go to Beijing by plane. / What's your favourite festival? / We get lucky money at New Year.
en.truyen: Anna's Year — At school, Anna knows the way: turn left at the gate, and the library is next to the office. On Saturday she goes shopping at the supermarket. Toys are expensive, but fruit is cheap. In the summer she travels to London with her suitcase. At New Year she gets lucky money. "I'm lucky!" she says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "shopping travel festival words review kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 教室 jiàoshì, 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān, 迟到 chídào, 问题 wèntí, 意思 yìsi, 超市 chāoshì, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán, 远 yuǎn, 近 jìn, 玩具 wánjù, 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 参观 cānguān, 拍照 pāizhào, 海滩 hǎitān, 节日 jiérì, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 红包 hóngbāo
zh.cum: 在左边 zài zuǒbiān / 太贵了 tài guì le / 很便宜 hěn piányi / 坐飞机去伦敦 zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn / 拿红包 ná hóngbāo
zh.cau: 图书馆在哪儿？——图书馆在左边。(Túshūguǎn zài nǎr? — Túshūguǎn zài zuǒbiān.) / 这个多少钱？——十块钱。(Zhège duōshao qián? — Shí kuài qián.) / 这个帽子太贵了。(Zhège màozi tài guì le.) / 你怎么去北京？——我坐飞机去北京。(Nǐ zěnme qù Běijīng? — Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.) / 你最喜欢什么节日？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?) / 我们拿红包。(Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.)
zh.truyen: Anna的一年 — 在学校，Anna知道图书馆在哪儿：图书馆在办公室旁边。星期六，她去超市买东西。玩具太贵了，水果很便宜。夏天，她坐飞机去伦敦旅行。新年，她拿了一个大红包。Anna说：“我很开心！”(Zài xuéxiào, Anna zhīdào túshūguǎn zài nǎr: túshūguǎn zài bàngōngshì pángbiān. Xīngqīliù, tā qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi. Wánjù tài guì le, shuǐguǒ hěn piányi. Xiàtiān, tā zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn lǚxíng. Xīnnián, tā ná le yī gè dà hóngbāo. Anna shuō: “Wǒ hěn kāixīn!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "多少钱 在哪儿 你想去哪儿 中文 复习 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 112. Cuối khóa · Dự án "My Town and Me" và hồ sơ BRIDGE

en.tu: Ôn: school, library, playground, supermarket, market, bus stop, café, sports centre, cheap, festival, lantern, travel, visit
en.cum: This is my town. / You can … here. / It's next to … / During the festival, … / Come and visit!
en.cau: [Hồ sơ BRIDGE: con nói bài giới thiệu bằng tiếng Anh, rồi chuyển ngữ sang tiếng Trung] This is my town. / My school has a big library and a playground. / The supermarket is next to the bus stop. / You can buy cheap fruit at the market. / During the Mid-Autumn Festival, children carry lanterns. / Come and visit my town!
en.truyen: Bông's Town Guide — Bông makes a poster for her project. "This is my town. My school has a big library and a playground. The supermarket is next to the bus stop, and the fruit at the market is cheap. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, children carry lanterns in the street. Come and visit my town!" Her friends say, "Good idea! Let's visit!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "my town presentation for kids English"

zh.tu: Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 操场 cāochǎng, 超市 chāoshì, 车站 chēzhàn, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 便宜 piányi, 节日 jiérì, 灯笼 dēnglong, 旅行 lǚxíng, 参观 cānguān, 欢迎 huānyíng
zh.cum: 这是我住的地方 zhè shì wǒ zhù de dìfang / 在……旁边 zài…pángbiān / ……的时候 …de shíhou / 欢迎你来参观 huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān
zh.cau: [Hồ sơ BRIDGE: con nói bài giới thiệu bằng tiếng Trung, rồi chuyển ngữ sang tiếng Anh] 这是我住的地方。(Zhè shì wǒ zhù de dìfang.) / 我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个操场。(Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yī gè dà túshūguǎn hé yī gè cāochǎng.) / 超市在车站旁边。(Chāoshì zài chēzhàn pángbiān.) / 这儿的水果很便宜。(Zhèr de shuǐguǒ hěn piányi.) / 中秋节的时候，我们拿灯笼。(Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, wǒmen ná dēnglong.) / 欢迎你来参观！(Huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān!)
zh.truyen: Bông的介绍 — Bông做了一张画，介绍她住的地方：“我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个操场。超市在车站旁边，这儿的水果很便宜。中秋节的时候，我们拿灯笼。欢迎你来参观！”同学们说：“我们想去！”(Bông zuò le yī zhāng huà, jièshào tā zhù de dìfang: “Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yī gè dà túshūguǎn hé yī gè cāochǎng. Chāoshì zài chēzhàn pángbiān, zhèr de shuǐguǒ hěn piányi. Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, wǒmen ná dēnglong. Huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān!” Tóngxuémen shuō: “Wǒmen xiǎng qù!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "介绍我的家乡 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Ôn U9–12: gate, office, turn, left, right, have (got) to, come on, supermarket, shopping, cheap, expensive, money, how much, bus stop, ticket, travel, visit, hotel, suitcase, London, festival, holiday, lucky, wish, lantern, mooncake
en.slide: 1) Dạng Movers Listening (nghe và vẽ đường trên bản đồ thị trấn, 4 lệnh): Start at the school gate. / Turn left at the office. / The supermarket is next to the bus stop. / Go to the hotel and stop. 2) Trình bày dự án "My Town and Me": mỗi con giới thiệu poster bằng 4–5 câu theo khung: This is my town. / My school has … / The supermarket is next to … / During …, we … / Come and visit! 3) Hồ sơ BRIDGE – nhiệm vụ chuyển ngữ ghi âm: nghe bạn nói câu tiếng Trung, nói lại bằng tiếng Anh: 图书馆在左边。→ The library is on the left. / 这个帽子太贵了。→ This hat is too expensive. / 我坐飞机去北京。→ I go to Beijing by plane.
en.truyen: Bông's Town Guide — For the end-of-year project, Bông makes a poster about her town. "This is my town. My school has a big library and a playground. Turn left at the gate and you can see the supermarket. It's next to the bus stop. The fruit at the market is cheap, but the toys in the shopping centre are expensive. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, children carry lanterns and eat mooncakes. At New Year, we get lucky money. Come and visit my town!" Her friends say, "Good idea! Let's visit!"
en.baihat: Come and Visit My Town (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Come and visit my town, my town, my town, / Come and visit my town, it's lots of fun! / Turn left at the school gate, the school gate, the school gate, / Turn left at the school gate, then come on, run!

zh.flash: Ôn U9–12: 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 教室 jiàoshì, 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān, 迟到 chídào, 超市 chāoshì, 车站 chēzhàn, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 太 tài, 元 yuán, 远 yuǎn, 近 jìn, 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 参观 cānguān, 拍照 pāizhào, 节日 jiérì, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 红包 hóngbāo
zh.slide: 1) Dạng YCT3 阅读 (đọc câu, chọn tranh đúng, 4 câu): 超市在车站旁边。/ 这个玩具太贵了。/ 我坐火车去北京。/ 中秋节我们吃月饼。 2) Trình bày dự án bằng tiếng Trung (3–4 câu): 这是我住的地方。/ 超市在车站旁边。/ 中秋节的时候，我们拿灯笼。/ 欢迎你来参观！ 3) Hồ sơ BRIDGE – chuyển ngữ ghi âm: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung: How much is this? → 这个多少钱？/ I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. → 我想去动物园看熊猫。/ We get lucky money. → 我们拿红包。
zh.truyen: Bông的介绍 — Bông做了一张画，介绍她住的地方：“我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个操场。超市在车站旁边，很近。这儿的水果很便宜，可是玩具太贵了。中秋节的时候，我们拿灯笼，吃月饼。新年的时候，我们拿红包。欢迎你来参观！”同学们说：“我们想去！”(Bông zuò le yī zhāng huà, jièshào tā zhù de dìfang: “Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yī gè dà túshūguǎn hé yī gè cāochǎng. Chāoshì zài chēzhàn pángbiān, hěn jìn. Zhèr de shuǐguǒ hěn piányi, kěshì wánjù tài guì le. Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, wǒmen ná dēnglong, chī yuèbǐng. Xīnnián de shíhou, wǒmen ná hóngbāo. Huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān!” Tóngxuémen shuō: “Wǒmen xiǎng qù!”)
zh.baihat: 欢迎你来 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 欢迎你来，欢迎你来，来参观，来参观，学校有图书馆，超市就在旁边，真好玩！真好玩！(Huānyíng nǐ lái, huānyíng nǐ lái, lái cānguān, lái cānguān, xuéxiào yǒu túshūguǎn, chāoshì jiù zài pángbiān, zhēn hǎowán! Zhēn hǎowán!)

blocks.title: Tuần lễ hội 1 (xếp theo lịch thật: Trung thu / Halloween / Noel / Tết / 1-6)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 57. Tuần lễ hội 1 · Noel – Cây thông, ông già Noel (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 113. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: cây thông và lời chúc

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas, Christmas tree, Merry Christmas | Ôn: present, star, winter, December
en.cum: Merry Christmas! / a big Christmas tree / a gold star on the top / presents under the tree
en.cau: Merry Christmas! / This is a Christmas tree. / There's a big star on the top of the tree. / The presents are under the tree. / Christmas is in December.
en.truyen: Christmas at School — It's December and it's cold. In the classroom there's a big Christmas tree. Anna puts a gold star on the top. "Merry Christmas!" says the teacher. Under the tree there are presents for all the children.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Christmas vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞快乐 Shèngdàn kuàilè | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 星星 xīngxing, 冬天 dōngtiān
zh.cum: 圣诞快乐 Shèngdàn kuàilè / 一棵大圣诞树 yī kē dà Shèngdànshù / 树上的星星 shù shang de xīngxing / 树下的礼物 shù xià de lǐwù
zh.cau: 圣诞快乐！(Shèngdàn kuàilè!) / 这是圣诞树。(Zhè shì Shèngdànshù.) / 树上有一个大星星。(Shù shang yǒu yī gè dà xīngxing.) / 树下有很多礼物。(Shù xià yǒu hěn duō lǐwù.)
zh.truyen: 学校的圣诞节 — 冬天到了，天气很冷。教室里有一棵大圣诞树。Anna在树上放了一个金色的星星。老师说：“圣诞快乐！”树下有很多礼物。(Dōngtiān dào le, tiānqì hěn lěng. Jiàoshì li yǒu yī kē dà Shèngdànshù. Anna zài shù shang fàng le yī gè jīnsè de xīngxing. Lǎoshī shuō: “Shèngdàn kuàilè!” Shù xià yǒu hěn duō lǐwù.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞节 儿歌 圣诞树"

web.label: Ngày 114. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: ông già Noel và tuần lộc

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Father Christmas, reindeer, sleigh | Ôn: snow, snowman, present, fly
en.cum: Father Christmas / on his sleigh / the reindeer can fly / a bag of presents / in the snow
en.cau: Look! It's Father Christmas! / He's got a big bag of presents. / His reindeer can fly. / Father Christmas is on his sleigh. / The children make a snowman in the snow.
en.truyen: Father Christmas Is Coming — It's snowing. Leo and Nhan make a snowman. Then they look up at the sky. "Look! It's Father Christmas on his sleigh!" says Leo. The reindeer can fly! Father Christmas has got a big bag of presents. "Merry Christmas!" he says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Father Christmas reindeer story for kids"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 雪橇 xuěqiāo | Ôn: 雪人 xuěrén, 礼物 lǐwù, 天空 tiānkōng
zh.cum: 圣诞老人来了 Shèngdàn lǎorén lái le / 坐雪橇 zuò xuěqiāo / 驯鹿会飞 xùnlù huì fēi / 很多礼物 hěn duō lǐwù
zh.cau: 看！圣诞老人来了！(Kàn! Shèngdàn lǎorén lái le!) / 圣诞老人有很多礼物。(Shèngdàn lǎorén yǒu hěn duō lǐwù.) / 驯鹿会飞！(Xùnlù huì fēi!) / 圣诞老人坐雪橇。(Shèngdàn lǎorén zuò xuěqiāo.)
zh.truyen: 圣诞老人来了 — 下雪了。Leo和Nhan做雪人。他们看天空。Leo说：“看！圣诞老人坐雪橇来了！”驯鹿会飞！圣诞老人有很多礼物。他说：“圣诞快乐！”(Xià xuě le. Leo hé Nhan zuò xuěrén. Tāmen kàn tiānkōng. Leo shuō: “Kàn! Shèngdàn lǎorén zuò xuěqiāo lái le!” Xùnlù huì fēi! Shèngdàn lǎorén yǒu hěn duō lǐwù. Tā shuō: “Shèngdàn kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞老人 驯鹿 儿童 动画"

en.flash: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas, Christmas tree, Merry Christmas, Father Christmas, reindeer, sleigh | Ôn: present, star, snowman, snow, December
en.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm vào tranh (không chấm điểm, 6 lượt): Christmas tree / star / present / Father Christmas / reindeer / sleigh. 2) Trang trí cây thông trên slide theo lệnh: Put the star on the top. / Put three presents under the tree. / Put the snowman next to the tree. 3) Nghe truyện và giơ thẻ Yes/No: Father Christmas has got a bag of presents. (Yes) / The reindeer can swim. (No)
en.truyen: Father Christmas Is Coming — It's December and it's snowing. In the classroom there's a big Christmas tree with a gold star on the top. After school, Leo and Nhan make a snowman. Then they look up at the sky. "Look! It's Father Christmas on his sleigh!" The reindeer can fly! Father Christmas has got a big bag of presents. "Merry Christmas, children!" he says.
en.baihat: Christmas Tree (giai điệu Jingle Bells, dân ca hết bản quyền) — Christmas tree, Christmas tree, a star on the top! / Presents here, presents there, we jump and hop! / Father Christmas on his sleigh, the reindeer fly away! / Merry, merry Christmas, it's a happy day!

zh.flash: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞快乐 Shèngdàn kuàilè, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 雪橇 xuěqiāo | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 星星 xīngxing, 雪人 xuěrén
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm vào tranh (không chấm điểm, 5 lượt): 圣诞树 / 圣诞老人 / 驯鹿 / 雪橇 / 礼物. 2) Trang trí cây thông theo lệnh: 星星放在树上。/ 礼物放在树下。/ 雪人在树旁边。 3) Nói lời chúc theo tranh: 圣诞快乐！/ 新年快乐！
zh.truyen: 圣诞老人来了 — 冬天到了，下雪了。教室里有一棵大圣诞树，树上有一个金色的星星。放学以后，Leo和Nhan做雪人。Leo说：“看！圣诞老人坐雪橇来了！”驯鹿会飞！圣诞老人说：“小朋友们，圣诞快乐！”(Dōngtiān dào le, xià xuě le. Jiàoshì li yǒu yī kē dà Shèngdànshù, shù shang yǒu yī gè jīnsè de xīngxing. Fàngxué yǐhòu, Leo hé Nhan zuò xuěrén. Leo shuō: “Kàn! Shèngdàn lǎorén zuò xuěqiāo lái le!” Xùnlù huì fēi! Shèngdàn lǎorén shuō: “Xiǎopéngyoumen, Shèngdàn kuàilè!”)
zh.baihat: 圣诞老人 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 圣诞老人，圣诞老人，来了吗？来了吗？带着很多礼物，坐着驯鹿雪橇，真快乐！真快乐！(Shèngdàn lǎorén, Shèngdàn lǎorén, lái le ma? Lái le ma? Dài zhe hěn duō lǐwù, zuò zhe xùnlù xuěqiāo, zhēn kuàilè! Zhēn kuàilè!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 58. Tuần lễ hội 1 · Noel – Thiệp, chuông và tiệc Noel của lớp (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 115. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: thiệp và chuông

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas card, bell, decorate | Ôn: card, write, colour, star, wish
en.cum: make a Christmas card / ring the bell / decorate the tree / write "Merry Christmas"
en.cau: Let's make a Christmas card! / I write "Merry Christmas" on my card. / We decorate the tree with stars and bells. / Listen! The bell goes ding, dong!
en.truyen: Christmas Cards — Xiaomei and Bông make Christmas cards. Xiaomei draws a tree and colours it green. Bông draws a big bell. They write "Merry Christmas! I wish you a happy New Year!" Then they decorate the classroom tree with stars and bells.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how to make a Christmas card for kids"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞卡片 Shèngdàn kǎpiàn, 铃铛 língdang | Ôn: 卡片 kǎpiàn, 写 xiě, 画 huà, 星星 xīngxing
zh.cum: 做圣诞卡片 zuò Shèngdàn kǎpiàn / 写“圣诞快乐” xiě “Shèngdàn kuàilè” / 一个大铃铛 yī gè dà língdang / 叮叮当 dīng dīng dāng
zh.cau: 我们做圣诞卡片吧！(Wǒmen zuò Shèngdàn kǎpiàn ba!) / 我在卡片上写“圣诞快乐”。(Wǒ zài kǎpiàn shang xiě “Shèngdàn kuàilè”.) / 树上有星星和铃铛。(Shù shang yǒu xīngxing hé língdang.) / 听！铃铛叮叮当！(Tīng! Língdang dīng dīng dāng!)
zh.truyen: 做卡片 — Xiaomei和Bông做圣诞卡片。Xiaomei画了一棵绿色的树，Bông画了一个大铃铛。她们写：“圣诞快乐！新年快乐！”然后，她们在教室的圣诞树上放星星和铃铛。(Xiaomei hé Bông zuò Shèngdàn kǎpiàn. Xiaomei huà le yī kē lǜsè de shù, Bông huà le yī gè dà língdang. Tāmen xiě: “Shèngdàn kuàilè! Xīnnián kuàilè!” Ránhòu, tāmen zài jiàoshì de Shèngdànshù shang fàng xīngxing hé língdang.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞卡片 手工 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 116. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: truyện Món quà của Leo

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas, Christmas tree, Merry Christmas, Father Christmas, reindeer, sleigh, Christmas card, bell | Ôn: present, give, friend
en.cum: a present for my friend / under the Christmas tree / Merry Christmas! / Thank you very much!
en.cau: What's in the box? / It's a present for you! / Merry Christmas, Nhan! / Thank you very much!
en.truyen: Leo's Present — On Christmas morning, Leo finds a box under the Christmas tree. "What's in the box?" he asks. It's a toy reindeer and a Christmas card from Father Christmas! Leo gives a present to his friend Nhan, too. "Merry Christmas, Nhan!" "Thank you very much!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Christmas story for kids short"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞快乐 Shèngdàn kuàilè, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 铃铛 língdang | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 送 sòng, 朋友 péngyou
zh.cum: 送给朋友 sòng gěi péngyou / 在圣诞树下 zài Shèngdànshù xià / 一个小礼物 yī gè xiǎo lǐwù / 谢谢你 xièxie nǐ
zh.cau: 盒子里有什么？(Hézi li yǒu shénme?) / 这是给你的礼物！(Zhè shì gěi nǐ de lǐwù!) / Nhan，圣诞快乐！(Nhan, Shèngdàn kuàilè!) / 谢谢你！(Xièxie nǐ!)
zh.truyen: Leo的礼物 — 圣诞节早上，Leo在圣诞树下看见一个盒子。他问：“盒子里有什么？”是一个驯鹿玩具和一张圣诞卡片！Leo也送给朋友Nhan一个礼物。“Nhan，圣诞快乐！”“谢谢你！”(Shèngdàn Jié zǎoshang, Leo zài Shèngdànshù xià kànjiàn yī gè hézi. Tā wèn: “Hézi li yǒu shénme?” Shì yī gè xùnlù wánjù hé yī zhāng Shèngdàn kǎpiàn! Leo yě sòng gěi péngyou Nhan yī gè lǐwù. “Nhan, Shèngdàn kuàilè!” “Xièxie nǐ!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞节的故事 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas card, bell, decorate | Ôn: Christmas, Christmas tree, Merry Christmas, Father Christmas, reindeer, present, card, wish
en.slide: 1) Làm thiệp Noel theo lệnh trên slide (thủ công): Draw a Christmas tree. / Colour it green. / Draw a bell. / Write "Merry Christmas!" 2) Trò chơi "What's in the box?": con đoán món quà trong hộp bằng câu: Is it a toy reindeer? / Is it a bell? 3) Tặng thiệp cho bạn và nói: Merry Christmas! This is for you. – Thank you very much!
en.truyen: Leo's Present — Xiaomei and Bông make Christmas cards and decorate the classroom tree with stars and bells. On Christmas morning, Leo finds a box under the tree at home. "What's in the box?" It's a toy reindeer and a Christmas card from Father Christmas! At school, Leo gives a present to Nhan. "Merry Christmas, Nhan!" "Thank you very much!" The bell on the tree goes ding, dong!
en.baihat: Ring the Bell (giai điệu We Wish You a Merry Christmas, dân ca Anh) — We ring the bell for Christmas, / We ring the bell for Christmas, / We ring the bell for Christmas, / Ding, dong, ding! / We make a card for Christmas, / We make a card for Christmas, / We make a card for Christmas, / And give it to a friend!

zh.flash: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞卡片 Shèngdàn kǎpiàn, 铃铛 língdang | Ôn: 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞快乐 Shèngdàn kuàilè, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 礼物 lǐwù, 送 sòng
zh.slide: 1) Làm thiệp Noel theo lệnh tiếng Trung (thủ công): 画一棵圣诞树。/ 画一个铃铛。/ 写“圣诞快乐”。/ 送给你的朋友。 2) Trò chơi đoán quà: 盒子里有什么？— 是驯鹿玩具吗？/ 是铃铛吗？ 3) Tặng thiệp cho bạn: 圣诞快乐！这是给你的。— 谢谢你！
zh.truyen: Leo的礼物 — Xiaomei和Bông做圣诞卡片，在教室的圣诞树上放星星和铃铛。圣诞节早上，Leo在家里的圣诞树下看见一个盒子，里面是一个驯鹿玩具和一张圣诞卡片！在学校，Leo送给Nhan一个礼物：“Nhan，圣诞快乐！”“谢谢你！”(Xiaomei hé Bông zuò Shèngdàn kǎpiàn, zài jiàoshì de Shèngdànshù shang fàng xīngxing hé língdang. Shèngdàn Jié zǎoshang, Leo zài jiā li de Shèngdànshù xià kànjiàn yī gè hézi, lǐmiàn shì yī gè xùnlù wánjù hé yī zhāng Shèngdàn kǎpiàn! Zài xuéxiào, Leo sòng gěi Nhan yī gè lǐwù: “Nhan, Shèngdàn kuàilè!” “Xièxie nǐ!”)
zh.baihat: 圣诞卡片 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 圣诞卡片，圣诞卡片，送给你，送给你，铃铛叮叮当当，大家一起唱歌，真快乐！真快乐！(Shèngdàn kǎpiàn, Shèngdàn kǎpiàn, sòng gěi nǐ, sòng gěi nǐ, língdang dīngdīng dāngdāng, dàjiā yīqǐ chànggē, zhēn kuàilè! Zhēn kuàilè!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 59. Tuần lễ hội 2 · Quốc tế Thiếu nhi 1/6 – Bóng bay, tiệc, trò chơi (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 117. Lễ hội 2 · Quốc tế Thiếu nhi 1/6: bóng bay và bữa tiệc

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Children's Day, balloon, party | Ôn: June, cake, games, sing, dance
en.cum: Happy Children's Day! / a red balloon / a class party / on the first of June
en.cau: Happy Children's Day! / Children's Day is on the first of June. / I've got a red balloon. / Let's have a party! / We sing, dance and play games at the party.
en.truyen: Children's Day Party — It's the first of June. "Happy Children's Day!" says the teacher. The classroom has got lots of balloons: red, blue and yellow. There's a big cake on the table. The children sing, dance and play games at the party.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Children's Day June 1 for kids"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 儿童节 Értóng Jié, 六一 Liù-Yī, 气球 qìqiú | Ôn: 蛋糕 dàngāo, 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 游戏 yóuxì
zh.cum: 儿童节快乐 Értóng Jié kuàilè / 六月一日 liù yuè yī rì / 一个红气球 yī gè hóng qìqiú / 唱歌跳舞 chànggē tiàowǔ
zh.cau: 儿童节快乐！(Értóng Jié kuàilè!) / 六月一日是儿童节。(Liù yuè yī rì shì Értóng Jié.) / 我有一个红气球。(Wǒ yǒu yī gè hóng qìqiú.) / 我们一起唱歌、跳舞、玩游戏。(Wǒmen yīqǐ chànggē, tiàowǔ, wán yóuxì.)
zh.truyen: 六一儿童节 — 今天是六月一日。老师说：“儿童节快乐！”教室里有很多气球：红的、蓝的、黄的。桌子上有一个大蛋糕。小朋友们一起唱歌、跳舞、玩游戏。(Jīntiān shì liù yuè yī rì. Lǎoshī shuō: “Értóng Jié kuàilè!” Jiàoshì li yǒu hěn duō qìqiú: hóng de, lán de, huáng de. Zhuōzi shang yǒu yī gè dà dàngāo. Xiǎopéngyoumen yīqǐ chànggē, tiàowǔ, wán yóuxì.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "六一儿童节 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 118. Lễ hội 2 · Quốc tế Thiếu nhi 1/6: trò chơi và phần thưởng

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): race, prize | Ôn: team, win, fast, slow, playground
en.cum: run a race / win a prize / a big prize / in the playground
en.cau: Let's have a race in the playground! / Ready, steady, go! / Anna's team wins the race. / The prize is a big box of sweets. / Leo is slow, but he laughs.
en.truyen: The Big Race — On Children's Day, the class has a race in the playground. "Ready, steady, go!" Anna is very fast. Leo is slow, but he laughs and runs. Anna's team wins the race! The prize is a big box of sweets for the whole class.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports day race for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 比赛 bǐsài, 奖品 jiǎngpǐn | Ôn: 跑步 pǎobù, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 操场 cāochǎng
zh.cum: 跑步比赛 pǎobù bǐsài / 一个大奖品 yī gè dà jiǎngpǐn / 跑得很快 pǎo de hěn kuài / 在操场上 zài cāochǎng shang
zh.cau: 我们在操场上跑步比赛吧！(Wǒmen zài cāochǎng shang pǎobù bǐsài ba!) / 一、二、三，跑！(Yī, èr, sān, pǎo!) / Anna跑得很快。(Anna pǎo de hěn kuài.) / 奖品是一大盒糖果。(Jiǎngpǐn shì yī dà hé tángguǒ.)
zh.truyen: 跑步比赛 — 儿童节，我们在操场上跑步比赛。“一、二、三，跑！”Anna跑得很快。Leo跑得很慢，可是他笑了。最后，奖品是一大盒糖果，大家一起吃！(Értóng Jié, wǒmen zài cāochǎng shang pǎobù bǐsài. “Yī, èr, sān, pǎo!” Anna pǎo de hěn kuài. Leo pǎo de hěn màn, kěshì tā xiào le. Zuìhòu, jiǎngpǐn shì yī dà hé tángguǒ, dàjiā yīqǐ chī!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "运动会 跑步 儿歌"

en.flash: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Children's Day, balloon, party, race, prize | Ôn: June, cake, team, win, fast, slow, playground
en.slide: 1) Nghe và tô màu bóng bay (không chấm điểm, 4 lệnh): Colour the big balloon red. / Colour the small balloon blue. / Colour the balloon next to the cake yellow. / Colour the prize box green. 2) Trò chơi chạy tiếp sức trong lớp theo lệnh: Ready, steady, go! / Run to the balloon! / Come back! 3) Nói lời chúc và giơ bóng: Happy Children's Day! / We've got a party today!
en.truyen: Children's Day — It's the first of June. "Happy Children's Day!" says the teacher. There are lots of balloons and a big cake. The children sing, dance and play games at the party. Then they have a race in the playground. Anna is very fast. Leo is slow, but he laughs. Anna's team wins, and the prize is a big box of sweets for the whole class!
en.baihat: My Red Balloon (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — I have got a red balloon, / Red balloon, red balloon, / I have got a red balloon / On Children's Day! / Let's all have a party now, / Party now, party now, / Let's all have a party now, / Hip, hip, hooray!

zh.flash: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 儿童节 Értóng Jié, 六一 Liù-Yī, 气球 qìqiú, 比赛 bǐsài, 奖品 jiǎngpǐn | Ôn: 蛋糕 dàngāo, 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 游戏 yóuxì, 跑步 pǎobù, 快 kuài, 慢 màn
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và chạm tranh (không chấm điểm, 5 lượt): 儿童节 / 气球 / 蛋糕 / 比赛 / 奖品. 2) Trò chơi chạy tiếp sức theo lệnh tiếng Trung: 一、二、三，跑！/ 快跑！/ 回来！ 3) Nói lời chúc: 儿童节快乐！/ 我有一个红气球！
zh.truyen: 六一儿童节 — 今天是六月一日。老师说：“儿童节快乐！”教室里有很多气球和一个大蛋糕。小朋友们一起唱歌、跳舞、玩游戏。然后，大家在操场上跑步比赛。Anna跑得很快，Leo跑得很慢，可是他笑了。奖品是一大盒糖果，大家一起吃！(Jīntiān shì liù yuè yī rì. Lǎoshī shuō: “Értóng Jié kuàilè!” Jiàoshì li yǒu hěn duō qìqiú hé yī gè dà dàngāo. Xiǎopéngyoumen yīqǐ chànggē, tiàowǔ, wán yóuxì. Ránhòu, dàjiā zài cāochǎng shang pǎobù bǐsài. Anna pǎo de hěn kuài, Leo pǎo de hěn màn, kěshì tā xiào le. Jiǎngpǐn shì yī dà hé tángguǒ, dàjiā yīqǐ chī!)
zh.baihat: 儿童节 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 六一到了，六一到了，真快乐，真快乐，我有红色气球，大家一起唱歌，儿童节！儿童节！(Liù-Yī dào le, Liù-Yī dào le, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè, wǒ yǒu hóngsè qìqiú, dàjiā yīqǐ chànggē, Értóng Jié! Értóng Jié!)

en.cum: a Children's Day show / on the stage / clap your hands / sing a song in English and Chinese
en.cau: Welcome to our show! / We sing a song in English and Chinese. / Xiaomei and Bông dance on the stage. / The parents clap their hands. / Thank you for coming!
en.truyen: Our Children's Day Show — The class has a show for the parents. Nhan says, "Welcome to our show!" The children sing a song in English and Chinese. Xiaomei and Bông dance on the stage. All the mums and dads clap their hands. "Well done!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "kids school show song and dance"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 表演 biǎoyǎn, 舞台 wǔtái, 鼓掌 gǔzhǎng | Ôn: 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 汉语 Hànyǔ, 英语 Yīngyǔ, 欢迎 huānyíng
zh.cum: 儿童节表演 Értóng Jié biǎoyǎn / 在舞台上 zài wǔtái shang / 用汉语唱歌 yòng Hànyǔ chànggē / 大家鼓掌 dàjiā gǔzhǎng
zh.cau: 欢迎大家来看我们的表演！(Huānyíng dàjiā lái kàn wǒmen de biǎoyǎn!) / 我们用英语和汉语唱歌。(Wǒmen yòng Yīngyǔ hé Hànyǔ chànggē.) / Xiaomei和Bông在舞台上跳舞。(Xiaomei hé Bông zài wǔtái shang tiàowǔ.) / 爸爸妈妈们鼓掌。(Bàba māmamen gǔzhǎng.)
zh.truyen: 我们的表演 — 儿童节，我们班给爸爸妈妈表演。Nhan说：“欢迎大家来看我们的表演！”我们用英语和汉语唱歌。Xiaomei和Bông在舞台上跳舞。爸爸妈妈们都鼓掌了。(Értóng Jié, wǒmen bān gěi bàba māma biǎoyǎn. Nhan shuō: “Huānyíng dàjiā lái kàn wǒmen de biǎoyǎn!” Wǒmen yòng Yīngyǔ hé Hànyǔ chànggē. Xiaomei hé Bông zài wǔtái shang tiàowǔ. Bàba māmamen dōu gǔzhǎng le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童节 表演 唱歌 跳舞"

en.cum: Thank you, teacher! / my best friend / see you next year / Goodbye!
en.cau: Thank you, teacher! / You are my best friend. / See you next year! / Goodbye, everyone!
en.truyen: Thank You, Teacher! — After the Children's Day show, the children give the teacher a big card. It says, "Thank you, teacher! We love English and Chinese!" The teacher is very happy. Everyone gets a balloon. "See you next year!" says Anna. "Goodbye!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "thank you teacher song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 儿童节 Értóng Jié, 气球 qìqiú, 比赛 bǐsài, 奖品 jiǎngpǐn, 表演 biǎoyǎn, 舞台 wǔtái, 鼓掌 gǔzhǎng | Ôn: 谢谢 xièxie, 朋友 péngyou, 老师 lǎoshī, 再见 zàijiàn
zh.cum: 谢谢老师 xièxie lǎoshī / 好朋友 hǎo péngyou / 明年见 míngnián jiàn / 再见 zàijiàn
zh.cau: 谢谢老师！(Xièxie lǎoshī!) / 你是我的好朋友。(Nǐ shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.) / 明年见！(Míngnián jiàn!) / 大家再见！(Dàjiā zàijiàn!)
zh.truyen: 谢谢老师 — 表演以后，小朋友们送给老师一张大卡片。卡片上写着：“谢谢老师！我们喜欢英语和汉语！”老师很高兴。每个人都有一个气球。Anna说：“明年见！再见！”(Biǎoyǎn yǐhòu, xiǎopéngyoumen sòng gěi lǎoshī yī zhāng dà kǎpiàn. Kǎpiàn shang xiě zhe: “Xièxie lǎoshī! Wǒmen xǐhuan Yīngyǔ hé Hànyǔ!” Lǎoshī hěn gāoxìng. Měi gè rén dōu yǒu yī gè qìqiú. Anna shuō: “Míngnián jiàn! Zàijiàn!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "谢谢老师 儿歌"

zh.slide: 1) Tập lời dẫn MC nhí bằng tiếng Trung (không chấm điểm): 欢迎大家来看我们的表演！/ 现在我们用汉语唱歌。/ 谢谢大家！ 2) Trò chơi "Đúng thì vỗ tay": 我们在舞台上唱歌。/ 儿童节在十二月。/ 我们有很多气球。 3) Viết thiệp cảm ơn bằng tiếng Trung rồi đọc: 谢谢老师！我们喜欢汉语！
zh.truyen: 表演和再见 — 儿童节，我们班给爸爸妈妈表演。Nhan说：“欢迎大家来看我们的表演！”我们用英语和汉语唱歌。Xiaomei和Bông在舞台上跳舞。爸爸妈妈们都鼓掌了。表演以后，我们送给老师一张大卡片：“谢谢老师！”每个人都有一个气球。Anna说：“明年见！再见！”(Értóng Jié, wǒmen bān gěi bàba māma biǎoyǎn. Nhan shuō: “Huānyíng dàjiā lái kàn wǒmen de biǎoyǎn!” Wǒmen yòng Yīngyǔ hé Hànyǔ chànggē. Xiaomei hé Bông zài wǔtái shang tiàowǔ. Bàba māmamen dōu gǔzhǎng le. Biǎoyǎn yǐhòu, wǒmen sòng gěi lǎoshī yī zhāng dà kǎpiàn: “Xièxie lǎoshī!” Měi gè rén dōu yǒu yī gè qìqiú. Anna shuō: “Míngnián jiàn! Zàijiàn!”)
zh.baihat: 再见了 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 表演开始，表演开始，唱唱歌，跳跳舞，爸爸妈妈鼓掌，老师同学笑了，再见了！再见了！(Biǎoyǎn kāishǐ, biǎoyǎn kāishǐ, chàngchang gē, tiàotiao wǔ, bàba māma gǔzhǎng, lǎoshī tóngxué xiào le, zàijiàn le! Zàijiàn le!)
